title: Distinct Roles of Deep and Superficial Cortical Layers in Tone Prediction, Comparison, and Adaptation in Human Auditory Cortices
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Auditory perception relies on prior sensations to form expectations and adapt to repeated inputs. Yet, how these processes interact with frequency-specific preference across cortical depth remains unclear. Using ultra-high-field functional magnetic resonance imaging (at 7T), participants listened to stochastic tone sequences varying in their repetition structure and predictability. We modelled voxel-wise responses for stimulus preference, repetition suppression, and expectations, partitioning their unique and shared variance across three depth bins (infragranular, granular, supragranular). Expectation-related signals explained most unique variance in deep layers, aligning with internal model representations. Variance jointly explained by stimulus preference and expectation was instead strongest in superficial layers, consistent with the content-specific alignment of top-down predictions (prediction error signalling). Finally, repetition suppression accounted for variance uniformly across depth. Together, the data suggest that deep layers contain content-specific predictive models, superficial layers register prediction-input alignment, and repetition suppression provides a depth-invariant, local gain control that complements predictive processing.
title_zh: 深层和浅层皮质层在人类听觉皮层音调预测、比较和适应中的不同作用
abstract_zh: 听觉感知依赖于先前的感觉来形成期望并适应重复的输入。然而，这些过程如何与皮质深度的频率特定偏好相互作用仍不清楚。使用超高场功能磁共振成像（7T），参与者聆听了重复结构和可预测性不同的随机音调序列。我们对刺激偏好、重复抑制和期望的体素响应进行建模，将其独特且共享的方差划分到三个深度箱（粒下、粒状、上粒）。与期望相关的信号解释了深层中最独特的方差，与内部模型表示相一致。由刺激偏好和期望共同解释的方差在表面层中最强，这与自上而下的预测（预测误差信号）的内容特定对齐一致。最后，重复抑制均匀地解释了深度上的方差。总之，数据表明深层包含特定于内容的预测模型，浅层记录预测输入对齐，而重复抑制提供了深度不变的局部增益控制，可补充预测处理。

title: An Iron(V)-Oxo TAML Radical Cation Complex in Photocatalytic Water Oxidation and Electron-Transfer Reactions
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Iron(V)-oxo complexes have been proposed as critical reactive intermediates in catalytic water oxidation. However, iron-oxo complexes bearing redox-active (noninnocent) ligands with a formal oxidation state exceeding +5 have remained elusive. Herein, we report that an iron(V)-oxo complex bearing a one-electron oxidized tetraamido macrocyclic ligand, [FeV(O)(TAML•+)], effectively oxidizes water to evolve dioxygen (O2) via O-O bond formation. The precursor [FeIII(TAML)]- complex acts as an effective catalyst for the photochemical oxidation of water by 2,3-dichloro-5,6-dicyano-p-benzoquinone (DDQ). Transient absorption measurements reveal a stepwise, photodriven pathway: [FeIII(TAML)]- and DDQ first generate [FeV(O)(TAML)]- via a μ-oxo dimer intermediate, [(TAML)FeIV(O)FeIV(TAML)]2-. Subsequent electron transfer (ET) to the triplet excited state of DDQ (3DDQ*) yields the [FeV(O)(TAML•+)] intermediate and DDQ•-. In the presence of water, this complex reacts to produce a presumed [FeIV(OOH)(TAML)]- intermediate. The rate constants of the reaction of [FeV(O)(TAML•+)] with H2O and D2O at 298 K are determined to be 1.4 × 106 and 7.1 × 105 M-1 s-1, respectively, giving a deuterium kinetic isotope effect (KIE) of 2.0. In ET reactions, [FeV(O)(TAML•+)] is a highly reactive oxidant with an extremely small reorganization energy (λ = 0.80 eV). Such a small reorganization energy is ascribed to the TAML ligand-centered ET reduction of [FeV(O)(TAML•+)]. To the best of our knowledge, this iron(V)-oxo TAML radical cation complex, [FeV(O)(TAML•+)], represents one of the most powerful high-valent iron-oxo oxidants identified to date in water oxidation and electron transfer reactions.
title_zh: 光催化水氧化和电子转移反应中的铁 (V)-Oxo TAML 自由基阳离子配合物
abstract_zh: 铁(V)-氧配合物已被提议作为催化水氧化中的关键反应中间体。然而，具有氧化还原活性（非无害）配体且形式氧化态超过+5的铁氧配合物仍然难以捉摸。在此，我们报道了带有单电子氧化四酰胺大环配体的铁(V)-氧配合物[FeV(O)(TAML•+)]，可有效氧化水通过O-O键形成产生双氧(O2)。前体 [FeIII(TAML)]- 配合物可作为 2,3-二氯-5,6-二氰基-对苯醌 (DDQ) 光化学氧化水的有效催化剂。瞬时吸收测量揭示了逐步的光驱动途径：[FeIII(TAML)]-和DDQ首先通过μ-氧二聚体中间体[(TAML)FeIV(O)FeIV(TAML)]2-生成[FeV(O)(TAML)]-。随后电子转移 (ET) 至 DDQ (3DDQ*) 的三重激发态，产生 [FeV(O)(TAML•+)] 中间体和 DDQ•-。在水存在下，该络合物发生反应，产生推测的[FeIV(OOH)(TAML)]-中间体。 [FeV(O)(TAML•+)]与H2O和D2O在298 K下的反应速率常数分别确定为1.4 × 106和7.1 × 105 M-1 s-1，氘动力学同位素效应(KIE)为2.0。在ET反应中，[FeV(O)(TAML•+)]是一种高活性氧化剂，具有极小的重组能(λ = 0.80 eV)。如此小的重组能归因于[FeV(O)(TAML•+)]以TAML配体为中心的ET还原。据我们所知，这种铁(V)-氧代TAML自由基阳离子络合物[FeV(O)(TAML•+)]代表了最强大的高价阳离子络合物之一。

title: Reduction Inverts the Thermodynamics of the Stone–Wales Rearrangement
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: We demonstrate that alkali-metal doping of polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons can reshape the potential energy surface in favor of an isomer that is disfavored in the neutral state. This effect enables an efficient inverse Stone-Wales rearrangement at temperatures as low as 250 °C for potassium-, rubidium-, and cesium-doped systems. In contrast, lithium and sodium doping exclusively promote cyclodehydrogenation at cove regions. Supported by density functional theory, we propose a mechanistically consistent pathway and report the isolation and characterization of key anionic intermediates by single-crystal X-ray diffraction, UV-vis spectroscopy, and magnetometry. These findings highlight how reduction can unlock otherwise inaccessible rearrangements in aromatic systems and inform our understanding of the functionalization of graphene, carbon nanotubes, and fullerenes.
title_zh: 还原反转了斯通-威尔士重排的热力学
abstract_zh: 我们证明，多环芳烃的碱金属掺杂可以重塑势能表面，有利于中性状态下不受欢迎的异构体。对于钾、铷和铯掺杂系统，这种效应可以在低至 250 °C 的温度下实现高效的逆斯通威尔士重排。相比之下，锂和钠掺杂专门促进湾区域的环化脱氢。在密度泛函理论的支持下，我们提出了一种机械上一致的途径，并通过单晶 X 射线衍射、紫外可见光谱和磁力测定报告了关键阴离子中间体的分离和表征。这些发现强调了还原如何解锁芳香系统中原本无法实现的重排，并让我们了解石墨烯、碳纳米管和富勒烯的功能化。

title: One-Step Integration of Sulfonated Polymer Films with Separators for Shuttle Mitigation in Lithium–Sulfur Batteries
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Interfacial polymerization (IP) offers a rapid and inexpensive method for fabricating thin polymer films. In this work, a one-step IP reaction between a triacyl chloride monomer and sulfonated diamine monomer is employed to add a dense, charge-selective sulfonated thin-film coating onto a commercial separator to improve selective transport in lithium-sulfur batteries. The coating effectively suppresses polysulfide shuttling, enhancing capacity retention, although at the expense of compromised rate performance due to hindered lithium conduction through the dense film. Fractional substitution of the trifunctionalized acyl chloride monomer for a difunctionalized analogue reduces the film cross-link density, which improves rate performance but decreases uniformity in film coverage. Uniform film coverage is achieved upon addition of a small fraction (0.25 wt %) of higher reactivity, nonsulfonated diamine in the IP reaction. This optimized thin film coating breaks the rate-capacity retention trade-off, enabling a capacity of 711.6 mAh g-1 after 200 cycles at 0.5C while still reaching over 800 mAh g-1 during rate testing at 2C.
title_zh: 磺化聚合物薄膜与隔膜的一步集成，用于缓解锂硫电池中的穿梭效应
abstract_zh: 界面聚合（IP）为制造聚合物薄膜提供了一种快速且廉价的方法。在这项工作中，采用三酰氯单体和磺化二胺单体之间的一步 IP 反应，在商业隔膜上添加致密的电荷选择性磺化薄膜涂层，以改善锂硫电池的选择性传输。该涂层有效地抑制了多硫化物穿梭，提高了容量保持率，但代价是由于锂通过致密膜的传导受到阻碍而导致倍率性能受到损害。三官能化酰氯单体对双官能化类似物的部分取代降低了薄膜交联密度，这提高了倍率性能，但降低了薄膜覆盖的均匀性。在 IP 反应中添加一小部分 (0.25 wt%) 较高反应活性的非磺化二胺即可实现均匀的薄膜覆盖。这种优化的薄膜涂层打破了倍率与容量保持权衡，在 0.5C 下循环 200 次后容量达到 711.6 mAh g-1，同时在 2C 倍率测试期间仍达到 800 mAh g-1 以上。

title: Refined PEMEL operation of hydrogen-integrated islanded microgrid via penalized sensitivity region-based robust optimization
source: ScienceDirect Publication: Applied Energy
abstract: Distributed renewable generators are essential for islanded microgrids (IMGs), yet their intermittency and uncertainty may increase operating costs and induce frequency and voltage issues. Proton exchange membrane electrolyzers (PEMELs) as a controllable demand-side resource can consume surplus renewables and produce green hydrogen. However, existing PEMEL models rely on the assumption of fixed conversion rate or lack physics-grounded characterization of device-level behaviors in power grid operation. Meanwhile, conventional IMG operation focuses on keeping operating constraints and ignores robustness on objectives against uncertainties, while hydrogen demand is not treated as an explicit uncertainty source. To address these gaps, this paper proposes a refined PEMEL operation method for a hydrogen-integrated IMG via new penalized sensitivity region based robust optimization (PSRRO). First, a power-responsive PEMEL model is developed to capture nonlinear device-level characteristics driven by current density. Second, a PSRRO method is proposed to optimize IMG operation under multi-dimensional uncertainties of renewable generation, electrical load, and hydrogen demand. Lastly, an efficient solution algorithm is developed to reduce computational burdens and enhance the applicability of the PSRRO method. Numerical results verify that the proposed method can achieve robust performance by keeping both narrow objective variations and operating constraints against multi-dimensional uncertainties, with high computing efficiency for practical use.
title_zh: 基于惩罚敏感区域的鲁棒优化氢集成孤岛微电网的精细化PEMEL运行
abstract_zh: 分布式可再生能源发电机对于孤岛微电网（IMG）至关重要，但其间歇性和不确定性可能会增加运营成本并引发频率和电压问题。质子交换膜电解槽（PEMEL）作为一种可控的需求侧资源，可以消耗剩余的可再生能源并生产绿色氢气。然而，现有的 PEMEL 模型依赖于固定转换率的假设，或者缺乏电网运行中设备级行为的基于物理的表征。同时，传统的IMG操作侧重于保持操作约束，忽略了目标对不确定性的鲁棒性，而氢气需求并未被视为明确的不确定性源。为了解决这些差距，本文提出了一种通过新的基于惩罚敏感区域的鲁棒优化（PSRRO）的氢集成 IMG 的改进 PEMEL 操作方法。首先，开发了功率响应 PEMEL 模型来捕获由电流密度驱动的非线性器件级特性。其次，提出了一种PSRRO方法，用于在可再生能源发电、电力负荷和氢气需求的多维不确定性下优化IMG运行。最后，开发了一种有效的求解算法来减少计算负担并增强PSRRO方法的适用性。数值结果验证了该方法能够在保持狭窄的客观变化和针对多维不确定性的操作约束的情况下实现稳健的性能，并且在实际使用中具有较高的计算效率。

title: Electrochemical Nitrate Reduction with Low-Index Cu Single Crystals: Selectivity Trends in Alkaline Solution
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Electrochemical nitrate (NO3-) reduction is a promising pathway toward the production of ammonia (NH3). While copper (Cu) electrodes are commonly used for this reaction, the influence of Cu surface structure on reaction selectivity is poorly understood. Here, we performed electrochemical NO3- reduction in alkaline electrolytes with Cu(100), Cu(110), and Cu(111) single-crystal electrodes and quantified the product distributions across a range of applied potentials. Our systematic study of electrocatalytic NO3- reduction demonstrated that the Cu(100) and Cu(110) surfaces exhibited similar selectivity and rates for NH3 production, but the Cu(100) surface provided >95% Faradaic efficiency toward NH3 over the broadest range of applied potentials. In contrast, the Cu(111) surface was significantly less selective for NH3 production. Further comparing the electrochemical behavior of Cu single crystals to their corresponding product distributions revealed that nitrite (NO2-) reduction voltammograms were strong predictors of electrocatalytic performance for all three low-index Cu surfaces in alkaline electrolytes. Quantum mechanical calculations indicate that the Cu(100) surface exhibits the lowest potential-determining step for NO3- reduction to NH3, supporting our experimental findings. Detailed analysis of metal-adsorbate interactions also revealed the role of Cu surface structure in stabilizing key reaction intermediates to promote selective NH3 production. Our combined experimental and computational study establishes electrocatalytic selectivity of low-index Cu facets for NH3 synthesis and offers practical guidelines for the design of Cu-based electrocatalysts capable of selective electrochemical NO3- reduction in alkaline solutions.

title: Assessing state biodiversity conservation planning and large-scale wind and solar energy development in the United States
source: ScienceDirect Publication: Energy Policy
abstract: The accelerating rollout of large-scale wind and photovoltaic solar (LSWS; >1 MW) projects raises key questions about how to balance the indirect impacts from renewable energy expansion with biodiversity conservation. In the United States, biodiversity conservation is, in part, operationalized through State Wildlife Action Plans (SWAPs), yet the extent to which these plans anticipate and guide LSWS development remains unclear. Using a keyword-assisted qualitative content analysis, we evaluate how LSWS-related threats and conservation opportunities are represented in SWAPs. Further, we use a GIS-based overlay analysis to quantify overlap between spatially explicit conservation priorities (‘Conservation Opportunity Areas’ or COAs) and areas indirectly impacted by current and projected LSWS buildout. To capture potential indirect impacts from LSWS, we apply technology-specific and project-level buffers and assess spatial overlap with SWAP-designated COAs under two land-use scenarios. We find misalignment between conservation opportunities identified in SWAPs and the trajectory of LSWS buildout. Across SWAPs, 80% identify at least one LSWS-related biodiversity threat, but 17 plans identify no LSWS-related conservation opportunity. The most common conservation opportunity identified in SWAPs is the need for additional research. Spatial analyses reveal that areas indirectly impacted by LSWS may expand rapidly, reaching more than 440,000 km 2 by 2045. Land-cover analyses show that LSWS–COA overlap occurs primarily in natural habitat and agricultural lands. States with the highest projected overlap, including Iowa, Michigan, and Montana identify few actionable conservation opportunities. These findings stress the necessity of early, coordinated LSWS planning to align LSWS and biodiversity conservation aims.

title: Coupling Photochromism and Charge Transport in π-Extended Arylazo Oligothiophenes and Oligothienoacenes
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Developing photoresponsive molecular materials that couple efficient charge transport with robust photoswitching remains challenging because structural features enhancing one function often compromise the other. In this study, two homologous series of arylazo oligothiophenes and oligothienoacenes-in which an azo photoswitch is directly conjugated to a π-extended thiophenic scaffold-were systematically investigated. Ultraviolet-visible (UV-vis) spectroscopy combined with theoretical calculations shows that, in solution, π-extension enables E → Z photoisomerization using visible light but concurrently lowers the barrier for thermal Z → E back-conversion by activating rotational isomerization pathways. Aryl fluorination counteracts this effect by strengthening intramolecular S(n)···π interactions, extending the Z-isomer half-life from minutes to hours. In the solid state, π-extension promotes dense intermolecular packing that inhibits photoisomerization. Introduction of a bulky trityl group reduces packing density, as revealed by single-crystal analysis, restoring E ⇆ Z photochromism in crystalline thin films and inducing a crystalline-to-amorphous transformation, as evidenced by X-ray diffraction (XRD) and microscopic analysis. The resulting light-driven molecular and morphological reorganization enables reversible, light-induced modulation of electrical conductivity in two-contact planar devices. Space-charge-limited-current measurements show that conductivity changes correlate with isomer-dependent electron mobility properties. Overall, these findings establish π-extended azo-thiophene scaffolds as a versatile platform to couple photochromism and morphological reorganization with charge transport phenomena.

title: Multicenter Electronic Interactions Driving Active Phase Formation in NiFe-MOFs for Anion-Exchange Membrane Water Electrolysis
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Multimetal doping is widely employed to enhance oxygen evolution reaction electrocatalysis; however, the underlying mechanism remains poorly understood due to the complex interplay. Herein, we rationally integrate rare-earth Ce and transition-metal Ru into NiFe-MOFs (Ce,Ru-NiFe-MOFs) to achieve orbital complementarity between localized 4f and delocalized 4d states, thereby enabling a fundamentally distinct electronic regulation strategy beyond conventional charge transfer. This coupling effect fundamentally alters the dynamic evolution of the catalyst by accelerating the transformation of NiFe-MOFs into active NiFeOOH species. We further demonstrate that Ce/Ru codoping induces oxygen-bridged multicenter orbital coupling (3d-4d-4f), as evidenced by soft- and hard-X-ray absorption spectroscopy and aberration-corrected high-angle annular dark-field scanning transmission electron microscopy, together with density functional theory calculations, thereby establishing nonadditive electronic interactions and multilevel electron-transfer pathways. Consequently, the reconstructed catalyst exhibits an optimized electronic structure with enhanced OH- adsorption, suppressed proton-induced corrosion, and reduced energy barrier for the rate-determining step. Therefore, the catalyst delivers an overpotential of 199 mV at 10 mA cm-2 and outstanding durability exceeding 1600 h at 400 mA cm-2. Additionally, when integrated into an anion-exchange membrane water electrolysis system, it achieves a low cell voltage of 1.747 V at 1000 mA cm-2 (meeting the U.S. DOE 2026 target) and maintains stable operation for over 95 h at 500 mA cm-2. This work establishes a clear mechanistic framework linking orbital-level coupling, reconstruction kinetics, and catalytic performance, and provides a general design principle for engineering advanced electrocatalysts via multicenter orbital interactions.

title: Self-Reinforcing Structural–Interfacial Evolution in LiCuFe 2 (VO 4 ) 3 Anodes Enables Durable, High-Capacity Lithium Storage
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Designing high-capacity and durable anodes for lithium-ion batteries (LIBs) remains a formidable challenge due to persistent structural degradation and sluggish interfacial kinetics. Herein, a polycationic vanadate-based compound, LiCuFe2(VO4)3, is engineered to address these issues through a coupled mechanism of electrochemical lattice reorganization and self-adaptive interface modulation. The electrode exhibits an exceptional cycling performance, retaining a specific capacity of 1178 mAh g-1 after 1000 cycles at 0.5 A g-1, accompanied by a continuous capacity elevation phenomenon. Advanced synchrotron radiation X-ray diffraction and first-principles calculations reveal that, during cycling, the precipitation of metallic Cu nanoparticles orchestrates charge percolation networks, while Fe3+-derived Fe3O4 catalyzes dynamic electrolyte translation, yielding a polymer gel-like film. This dual-regulation framework simultaneously alleviates mechanical stress and enables high-rate surface-dominated storage. These findings shed light on an electrochemically induced optimization paradigm, positioning LiCuFe2(VO4)3 as a prototype material for next-generation high-performance LIB anode.
title_zh: LiCuFe 2 (VO 4 ) 3 阳极的自增强结构-界面演化可实现耐用、高容量的锂存储
abstract_zh: 由于持续的结构退化和缓慢的界面动力学，为锂离子电池（LIB）设计高容量且耐用的阳极仍然是一项艰巨的挑战。本文设计了一种基于聚阳离子钒酸盐的化合物LiCuFe2(VO4)3，通过电化学晶格重组和自适应界面调制的耦合机制来解决这些问题。该电极表现出优异的循环性能，在0.5 A g-1下循环1000次后，比容量仍保持在1178 mAh g-1，并伴有持续的容量提升现象。先进的同步加速器辐射X射线衍射和第一原理计算表明，在循环过程中，金属Cu纳米粒子的沉淀协调电荷渗流网络，而Fe3+衍生的Fe3O4催化动态电解质转化，产生聚合物凝胶状薄膜。这种双调节框架可同时减轻机械应力并实现高速表面主导存储。这些发现揭示了电化学诱导优化范例，将 LiCuFe2(VO4)3 定位为下一代高性能 LIB 阳极的原型材料。

title: Role of Grain Boundary Features in the Thermal Stability of LASTT-10 Thermoelectric Materials
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Nanostructured PbTe-based compounds, including n-type LAST-m (AgPbmSbTem+2) and p-type LASTT-m (Ag(Pb1-xSnx)mSbTem+2), exhibit high thermoelectric performance, but their long-term thermal stability remains a major limitation for high-temperature applications. In this work, we provide detailed insights into the origin of thermal instabilities in p-type LASTT compounds by studying the Ag0.9(Pb0.5Sn0.5)10Sb0.8Te12 (LASTT-10) composition synthesized via melting, annealing, and spark plasma sintering. The prepared bulk samples exhibit a high zT of ∼1.05 ± 0.10 at 673 K. Systematic thermal cycling and isothermal annealing experiments reveal that the observed irreversible changes in transport properties stem from microstructural evolution of Te-rich (Ag1-xSbx)1+yTe2 (x = 0.12, y = 0.18) secondary phases located at the grain boundaries. Differential thermal analysis of LASTT-10 identifies an endothermic reaction ∼630 K associated with the thermodynamic instability of the grain boundary phases. Beyond 610 K, (Ag1-xSbx)1+yTe2 undergoes multiple phase transformations, which lead to macroscopic thermal instability. Cyclic power generation tests indicate a stable performance for LASTT-10 below 610 K, with maximum power density ∼0.51 W/cm2 and conversion efficiency ∼4.3% at ΔT ∼316 K. These findings clarify the mechanisms underlying the thermal degradation in LASTT-10 and highlight critical parameters for improving the thermal robustness of PbTe-based thermoelectric materials for high-temperature power generation.
title_zh: 晶界特征在 LASTT-10 热电材料热稳定性中的作用
abstract_zh: 纳米结构 PbTe 基化合物，包括 n 型 LAST-m (AgPbmSbTem+2) 和 p 型 LASTT-m (Ag(Pb1-xSnx)mSbTem+2)，表现出较高的热电性能，但其长期热稳定性仍然是高温应用的主要限制。在这项工作中，我们通过研究通过熔化、退火和放电等离子烧结合成的 Ag0.9(Pb0.5Sn0.5)10Sb0.8Te12 (LASTT-10) 成分，详细了解了 p 型 LASTT 化合物热不稳定性的起源。制备的块状样品在 673 K 时表现出 ~1.05 ± 0.10 的高 zT。系统热循环和等温退火实验表明，观察到的输运特性的不可逆变化源于位于晶界的富 Te (Ag1-xSbx)1+yTe2 (x = 0.12, y = 0.18) 第二相的微观结构演化。 LASTT-10 的差热分析确定了~630 K 的吸热反应，该反应与晶界相的热力学不稳定性相关。超过 610 K，(Ag1-xSbx)1+yTe2 会经历多次相变，从而导致宏观热不稳定。循环发电测试表明，LASTT-10 在低于 610 K 的温度下性能稳定，最大功率密度为 ∼0.51 W/cm2，在 ΔT ∼316 K 时转换效率为 ∼4.3%。这些发现阐明了 LASTT-10 热降解的机制，并强调了提高高温发电用 PbTe 基热电材料的热鲁棒性的关键参数。

title: Stimuli-Responsive Synthetic Coacervates: Structural Design, Dynamics, and Functions
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS), an interesting process in which a homogeneous solution demixes into solute-rich and solute-poor phases, serves as a ubiquitous mechanism for the formation of biomolecular condensates in living cells. Biomolecular condensates, also known as membraneless organelles, play critical roles in many fundamental physiological processes, including gene transcription, signal transduction, and stress responses. The intriguing LLPS phenomenon has inspired the development of artificial coacervates composed of biopolymers, synthetic macromolecules, or small molecules, driving exploration toward smart functional materials. For these synthetic coacervates, tailoring their structures and manipulating phase separation behaviors through external stimuli are essential to achieve precise functional control. This review summarizes recent advances in stimuli-responsive LLPS-based coacervates, focusing on structural design, formation mechanisms, stimuli-responsive characteristics, and functional applications. We thoroughly categorize the coacervates based on the diversity of stimulus sources used to regulate phase separation, with particular emphasis on the underlying molecular-level mechanisms. We highlight the applications of stimuli-responsive coacervates ranging from drug delivery and microreactors to biosensing. The prospects for stimuli-responsive LLPS systems for next-generation smart materials are also presented, aiming to elucidate their great potential in bridging the gap between the sophistication of biological coacervates and the performance of artificial smart materials.
title_zh: 刺激响应合成凝聚层：结构设计、动力学和功能
abstract_zh: 液-液相分离（LLPS）是一个有趣的过程，其中均匀溶液分层混合成富溶质相和贫溶质相，是活细胞中形成生物分子凝聚物的普遍机制。生物分子凝聚体，也称为无膜细胞器，在许多基本生理过程中发挥着关键作用，包括基因转录、信号转导和应激反应。有趣的 LLPS 现象激发了由生物聚合物、合成大分子或小分子组成的人工凝聚层的开发，推动了对智能功能材料的探索。对于这些合成凝聚层，调整其结构并通过外部刺激操纵相分离行为对于实现精确的功能控制至关重要。本综述总结了基于 LLPS 的刺激响应凝聚层的最新进展，重点关注结构设计、形成机制、刺激响应特性和功能应用。我们根据用于调节相分离的刺激源的多样性对凝聚层进行彻底分类，特别强调潜在的分子水平机制。我们重点介绍刺激响应凝聚层的应用，从药物输送、微反应器到生物传感。还提出了用于下一代智能材料的刺激响应 LLPS 系统的前景，旨在阐明其在缩小生物凝聚层的复杂性与艺术表现之间的差距方面的巨大潜力

title: A cracking-assisted transfer printing technology for high-resolution quantum dot light-emitting diode displays
source: Nature Electronics
abstract: Inorganic colloidal quantum dot light-emitting diodes could be used to build next-generation electroluminescent displays due to their colour properties and electrical stability. However, to create high-resolution and large-area displays, a pixel integration method is required, which can deposit quantum dot arrays on an active-matrix backplane and maintain uniformity and precision, without colour cross-contamination. Here we report a cracking-assisted transfer printing technology that can be used to pattern high-resolution full-colour pixel arrays over large areas. The technology uses a controlled cracking process to fracture interparticle cohesive bonds between quantum dots. This facilitates subsequent pick-up and transfer to a thin-film transistor backplane with high precision. With the technology, we achieve pixels down to a size of 600 nm with electroluminescent emission and uniform pixelization over areas up to 4 inches. We create a cadmium-free full-colour active-matrix display with a resolution of 341 pixels per inch, as well as a blue active-matrix display with a flexible form factor. Furthermore, the cracking-assisted transfer printing can improve electroluminescence performance—with higher maximum luminance and operational lifetime than other quantum dot patterning techniques—through precise nano-interface control and high quantum dot packing density.
title_zh: 用于高分辨率量子点发光二极管显示器的裂解辅助转印技术
abstract_zh: 无机胶体量子点发光二极管由于其颜色特性和电稳定性，可用于构建下一代电致发光显示器。然而，为了创建高分辨率和大面积的显示器，需要一种像素集成方法，该方法可以将量子点阵列沉积在有源矩阵背板上并保持均匀性和精度，而不会出现颜色交叉污染。在这里，我们报告了一种裂纹辅助转移印刷技术，可用于在大面积上形成高分辨率全彩像素阵列图案。该技术使用受控裂解过程来破坏量子点之间的颗粒间内聚键。这有利于后续高精度拾取并转移到薄膜晶体管背板。通过该技术，我们可以实现尺寸小至 600 nm 的像素，并在高达 4 英寸的区域内进行电致发光和均匀像素化。我们打造了分辨率为每英寸 341 像素的无镉全彩有源矩阵显示器，以及具有灵活外形的蓝色有源矩阵显示器。此外，通过精确的纳米界面控制和高量子点堆积密度，裂解辅助转移印刷可以提高电致发光性能，比其他量子点图案化技术具有更高的最大亮度和使用寿命。

title: A Versatile Tumor Microenvironment-Responsive Nanoprobe for Cancer Screening and Early Detection
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: It has been highly challenging to reliably detect various cancers at an early stage when tumors are just millimeters in size. To address this, we developed a tumor microenvironment (TME)-responsive nanoprobe, PR-KAd@CD-AuNC, enabling cross-validated cancer detection through in vivo second near-infrared (NIR-II) fluorescence imaging and in vitro colorimetric urinalysis. The nanoprobe consists of three integrated components: a renal-clearable signal-output segment (cyclodextrin-functionalized gold nanocluster, CD-AuNC), a tumor-targeting and size-controlling component (PR), and a matrix metalloproteinase-2 (MMP2)-cleavable linker (KAd). PR, composed of 8-arm poly(ethylene glycol) for prolonged circulation and c(RGDfK) peptides for αvβ3 integrin targeting, directed selective tumor accumulation after intravenous injection of PR-KAd@CD-AuNC. The intrinsic emission of CD-AuNC above 1100 nm enabled high-resolution, real-time NIR-II fluorescence imaging with attenuated photon scattering, allowing precise tumor delineation. Within the TME, specifically overexpressed MMP2 cleaved the KAd linker, releasing ∼2 nm CD-AuNC fragments from the ∼10 nm parent nanoprobe. Being smaller than the ∼5.5 nm renal filtration threshold, these fragments were renally excreted. Concurrently, the peroxidase-like activity of CD-AuNC catalyzed tetramethylbenzidine oxidation to produce a visible blue signal, providing a simple and low-cost urinalysis method suitable for broad cancer screening applications. This dual-modality strategy effectively distinguished cancers from inflammation and other diseases, detecting small tumors for multiple cancer types with a sensitivity surpassing that of computed tomography (CT) imaging, which makes it a promising early detection approach. Furthermore, it was also employed to dynamically assess cancer therapeutic efficacy (i.e., immunotherapy, chemotherapy, and surgical resection), suggesting clinical value for guiding treatment decisions.
title_zh: 用于癌症筛查和早期检测的多功能肿瘤微环境响应纳米探针

title: Two Mechanisms One Molecule: Developing a ‘Truly’ Bifunctional Degrader Targeting Rpn13 and CRBN
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Targeted protein degradation (TPD) has emerged as a powerful strategy to eliminate disease-relevant proteins, yet current approaches remain largely constrained to hijacking ubiquitin ligases. We previously introduced ByeTACs, bifunctional molecules that directly recruit proteins to the proteasome for E-ligase independent degradation. Here, we report "Truly" degraders, a new class of dual-mechanism molecules that combine a ligand for the proteasomal receptor Rpn13 with a ligand for cereblon (CRBN) to simultaneously engage both ubiquitin-independent and ubiquitin-dependent degradation pathways. Structure-guided design identified an optimal linker length that supports efficient substrate processing, with the PEG4 derivative (Truly-4) inducing robust depletion of both Rpn13 and CRBN in several cancer cell types. Remarkably, Truly-4 is the first noncovalent small molecule shown to degrade full-length Rpn13, a target previously approached using covalent or domain-restricted strategies. Mechanistic studies confirmed that degradation of Rpn13 proceeds via CRBN-dependent E3 ligase activity, whereas CRBN degradation occurs through an E-ligase independent process, consistent with a ByeTAC mechanism. Importantly, Truly-4 induces selective cytotoxicity in hematologic and solid cancer cell lines but not in healthy cells, despite comparable Rpn13 depletion, indicating that dual degradation can uncouple target engagement from toxicity. These findings establish a generalizable framework for engineering bifunctional degraders that program the proteasome to execute parallel degradation mechanisms and highlight proteasome receptors as druggable nodes for selective destruction of disease-relevant proteins.
title_zh: 一个分子的两种机制：开发一种针对 Rpn13 和 CRBN 的“真正”双功能降解剂
abstract_zh: 靶向蛋白质降解（TPD）已成为消除疾病相关蛋白质的强大策略，但目前的方法仍然很大程度上局限于劫持泛素连接酶。我们之前介绍过 ByeTAC，这是一种双功能分子，可直接将蛋白质招募到蛋白酶体以进行不依赖于 E 连接酶的降解。在此，我们报告了“Truly”降解剂，这是一类新型双机制分子，它将蛋白酶体受体 Rpn13 的配体与 cereblon (CRBN) 的配体结合在一起，同时参与不依赖于泛素的降解途径和依赖于泛素的降解途径。结构引导设计确定了支持有效底物加工的最佳接头长度，其中 PEG4 衍生物 (Truly-4) 可在多种癌细胞类型中诱导 Rpn13 和 CRBN 的强烈消耗。值得注意的是，Truly-4 是第一个被证明可以降解全长 Rpn13 的非共价小分子，Rpn13 是之前使用共价或结构域限制策略接近的靶标。机理研究证实，Rpn13 的降解通过 CRBN 依赖性 E3 连接酶活性进行，而 CRBN 降解通过 E 连接酶独立过程发生，与 ByeTAC 机制一致。重要的是，Truly-4 在血液和实体癌细胞系中诱导选择性细胞毒性，但在健康细胞中则不然，尽管 Rpn13 消耗相当，这表明双重降解可以将靶标参与与毒性分开。这些发现为工程双功能降解剂建立了一个通用框架，对蛋白酶体进行编程以执行并行降解机制

title: Influence of Primary Coordination Sphere on Anion Rebound Selectivity in Nonheme Fe Enzyme-Catalyzed C(sp 3 )–H Functionalization: A Comparative Experimental and Computational Study of EgtB and ACCO
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Developing enzymatic mechanisms for C-F bond formation remains a long-standing challenge. Here, we repurposed the biosynthetic nonheme Fe enzyme EgtB, which features a three-histidine facial triad, to catalyze C(sp3)-H fluorination reactions. Directed evolution of EgtB afforded two new-to-nature fluorine atom transferases with opposite enantiopreference, EgtBCHF1 and EgtBCHF2, with up to 28-fold improved total activity. In contrast to our previously evolved nonheme Fe fluorine atom transfer biocatalyst ACCOCHF, which contains a two-histidine-one-carboxylate facial triad, the evolved EgtBCHF variants displayed unexpected hydroxylation activity. 18O-labeling experiments showed that the hydroxy group originated from water rather than residual O2. Computational studies suggested that the three-histidine-supported Fe(III) center exhibits enhanced Lewis acidity compared to the two-histidine-one-carboxylate system, allowing deprotonation of Fe(III)-bound water to form a Fe(III)-OH species that catalyzes radical hydroxylation. Primary coordination-sphere mutagenesis in EgtB and ACCO further supported the critical role of Fe coordination chemistry in controlling radical rebound reactivity and selectivity. Computational studies revealed that Fe coordination chemistry strongly influences both fluorine atom abstraction and radical rebound, with the intrinsic C-X (X = F, OH, and N3) bond forming radical rebound preference following the order N3 > OH > F. Furthermore, multivariate linear regression analysis revealed that fluorine atom abstraction is primarily governed by the intrinsic Fe-F bond strength, whereas fluorine rebound is predominantly controlled by the electronic structure of the Fe(III) intermediate. Together, these findings provide mechanistic insights into nonheme Fe enzymology and reprogramming toward selective radical rebound reactions, including challenging C-H fluorination.
title_zh: 初级配位球对非血红素 Fe 酶催化 C(sp 3 )–H 官能化中阴离子反弹选择性的影响：EgtB 和 ACCO 的比较实验和计算研究
abstract_zh: 开发 C-F 键形成的酶机制仍然是一个长期存在的挑战。在这里，我们重新利用生物合成非血红素 Fe 酶 EgtB（其具有三组氨酸面部三联体）来催化 C(sp3)-H 氟化反应。 EgtB 的定向进化提供了两种具有相反对映体的全新氟原子转移酶 EgtBCHF1 和 EgtBCHF2，总活性提高了 28 倍。与我们之前进化的非血红素铁氟原子转移生物催化剂 ACCOCHF（包含二组氨酸一羧酸盐面部三联体）相比，进化的 EgtBCHF 变体表现出意想不到的羟基化活性。 18O标记实验表明羟基源自水而不是残留的O2。计算研究表明，与二组氨酸一羧酸盐系统相比，三组氨酸支撑的 Fe(III) 中心表现出增强的路易斯酸性，允许 Fe(III) 结合水去质子化形成催化自由基羟基化的 Fe(III)-OH 物质。 EgtB 和 ACCO 中的初级配位层诱变进一步支持了 Fe 配位化学在控制自由基反弹反应性和选择性中的关键作用。计算研究表明，Fe 配位化学强烈影响氟原子的夺取和自由基反弹，内在的 C-X（X = F、OH 和 N3）键形成自由基反弹偏好，顺序为 N3 > OH > F。此外，多元线性回归分析表明，氟原子的夺取主要受内在的 Fe 控制。

title: Dipyrrole-Fused Naphthalene Diimide as a Building Block for High-Performance Organic Semiconductors
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Core annulation of naphthalene diimide (NDI) represents a powerful strategy to modulate its electronic structure and solid-state organization. Here, we report the first pyrrole-fused NDI (NDPI) framework and elucidate its structural and electronic characteristics. Single-crystal X-ray diffraction reveals a highly planar π-core with short π-π stacking distance (3.33 Å) and strong intermolecular N-H···O hydrogen bonding (2.07 Å), highlighting the unique supramolecular features introduced by pyrrole annulation. Building on this motif, a series of donor-acceptor polymers was synthesized and systematically evaluated in OFET devices. The polymers exhibit optical bandgaps of 1.32-1.39 eV. Device mobilities range from 0.10 to 0.59 cm2 V-1 s-1, with charge transport behavior tunable from balanced ambipolar to unipolar n-type depending on donor strength. Correlation of AFM and GIWAXS analyses suggests that charge mobility is governed not solely by crystallinity, but by the interplay between π-π stacking and domain connectivity. This work establishes NDPI as a versatile building block for high-performance organic semiconductors.
title_zh: 二吡咯稠合萘二酰亚胺作为高性能有机半导体的构建模块
abstract_zh: 萘二酰亚胺（NDI）的核心成环代表了调节其电子结构和固态组织的强大策略。在这里，我们报告了第一个吡咯稠合 NDI (NDPI) 框架并阐明了其结构和电子特性。单晶X射线衍射揭示了高度平坦的π核，具有短的π-π堆积距离（3.33 Å）和强的分子间N-H·O氢键（2.07 Å），突出了吡咯环化引入的独特超分子特征。在此基础上，合成了一系列供体-受体聚合物，并在 OFET 器件中进行了系统评估。该聚合物表现出1.32-1.39 eV的光学带隙。器件迁移率范围为 0.10 至 0.59 cm2 V-1 s-1，电荷传输行为可根据施主强度从平衡双极性调节到单极性 n 型。 AFM 和 GIWAXS 分析的相关性表明，电荷迁移率不仅取决于结晶度，还取决于 π-π 堆叠和域连接之间的相互作用。这项工作将 NDPI 确立为高性能有机半导体的通用构建模块。

title: Surface-Confinement Effect Enables Bioorthogonal Drug Release in Tumors
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: A critical challenge in the bench-to-bedside translation of controlled drug release strategies is the sharp decline in reaction efficiency as biological complexity increases. A platform capable of maintaining bioorthogonal-like drug release─remaining minimally perturbed by physiological environments─would address an unmet clinical need. This is particularly relevant for radiotherapy-mediated drug release, where the oxidative activation of prodrugs is often compromised by the rapid quenching of reactive intermediates in vivo. Herein, we engineer a hafnium-based nanoscale metal-organic layer platform that leverages a unique "surface-confinement effect" to overcome this challenge. By covalently tethering prodrugs to the Hf-nMOLs surface, we constructed two-dimensional nanoreactors that spatially localize the activation process within an interface enriched with reactive species. This design effectively insulates the activation step from biological scavengers, ensuring efficient payload release efficiency across increasing biological complexity. When loaded with the topoisomerase I inhibitor Exatecan, the Hf-nMOLs system achieved an intratumoral drug-release G-value of 568 nM·Gy-1, resulting in potent radiosensitization and significant tumor-growth suppression under low-dose X-ray irradiation. This work presents a versatile strategy for robust radio-chemotherapeutic combinations, achieving the simultaneous release of diverse payloads activated by radiotherapy. Our findings also suggest that engineering nanoscale surface confinement may provide a generalizable materials strategy to help confer bioorthogonality to otherwise labile activation reactions.
title_zh: 表面限制效应使肿瘤中的生物正交药物释放成为可能
abstract_zh: 受控药物释放策略从实验室到临床转化的一个关键挑战是，随着生物复杂性的增加，反应效率急剧下降。一个能够维持类生物正交药物释放（且受生理环境干扰最小化）的平台将解决未满足的临床需求。这与放射治疗介导的药物释放特别相关，其中前药的氧化活化常常受到体内反应中间体的快速猝灭的影响。在这里，我们设计了一种基于铪的纳米级金属有机层平台，利用独特的“表面限制效应”来克服这一挑战。通过将前药共价束缚到 Hf-nMOLs 表面，我们构建了二维纳米反应器，将活化过程空间定位在富含活性物质的界面内。这种设计有效地将激活步骤与生物清除剂隔离开来，确保在不断增加的生物复杂性中有效负载释放效率。当装载拓扑异构酶 I 抑制剂 Exatecan 时，Hf-nMOLs 系统实现了 568 nM·Gy-1 的瘤内药物释放 G 值，在低剂量 X 射线照射下产生有效的放射增敏和显着的肿瘤生长抑制。这项工作提出了一种稳健的放化疗组合的多功能策略，实现了放疗激活的多种有效载荷的同时释放。我们的研究结果还表明，工程纳米级表面限制可能提供一种通用的材料策略

title: Controlled Precursor Differentiation Enables Palladium-Catalyzed Divergent Carbonylation of Cyclobutenols
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Controlling reaction selectivity is a central challenge in synthetic chemistry, particularly when multiple competing reactivity modes coexist within a single substrate. Existing strategies generally rely either on selectivity control during substrate activation or on downstream divergence from a common intermediate. However, these paradigms are less effective when distinct precursor states can independently evolve into distinct reaction manifolds. Herein, we introduce precursor differentiation as a distinct strategy for achieving divergent carbonylation. Through condition-controlled modulation of substrate evolution, a common cyclobutenol substrate can be selectively diverted into two distinct reactive precursors prior to catalytic engagement, thereby enabling access to two different carbonylation pathways. Under palladium catalysis, this strategy enables the highly selective synthesis of either hydroxyl-retained cyclobutanecarboxamides or cyclobutenamides from the same cyclobutenol platform. The method exhibits broad substrate scope (99 examples), consistently high selectivity (>20:1), and compatibility with pharmaceuticals and biologically relevant molecules. Furthermore, the resulting cyclobutenamide products serve as versatile platform intermediates for the selective synthesis of structurally distinct 3-azabicyclo[3.2.0]heptane and 3-azabicyclo[3.1.1]heptane frameworks. Mechanistic studies support a condition-controlled precursor differentiation process prior to carbonylation, providing a conceptual basis for achieving divergent carbonylation through selective control of precursor evolution.
title_zh: 受控前体分化使得钯催化的环丁烯醇发散羰基化成为可能
abstract_zh: 控制反应选择性是合成化学中的一个核心挑战，特别是当多种竞争反应模式共存于单一底物中时。现有策略通常依赖于底物激活过程中的选择性控制或依赖于常见中间体的下游分歧。然而，当不同的前体态可以独立地演化成不同的反应流形时，这些范式的效果就不那么有效了。在这里，我们引入前体分化作为实现不同羰基化的独特策略。通过底物演化的条件控制调节，常见的环丁烯醇底物可以在催化接合之前选择性地转化为两种不同的反应前体，从而能够进入两种不同的羰基化途径。在钯催化下，该策略能够从同一环丁烯醇平台高度选择性地合成保留羟基的环丁烷甲酰胺或环丁烯酰胺。该方法具有广泛的底物范围（99 个示例）、始终如一的高选择性 (>20:1) 以及与药物和生物相关分子的兼容性。此外，所得环丁烯酰胺产品可作为多功能平台中间体，用于选择性合成结构不同的3-氮杂双环[3.2.0]庚烷和3-氮杂双环[3.1.1]庚烷骨架。机理研究支持羰基化之前的条件控制前体分化过程，为通过选择性控制o实现不同的羰基化提供了概念基础。

title: Challenges and trends in automotive battery recycling
source: Nature Energy
abstract: The electrification of the automotive industry is driving a rapid global expansion of battery production, which generates substantial volumes of waste from both manufacturing scrap and end-of-life batteries. Consequently, recycling capacities must scale significantly from 2026 onwards, while recyclers face major challenges: meeting regulatory requirements, establishing efficient reverse logistics and coping with the growing complexity of return streams, system designs, cell formats, and evolving chemistries. Here we provide a comprehensive overview of current recycling technologies and assess their compatibility with both state-of-the-art and next-generation batteries, highlighting the technical and economic challenges of managing diverse battery waste. We show that although established processes are largely suitable for today’s lithium-ion chemistries, future systems such as sodium-ion and solid-state batteries will require process adaptation. Beyond technical aspects, we identify seven key trends to enhance recycling economics, optimize material flows and support the development of a fully circular battery industry in the future.
title_zh: 汽车电池回收的挑战和趋势
abstract_zh: 汽车行业的电气化正在推动全球电池生产的快速扩张，生产废料和报废电池会产生大量废物。因此，从 2026 年起，回收能力必须大幅扩大，而回收商面临着重大挑战：满足监管要求、建立高效的逆向物流以及应对日益复杂的回流、系统设计、电池格式和不断发展的化学物质。在这里，我们全面概述了当前的回收技术，并评估了它们与最先进的和下一代电池的兼容性，强调了管理各种电池废物的技术和经济挑战。我们表明，尽管现有的工艺在很大程度上适合当今的锂离子化学物质，但未来的系统（例如钠离子和固态电池）将需要工艺调整。除了技术方面之外，我们还确定了七个关键趋势，以增强回收经济性、优化物质流并支持未来完全循环电池行业的发展。

title: High-rate electro-photochemical alkane conversion to isoalcohols under ambient conditions
source: Joule
abstract: Industrial isopropanol synthesis currently relies on energy- and carbon-intensive high-temperature, high-pressure processes. Here, the authors present an ambient-condition cascade electro-photochemical system that employs a bromide mediator to efficiently convert propane into high-value isopropanol, offering a sustainable pathway toward decarbonizing chemical manufacturing.
title_zh: 在环境条件下高速率电光化学烷烃转化为异醇
abstract_zh: 工业异丙醇合成目前依赖于能源和碳密集型高温高压工艺。在这里，作者提出了一种环境条件级联电光化学系统，该系统采用溴化物介体有效地将丙烷转化为高价值异丙醇，为化学制造脱碳提供了一条可持续的途径。

title: Embryonic and postnatal macrophages are necessary for proper tooth development and homeostasis
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The role of macrophages in teeth, beyond their function in innate immunity, remains unexplored. This study demonstrates that macrophages populate dental tissues during early development and increase in number during pre-eruptive stages postnatally. In continuously growing teeth, they are associated with epithelial and mesenchymal stem cell niches throughout lifetime. To investigate their role in development, we genetically disrupt macrophage migration using neural-crest specific Wnt1Cre/Csf1fl/fl and general Csf1R knockout mouse models. This results in abnormal dentin and enamel deposition, eruption defects, early tooth mispatterning, and impaired osteogenesis. Notably, the phenotype is partially rescued via bone marrow transplantation. In addition, the short-term pharmacological depletion of macrophages in wildtype adult mice causes striking disintegration of both dentin and enamel in the apical part of continuously-growing teeth, which is restored after withdrawal of clodronate. Following treatment, macrophages rapidly repopulate dental tissue and the presence of M2 reparative state phenotype is observed by single-cell RNA-seq analysis. Overall, our findings reveal essential role of macrophages in the dental development and patterning of both mesenchymal and epithelial tooth compartments. This previously unrecognized role of macrophages in teeth is reminiscent of their function in complex tissue regeneration and requires future studies to dissect precise cellular and molecular mechanisms.
title_zh: 胚胎和出生后巨噬细胞对于牙齿的正常发育和体内平衡是必需的
abstract_zh: 除了先天免疫功能之外，巨噬细胞在牙齿中的作用仍有待探索。这项研究表明，巨噬细胞在早期发育过程中填充牙组织，并在出生后萌芽前阶段数量增加。在不断生长的牙齿中，它们在一生中与上皮和间充质干细胞生态位相关。为了研究它们在发育中的作用，我们使用神经嵴特异性 Wnt1Cre/Csf1fl/fl 和一般 Csf1R 敲除小鼠模型从基因上破坏巨噬细胞迁移。这会导致牙本质和牙釉质沉积异常、萌出缺陷、早期牙齿畸形和成骨受损。值得注意的是，该表型通过骨髓移植得到部分挽救。此外，野生型成年小鼠中巨噬细胞的短期药理学耗竭导致持续生长的牙齿根尖部的牙本质和牙釉质发生显着崩解，在停止氯膦酸盐后会恢复。治疗后，巨噬细胞迅速重新填充牙组织，并通过单细胞 RNA-seq 分析观察到 M2 修复状态表型的存在。总的来说，我们的研究结果揭示了巨噬细胞在牙齿发育和间充质和上皮牙室模式中的重要作用。巨噬细胞在牙齿中以前未被认识的作用让人想起它们在复杂组织再生中的功能，需要未来的研究来剖析精确的细胞和分子机制。

title: Sulfotransferase signaling sustains fibroblast identity and antagonizes therapeutic cardiac reprogramming
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Differentiated cells maintain their identity through active mechanisms that suppress alternative cell fates, but disrupting these barriers can enhance direct reprogramming for organ repair. Among the regulators of cell fate stability, glycosylation-associated genes have emerged as barriers to cardiac reprogramming. Here we show that carbohydrate sulfotransferases are central fate-stabilizing regulators, with CHST7 acting through CD44 to control nuclear JUNB levels, chromatin binding, and downstream transcriptional activity. Integrated RNA-seq and ATAC-seq analyses reveal that CHST7 maintains open chromatin at JUNB- and CTCF-enriched loci while restricting accessibility at MEF2C-enriched regions, collectively reinforcing fibroblast identity and suppressing cardiac fate acquisition. We further identify PIP4K2C as a downstream effector whose inhibition enhances cardiac reprogramming efficiency and improves myocardial repair in vivo. These findings define a sulfotransferase-dependent barrier to cell fate conversion with therapeutic implications for heart regeneration.
title_zh: 磺基转移酶信号传导维持成纤维细胞身份并拮抗治疗性心脏重编程
abstract_zh: 分化的细胞通过抑制细胞命运的主动机制来维持其身份，但破坏这些屏障可以增强器官修复的直接重编程。在细胞命运稳定性的调节因子中，糖基化相关基因已成为心脏重编程的障碍。在这里，我们证明碳水化合物磺基转移酶是命运稳定的核心调节因子，CHST7 通过 CD44 发挥作用来控制核 JUNB 水平、染色质结合和下游转录活性。整合的 RNA-seq 和 ATAC-seq 分析表明，CHST7 在 JUNB 和 CTCF 富集位点保持开放染色质，同时限制 MEF2C 富集区域的可及性，共同增强成纤维细胞身份并抑制心脏命运获得。我们进一步确定 PIP4K2C 作为下游效应器，其抑制可提高心脏重编程效率并改善体内心肌修复。这些发现定义了细胞命运转换的磺基转移酶依赖性屏障，对心脏再生具有治疗意义。

title: Scope of Ni(II)-Catalyzed Nonalternating Ethylene/Carbon Monoxide Copolymerization
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: The recent achievement of a nonalternating ethylene/carbon monoxide (CO) copolymerization was a long-sought breakthrough. Their in-chain keto functional groups endow the resulting polyethylenes (keto-PEs) with photodegradability. To date, only two types of catalysts, based on long-known structural motifs, are capable of this challenging copolymerization to keto-PE materials, raising the question whether the reaction is restricted to this narrow scope. Here, we report a diverse range of neutral Ni(II) complexes provides access to keto-PEs, including a phosphine imidate Ni(II) catalyst that is competitive with state-of-the-art catalysts and a N-heterocyclic-carbene (NHC) phenolate Ni(II) catalyst with exceptional preference for ethylene vs CO incorporation. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations rationalize the observed selectivity for nonalternating and alternating chain growth from the individual catalysts' activation barrier differences ΔΔG‡ and identify the strong trans-effect of the [NHC,O]-ligand and its high steric hindrance as origins of the desirable exceptionally low preference for CO incorporation.
title_zh: Ni(II) 催化非交替乙烯/一氧化碳共聚的范围
abstract_zh: 最近取得的非交替乙烯/一氧化碳 (CO) 共聚成果是一项长期寻求的突破。它们的链内酮官能团赋予所得聚乙烯（酮-PE）具有光降解性。迄今为止，只有两种基于众所周知的结构主题的催化剂能够与酮基聚乙烯材料进行这种具有挑战性的共聚，这就提出了该反应是否仅限于如此狭窄的范围的问题。在这里，我们报道了多种中性Ni(II)配合物提供了酮-PE的途径，包括与最先进的催化剂竞争的亚膦酰亚胺Ni(II)催化剂和N-杂环卡宾(NHC)酚盐Ni(II)催化剂，与CO的结合相比，N-杂环卡宾(NHC)酚盐Ni(II)催化剂具有特殊的优先性。密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算合理化了根据各个催化剂的活化势垒差异 ΔΔG‡ 观察到的非交替和交替链增长的选择性，并确定了 [NHC,O]-配体的强反式效应及其高空间位阻作为 CO 掺入的理想极低偏好的起源。

title: CD33 and clusterin interact biophysically and genetically to modulate Alzheimer risk
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Mechanisms linking CD33 variants to Alzheimer Disease (AD) are poorly defined. Here, we combine structural, cellular, and genetic analyses to delineate how the CD33M splice isoform, upregulated in carriers of CD33 risk alleles, modulates microglial function. We show that CD33M ectodomain dimerizes, enabling binding of large multi-sialylated molecules. We demonstrate that another AD risk protein - clusterin (CLU) ± Aβ oligomers (but not ApoE) binds with nanomolar avidity to CD33M, but not CD33m. We show that in human monocytes CD33M:CLU binding induces CD33M ITIM phosphorylation, recruits SHP-1, suppresses Aβ phagocytosis, and impairs clearance of amyloid plaques. We identify a soluble CD33M ectodomain fragment (sCD33M) - absent from CD33m-expressing cells - which could contribute to the role of CD33M in AD. Genetic analyses confirm that CD33:CLU interaction modulates amyloid burden, cognition, and disease risk. These findings define a mechanistic CLU:Aβ:CD33M axis, highlighting CD33M dimerization and ligand-binding sites as potential therapeutic targets.
title_zh: CD33 和簇蛋白通过生物物理和遗传相互作用来调节阿尔茨海默病风险
abstract_zh: CD33 变异与阿尔茨海默病 (AD) 之间的联系机制尚不清楚。在这里，我们结合结构、细胞和遗传分析来描述在 CD33 风险等位基因携带者中上调的 CD33M 剪接亚型如何调节小胶质细胞功能。我们发现 CD33M 胞外域二聚化，能够结合大的多唾液酸化分子。我们证明另一种 AD 风险蛋白 - 簇蛋白 (CLU) ± Aβ 寡聚物（但不是 ApoE）以纳摩尔亲和力与 CD33M 结合，但不与 CD33m 结合。我们发现，在人单核细胞中，CD33M:CLU 结合诱导 CD33M ITIM 磷酸化，招募 SHP-1，抑制 Aβ 吞噬作用，并损害淀粉样斑块的清除。我们鉴定出一种可溶性 CD33M 胞外域片段 (sCD33M)——表达 CD33m 的细胞中不存在——这可能有助于 CD33M 在 AD 中的作用。遗传分析证实 CD33:CLU 相互作用可调节淀粉样蛋白负荷、认知和疾病风险。这些发现定义了一个机制 CLU:Aβ:CD33M 轴，强调 CD33M 二聚化和配体结合位点作为潜在的治疗靶点。

title: Misregulation of T-box transcription factors drives BNP–NPR1 signalling underlying chronic itch
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Chronic itch poses a significant clinical burden, with activation of the brain natriuretic peptide (BNP) pathway as a hallmark, though its transcriptional control remains unclear. We identify T-box transcription factor 20 (TBX20) as upregulated in skin of atopic dermatitis patients, with increased expression in NPR1+ keratinocytes. ChIP peak calling, ChIP-qPCR and dual-luciferase assays show TBX20 activates the NPR1 promoter. In mice, keratinocyte-specific TBX20 knockout (TBX20fl/fl; K14-Cre) reduces scratching, IL-4 and Oncostatin M levels, basophil markers, and decreases cutaneous NPR1 expression. TBX20 is also expressed in a subset of NPR1+ sensory neurons, and neuron-specific deletion similarly alleviates itch, basophil infiltration, and barrier dysfunction. RNA-seq identifies lipocalin-2 as a downstream effector of the TBX20-NPR1 axis, and its deletion reduces itch. Conversely, AAV-mediated TBX20 rescue exacerbates symptoms. Neuregulin 1 suppresses TBX20, attenuates IL-13-driven NPR1 signalling, and reduces itch. These findings define a TBX20-NPR1 axis as a critical regulator of chronic itch and skin dysfunction.
title_zh: T-box转录因子的错误调节驱动慢性瘙痒背后的BNP-NPR1信号传导
abstract_zh: 慢性瘙痒造成了重大的临床负担，其标志是脑钠肽（BNP）通路的激活，尽管其转录控制仍不清楚。我们发现特应性皮炎患者皮肤中的 T 盒转录因子 20 (TBX20) 上调，并且 NPR1+ 角质形成细胞中的表达增加。 ChIP 峰检出、ChIP-qPCR 和双荧光素酶检测显示 TBX20 激活 NPR1 启动子。在小鼠中，角质形成细胞特异性 TBX20 敲除（TBX20fl/fl；K14-Cre）可减少抓挠、IL-4 和制瘤素 M 水平、嗜碱性粒细胞标记物，并降低皮肤 NPR1 表达。 TBX20 也在 NPR1+ 感觉神经元的子集中表达，神经元特异性缺失同样可以减轻瘙痒、嗜碱性粒细胞浸润和屏障功能障碍。 RNA-seq 将 lipocalin-2 识别为 TBX20-NPR1 轴的下游效应子，其缺失可减少瘙痒。相反，AAV 介导的 TBX20 救援会加剧症状。 Neuregulin 1 抑制 TBX20，减弱 IL-13 驱动的 NPR1 信号传导，并减少瘙痒。这些发现将 TBX20-NPR1 轴定义为慢性瘙痒和皮肤功能障碍的关键调节因子。

title: Meta-analytic evidence for distinct neural correlates of conditioned versus verbally induced placebo analgesia
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Placebo analgesia demonstrates that belief and expectation can significantly alter pain, even without active treatment. Placebo analgesia can be induced through verbal suggestion, classical conditioning, or their combination, though the role of conditioned neural responses above and beyond effects of verbal instructions remains unclear. We conduct a systematic meta-analysis of individual participant data from 16 within-participant placebo neuroimaging studies (n = 409), employing univariate and multivariate analyses to identify shared and distinct mechanisms of placebo analgesia induced by suggestions alone versus suggestions combined with conditioning. Both techniques increase activity during pain in the dorsolateral prefrontal and inferior parietal cortices and decrease activation in the insula, putamen, and primary sensory areas. Adding conditioning enhances engagement of regions associated with context representation and pain modulation (e.g., dorsolateral/dorsomedial prefrontal cortices) and decreases in nociceptive regions (e.g., primary sensory and insular areas). Conditioning also strengthens the negative association between analgesia and nociceptive activity, as quantified by the Neurologic Pain Signature. Combining conditioning with instructions yields greater placebo analgesia, mediated by increased ventromedial prefrontal and dorsal caudate activity, alongside decreased sensory-nociceptive and cerebellar activity. These findings suggest the two strategies rely on partially distinct mechanisms in the brain.
title_zh: 条件镇痛与言语诱导安慰剂镇痛的不同神经相关性的荟萃分析证据
abstract_zh: 安慰剂镇痛表明，即使没有积极治疗，信念和期望也可以显着改变疼痛。安慰剂镇痛可以通过言语暗示、经典条件反射或它们的组合来诱导，尽管条件神经反应在言语指令影响之外的作用仍不清楚。我们对 16 项参与者内安慰剂神经影像研究 (n = 409) 的个体参与者数据进行了系统的荟萃分析，采用单变量和多变量分析来确定单独建议与建议与条件相结合诱导的安慰剂镇痛的共同和独特机制。这两种技术都能增加疼痛时背外侧前额叶和下顶叶皮质的活动，并减少岛叶、壳核和初级感觉区域的活动。添加条件反射可以增强与情境表征和疼痛调节相关的区域（例如，背外侧/背内侧前额皮质）的参与，并减少伤害性区域（例如，初级感觉和岛叶区域）。调节还加强了镇痛和伤害性活动之间的负相关性，如神经疼痛特征所量化的。将调节与指令相结合可产生更好的安慰剂镇痛效果，这是通过增加腹内侧前额叶和背侧尾状核活动以及减少感觉伤害和小脑活动来介导的。这些发现表明这两种策略依赖于大脑中部分不同的机制。

title: Antiretroviral therapy in the peripartum period impairs post pregnancy cardiac reverse remodeling in a rodent model
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Cardiovascular (CV) disease is the leading cause of maternal mortality worldwide and has been partially linked to the cardiometabolic remodeling required to support fetal growth. In healthy pregnancies, these adaptations reverse postpartum without long-term consequences; however, impaired reverse remodeling (RR) increases future CV risk. Pregnant women living with HIV face additional risk, though it remains unclear whether this is driven by chronic low-level viremia or continuous antiretroviral therapy (ART). ART used during pregnancy often includes nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitors (NRTIs), which can affect mitochondria - organelles essential for maintaining cardiac function. Here, we tested the hypothesis that NRTI-containing ART negatively impacts the maternal heart. Using a rat model, we show that ART impairs pregnancy-associated cardiac RR. Mechanistically, ART induced mitochondrial alterations in both the heart and the liver, leading to dyslipidemia that collectively compromised cardiac function. These findings emphasize the importance of maternal cardiovascular health research and the need for further studies on the long-term effects of ART.
title_zh: 围产期抗逆转录病毒治疗会损害啮齿动物模型中的妊娠后心脏逆转重塑
abstract_zh: 心血管（CV）疾病是全世界孕产妇死亡的主要原因，并且与支持胎儿生长所需的心脏代谢重塑部分相关。在健康怀孕期间，这些适应会在产后逆转，而不会产生长期后果。然而，逆重塑 (RR) 受损会增加未来的心血管风险。感染艾滋病毒的孕妇面临着额外的风险，但目前尚不清楚这是由慢性低水平病毒血症还是持续抗逆转录病毒治疗（ART）引起的。怀孕期间使用的抗逆转录病毒治疗通常包括核苷逆转录酶抑制剂 (NRTI)，它会影响线粒体（维持心脏功能所必需的细胞器）。在这里，我们测试了含有 NRTI 的 ART 对母体心脏产生负面影响的假设。使用大鼠模型，我们表明 ART 会损害妊娠相关的心脏 RR。从机制上讲，ART 会引起心脏和肝脏的线粒体改变，导致血脂异常，从而共同损害心脏功能。这些发现强调了孕产妇心血管健康研究的重要性以及进一步研究 ART 长期影响的必要性。

title: Extracellular matrix stiffness directs region-specific lung epithelial differentiation revealed by hPSC-derived lung organoids
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Regional epithelial lineages of the human respiratory system reside within an extracellular matrix (ECM) whose mechanics vary along the airway–alveolar axis, yet how ECM stiffness directs epithelial fates remains unclear. Here, utilizing human pluripotent stem cell-derived lung organoids embedded in stiffness-tunable hydrogels as an in vitro model, we show ECM stiffness governs region-specific epithelial differentiation. Stepwise softening of ECM stiffness yields airway organoids with proximal-to-distal airway epithelial compositions and biomimetic physiological functions. During alveolar differentiation, increased stiffness promotes alveolar type 2 (AT2) and type 1 (AT1) maturation and drives AT2-to-AT1 transition. Furthermore, RNA sequencing reveals ECM stiffness regulates epithelial fates primarily through mechanotransduction pathways. Finally, these organoids reproduce the infection tropisms of SARS-CoV-2 variants. Together, this research elucidates ECM stiffness as a critical determinant of epithelial cell fate specification and region-specific lung organoid generation, which offers a valuable in vitro model for studying region-specific lung development, diseases pathogenesis, and drug screening.
title_zh: hPSC 衍生的肺类器官揭示细胞外基质硬度指导区域特异性肺上皮分化
abstract_zh: 人类呼吸系统的区域上皮谱系位于细胞外基质（ECM）内，其力学沿气道-肺泡轴变化，但 ECM 硬度如何指导上皮命运仍不清楚。在这里，利用嵌入硬度可调水凝胶中的人类多能干细胞衍生的肺类器官作为体外模型，我们证明了 ECM 硬度控制区域特异性上皮分化。 ECM 硬度的逐步软化产生具有近端到远端气道上皮成分和仿生生理功能的气道类器官。在肺泡分化过程中，硬度增加会促进 2 型 (AT2) 和 1 型 (AT1) 肺泡成熟，并驱动 AT2 向 AT1 的转变。此外，RNA 测序揭示 ECM 硬度主要通过机械转导途径调节上皮命运。最后，这些类器官再现了 SARS-CoV-2 变体的感染向性。总之，这项研究阐明了 ECM 硬度是上皮细胞命运规范和区域特异性肺类器官生成的关键决定因素，这为研究区域特异性肺发育、疾病发病机制和药物筛选提供了有价值的体外模型。

title: Glycerol metabolism triggers trypanosome differentiation into transmissible forms in mammalian tissue-like conditions
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: In the mammalian host, Trypanosoma brucei proliferates as slender bloodstream forms before undergoing quorum-sensing (QS)-dependent differentiation into non-dividing transmissible stumpy-QS forms, a process that both controls parasitaemia and enables transmission to the tsetse fly. However, this model does not explain how transmission occurs in chronically infected patients and cattle, where parasite densities are often too low to trigger QS-mediated differentiation. We identify a relevant glycerol-dependent pathway driven by adipocyte-derived glycerol that offers an explanation for this transmission paradox. We show that, at low parasite density, and with physiological levels of glycerol (0.2 mM) and glucose (4 mM) mimicking adipose and hypodermal interstitial fluids, glycerol promotes the emergence of novel proliferative forms that we termed, slender-Glyc forms. These cells are transmissible, unlike the slender forms, since they (i) differentiate in vitro into procyclic forms, which appear in the midgut of the infected flies, and (ii) establish infections in the fly. In addition, at high parasite density, tissular amounts of glycerol extends the lifespan of stumpy-QS forms (named stumpy-QS/Glyc), increasing transmission chances for tissue parasites, especially in the skin. Altogether, our findings suggest that local metabolic conditions, either on their own or in combination with parasite density, can drive transmission capacity.
title_zh: 甘油代谢触发锥虫在哺乳动物组织样条件下分化为可传播形式
abstract_zh: 在哺乳动物宿主中，布氏锥虫以细长的血流形式增殖，然后进行群体感应（QS）依赖性分化为不可分裂的可传染的短节 QS 形式，这一过程既控制寄生虫血症又能够传播给采采蝇。然而，该模型无法解释慢性感染患者和牛中的传播如何发生，因为这些地方的寄生虫密度通常太低，无法触发 QS 介导的分化。我们确定了由脂肪细胞衍生的甘油驱动的相关甘油依赖性途径，为这种传输悖论提供了解释。我们发现，在寄生虫密度较低的情况下，甘油（0.2 mM）和葡萄糖（4 mM）的生理水平模仿脂肪和皮下间质液，甘油促进了新的增殖形式的出现，我们称之为细长的甘油形式。与细长形式不同，这些细胞是可传播的，因为它们（i）在体外分化为原循环形式，出现在受感染果蝇的中肠中，并且（ii）在果蝇中建立感染。此外，在寄生虫密度较高的情况下，组织中的甘油量可以延长短截-QS形式（称为短截-QS/Glyc）的寿命，从而增加组织寄生虫的传播机会，尤其是在皮肤中。总而言之，我们的研究结果表明，局部代谢条件本身或与寄生虫密度相结合，可以提高传播能力。

title: Versatile Glycan Probes for Multiplatform Investigation of Glycan Interactions with Proteins, Viruses, and Cells
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Glycan-mediated interactions are vital to development, microbial colonisation, immune signalling, and cancer progression. Glycan microarrays have revolutionised glycobiology by enabling high-throughput analysis of these complex interactions, supported by techniques that reveal kinetics and dynamics in solution or at the cellular level. We introduce multifunctional glycan probes based on a tri-functional Fmoc-Amino-Azido (FAA) linker, enabling multi-platform investigation of glycan-mediated interactions. These FAA probes support glycan presentation on both covalent and non-covalent array platforms, allowing direct comparison of glycan recognition by diverse proteins. Notably, certain viral adhesins and immune lectins show a preference for the non-covalent platform. The azido group allows further functionalisation via ‘click chemistry’, enabling biotinylation for immobilisation on bio-layer interferometry biosensors for influenza virus binding, or fluorescent tagging for flow cytometry analysis of glycan-lectin interactions on cells. These versatile probes offer a unified platform for in-depth interrogation of glycan interactions using complementary approaches, with strong potential to advance glycan-based diagnostics and therapeutics.
title_zh: 用于多平台研究聚糖与蛋白质、病毒和细胞相互作用的多功能聚糖探针
abstract_zh: 聚糖介导的相互作用对于发育、微生物定植、免疫信号传导和癌症进展至关重要。聚糖微阵列通过揭示溶液或细胞水平的动力学和动力学的技术支持对这些复杂的相互作用进行高通量分析，彻底改变了糖生物学。我们引入了基于三功能 Fmoc-氨基-叠氮 (FAA) 连接体的多功能聚糖探针，从而能够对聚糖介导的相互作用进行多平台研究。这些 FAA 探针支持共价和非共价阵列平台上的聚糖呈现，允许直接比较不同蛋白质的聚糖识别。值得注意的是，某些病毒粘附素和免疫凝集素表现出对非共价平台的偏好。叠氮基团允许通过“点击化学”进一步功能化，实现生物素化以固定在生物层干涉测量生物传感器上用于流感病毒结合，或荧光标记用于细胞上聚糖-凝集素相互作用的流式细胞术分析。这些多功能探针为使用互补方法深入探究聚糖相互作用提供了一个统一的平台，具有推进基于聚糖的诊断和治疗的巨大潜力。

title: ASB2 inhibits lipid accumulation to promote ILC1 homeostatic fitness and anti-tumor immunity in the mouse liver
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Type 1 innate lymphoid cells (ILC1) are abundant in the adult liver and are pivotal for immune surveillance and modulation, but the regulation of their maintenance and functionality remains underexplored. Here, we re-analyze published single-cell RNA- sequencing data and find increased expression of Asb2 in ILC1s from adult mouse livers. Conditional ablation of Asb2 in NKp46+ cells, depleting ASB2 in ILC1s and NK cells, in mice impairs ILC1 survival and reduces adult liver ILC1 numbers. Proteomics and bulk RNA-sequencing reveal enriched lipid metabolism pathways in ASB2-deficient ILC1s, concomitant with increased lipid storage. Importantly, pharmacological inhibition of lipid synthesis prevents the apoptosis of ASB2-deficient ILC1s in vitro. In a mouse model of colorectal cancer liver metastasis, we find increased ILC1 lipid storage, and conditional Asb2 deficiency in ILC1 cells exacerbates liver metastasis progression. Conversely, inhibiting lipid accumulation in wild-type colorectal cancer-bearing mice prolongs animal survival, potentially via promoting ILC1-mediated anti-tumor immunity. Thus, our study uncovers ASB2-regulated lipid metabolism as a gatekeeper for ILC1 homeostatic fitness and tumor surveillance, highlighting potential ILC1-based therapeutic strategies against liver tumors.
title_zh: ASB2抑制脂质积累促进小鼠肝脏ILC1稳态适应性和抗肿瘤免疫
abstract_zh: 1 型先天淋巴细胞 (ILC1) 在成人肝脏中含量丰富，对于免疫监视和调节至关重要，但其维持和功能的调节仍待探索。在这里，我们重新分析了已发表的单细胞 RNA 测序数据，发现成年小鼠肝脏 ILC1 中 Asb2 的表达增加。在小鼠中，有条件地去除 NKp46+ 细胞中的 Asb2，耗尽 ILC1 和 NK 细胞中的 ASB2，会损害 ILC1 存活并减少成年肝脏 ILC1 数量。蛋白质组学和批量 RNA 测序揭示了 ASB2 缺陷的 ILC1 中脂质代谢途径丰富，同时脂质储存增加。重要的是，脂质合成的药理学抑制可防止 ASB2 缺陷的 ILC1 体外凋亡。在结直肠癌肝转移的小鼠模型中，我们发现ILC1脂质储存增加，并且ILC1细胞中条件性Asb2缺乏会加剧肝转移进展。相反，抑制野生型结直肠癌小鼠体内的脂质积累可以延长动物的存活时间，这可能是通过促进 ILC1 介导的抗肿瘤免疫来实现的。因此，我们的研究揭示了 ASB2 调节的脂质代谢作为 ILC1 稳态适应性和肿瘤监测的看门人，强调了基于 ILC1 的潜在肝肿瘤治疗策略。

title: Overcoming Antifungal Resistance: A Histatin 5-Gated Nanodevice for On-Demand Surfactant Delivery against C. albicans Infections
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: The escalating incidence of fungal infections, coupled with the emergence of antifungal resistance, represents a formidable global public health challenge. Candida albicans is a common opportunistic fungus that causes life-threatening, widespread candidiasis, especially in immunocompromised patients. Conventional antifungals, including azoles, echinocandins, and polyenes, have some drawbacks, such as host toxicity and the rapid appearance of resistant fungal strains. To overcome these limitations, we engineered a stimuli-responsive gated antimicrobial nanoparticle using mesoporous silica nanoparticles, functionalized with the antimicrobial peptide histatin 5 (Hst5) and loaded with the surfactant (3-(methyl)-1-tetradecylimidazolium) [C14MIM]+. The nanoparticles exhibit potent antimicrobial activity against C. albicans, with minimum inhibitory concentration values comparable to current clinical antifungals. Crucially, the nanodevice exhibits a dual mechanism of action, causing membrane disruption and inducing reactive oxygen species generation, which effectively hinders the development of resistance. Furthermore, the nanoparticles display strong synergistic interactions with conventional antifungals, significantly enhancing their efficacy. In addition to its planktonic activity, the system effectively inhibits biofilm formation and demonstrates high biocompatibility with human dermal cell lines. Based on these results, the nanodevice is successfully incorporated into a wound dressing matrix, demonstrating its promising translational potential for the topical treatment of cutaneous candidiasis.
title_zh: 克服抗真菌耐药性：组蛋白 5 门控纳米装置，用于按需输送表面活性剂以对抗白色念珠菌感染
abstract_zh: 真菌感染发病率的不断上升，加上抗真菌耐药性的出现，构成了全球公共卫生的巨大挑战。白色念珠菌是一种常见的机会性真菌，可导致危及生命的广泛念珠菌病，尤其是在免疫功能低下的患者中。传统的抗真菌药物，包括唑类、棘白菌素类和多烯类，具有一些缺点，例如宿主毒性和耐药真菌菌株的快速出现。为了克服这些限制，我们使用介孔二氧化硅纳米颗粒设计了一种刺激响应的门控抗菌纳米颗粒，用抗菌肽组蛋白 5 (Hst5) 进行功能化，并负载表面活性剂 (3-(甲基)-1-十四烷基咪唑) [C14MIM]+。纳米颗粒对白色念珠菌表现出有效的抗菌活性，其最低抑制浓度值与目前的临床抗真菌药物相当。至关重要的是，纳米装置表现出双重作用机制，导致膜破裂并诱导活性氧的产生，从而有效地阻碍耐药性的发展。此外，纳米颗粒与传统抗真菌药物表现出强烈的协同相互作用，显着增强其功效。除了其浮游活性外，该系统还能有效抑制生物膜形成，并表现出与人类真皮细胞系的高度生物相容性。基于这些结果，纳米装置成功地融入伤口敷料基质中，证明了其在皮肤局部治疗方面的巨大转化潜力。

title: Stereodynamism in Pentacoordinate Al(Salen) Catalysts
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: M(Salen) complexes are totemic in asymmetric catalysis on account of the generality and selectivity that they confer. Consequently, the development of unifying models to place the function of these disruptive actors on a structural foundation is essential to sustain innovation. Motivated by the transformative effect that the Jacobsen catalyst (M = Al) has had on contemporary synthesis, a thorough three-dimensional structural investigation of the solution phase behavior of Al(Salen) complexes is reported, and complemented by solid-state 27Al MAS NMR and computational investigations. This interdisciplinary analysis of the venerable Al(Salen)Cl complex reveals a rapid equilibrium of R,R-(M) and R,R-(P) species in solution enabled by intermolecular halide-catalyzed rearrangements. Contrary to established models, the backbone remains in the trans-diequatorial conformation: the antipodal (axial) configurations (M/P) are enforced by a change in coordination geometry between square based pyramidal (sbp) and distorted trigonal bipyramidal (dtbp). The occurrence of orthogonal helical diastereomers, with conserved point chirality [R,R-(M) and R,R-(P)] converges on a revised model to describe the behavior of pentacoordinate M(Salen) complexes based on the Addison geometry parameter τ. Stereodynamism resulting from dynamic metal coordination geometry is determined to be a key parameter that should be considered in future reaction design and induction models. It is envisaged that this intriguing behavior of pentacoordinate Al(Salen) complexes will find application beyond asymmetric catalysis.
title_zh: 五配位 Al(Salen) 催化剂的立体动力学
abstract_zh: M(Salen) 配合物因其所赋予的通用性和选择性而成为不对称催化中的图腾。因此，开发统一模型以将这些破坏性参与者的功能置于结构基础上对于维持创新至关重要。受 Jacobsen 催化剂 (M = Al) 对当代合成的变革性影响的启发，报告了对 Al(Salen) 配合物溶液相行为的彻底三维结构研究，并辅以固态 27Al MAS NMR 和计算研究。对古老的 Al(Salen)Cl 配合物的跨学科分析揭示了溶液中 R,R-(M) 和 R,R-(P) 物质通过分子间卤化物催化重排实现的快速平衡。与已建立的模型相反，主干仍然处于跨双赤道构象：对映（轴向）构型（M/P）是通过基于方形的金字塔（sbp）和扭曲的三角双锥（dtbp）之间的配位几何形状的变化来强制执行的。具有保守点手性 [R,R-(M) 和 R,R-(P)] 的正交螺旋非对映异构体的出现收敛于修正模型，以描述基于 Addison 几何参数 τ 的五配位 M(Salen) 配合物的行为。动态金属配位几何结构产生的立体动力学被确定为未来反应设计和感应模型中应考虑的关键参数。预计五配位 Al(Salen) 配合物的这种有趣行为将在不对称催化之外找到应用

title: Interface Reconstruction Induced by Rare-Earth Incorporation Stabilizes High-Coordination Cu + Sites for Efficient Electrochemical Nitrate Reduction to Ammonia
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: The electrochemical nitrate reduction reaction (eNO3-RR) represents a promising route for simultaneous wastewater treatment and sustainable ammonia synthesis. While Cu2O catalysts featuring electron-deficient Cu+ sites have been widely studied for eNO3-RR, their practical implementation is hindered by self-reduction and structural instability. Constructing Cu-O-M interfacial sites, which enhance charge transfer and stabilize catalytic sites, presents an effective strategy for addressing these challenges. Here, we report a La incorporation strategy to create Cu2O-LayO heterointerfaces (Cu1La4) for highly efficient conversion of NH3. Experimental and theoretical studies indicate that the high-coordinated Cu+ active sites at the Cu2O/La2O2(CO3) interface, together with the steric hindrance introduced by La incorporation, optimize the adsorption energy of key intermediates, thereby circumventing the high energy barrier associated with the *NH3→NH3 transition on traditional low-coordination Cu+ sites. Furthermore, the covalent Cu-O-La interfacial bonding inhibits Cu+ reduction and stabilizes the catalytic system. The optimized Cu1La4 catalyst demonstrates outstanding eNO3-RR performance, achieving a Faradaic efficiency (FE) of 94% at -0.6 V and an NH3 yield rate of 234 μmol h-1 cm-2. Significantly, the Cu1La4 catalyst exhibited exceptional stability in a membrane electrode assembly (MEA), sustaining ∼7.8 mg h-1 cm-2 NH3 production and high FE of ∼85% over 150 h at 400 mA.
title_zh: 稀土掺入引起的界面重建稳定了高配位 Cu + 位点，用于有效电化学硝酸盐还原为氨
abstract_zh: 电化学硝酸盐还原反应（eNO3-RR）代表了同步废水处理和可持续氨合成的一条有前途的途径。虽然具有缺电子 Cu+ 位点的 Cu2O 催化剂已被广泛研究用于 eNO3-RR，但其实际应用受到自还原和结构不稳定的阻碍。构建可增强电荷转移并稳定催化位点的 Cu-O-M 界面位点，为解决这些挑战提供了有效的策略。在这里，我们报告了一种 La 掺入策略，以创建 Cu2O-LayO 异质界面 (Cu1La4)，以实现 NH3 的高效转化。实验和理论研究表明，Cu2O/La2O2(CO3)界面上的高配位Cu+活性位点，加上La引入引入的空间位阻，优化了关键中间体的吸附能，从而规避了传统低配位Cu+位点上与*NH3→NH3转变相关的高能垒。此外，共价Cu-O-La界面键合抑制了Cu+还原并稳定了催化体系。优化后的 Cu1La4 催化剂表现出出色的 eNO3-RR 性能，在 -0.6 V 下实现了 94% 的法拉第效率 (FE)，NH3 产率为 234 μmol h-1 cm-2。值得注意的是，Cu1La4 催化剂在膜电极组件 (MEA) 中表现出卓越的稳定性，在 400 mA 电流下 150 小时内可维持约 7.8 mg h-1 cm-2 NH3 的产量和约 85% 的高 FE。

title: Inherent Photoluminescence-Enhanced Daytime Radiative Cooling by Highly Crystalline Cellulose Films
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Frequent high-temperature weather imposes high demands on the performance of passive daytime radiative cooling (PDRC) materials. Natural cellulose is a sustainable raw material with promising PDRC performance based on its unique macromolecular structure and hierarchical aggregation structure. However, it is still a great challenge to improve the PDRC performance of regenerated cellulose materials. In this work, it is found that the high crystal structure of the regenerated cellulose film can enhance its photoluminescence (PL) capacity. This intrinsic PL behavior will enhance its PDRC performance through the photon conversion mechanism. By converting the absorbed ultraviolet band photons into visible light for emission effectively, the regenerated cellulose film presents a higher reflectivity in the visible light band and a higher cooling power. The regenerated cellulose film with a crystallinity of 73.71% can achieve an average reflectivity of 93.48% in the 0.3-2.5 μm waveband, which is 4.79% higher than that of the regenerated cellulose film without PL enhancement, thereby increasing the cooling power by 115.9%. This kind of highly crystalline cellulose film with high PDRC performance is expected to make contributions to energy conservation in cities under diverse climatic conditions.
title_zh: 高结晶纤维素薄膜的固有光致发光增强日间辐射冷却
abstract_zh: 频繁的高温天气对被动日间辐射冷却（PDRC）材料的性能提出了很高的要求。天然纤维素是一种可持续的原材料，基于其独特的大分子结构和分级聚集结构，具有良好的PDRC性能。然而，提高再生纤维素材料的PDRC性能仍然是一个巨大的挑战。在这项工作中，发现再生纤维素膜的高晶体结构可以增强其光致发光（PL）能力。这种固有的 PL 行为将通过光子转换机制增强其 PDRC 性能。通过有效地将吸收的紫外波段光子转化为可见光发射，再生纤维素膜在可见光波段呈现出更高的反射率和更高的冷却能力。结晶度为73.71%的再生纤维素膜在0.3-2.5μm波段可实现93.48%的平均反射率，比未增强PL的再生纤维素膜提高4.79%，从而使制冷功率提高115.9%。这种具有高PDRC性能的高结晶纤维素薄膜有望为不同气候条件下的城市节能做出贡献。

title: Confidence-guided cryo-EM map optimisation with LocScale-2.0
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Cryogenic sample electron microscopy (cryo-EM) maps often display uneven quality, with high-resolution features coexisting alongside weak or poorly ordered regions. Such variation complicates structural interpretation, especially for heterogeneous macromolecular assemblies. Here, we present LocScale-2.0, a context-aware map optimisation framework that operates without prior knowledge of molecular structure or composition. By leveraging general expectations of electron scattering by biological macromolecules, it enhances local detail and connectivity while preserving weak but biologically relevant structural context. We further introduce LocScale-FEM, a Bayesian approximate deep-learning approach that emulates this optimisation to generate feature-enhanced maps. LocScaleFEM provides voxel-wise confidence scores that give a statistically grounded measure of reliability, are sensitive to local phase error in the feature-enhanced map, and highlight regions where interpretation warrants caution. Selected examples illustrate how confidence-guided map optimisation can aid biological interpretation and increase objectivity in cryo-EM density analysis.
title_zh: 使用 LocScale-2.0 进行置信引导的冷冻电镜图优化
abstract_zh: 低温样品电子显微镜 (cryo-EM) 图通常显示质量不均匀，高分辨率特征与弱或秩序不良的区域共存。这种变化使结构解释变得复杂，特别是对于异质大分子组装体。在这里，我们提出了 LocScale-2.0，一个上下文感知的地图优化框架，无需事先了解分子结构或组成即可运行。通过利用生物大分子对电子散射的普遍预期，它增强了局部细节和连接性，同时保留了微弱但与生物相关的结构背景。我们进一步介绍 LocScale-FEM，这是一种贝叶斯近似深度学习方法，可以模拟这种优化来生成特征增强的地图。 LocScaleFEM 提供体素方面的置信度评分，提供基于统计的可靠性度量，对特征增强地图中的局部相位误差敏感，并突出显示需要谨慎解释的区域。选定的示例说明了置信引导图优化如何帮助生物学解释并提高冷冻电镜密度分析的客观性。

title: Consequences of agricultural deforestation and subsequent afforestation on soil biodiversity and ecosystem multifunctionality
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The Earth is currently in an era where massive deforestation and afforestation coexist. The impact of large-scale agricultural deforestation and the subsequent afforestation on soil biota multidiversity, ecosystem multifunctionality (EMF), and the relationship between soil biota multidiversity and EMF (BEFm) remain unclear. Here, we investigate 405 paired plots along a 4000 km south-north transect, spanning tropical, subtropical, temperate, and boreal zones. We measure 19 ecological functions and sequence soil biota (including bacteria, fungi, archaea, viruses, protists, and invertebrates) and metagenomes. We find that agricultural deforestation reduces soil multitrophic biodiversity by 25% and EMF by 58%, and afforestation has partially restored them, but pristine levels have not been reached. Agricultural deforestation decouples the positive BEFm relationship across four climatic zones, while afforestation restores the positive BEFm relationship in tropics and subtropics but not in temperate and boreal zones. Afforestation in the warmer zone triggers potential multitrophic cascades to enhance EMF, thereby strengthening BEFm relationship. The changes in biogeochemical-cycling genes induced by afforestation exert more significant driving effects on EMF in the warmer zone than the colder zone. Our study provides integrative evidence that climate modulates the recovery of BEFm relationship and offers multitrophic and metagenomic insights into the mechanisms underlying EMF.
title_zh: 农业毁林和随后的造林对土壤生物多样性和生态系统多功能性的影响
abstract_zh: 地球目前正处于大规模砍伐森林与植树造林并存的时代。大规模农业砍伐和随后的造林对土壤生物群多样性、生态系统多功能性（EMF）的影响以及土壤生物群多样性与EMF（BEFm）之间的关系仍不清楚。在这里，我们调查了 4000 公里南北横断面上的 405 个配对地块，横跨热带、亚热带、温带和寒带。我们测量 19 种生态功能并对土壤生物群（包括细菌、真菌、古细菌、病毒、原生生物和无脊椎动物）和宏基因组进行测序。我们发现，农业砍伐使土壤多营养生物多样性减少了 25%，电磁场减少了 58%，而植树造林已部分恢复了这些生物多样性，但尚未达到原始水平。农业毁林使四个气候带的 BEFm 正关系脱钩，而造林恢复了热带和亚热带的 BEFm 正关系，但在温带和北方地区则不然。温暖地区的造林会引发潜在的多营养级联，从而增强 EMF，从而加强 BEFm 关系。造林引起的生物地球化学循环基因的变化对温暖地区电磁场的驱动作用比寒冷地区更显着。我们的研究提供了气候调节 BEFm 关系恢复的综合证据，并为 EMF 的机制提供了多营养和宏基因组的见解。

title: Core elements play distinct roles in promoter birth and transcriptional regulation
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Gene expression shapes phenotypes and evolution. However, studies of gene regulation focus on transcription factors, overlooking core promoters. To investigate how promoters emerge and regulate transcription, we determine the sequence–function landscapes of core elements, −35 and −10, in constitutive and transcription factor-regulated promoters in Escherichia coli. Characterization of in vivo transcriptional landscapes and in vitro RNA polymerase–promoter interactions shows the −10 element as essential for promoter evolution from random sequences. In contrast, the −35 element, though broadly conserved, is dispensable for promoter birth. Instead, it exerts greater impact on gene regulation via coordinated interactions with transcription activators and RNA polymerase. We further show that evolution fine-tunes the −35 and −10 sequences of transcription factor-regulated promoters to achieve near-maximal fold changes by lowering basal while elevating induced expression. A notable exception is PluxI, whose leaky expression provides a crucial baseline for initiating quorum sensing. These findings elucidate promoter design principles and underscore the interdependence and coevolution of core elements, RNA polymerase, and transcription factors.
title_zh: 核心元件在启动子诞生和转录调控中发挥独特作用
abstract_zh: 基因表达塑造表型和进化。然而，基因调控的研究主要集中在转录因子上，而忽视了核心启动子。为了研究启动子如何出现并调节转录，我们确定了大肠杆菌组成型和转录因子调节启动子中核心元件-35和-10的序列功能图谱。体内转录景观和体外 RNA 聚合酶启动子相互作用的表征表明 -10 元件对于启动子从随机序列进化至关重要。相比之下，-35 元素虽然广泛保守，但对于启动子的诞生来说是可有可无的。相反，它通过与转录激活剂和 RNA 聚合酶的协调相互作用对基因调控产生更大的影响。我们进一步表明，进化微调转录因子调节启动子的-35和-10序列，通过降低基础表达同时提高诱导表达来实现接近最大的倍数变化。一个值得注意的例外是 PluxI，其泄漏表达为启动群体感应提供了关键的基线。这些发现阐明了启动子设计原理，并强调了核心元件、RNA 聚合酶和转录因子的相互依赖性和共同进化。
