title: Nonplanar Monomer Strategy for Soluble Covalent Organic Frameworks with Reversible Thermal Behavior
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: The inherent insolubility and poor processability of conventional covalent organic frameworks (COFs) represent a formidable obstacle to their practical deployment. Herein, we present a molecular design paradigm that circumvents this limitation by using a nonplanar monomer featuring a sterically congested, double‑layer conjugated benzene ring to construct a soluble heat-triggered solubility COF (HTS-COF). This structure substantially enlarges the interlayer spacing and attenuates π-π stacking interactions, thereby conferring reversible heat‑triggered solubility without compromising crystallinity or structural integrity. The resultant HTS‑COF readily undergoes solution processing into uniform membranes and aerogels. Notably, under dynamic filtration, the HTS‑COF membrane achieves expeditious and highly efficient iodine sequestration from both aqueous and organic media, exhibiting outstanding rejection efficiency and cycling stability.
title_zh: 具有可逆热行为的可溶性共价有机框架的非平面单体策略
abstract_zh: 传统共价有机框架（COF）固有的不溶性和较差的加工性能对其实际应用构成了巨大的障碍。在此，我们提出了一种分子设计范式，通过使用具有空间拥挤的双层共轭苯环的非平面单体来构建可溶性热触发溶解性COF（HTS-COF），从而规避了这一限制。这种结构大大扩大了层间距并减弱了 π-π 堆积相互作用，从而在不影响结晶度或结构完整性的情况下赋予可逆的热引发溶解度。由此产生的 HTS-COF 很容易通过溶液加工成均匀的膜和气凝胶。值得注意的是，在动态过滤下，HTS-COF 膜可从水性和有机介质中实现快速高效的碘螯合，表现出出色的截留效率和循环稳定性。

title: Interlayer-Free Ferroelectric Transistors via Depletion Charge Boosting in Oxide Channel for Neuromorphic Applications
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Oxide semiconductors are considered one of the promising candidates to replace silicon as the channel material in ferroelectric field-effect transistors (FeFETs), owing to their compatibility with low-temperature complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) processing. However, intrinsic hole deficiency in oxide semiconductors limits complete ferroelectric polarization switching, and practical channel engineering strategies to overcome this limitation have rarely been demonstrated. This study demonstrates a depletion charge boosting method via in situ Ar+ plasma treatment during atomic layer deposition of the indium-gallium oxide (IGO) channel. Under the optimized plasma treatment condition (300 W for 60 s), plasma-induced ionized oxygen vacancies in the IGO front channel function as depletion charges that compensate for the negative bound charges in the zirconium-doped HfO2 (HZO) layer. The engineered IGO/HZO FeFETs exhibit an improved memory window of 1.612 V, potentiation/depression cycling up to 5120 pulses, and stable multi-level retention of 100 s for 64 conductance states. Furthermore, the multilayer perception-based artificial neural network simulations yield a recognition accuracy of approximately 89% after 125 training epochs. This depletion charge boosting technology provides a potential pathway for improving oxide channel-based FeFETs toward neuromorphic applications.
title_zh: 通过氧化物通道中的耗尽电荷增强实现神经形态应用的无层间铁电晶体管
abstract_zh: 由于氧化物半导体与低温互补金属氧化物半导体（CMOS）工艺的兼容性，氧化物半导体被认为是替代硅作为铁电场效应晶体管（FeFET）沟道材料的有前途的候选材料之一。然而，氧化物半导体中固有的空穴缺陷限制了完全的铁电极化转变，并且克服这种限制的实用沟道工程策略很少被证明。本研究展示了在氧化铟镓 (IGO) 通道原子层沉积期间通过原位 Ar+ 等离子体处理的耗尽电荷增强方法。在优化的等离子体处理条件下（300 W，60 s），IGO 前通道中等离子体诱导的电离氧空位充当耗尽电荷，补偿锆掺杂 HfO2 (HZO) 层中的负束缚电荷。工程化的 IGO/HZO FeFET 具有 1.612 V 的改进存储窗口、高达 5120 个脉冲的增强/抑制循环以及 64 种电导状态的 100 秒的稳定多级保留。此外，基于多层感知的人工神经网络模拟在 125 个训练周期后的识别准确率约为 89%。这种耗尽电荷增强技术为改进基于氧化物通道的 FeFET 走向神经形态应用提供了一条潜在途径。

title: Homogenizing Interfacial Electric Fields through a Nanoporous CaSO 4 -Based Artificial SEI for Long-Lifespan Zinc Metal Anodes
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Despite the high energy density, intrinsic safety, and low cost that render aqueous zinc-ion batteries attractive, their practical viability is compromised by capacity decay and internal short circuits-phenomena traceable to uncontrolled dendritic growth during non-uniform Zn stripping/plating. In this work, we propose a cost-effective nanoporous CaSO4 coating strategy to enable the uniform zinc deposition. In situ dendrite visualization, scanning electron microscopy, and laser confocal microscopy collectively corroborate its exceptional dendrite-suppression capability. The artificial interlayer's ability to homogenize the interfacial electric field underpins the remarkable cyclability of the Zn@CaSO4 symmetric cell. Consequently, it maintains stable operation for over 1700 h at 1 mA cm-2 and 1 mAh cm-2, a duration that represents a 16-fold improvement relative to an unmodified Zn electrode. Furthermore, extended cycling reveals the durability of the Zn@CaSO4||MnO2 configuration. At a current density of 1 A g-1, it maintains a specific capacity of 158 mAh g-1 over 1000 cycles, achieving a capacity retention as high as 72.7%. The study pioneers nanoporous CaSO4 as a low-cost, eco-friendly, and readily scalable protective layer for Zn anodes, significantly enhancing cycling stability and capacity retention.
title_zh: 通过基于纳米多孔 CaSO 4 的人工 SEI 均匀化界面电场，实现长寿命锌金属阳极
abstract_zh: 尽管水性锌离子电池具有高能量密度、本质安全性和低成本等优点，但其实际可行性受到容量衰减和内部短路现象的影响，这些现象可追溯到非均匀锌剥离/电镀过程中不受控制的枝晶生长。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种经济高效的纳米多孔 CaSO4 涂层策略，以实现均匀的锌沉积。原位枝晶可视化、扫描电子显微镜和激光共焦显微镜共同证实了其卓越的枝晶抑制能力。人工中间层均匀化界面电场的能力支撑着 Zn@CaSO4 对称电池卓越的循环性能。因此，它在 1 mA cm-2 和 1 mAh cm-2 下保持稳定运行超过 1700 小时，相对于未改性的 Zn 电极，该持续时间提高了 16 倍。此外，延长的循环显示了 Zn@CaSO4||MnO2 配置的耐久性。在1 A g-1的电流密度下，经过1000次循环仍保持158 mAh g-1的比容量，容量保持率高达72.7%。该研究开创了纳米多孔 CaSO4 作为一种低成本、环保且易于扩展的锌阳极保护层，显着提高了循环稳定性和容量保持率。

title: An enzyme-specific protein language model for catalytic property prediction
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Enzymes drive cellular metabolism, yet predicting catalytic properties from amino acid sequences remains challenging. Existing protein language models (PLMs) provide powerful general-purpose representations but are often inefficient for high-throughput screening and insufficiently adapted to enzyme-specific tasks. Here, we propose EnzGFM, an enzyme-specific PLM based on a Mamba-Transformer hybrid architecture with hierarchical pre-training to capture enzyme-specific patterns. Across enzyme property prediction benchmarks, EnzGFM consistently outperforms Transformer-based PLMs with 2–5-fold acceleration, achieving relative improvements of 16.67% in kinetic parameter prediction, 15.69% in enzyme-reaction mapping, 13.19% in EC number classification, and 20.04% in mutation effect assessment. Building on EnzGFM, we develop EnzGFM-Agent, an enzyme-focused agentic pipeline. Experimental validation further suggests that EnzGFM-Agent can enrich beneficial variants within small candidate pools. Together, these results demonstrate that EnzGFM captures enzyme-specific sequence-function patterns, while EnzGFM-Agent translates these predictions into experimentally actionable candidates and can help reduce wet-lab screening burden for practical enzyme engineering.
title_zh: 用于催化特性预测的酶特异性蛋白质语言模型
abstract_zh: 酶驱动细胞新陈代谢，但从氨基酸序列预测催化特性仍然具有挑战性。现有的蛋白质语言模型（PLM）提供了强大的通用表示，但对于高通量筛选通常效率低下，并且不足以适应酶特异性任务。在这里，我们提出了 EnzGFM，一种基于 Mamba-Transformer 混合架构的酶特异性 PLM，具有分层预训练来捕获酶特异性模式。在酶特性预测基准中，EnzGFM 始终优于基于 Transformer 的 PLM，加速速度提高了 2-5 倍，在动力学参数预测方面相对提高了 16.67%，在酶反应图谱方面相对提高了 15.69%，在 EC 数分类方面提高了 13.19%，在突变效应评估方面提高了 20.04%。在 EnzGFM 的基础上，我们开发了 EnzGFM-Agent，这是一种以酶为中心的代理管道。实验验证进一步表明 EnzGFM-Agent 可以丰富小型候选池中的有益变体。总之，这些结果表明 EnzGFM 捕获酶特异性序列功能模式，而 EnzGFM-Agent 将这些预测转化为实验上可行的候选物，并有助于减轻实际酶工程的湿实验室筛选负担。

title: Bootstrapping multimodal large language model with medical knowledge for automatic esophagogastroduodenoscopy diagnosis and reporting
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Esophagogastroduodenoscopy (EGD) is an essential clinical procedure for diagnosing gastrointestinal (GI) diseases, while the subsequent EGD reports play a vital role in clinical decision-making and therapeutic interventions. This paper makes the first attempt to bootstrap Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLM) with medical knowledge for EGD diagnosis and reporting (EDR). We collected the largest multicentric EGD dataset so far, containing 4461 participants with 203,838 EGD images and 4461 corresponding EGD reports. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method, MLLM-EDR, achieves an average diagnostic accuracy of 0.882 for nineteen GI diseases, outperforming both state-of-the-art AI models (0.720) and junior endoscopists (0.784). The completeness and facticity scores of our generated reports match the quality of those created by senior endoscopists. Moreover, our method substantially reduces the endoscopists’ workload from 7 minutes to 13.48 seconds. These results highlight the vigor and significance of MLLM-EDR for AI-assisted EGD diagnostic and reporting applications.
title_zh: 利用医学知识引导多模态大语言模型，用于自动食管胃十二指肠镜诊断和报告
abstract_zh: 食管胃十二指肠镜检查（EGD）是诊断胃肠道（GI）疾病的重要临床检查，而随后的EGD报告在临床决策和治疗干预中发挥着至关重要的作用。本文首次尝试利用医学知识引导多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 用于 EGD 诊断和报告 (EDR)。我们收集了迄今为止最大的多中心 EGD 数据集，包含 4461 名参与者、203,838 张 EGD 图像和 4461 份相应的 EGD 报告。实验结果表明，所提出的方法 MLLM-EDR 对 19 种胃肠道疾病的平均诊断准确度为 0.882，优于最先进的人工智能模型 (0.720) 和初级内窥镜医师 (0.784)。我们生成的报告的完整性和真实性得分与高级内窥镜医师创建的报告的质量相匹配。此外，我们的方法将内窥镜医师的工作量从 7 分钟减少到 13.48 秒。这些结果凸显了 MLLM-EDR 对于人工智能辅助 EGD 诊断和报告应用的活力和意义。

title: Compressive learning scaffolds higher-order network structure to enhance human knowledge acquisition
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Humans naturally seek knowledge, yet integrating vast, fragmented information remains challenging. Traditionally, knowledge acquisition has relied on random walks within network—an unguided and inefficient process. Here, we introduce “compressive learning”, a conceptual framework that embeds higher-order structural features—specifically node-degree inhomogeneity—into pre-learning trajectories to scaffold more efficient learning. We show that scale-free networks, owing to their pronounced degree inhomogeneity, are more compressible and more learnable than other network types. Critically, pre-learning paths that highlight this inhomogeneous higher-order structure facilitate subsequent network learning. Magnetoencephalography (MEG) recordings reveal that compressive pre-learning enhances structured neural representations in the dorsal anterior cingulate cortex (ACC). Two-stage computational modeling indicates that compressive learning constructs a network skeleton defined by higher-order structure that efficiently accommodates new inputs. Together, our results highlight the central role of higher-order network structure in human learning and offer a strategic approach to effectively integrating fragmented information into a coherent knowledge framework.
title_zh: 压缩学习支架高阶网络结构以增强人类知识获取
abstract_zh: 人类自然地寻求知识，但整合大量、碎片化的信息仍然具有挑战性。传统上，知识获取依赖于网络内的随机游走——一个无指导且低效的过程。在这里，我们引入“压缩学习”，这是一种概念框架，它将高阶结构特征（特别是节点度不均匀性）嵌入到预学习轨迹中，以支持更有效的学习。我们表明，无标度网络由于其明显的程度不均匀性，比其他网络类型更具可压缩性和可学习性。至关重要的是，突出这种非同质高阶结构的预学习路径有利于后续的网络学习。脑磁图（MEG）记录显示，压缩预学习增强了背侧前扣带皮层（ACC）的结构化神经表征。两阶段计算模型表明，压缩学习构建了一个由高阶结构定义的网络骨架，可以有效地容纳新的输入。总之，我们的结果强调了高阶网络结构在人类学习中的核心作用，并提供了一种有效地将碎片信息整合到连贯知识框架中的战略方法。

title: IL-26-driven epigenetic remodeling promotes immune evasion in colorectal cancer
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Cancer cells acquire malignant traits through epigenetic remodeling driven by inflammatory secretomes in the tumor microenvironment. However, how immune-derived inflammatory factors regulate cancer cell epigenetics remains poorly understood. Here, we show that IL-26 produced by tumor-specific type 17 T cells acts as a key mediator of epigenetic reprogramming associated with cancer malignancy. We identify selective accumulation of IL-26–expressing T cells in colorectal tumors resistant to immune checkpoint blockade therapy. IL-26 functions as a noncanonical cytokine by translocating into the nucleus of tumor cells, where it directly binds STAT1 and forms transcriptional complexes with NF-κB and AP-1. Nuclear IL-26 induces a transcriptionally active chromatin state characterized by BRD4 and H3K27ac enrichment, resulting in upregulation of CXCL chemokines. This process promotes neutrophil infiltration and enhances immune evasion and tumor progression by suppressing CD8 + T cell responses. Together, these findings support a model in which tumor-specific type 17 T cells directly reprogram cancer cell epigenetics through IL-26, reshaping the tumor immune microenvironment to promote immune evasion.
title_zh: IL-26驱动的表观遗传重塑促进结直肠癌的免疫逃避
abstract_zh: 癌细胞通过肿瘤微环境中炎症分泌组驱动的表观遗传重塑获得恶性特征。然而，免疫源性炎症因子如何调节癌细胞表观遗传学仍知之甚少。在这里，我们证明肿瘤特异性 17 型 T 细胞产生的 IL-26 是与癌症恶性肿瘤相关的表观遗传重编程的关键介质。我们发现，结直肠肿瘤中表达 IL-26 的 T 细胞选择性积累，对免疫检查点阻断疗法具有抗性。 IL-26 通过易位到肿瘤细胞的细胞核中发挥非典型细胞因子的作用，在细胞核中直接结合 STAT1 并与 NF-κB 和 AP-1 形成转录复合物。核 IL-26 诱导转录活性染色质状态，其特征是 BRD4 和 H3K27ac 富集，导致 CXCL 趋化因子上调。该过程通过抑制 CD8 + T 细胞反应促进中性粒细胞浸润并增强免疫逃避和肿瘤进展。总之，这些发现支持了一种模型，其中肿瘤特异性 17 型 T 细胞通过 IL-26 直接重新编程癌细胞表观遗传学，重塑肿瘤免疫微环境以促进免疫逃避。

title: Convergent nuclear proteostasis alterations across 40S ribosomal protein deficiencies
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Defects in ribosome biogenesis cause ribosomopathies, but the pathogenic role of malformed preribosomes remains unclear. Using preribosome fractionation, live-cell and confocal microscopy, and automated imaging screens, we tracked abortive preribosomes following depletion of the 33 small-subunit ribosomal proteins (RPSs). We found that all RPS deficiencies lead to accumulation of nucleolar preribosome materials in the nucleoplasm, regardless of the affected 40S subunit maturation stage. These aberrant particles appear as dispersed complexes or persistent aggregates arising during nucleolar reassembly in late mitosis. Although nucleolar morphology remains largely intact, their accumulation impairs recycling of nucleolar factors and disrupts nucleolar–nucleoplasmic proteostasis. Distinct RPS deficiencies produce different preribosome behaviors, indicating maturation-specific properties. Notably, depletion of RPS19, the protein encoded by the most frequently mutated gene in Diamond–Blackfan anemia, causes particularly severe defects. Our findings identify nucleoplasmic preribosome aggregation and dispersion as common consequences of RPS deficits and potential contributors to 40S ribosomopathy pathogenesis.
title_zh: 40S 核糖体蛋白缺陷的趋同性核蛋白内稳态改变
abstract_zh: 核糖体生物发生的缺陷导致核糖体病，但畸形前核糖体的致病作用仍不清楚。使用前核糖体分离、活细胞和共聚焦显微镜以及自动成像屏幕，我们追踪了 33 种小亚基核糖体蛋白 (RPS) 耗尽后失效的前核糖体。我们发现，无论受影响的 40S 亚基成熟阶段如何，所有 RPS 缺陷都会导致核仁前核糖体材料在核质中积累。这些异常颗粒表现为分散的复合物或持久的聚集体，是在有丝分裂后期的核仁重新组装过程中产生的。尽管核仁形态基本保持完整，但它们的积累会损害核仁因子的循环并破坏核仁-核质蛋白质稳态。不同的 RPS 缺陷会产生不同的前核糖体行为，表明成熟特异性。值得注意的是，RPS19（由 Diamond-Blackfan 贫血中最常见的突变基因编码的蛋白质）的缺失会导致特别严重的缺陷。我们的研究结果表明，核质前核糖体聚集和分散是 RPS 缺陷的常见后果，也是 40S 核糖体病发病机制的潜在因素。

title: A magic methyl effect in the active site of a methyltransferase ribozyme
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The chemical richness of RNAs is greatly enhanced by post-transcriptional modifications with RNA methylation as the most prominent type. RNA modifications modulate the stability, folding and interaction pattern of RNA molecules. Furthermore, emerging data suggests RNA modifications also directly regulate the activity of catalytic RNA molecules, i.e., ribozymes. Here, we employ classical and hybrid quantum-classical (QM/MM) molecular dynamics (MD) simulations to investigate the reaction mechanism of an artificial methyltransferase ribozyme MTR1. Importantly, we pinpoint how 2’-O-methylations of active site nucleotides synergistically enhance ribozyme activity by reducing the conformational flexibility of the ribose rings and rigidifying the active site. Finally, the herein reported crystal structure of the modified MTR1, solved at 2.6 Å resolution, validates the results of our simulations. Taken together, our work supports the purported central role of modified RNA for early RNA catalysis and may guide rational design of more efficient ribozymes.
title_zh: 甲基转移酶核酶活性位点的神奇甲基效应
abstract_zh: RNA 的化学丰富度通过转录后修饰大大增强，其中 RNA 甲基化是最突出的类型。 RNA 修饰调节 RNA 分子的稳定性、折叠和相互作用模式。此外，新出现的数据表明 RNA 修饰还直接调节催化 RNA 分子（即核酶）的活性。在这里，我们采用经典和混合量子经典 (QM/MM) 分子动力学 (MD) 模拟来研究人工甲基转移酶核酶 MTR1 的反应机制。重要的是，我们查明了活性位点核苷酸的 2'-O-甲基化如何通过降低核糖环的构象灵活性和刚性化活性位点来协同增强核酶活性。最后，本文报道的修改后的 MTR1 晶体结构以 2.6 Å 分辨率求解，验证了我们的模拟结果。总而言之，我们的工作支持了所谓的修饰 RNA 在早期 RNA 催化中的核心作用，并可能指导更有效核酶的合理设计。

title: Direct Deposition of C 60 -Free SnO x Electron Contact on Perovskite Enables Efficient and Outdoor-Stable Inverted Solar Modules
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Fullerene-free electron transport layers (ETLs) are highly attractive for lowering the cost and simplifying the fabrication of inverted perovskite photovoltaics, but directly depositing inorganic ETLs on perovskite remains challenging. Here, we develop a low-cost SnOx-based ETL that can be blade-coated directly onto perovskite films without using C60 or other fullerene-derivative interlayers. Solvent engineering with 1-hexanol prolongs the wet-film lifetime and improves SnOx film formation, yielding a smooth and compact ETL, while yttrium doping optimizes the interfacial energetics and promotes efficient electron extraction. Consequently, the directly deposited C60-free ETL enables small-area devices with a power conversion efficiency of 19.15% and an open-circuit voltage of 1.06 V. Importantly, this strategy is readily extended to 21 cm2 monolithic modules, delivering a champion efficiency of 15.82% with a geometric fill factor of 97.27%. The encapsulated modules retain 91.03% of their initial efficiency after 1000 h of maximum power point tracking at 40 °C and 50% relative humidity and also demonstrate stable outdoor operation over 63 days. These results highlight a practical and scalable route toward low-cost, efficient, and stable C60-free inverted perovskite solar modules.
title_zh: 在钙钛矿上直接沉积无 C 60 SnO x 电子接触可实现高效且户外稳定的倒置太阳能模块
abstract_zh: 无富勒烯电子传输层（ETL）对于降低成本和简化倒置钙钛矿光伏电池的制造非常有吸引力，但在钙钛矿上直接沉积无机 ETL 仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们开发了一种低成本的基于 SnOx 的 ETL，可以直接刮涂到钙钛矿薄膜上，而无需使用 C60 或其他富勒烯衍生物中间层。使用 1-己醇进行溶剂工程可延长湿膜寿命并改善 SnOx 薄膜的形成，从而产生光滑且紧凑的 ETL，而钇掺杂可优化界面能量并促进有效的电子提取。因此，直接沉积的无 C60 ETL 使小面积器件的功率转换效率为 19.15%，开路电压为 1.06 V。重要的是，该策略很容易扩展到 21 cm2 单片模块，提供 15.82% 的冠军效率和 97.27% 的几何填充因子。在 40°C 和 50% 相对湿度下进行 1000 小时的最大功率点跟踪后，封装模块仍保留了 91.03% 的初始效率，并且还表现出 63 天的稳定户外运行。这些结果突出了一条实用且可扩展的路线，用于实现低成本、高效且稳定的无 C60 倒置钙钛矿太阳能模块。

title: Water-catalyzed ultrafast formation of hydronium clusters
source: National Science Review Advance Access
abstract: Water catalyzes proton transport through hydrogen-bond networks, yet the minimal structural complexity required to initiate this behavior remains unresolved. Here, we track the birth of the hydrated proton by monitoring the ultrafast formation of size-selected hydronium clusters (H2O)n-1H+ in real time using femtosecond reaction microscopy. We observe a kinetic collapse in the formation timescale, which drops from ∼ 259 fs for the water dimer (n = 2) to ∼ 70 fs for the trimer (n = 3) before converging for larger sizes. This identifies the cyclic water trimer as the minimal catalytic unit. Ab initio molecular dynamics simulations reveal that this acceleration is not driven by the initial proton transfer step, which remains ultrafast, but by the elimination of the reaction barrier governing the separation of the hydronium-solvated products. Our findings demonstrate that the cooperative action of just three water molecules establishes the critical topological threshold for efficient water catalysis, providing a microscopic blueprint for the onset of broader aqueous reactivity.
title_zh: 水催化超快形成水合氢簇
abstract_zh: 水通过氢键网络催化质子传输，但引发这种行为所需的最小结构复杂性仍未解决。在这里，我们通过使用飞秒反应显微镜实时监测选定尺寸的水合氢簇 (H2O)n-1H+ 的超快形成来跟踪水合质子的诞生。我们观察到形成时间尺度的动力学崩溃，从水二聚体 (n = 2) 的 ∼ 259 fs 下降到三聚体 (n = 3) 的 ∼ 70 fs，然后收敛为更大的尺寸。这将循环水三聚体确定为最小催化单元。从头算分子动力学模拟表明，这种加速不是由仍然超快的初始质子转移步骤驱动的，而是由控制水合氢溶剂化产物分离的反应势垒的消除驱动的。我们的研究结果表明，仅三个水分子的协同作用就建立了有效水催化的关键拓扑阈值，为更广泛的水反应性的开始提供了微观蓝图。

title: Reduced melanocortin tone modulates feeding during pregnancy in mice
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: During pregnancy mammals increase their food intake to accommodate the elevated metabolic demands associated with fetal growth and development. However, the molecular and neural circuit mechanisms mediating increased feeding during pregnancy are largely unknown. Here, we demonstrate that arcuate nucleus agouti-related peptide (AgRP) neurons are activated and pro-opiomelanocortin (POMC) neurons are inhibited during pregnancy in mice. These changes are acutely required for promoting hyperphagia during pregnancy as chemogenetic inhibition of AgRP neurons or activation of POMC neurons both reduced the feeding of pregnant mice to non-pregnant levels. Finally, we utilized single cell resolution spatial transcriptomics in the arcuate nucleus of non-pregnant and pregnant mice to characterize pregnancy-induced changes in the transcriptomic state of arcuate nucleus neurons, including significant changes in many neurons controlling energy homeostasis, including AgRP and POMC neurons. Together, these findings outline a circuit mechanism regulating increased feeding during pregnancy, providing important mechanistic insights related to conditions at the intersection of reproduction and metabolism.
title_zh: 黑皮质素张力降低可调节小鼠怀孕期间的喂养
abstract_zh: 在怀孕期间，哺乳动物增加食物摄入量，以满足与胎儿生长和发育相关的代谢需求增加。然而，介导怀孕期间增加喂养的分子和神经回路机制在很大程度上尚不清楚。在这里，我们证明了小鼠怀孕期间弓状核刺鼠相关肽（AgRP）神经元被激活，而阿片黑皮素原（POMC）神经元被抑制。这些变化对于促进怀孕期间的食欲亢进是迫切需要的，因为 AgRP 神经元的化学遗传学抑制或 POMC 神经元的激活都会将怀孕小鼠的进食量降低到非怀孕水平。最后，我们利用非怀孕和怀孕小鼠弓状核的单细胞分辨率空间转录组学来表征怀孕引起的弓状核神经元转录组状态的变化，包括许多控制能量稳态的神经元（包括 AgRP 和 POMC 神经元）的显着变化。总之，这些发现概述了调节怀孕期间增加喂养的回路机制，提供了与生殖和新陈代谢交叉点条件相关的重要机制见解。

title: β-arrestin recruitment facilitates a direct association with G proteins
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: G protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs) are targets for almost a third of all FDA-approved drugs. GPCRs are known to signal through both heterotrimeric G proteins and β-arrestins. Traditionally these pathways were viewed as largely separable, with G proteins primarily initiating downstream signaling while β-arrestins modulate receptor trafficking and desensitization in addition to regulating their own signaling events. Recent studies suggest an integrated role of G proteins and β-arrestins in GPCR signaling, however the cellular and biochemical requirements for G protein:β-arrestin interactions remain unclear. Here, we show that G proteins and β-arrestins can directly interact. Through utilization of β-arrestin-biased receptors and artificially enforced β-arrestin relocalization, we demonstrate that recruitment of β-arrestin to the plasma membrane is sufficient to interact with the G protein Gαi. Using purified proteins, we show that Gαi directly interacts with β-arrestin. In addition, we find that Gαi family members differ in their degree of association with β-arrestin, and that a large degree of this selectivity resides within the alpha helical domain of Gαi. These findings delineate the cellular and biochemical conditions that drive direct interactions between G proteins and β-arrestins and illuminate the molecular basis for how they interact.
title_zh: β-arrestin 募集促进与 G 蛋白的直接关联
abstract_zh: G 蛋白偶联受体 (GPCR) 是 FDA 批准的几乎三分之一药物的靶标。已知 GPCR 通过异源三聚体 G 蛋白和 β-抑制蛋白发出信号。传统上，这些途径被认为在很大程度上是可分离的，G 蛋白主要启动下游信号传导，而 β-抑制蛋白除了调节自身的信号传导事件外，还调节受体运输和脱敏。最近的研究表明 G 蛋白和 β-arrestin 在 GPCR 信号传导中发挥综合作用，但 G 蛋白：β-arrestin 相互作用的细胞和生化要求仍不清楚。在这里，我们证明 G 蛋白和 β-arrestins 可以直接相互作用。通过利用 β-arrestin 偏向受体和人为强制 β-arrestin 重新定位，我们证明将 β-arrestin 募集到质膜足以与 G 蛋白 Gαi 相互作用。使用纯化的蛋白质，我们证明 Gαi 直接与 β-arrestin 相互作用。此外，我们发现 Gαi 家族成员与 β-arrestin 的关联程度不同，并且这种选择性很大程度上存在于 Gαi 的 α 螺旋结构域内。这些发现描述了驱动 G 蛋白和 β-抑制蛋白之间直接相互作用的细胞和生化条件，并阐明了它们相互作用的分子基础。

title: Two distinct Okazaki fragment failure modes dominate mutagenesis in the absence of flap endonuclease 1
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The yeast RAD27 gene encodes the Rad27/Fen1 nuclease, which contributes to genome stability during Okazaki fragment maturation (OFM), DNA mismatch repair (MMR), base excision repair, and other processes. Here, we analyze whole genome mutation accumulation in Saccharomyces cerevisiae lacking RAD27 and show that its loss elevates diverse mutation classes arising through multiple mechanistic pathways. Overall mutation rates in rad27Δ cells are over 60-fold higher than in wild type and only modestly lower than in MMR-deficient strains. However, most mutations in rad27Δ cells cannot be explained by defective MMR, elevated translesion synthesis, or defects in other Rad27-associated repair processes. Instead, mutation spectra implicate aberrant processing of Okazaki fragment intermediates via DNA terminus slippage before ligation (SBL) and template switching (TS). The latter may arise through replication-associated processes such as transient primer relocation (TPR) or through recombination-mediated mechanisms including homoeologous recombination. SBL accounts for the majority of insertion mutations in rad27Δ cells, while TS explains substantial fractions of substitutions, insertions, deletions, and copy number variants, often involving non-local templates. Our results indicate that Rad27 suppresses genome instability through multiple mechanistically distinct roles. Together, these findings reveal Rad27/Fen1 to be a determinant of replication-associated genome stability on par with MMR.
title_zh: 在没有瓣核酸内切酶 1 的情况下，两种不同的冈崎片段失效模式主导诱变
abstract_zh: 酵母 RAD27 基因编码 Rad27/Fen1 核酸酶，该酶有助于冈崎片段成熟 (OFM)、DNA 错配修复 (MMR)、碱基切除修复和其他过程期间的基因组稳定性。在这里，我们分析了缺乏 RAD27 的酿酒酵母的全基因组突变积累，并表明它的缺失提高了通过多种机制途径产生的多种突变类别。 rad27Δ 细胞的总体突变率比野生型高 60 倍以上，仅略低于 MMR 缺陷菌株。然而，rad27Δ细胞中的大多数突变不能用错配修复缺陷、跨损伤合成升高或其他 Rad27 相关修复过程中的缺陷来解释。相反，突变谱表明冈崎片段中间体通过连接前 DNA 末端滑动 (SBL) 和模板切换 (TS) 进行异常加工。后者可能通过复制相关过程（例如瞬时引物重定位（TPR））或通过重组介导的机制（包括同源重组）产生。 SBL 解释了 rad27Δ 细胞中的大部分插入突变，而 TS 解释了大部分替换、插入、删除和拷贝数变异，通常涉及非本地模板。我们的结果表明 Rad27 通过多种机制上不同的作用抑制基因组不稳定性。总之，这些发现表明 Rad27/Fen1 是与 MMR 同等的复制相关基因组稳定性的决定因素。

title: Topology-engineered metallic glass metamaterial-supported NiMo nanoglass catalysts for ultra-efficient water splitting
source: National Science Review Advance Access
abstract: Electrocatalytic water splitting represents a cornerstone for sustainable hydrogen production, yet its industrial implementation remains constrained by inherent trade-offs among activity, stability, and mass transport efficiency. Achieving concurrent optimization of these properties in an integrated catalyst is challenging, as they are dictated by structures spanning multiple length scales. Here, we report a multiscale metamaterial catalyst design strategy that couples topology-engineered transport pathways with nanoglass heterointerface-regulated catalytic activity. Specifically, multiscale metamaterial catalysts (NiMo@Zr MMCs) are constructed by integrating μLPBF-fabricated Zr-based metallic-glass triply periodic minimal surface (TPMS) scaffolds with pulsed-electrodeposition-derived NiMo nanoglass heterostructures. The Gyroid architecture provides enhanced permeability, efficient electrolyte/gas transport, and mechanical robustness, while the abundant amorphous–amorphous interfaces within the NiMo nanoglass heterostructure optimize the local electronic environment and catalytic activity. Through the synergistic integration of topology engineering, metallic-glass scaffolds, and nanoglass interface engineering, the resulting NiMo@G catalyst delivers record-low cell voltages for overall water splitting (1.438 V at 100 mA cm−2 in 1 M KOH) and outstanding long-term durability (>200 h). This work extends the concept of metamaterial catalysts from topology-controlled transport design to the coupling of transport and catalytic-interface engineering across multiple length scales, providing a generalizable framework for next-generation electrocatalysts.
title_zh: 拓扑工程金属玻璃超材料支持的 NiMo 纳米玻璃催化剂用于超高效水分解
abstract_zh: 电催化水分解是可持续制氢的基石，但其工业实施仍然受到活性、稳定性和传质效率之间固有权衡的限制。在集成催化剂中实现这些特性的同时优化具有挑战性，因为它们是由跨多个长度尺度的结构决定的。在这里，我们报告了一种多尺度超材料催化剂设计策略，该策略将拓扑工程传输路径与纳米玻璃异质界面调节的催化活性结合起来。具体来说，多尺度超材料催化剂（NiMo@Zr MMC）是通过将μLPBF制造的Zr基金属玻璃三周期最小表面（TPMS）支架与脉冲电沉积衍生的NiMo纳米玻璃异质结构集成而构建的。 Gyroid 结构提供了增强的渗透性、高效的电解质/气体传输和机械鲁棒性，而 NiMo 纳米玻璃异质结构内丰富的非晶-非晶界面优化了局部电子环境和催化活性。通过拓扑工程、金属玻璃支架和纳米玻璃界面工程的协同集成，所得的 NiMo@G 催化剂可为整体水分解提供创纪录的低电池电压（1 M KOH 中 100 mA cm−2 时为 1.438 V）和出色的长期耐用性（> 200 小时）。这项工作将超材料催化剂的概念从拓扑控制的传输设计扩展到跨多个长度尺度的传输和催化界面工程的耦合，

title: Major urinary protein 1 modulates neuronal excitability in the medial prefrontal cortex in a male mouse model of affective empathy
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Affective empathy describes the capacity to share others’ emotions, yet the molecular mechanisms governing individual differences in empathic sensitivity remain poorly understood. Using a male mouse model of social transmission of depression (STD), we demonstrated that STD‑sensitive observer mice exhibit heightened neuronal excitability and upregulated major urinary protein 1 (MUP1) expression in the medial prefrontal cortex (mPFC) compared with STD‑insensitive observer mice. Mechanistically, MUP1 drives the STD‑sensitive phenotype by modulating astrocytic glutamate transporter 1 (GLT1) to augment mPFC neuronal excitability. Via virtual screening, we identified two small‑molecule compounds (C25 and C11) that bidirectionally modulate STD‑related behaviors. In summary, our work establishes MUP1 as a master modulator of STD vulnerability, deciphers mechanisms driving heterogeneous affective empathy across individuals, and unveils actionable therapeutic candidates for empathy-related psychiatric illnesses.
title_zh: 主要尿蛋白 1 调节雄性小鼠情感共情模型内侧前额叶皮层的神经元兴奋性
abstract_zh: 情感同理心描述了分享他人情感的能力，但控制同理心敏感性个体差异的分子机制仍然知之甚少。使用抑郁症社会传播 (STD) 的雄性小鼠模型，我们证明，与 STD 不敏感的观察小鼠相比，STD 敏感的观察小鼠表现出更高的神经元兴奋性，并且内侧前额叶皮层 (mPFC) 中主要尿蛋白 1 (MUP1) 的表达上调。从机制上讲，MUP1 通过调节星形胶质细胞谷氨酸转运蛋白 1 (GLT1) 来增强 mPFC 神经元兴奋性，从而驱动 STD 敏感表型。通过虚拟筛选，我们确定了两种可双向调节 STD 相关行为的小分子化合物（C25 和 C11）。总之，我们的工作将 MUP1 确立为 STD 脆弱性的主调节器，破译了驱动个体间异质情感同理心的机制，并揭示了与同理心相关的精神疾病的可行的治疗候选药物。

title: Internalized components of membrane attack complexes disrupt proteostasis and acquire alarmin-like properties
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Immune effects of membrane attack complexes (MAC) have been widely attributed to their abilities to cause cell death. Here, we show that the MAC component, C9, forms non-cytolytic aggregates with pro-inflammatory effects. Intracellular aggregates of C9 are detected within inflamed tissues of patients in association with endothelial cell (EC) activation but not increased cell death. We identify NUMBL as a Rab35 effector that directly binds surface-bound C9 to promote C9 internalization and entry into the endolysosomal pathway. Within acidified endolysosomes, C9 forms insoluble aggregates that are targeted for degradative aggrephagy in a process that activates NF-κB. For C9 aggrephagy to occur, ZFYVE21, a Rab5 effector, complexes with RNF34 to bridge C9 aggregates to LC3B+ aggresome membranes. We detect C9 aggregates in vivo, and we show that a ZFYVE21-RNF34 signaling axis is required for C9 aggrephagy and NF-κB -dependent EC activation in three separate mouse models. Mice with conditional loss of ZFYVE21 in ECs show reduced aggregraphy, resulting in attenuated systemic inflammation and reduced tissue injury following skin transplantation. Our data show that the C9 component of MACs forms intracellular aggregates with alarmin-like properties.
title_zh: 膜攻击复合物的内化成分破坏蛋白质稳态并获得警报素样特性
abstract_zh: 膜攻击复合物（MAC）的免疫作用被广泛归因于其导致细胞死亡的能力。在这里，我们证明 MAC 成分 C9 形成具有促炎作用的非溶细胞聚集体。在患者发炎组织内检测到 C9 的细胞内聚集物，与内皮细胞 (EC) 激活相关，但与细胞死亡增加无关。我们将 NUMBL 确定为 Rab35 效应子，直接结合表面结合的 C9，促进 C9 内化并进入内溶酶体途径。在酸化的内溶酶体中，C9 形成不溶性聚集体，在激活 NF-κB 的过程中以降解性聚集吞噬为目标。为了发生 C9 聚集吞噬，Rab5 效应子 ZFYVE21 与 RNF34 复合，将 C9 聚集体桥接到 LC3B+ 聚集体膜上。我们在体内检测了 C9 聚集体，并表明在三个不同的小鼠模型中，ZFYVE21-RNF34 信号轴是 C9 聚集吞噬和 NF-κB 依赖性 EC 激活所必需的。 EC 中 ZFYVE21 有条件缺失的小鼠表现出聚集减少，从而减轻了皮肤移植后的全身炎症并减少了组织损伤。我们的数据表明，MAC 的 C9 成分形成具有类似警报素特性的细胞内聚集体。

title: Mediterranean outflow waters supply North Atlantic convection sites
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The northward-flowing branch of the Mediterranean Outflow Water (MOW) carries warm and saline water into the Subpolar North Atlantic, where deep convection contributes to the formation of water masses that feed the lower limb of the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation. Due to its distinctive thermohaline characteristics, the MOW presence may act as a preconditioning factor for the formation of these waters. However, the complex dynamics of the subpolar regions make tracing its pathway beyond ∼" role="presentation">∼\sim50°N using conventional tracers and datasets challenging. We use an extensive dataset of Argo float salinity and oxygen profiles acquired over the North Atlantic during more than two decades to track the northward-flowing MOW and characterize its evolution along the way. Here we show that these observations allow for a multi-tracer approach, providing robust evidence of MOW’s presence in the subpolar basins, including the Irminger Sea, which has recently been identified as a basin where major deep convective processes occur. These findings highlight the potential role of the MOW in influencing the large-scale overturning circulation.
title_zh: 地中海流出水域供应北大西洋对流地点
abstract_zh: 地中海流出水（MOW）向北流动的分支将温暖的咸水带入北大西洋副极地，在那里深层对流有助于形成水团，为大西洋经向翻转环流的下肢提供水源。由于其独特的温盐特性，MOW 的存在可能充当这些水域形成的预处理因素。然而，副极地地区的复杂动态使得使用传统示踪剂和数据集追踪其超出∼" role="presentation">∼\sim50°N的路径具有挑战性。我们使用二十多年来在北大西洋获取的Argo浮子盐度和氧气剖面的广泛数据集来追踪向北流动的MOW并描述其沿途的演化特征。在这里，我们表明这些观测允许采用多示踪剂方法，为MOW在副极地盆地中的存在提供了有力的证据，包括厄明格海最近被确定为发生主要深对流过程的盆地，这些发现凸显了 MOW 在影响大规模翻转环流中的潜在作用。

title: Jammed interconnected bilayer emulsions as 3D-printable biological tissue mimics
source: Nature Materials
abstract: Here we present jammed interconnected bilayer emulsions (JIBEs) as a class of tissue-like materials with macroscopic scalability, comprising billions of bilayer-separated aqueous compartments per millilitre. These materials mimic the organizational structure and properties of biological tissues. Our self-assembly method generates up to decilitre-scale volumes of JIBEs within minutes. The process is highly adaptable to a wide range of amphiphiles, including lipids and block copolymers, providing flexibility in tailoring JIBEs for diverse applications. The jammed architecture of JIBEs imparts unique properties, such as direct extrusion 3D printability into aqueous solutions. Their membrane-bound structure allows functionalization with nanochannels, enabling the material to adopt the properties of the incorporated channels. In this study, we demonstrate three key features of JIBEs using distinct ion channels: tunable conductance, selective transport and memristance. We propose that functionalized JIBEs could unlock a broad range of applications, including separations, energy storage, neuromorphic computing, tissue engineering, drug delivery and soft robotics.
title_zh: 堵塞的互连双层乳液作为可 3D 打印的生物组织模拟物
abstract_zh: 在这里，我们提出了堵塞的互连双层乳液（JIBE）作为一类具有宏观可扩展性的类组织材料，每毫升包含数十亿个双层分隔的水室。这些材料模仿生物组织的组织结构和特性。我们的自组装方法可在几分钟内生成高达十升量级的 JIBE。该工艺对多种两亲物具有高度适应性，包括脂质和嵌段共聚物，为不同应用定制 JIBE 提供了灵活性。 JIBE 的堵塞结构赋予了独特的特性，例如直接挤出 3D 打印到水溶液中。它们的膜结合结构允许纳米通道功能化，使材料能够采用合并通道的特性。在这项研究中，我们使用不同的离子通道展示了 JIBE 的三个关键特征：可调电导、选择性传输和忆阻。我们认为，功能化 JIBE 可以解锁广泛的应用，包括分离、能量存储、神经形态计算、组织工程、药物输送和软机器人。

title: The Japanese Palaeolithic deserves more attention in Western narratives about human expansion across Asia
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Japan deserves more attention than it has so far received in Western narratives about the expansion of humans across Asia. It has over 10,000 Palaeolithic sites, many of which are well-dated. Japan provides excellent examples of Pleistocene sea-faring and long-distance Palaeolithic exchange networks. Okinawa in the Ryukyu Islands may provide one of the earliest examples of humans deliberately trans-locating an animal to a new environment. Japan may also have been a starting point for the colonisation of the Americas.

title: High-yield visible-to-ultraviolet upconversion by ZnSe quantum dots with dynamic triplet transfer
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Triplet–triplet annihilation upconversion sensitized by quantum dot is often limited by the short exciton lifetime, necessitating tethered triplet transmitter. Here, we report a transmitter-free system of ZnSe quantum dot and 2,5-diphenyloxazole achieving 24% upconversion quantum yield, the highest for quantum dot sensitization upconversion. The upconversion quantum yield peaks at 30 mM 2,5-diphenyloxazole. Transient spectroscopy shows the triplet energy transfer efficiency is over 80% regardless of the 2,5-diphenyloxazole concentration, but the triplet–triplet annihilation efficiency dominates the overall upconversion quantum yield and shows a strong dependence on the 2,5-diphenyloxazole concentration that increases first from 10% to 25%, then decreases. The optimal concentration is achieved when the triplet 2,5-diphenyloxazole collision probability is highest, thus ensuring a maximum triplet–triplet annihilation efficiency. This work demonstrates a design principle of binary quantum dot upconversion system and reveals the critical role of modulating emitter concentration for optimal upconversion quantum yield.
title_zh: ZnSe 量子点动态三重态转移高产率可见光到紫外上转换
abstract_zh: 量子点敏化的三重态-三重态湮没上转换通常受到激子寿命短的限制，需要束缚三重态发射器。在这里，我们报道了一种由 ZnSe 量子点和 2,5-二苯基恶唑组成的无发射器系统，实现了 24% 的上转换量子产率，这是量子点敏化上转换的最高值。上转换量子产率在 30 mM 2,5-二苯基恶唑处达到峰值。瞬态光谱显示，无论 2,5-二苯基恶唑浓度如何，三重态能量转移效率都超过 80%，但三重态-三重态湮灭效率在整体上转换量子产率中占主导地位，并显示出对 2,5-二苯基恶唑浓度的强烈依赖性，首先从 10% 增加到 25%，然后下降。当三重态 2,5-二苯基恶唑碰撞概率最高时达到最佳浓度，从而确保最大的三重态-三重态湮灭效率。这项工作展示了二元量子点上转换系统的设计原理，并揭示了调制发射极浓度对于最佳上转换量子产率的关键作用。

title: Targeted polar entropy regulation enables superior energy-storage in tungsten bronze multilayer capacitors
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Tetragonal tungsten bronze (TTB) ceramics have emerged as promising candidates for dielectric energy storage due to their intrinsic multi-site architectures. However, the limited energy storage performance achieved so far remains insufficient for advanced electronic and pulsed power applications. Here, we propose a targeted polar-entropy regulation strategy via minor multi-element substitution at the polar-active B-sites, enabling precise modulation of polar displacements and weakened coupling among polar nanoregions. Atomic-scale characterization reveals site-dependent structural responses, which collectively reshape local polarization configurations and dipolar correlations. As a result, we demonstrate the feasibility of TTB ceramics for state-of-the-art multilayer energy-storage device applications, achieving an outstanding recoverable energy density (Wrec) of 17.6 J·cm−3 with a high efficiency of 96.8%, corresponding to a high figure of merit (WF) of 550. Moreover, excellent thermal stability (ΔWrec ≤ 2.0%) is achieved, and a highest Wrec of 15.0 J·cm−3 is maintained over a wide temperature range (−40 to 125 °C). This work offers new insights into polarization regulation and provides an effective pathway for developing high-performance energy storage dielectric capacitors.
title_zh: 有针对性的极性熵调节可实现钨青铜多层电容器的卓越能量存储
abstract_zh: 由于其固有的多位点结构，四方钨青铜（TTB）陶瓷已成为介电储能的有前途的候选者。然而，迄今为止所实现的有限能量存储性能仍然不足以满足先进电子和脉冲功率应用的需要。在这里，我们提出了一种有针对性的极性熵调节策略，通过在极性活性 B 位点进行少量多元素取代，能够精确调节极性位移并减弱极性纳米区域之间的耦合。原子尺度表征揭示了位点相关的结构响应，这些响应共同重塑了局部偏振构型和偶极相关性。结果，我们证明了TTB陶瓷在最先进的多层储能装置应用中的可行性，实现了17.6 J·cm−3的出色可恢复能量密度（Wrec）和96.8%的高效率，对应于550的高品质因数（WF）。此外，还实现了出色的热稳定性（ΔWrec ≤ 2.0%），最高Wrec为15.0 J·cm−3 在很宽的温度范围内（−40 至 125 °C）保持不变。这项工作提供了对极化调节的新见解，并为开发高性能储能介电电容器提供了有效途径。

title: Dielectric-tuned charge and exciton dynamics in perylene bisimide supramolecular aggregates
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Optimizing charge separation and transport in supramolecular architectures is critical for advancing artificial photosynthesis and organic optoelectronics. However, disentangling the effects of the dielectric environment from structural reorganization remains a challenge due to the intrinsic complexity of these systems. Here, we report the dielectric-tuned charge and exciton dynamics in a structurally robust perylene bisimide H-aggregate that maintains its packing geometry regardless of solvent polarity. By performing solvent-polarity-dependent transient absorption experiments, we observe a fundamental mechanistic crossover of charge dynamics dictated by the dielectric medium: in nonpolar environments, reaction kinetics are driven by quantum tunneling via high-frequency vibrational modes (semiclassical regime), whereas in polar environments, they are gated by collective solvent fluctuations (classical regime). Furthermore, pump-fluence-dependent measurements show that charge separation from excimer-like S1 excitons competes with exciton-exciton annihilation, leading to solvent-polarity-dependent diffusion lengths, whereas the generated charge carriers display non-diffusive behavior. These findings provide an analytical framework for distinguishing between vibrationally-assisted or solvent-controlled electron transfer, offering a roadmap for engineering efficient charge and exciton transport in organic semiconducting molecular assemblies.
title_zh: 苝双酰亚胺超分子聚集体中介电调节的电荷和激子动力学
abstract_zh: 优化超分子结构中的电荷分离和传输对于推进人工光合作用和有机光电子学至关重要。然而，由于这些系统固有的复杂性，从结构重组中解开介电环境的影响仍然是一个挑战。在这里，我们报告了结构坚固的苝双酰亚胺 H 聚集体中介电调节的电荷和激子动力学，无论溶剂极性如何，该聚集体都保持其堆积几何形状。通过进行溶剂极性相关的瞬态吸收实验，我们观察到介电介质决定的电荷动力学的基本机械交叉：在非极性环境中，反应动力学由量子隧道通过高频振动模式（半经典体系）驱动，而在极性环境中，它们由集体溶剂波动（经典体系）控制。此外，依赖泵注量的测量表明，类准分子 S1 激子的电荷分离与激子-激子湮灭竞争，导致溶剂极性依赖的扩散长度，而生成的电荷载流子表现出非扩散行为。这些发现为区分振动辅助或溶剂控制的电子转移提供了一个分析框架，为有机半导体分子组装体中设计有效的电荷和激子传输提供了路线图。

title: Spatial Patterning of Reactive Inks for Programmable Gas-Generation Profiles in Untethered Soft Actuation
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Chemical reaction-based actuation offers a compelling route to untethered soft robotics because it can directly convert stored chemical energy into pressure and mechanical work within compliant structures. Its practical utility, however, depends on controlling not only the total amount of gas generated but also the onset, rate, and duration of gas evolution. Here, we introduce Gas-generating Actuation System (GAS) printing, an open-architecture strategy that encodes gas-generation kinetics through the spatial patterning of reactive inks. Using direct ink writing, we print high-solid-loading viscoelastic citric acid and sodium bicarbonate inks onto cellulose paper substrates, creating spatially separated reactive domains that remain stable prior to activation. Upon water-triggered activation, the printed architecture governs how the reactants interact, allowing gas-generation behavior to be programmed through geometric design. By tuning the inter-ink gap, interfacial arrangement, and folded configuration, we control the onset, rate, and overall profile of gas generation and thereby its translation into mechanical output. We validate this design principle through timer-controlled buoyancy, sustained surface propulsion, and origami-based three-dimensional deformation, showing that diverse untethered motions can be derived from a common printed chemical architecture. These results establish GAS printing as a low-cost, paper-based platform for programming gas-driven actuation in untethered soft robotic systems.
title_zh: 活性墨水的空间图案，用于不受束缚的软驱动中的可编程气体发生曲线
abstract_zh: 基于化学反应的驱动为不受束缚的软机器人技术提供了一条引人注目的途径，因为它可以直接将存储的化学能转化为顺应结构内的压力和机械功。然而，其实际用途不仅取决于控制产生的气体总量，还取决于控制气体逸出的开始、速率和持续时间。在这里，我们介绍气体发生驱动系统（GAS）打印，这是一种开放式架构策略，通过活性墨水的空间图案对气体发生动力学进行编码。使用直接墨水书写，我们将高固体含量的粘弹性柠檬酸和碳酸氢钠墨水打印到纤维素纸基材上，形成空间分离的反应域，这些反应域在激活之前保持稳定。在水触发激活后，印刷结构控制反应物如何相互作用，从而允许通过几何设计对气体产生行为进行编程。通过调整墨水间间隙、界面排列和折叠配置，我们控制气体产生的开始、速率和总体轮廓，从而控制气体产生的转化为机械输出。我们通过计时器控制的浮力、持续表面推进和基于折纸的三维变形验证了这一设计原理，表明可以从常见的印刷化学结构中衍生出多种不受束缚的运动。这些结果使 GAS 打印成为一种低成本、基于纸张的平台，用于在不受束缚的软机器人系统中对气体驱动驱动进行编程。

title: Reforging Mitsunobu reaction via sulfoxides-catalyzed C(sp3)-O bond activation of alkanols
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The stereospecific conversion of alkanols plays a pivotal role in synthetic chemistry and drug discovery. Among the substantial advances, the Mitsunobu reaction has long stood out as a powerful platform for C(sp3)-O bond activation to achieve the transformation of alkanols. Due to the inherent environmental drawbacks of phosphorus chemistry, an alternative element is pressingly demanded. Herein, we develop well-designed sulfoxide catalysts for an alternative catalytic Mitsunobu-type reaction with broad substrate scope, generating H2O as the sole by-product. Kinetic studies, mechanistic investigations, and density functional theory (DFT) calculations provide comprehensive mechanistic insights and uncover key structure-reactivity relationships. This approach establishes a sustainable and atom-economical pathway for the Mitsunobu-type reaction, and expands the conceptual scope of sulfur catalysis.
title_zh: 亚砜催化烷醇 C(sp3)-O 键活化的重铸 Mitsunobu 反应
abstract_zh: 烷醇的立体定向转化在合成化学和药物发现中发挥着关键作用。在这些重大进展中，Mitsunobu 反应长期以来一直作为 C(sp3)-O 键激活以实现烷醇转化的强大平台而脱颖而出。由于磷化学固有的环境缺陷，迫切需要一种替代元素。在此，我们开发了精心设计的亚砜催化剂，用于具有广泛底物范围的替代催化 Mitsunobu 型反应，产生 H2O 作为唯一副产物。动力学研究、机理研究和密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算提供了全面的机理见解并揭示了关键的结构-反应性关系。该方法为Mitsunobu型反应建立了可持续且原子经济的途径，并扩展了硫催化的概念范围。

title: Bound water as a kinetic crosslinker for bio-inspired impact-stiffening polymers
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Developing high-performance impact-stiffening polymers that are broadly applicable across chemical systems remains a key challenge, as existing designs rely on meticulously engineered molecular motifs. Inspired by water’s role in biological impact resistance, we introduce a generalizable biomimetic paradigm. We transform water—commonly considered a property-limiting plasticizer—into an active, rate-sensitive cross-linker by structurally confining bound-water networks within proton-rich polymer scaffolds. Programming their dissociation kinetics enables a sharp, reversible soft-to-rigid transition under impact via kinetic freezing. This design, demonstrated in a poly(thioctic acid)-based system, concurrently achieves outstanding energy dissipation, self-healing, and strong adhesion. Crucially, it bypasses de novo synthesis of specialized motifs and is applicable across diverse polymer backbones, establishing programmable water dynamics as a versatile principle for adaptive polymeric materials.
title_zh: 结合水作为仿生抗冲聚合物的动态交联剂
abstract_zh: 开发广泛适用于化学系统的高性能抗冲击硬化聚合物仍然是一个关键挑战，因为现有设计依赖于精心设计的分子图案。受水在生物抗冲击性中的作用的启发，我们引入了一种可推广的仿生范式。我们通过在结构上限制富含质子的聚合物支架内的结合水网络，将水（通常被认为是一种性能限制性增塑剂）转化为活性、速率敏感的交联剂。对它们的解离动力学进行编程，可以通过动力学冻结在冲击下实现急剧、可逆的软质到刚性的转变。这种设计在基于聚硫辛酸的系统中得到了证明，同时实现了出色的能量耗散、自修复和强附着力。至关重要的是，它绕过了专门图案的从头合成，并且适用于不同的聚合物主链，将可编程水动力学建立为自适应聚合物材料的通用原理。

title: Visualizing excitonic states in constructed cyclic molecular architectures by tip-enhanced photoluminescence
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Natural photosynthesis inspires the design of artificial cyclic light-harvesting architectures, yet probing their excitonic behaviors—particularly optically dark states—remains challenging for far-field optics due to diffraction limits and dipole selection rules. Here, combining scanning tunneling microscope manipulation with tip-enhanced photoluminescence, we visualize discrete excitonic states in constructed cyclic zinc-phthalocyanine architectures with sub-nanometer resolution. By controlling intermolecular distances, we map excitonic evolution across weak, intermediate, and strong coupling regimes. We uncover a transition dipole rotation phenomenon arising from the molecules’ orthogonal, degenerate dipoles, which facilitates coherent intermolecular coupling. Furthermore, by comparing hollow and solid architectures, we demonstrate that the molecular architectures determine the nature of the lowest-lying excitonic state: a hollow ring possesses an optically dark lowest-lying state, whereas a solid architecture features a bright one, highlighting a possible structural physical advantage of hollow cyclic architectures for suppressing radiative losses. These findings provide guidelines for designing organic architectures with high energy transfer efficiencies.
title_zh: 通过尖端增强光致发光可视化构建的循环分子结构中的激子态
abstract_zh: 自然光合作用激发了人工循环光捕获结构的设计，但由于衍射极限和偶极子选择规则，探测其激子行为（特别是光学暗态）对于远场光学仍然具有挑战性。在这里，将扫描隧道显微镜操作与尖端增强光致发光相结合，我们以亚纳米分辨率可视化构建的环状锌酞菁结构中的离散激子态。通过控制分子间距离，我们绘制了弱、中、强耦合状态下的激子演化图。我们发现了由分子的正交简并偶极子引起的过渡偶极子旋转现象，这有利于相干分子间耦合。此外，通过比较空心和实心结构，我们证明分子结构决定了最低激子态的性质：空心环具有光学暗的最低激子态，而实心结构则具有明亮的结构，这凸显了空心循环结构在抑制辐射损失方面可能具有的结构物理优势。这些发现为设计具有高能量传输效率的有机结构提供了指导。

title: High-performance multijunction perovskite LEDs with reduced interconnection loss
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Tandem light-emitting diodes (LEDs) offer advantages in efficiency, brightness and lower the current density for a target brightness, but their implementation in solution-processed perovskite LEDs is limited by interconnection strategies that introduce high voltage penalties and poor robustness. Here we demonstrate a hierarchically structured interconnection layer (ICL) integrating a near-degenerate charge-generation junction with a crystalline-amorphous oxide composite, enabling low-barrier transport and solvent-tolerant stacking with reduced loss. Using this ICL, we realize double-junction perovskite LEDs in which two subunits operate efficiently in series, achieving a peak external quantum efficiency (EQE) of 42.6%, a maximum radiance of 690 W sr−1 m−2, and low driving voltage. The ICL is compatible with multiple perovskite emitters and supports scalable multijunction integration, yielding multijunction devices with sub-bandgap turn-on voltages and high EQEs exceeding 60%. Our results establish a low-loss interconnection strategy for series-stacked perovskite emitters, providing a practical route toward high-brightness and multi-wavelength perovskite light sources.
title_zh: 具有降低互连损耗的高性能多结钙钛矿 LED
abstract_zh: 串联发光二极管 (LED) 在效率、亮度和较低的电流密度方面具有优势，可实现目标亮度，但它们在溶液处理的钙钛矿 LED 中的实施受到互连策略的限制，互连策略会带来高电压损失和较差的鲁棒性。在这里，我们展示了一种分层结构互连层（ICL），它将近简并电荷产生结与晶体非晶氧化物复合材料集成在一起，从而实现低势垒传输和耐溶剂堆叠，并减少损耗。利用该 ICL，我们实现了双结钙钛矿 LED，其中两个子单元串联高效工作，实现了 42.6% 的峰值外量子效率 (EQE)、690 W sr−1 m−2 的最大辐射亮度和低驱动电压。 ICL 与多个钙钛矿发射极兼容，并支持可扩展的多结集成，产生具有亚带隙开启电压和超过 60% 的高 EQE 的多结器件。我们的研究结果为串联堆叠钙钛矿发射器建立了低损耗互连策略，为高亮度和多波长钙钛矿光源提供了一条实用途径。

title: Flow matching for reaction pathway generation
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Elucidating reaction mechanisms requires efficient generation of transition states (TSs) and products. Existing diffusion and sequence-based models accelerate parts of this process over traditional string-based methods, but typically still require manual enumeration of either TSs or products, and stochastic diffusion dynamics can be inefficient and hard to control. We introduce MolGEN, a conditional flow-matching framework that uses deterministic optimal transport to map Gaussian priors to chemical distributions. For TS generation, MolGEN improves TS geometry and barrier-height prediction over diffusion models while enabling sub-second sampling. For reaction product generation, it achieves competitive top-k accuracy while preserving mass and electron balance. Using the same backbone for TS and product sampling, MolGEN enables template-free generative exploration of reaction networks without the repeated quantum-chemistry searches required by prior methods. For the γ-ketohydroperoxide decomposition network, it produces more valid TSs than string-based methods using only 12 quantum-chemistry evaluations instead of 1156, and identifies a lower-barrier pathway.
title_zh: 反应路径生成的流程匹配
abstract_zh: 阐明反应机制需要有效生成过渡态 (TS) 和产物。与传统的基于字符串的方法相比，现有的扩散和基于序列的模型加速了该过程的部分过程，但通常仍然需要手动枚举 TS 或产品，并且随机扩散动力学可能效率低下且难以控制。我们引入了 MolGEN，一种条件流匹配框架，它使用确定性最优传输将高斯先验映射到化学分布。对于 TS 生成，MolGEN 改进了扩散模型的 TS 几何形状和势垒高度预测，同时实现亚秒级采样。对于反应产物的生成，它在保持质量和电子平衡的同时实现了具有竞争力的 top-k 精度。 MolGEN 使用相同的 TS 和产品采样主干，实现了反应网络的无模板生成探索，无需先前方法所需的重复量子化学搜索。对于 γ-酮氢过氧化物分解网络，它比基于字符串的方法仅使用 12 次量子化学评估（而不是 1156 次）产生更有效的 TS，并确定了较低势垒的途径。

title: Mid-IR light modulators enabled by dynamically tunable ultra-high-Q silicon membrane metasurfaces
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Metasurfaces enable subwavelength control of free-space light for applications in sensing, nonlinear optics, and quantum photonics. However, their practical deployment is hindered by two key limitations: a tradeoff between low-Q resonances and weak amplitude contrast, and their predominantly static nature allowing only passive functionalities. These challenges are particularly severe in the mid-infrared (mid-IR), where the scarcity of low-loss materials constrains performance and scalability. Here, we demonstrate actively tunable single-crystalline silicon membrane metasurfaces combining high-Q resonances, strong amplitude contrast, and wafer-scale manufacturability. Our platform achieves record-high measured Q-factors up to 3000 in the mid-IR and supports two dynamic modulation schemes: electro-thermal tuning via Joule heating with >50% modulation depth at CMOS-compatible voltages and speeds up to 14.5 kHz, and ultrafast all-optical modulation via carrier generation in silicon with nanosecond response times and estimated sub-GHz rates. These results establish silicon membrane metasurfaces as a scalable platform for active mid-IR photonics.
title_zh: 由动态可调超高 Q 硅膜超表面实现的中红外光调制器
abstract_zh: 超表面能够对自由空间光进行亚波长控制，适用于传感、非线性光学和量子光子学等应用。然而，它们的实际部署受到两个关键限制的阻碍：低 Q 值谐振和弱振幅对比度之间的权衡，以及它们的主要静态性质仅允许无源功能。这些挑战在中红外 (mid-IR) 领域尤其严重，低损耗材料的稀缺限制了性能和可扩展性。在这里，我们展示了主动可调的单晶硅膜超表面，结合了高 Q 共振、强振幅对比度和晶圆级可制造性。我们的平台在中红外范围内实现了高达 3000 的创纪录高测量 Q 因子，并支持两种动态调制方案：通过焦耳加热进行电热调谐，在 CMOS 兼容电压下具有 >50% 的调制深度，速度高达 14.5 kHz，以及通过硅中的载波生成进行超快全光调制，具有纳秒响应时间和估计的 sub-GHz 速率。这些结果将硅膜超表面确立为主动中红外光子学的可扩展平台。

title: Enhancing sit-to-stand transitions and walking efficiency in older adults with a soft robotic suit
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Age-related declines in muscle strength and neuromuscular control make sit-to-stand transitions and walking progressively more difficult, compromising mobility and independence. Although wearable assistive technologies have been proposed to alleviate these challenges, few have demonstrated clear benefits in facilitating sit-to-stand movements for older adults who retain a degree of independent mobility. Here, we introduce a soft hip exosuit designed to assist both sit-to-stand transitions and walking activities. In a feasibility study involving ten older adults, the exosuit increased 1-minute sit-to-stand repetitions by an average of 1.8 and reduced the metabolic cost of walking by 13.6% compared with the unassisted condition. These improvements were achieved while preserving natural kinematics, lower-limb stability, and maintaining a strong sense of agency. Our findings demonstrate that soft exosuits can enhance sit-to-stand and walking performance in older adults while preserving biomechanical naturalness and user autonomy, highlighting their potential for practical home-integrated mobility assistance.
title_zh: 使用软机器人套装增强老年人从坐到站的转换和行走效率
abstract_zh: 与年龄相关的肌肉力量和神经肌肉控制能力下降，使得从坐到站的转换和行走逐渐变得更加困难，从而损害了活动能力和独立性。尽管可穿戴辅助技术已被提出来缓解这些挑战，但很少有技术在促进保持一定程度独立活动能力的老年人从坐到站运动方面表现出明显的好处。在这里，我们推出一款柔软的臀部外装套装，旨在帮助坐站转换和步行活动。在一项涉及 10 名老年人的可行性研究中，与无辅助条件下相比，外骨骼套装将 1 分钟从坐到站的重复次数平均增加了 1.8 次，并将步行的代谢成本降低了 13.6%。这些改进是在保持自然运动学、下肢稳定性和保持强烈的代理感的同时实现的。我们的研究结果表明，软质外装可以增强老年人的坐立和行走能力，同时保持生物力学自然性和用户自主性，突显了它们在实用的家庭集成移动辅助方面的潜力。

title: Coexistence of high temperature superconductivity and antiferromagnetic order in a cuprate with multiple hole Fermi pockets
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The intricate relationship between high temperature superconductivity and antiferromagnetic order in cuprates, and the fundamental origin of electron pairing remain open questions. By utilizing high-resolution laser-based spatially-resolved angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy, we investigate the seven-layer Bi2Sr2Ca6Cu7O18+δ (Bi2267) and identify a cuprate system that consists of multiple hole Fermi pockets. The observed Fermi pockets exhibit pronounced momentum-, temperature- and Fermi surface-dependent energy gaps. Crucially, high temperature superconductivity with a critical temperature (Tc) of ~ 75 K emerges in a system with multiple Fermi pockets and the presence of strong antiferromagnetic order and correlations. In particular, substantial electron pairing is observed along the Fermi pocket with an energy gap up to ~ 42 meV in lightly-doped CuO2 planes (p ~ 0.05). These findings challenge the conventional understanding of the roles of the nodal and antinodal electronic states in driving high temperature superconductivity. They show that superconductivity and antiferromagnetism can coexist in a cuprate with multiple Fermi pockets, offering further insights into the pairing mechanism in cuprate superconductors.
title_zh: 多孔费米袋铜酸盐中高温超导性与反铁磁有序性的共存
abstract_zh: 铜酸盐的高温超导性和反铁磁有序之间的复杂关系以及电子配对的基本起源仍然是悬而未决的问题。通过利用基于高分辨率激光的空间分辨角分辨光电子能谱，我们研究了七层 Bi2Sr2Ca6Cu7O18+δ (Bi2267) 并识别了由多个孔费米口袋组成的铜酸盐系统。观察到的费米口袋表现出明显的动量、温度和费米表面相关的能隙。至关重要的是，临界温度 (Tc) 约为 75 K 的高温超导性出现在具有多个费米口袋且存在强反铁磁序和相关性的系统中。特别是，在轻掺杂 CuO2 平面 (p ~ 0.05) 中，沿着费米口袋观察到大量电子配对，其能隙高达 ~ 42 meV。这些发现挑战了对节点和反节点电子态在驱动高温超导中的作用的传统理解。他们表明，超导性和反铁磁性可以在具有多个费米口袋的铜酸盐中共存，为铜酸盐超导体中的配对机制提供了进一步的见解。

title: Understanding the European energy crisis through structural causal models
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Natural gas supplies in Europe were disrupted and energy prices soared in the context of Russia’s invasion of Ukraine. Electricity prices in France experienced the largest relative increase among European countries, even though the share of natural gas in the electricity mix is small compared to its neighbours. In this article, we demonstrate the importance of causal statistical methods and propose causal graphs to investigate the French and Spanish electricity markets and pinpoint key influencing factors on electricity prices and net exports. We demonstrate that a causal approach resolves paradoxical results of simple correlation studies and enables a quantitative analysis of indirect causal effects and what-if scenarios. We introduce a linear structural causal model as well as non-linear tree-based machine learning combined with Shapley Flow values. The models elucidate the interplay of gas prices and the unavailability of nuclear power plants during the energy crisis as the high unavailability made France dependent on imports.
title_zh: 通过结构性因果模型理解欧洲能源危机
abstract_zh: 在俄罗斯入侵乌克兰的背景下，欧洲天然气供应中断，能源价格飙升。法国的电价在欧洲国家中经历了最大的相对涨幅，尽管与邻国相比，天然气在电力结构中所占的比例很小。在本文中，我们论证了因果统计方法的重要性，并提出因果图来调查法国和西班牙电力市场，并查明电价和净出口的关键影响因素。我们证明因果方法可以解决简单相关性研究的矛盾结果，并能够对间接因果效应和假设情景进行定量分析。我们引入了线性结构因果模型以及与 Shapley Flow 值相结合的非线性基于树的机器学习。这些模型阐明了能源危机期间天然气价格与核电站无法使用之间的相互作用，因为核电站的高度无法使用使法国依赖进口。

title: Measuring cardiac stroke volume through in-ear audio sensing
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Stroke volume, the volume of blood ejected by the left ventricle during a contraction, is a key metric of cardiovascular health. Currently, stroke volume is measured in clinic with specialised equipment. While purpose-made wearables exist to measure stroke volume, no solution relies solely on commodity devices. We present a deep learning system for stroke volume estimation from in-ear audio of earbuds. We combine generative self-supervised/transfer learning, a transformer-based autoencoder, to predict average stroke volume in unseen subjects. With data from 23 healthy participants, we compare our estimations to clinically validated device estimations. We achieve a mean absolute error of 5.24 ml, a Pearson correlation of r=0.94 between average predicted stroke volume and average true stroke volume, and a Percentage Error in the limits of agreement of 11.05% (within clinical range for stroke volume measurement devices). These findings open the doors to longitudinal, scalable and affordable cardiovascular measurement out of clinic.
title_zh: 通过耳内音频传感测量心搏量
abstract_zh: 每搏输出量，即收缩期间左心室射出的血液量，是心血管健康的关键指标。目前，每搏输出量是在临床上使用专用设备测量的。虽然存在用于测量每搏输出量的专用可穿戴设备，但没有任何解决方案完全依赖于商用设备。我们提出了一种深度学习系统，用于根据耳塞的耳内音频估计每搏输出量。我们结合生成式自监督/迁移学习（一种基于变压器的自动编码器）来预测未见过的受试者的平均每搏输出量。根据 23 名健康参与者的数据，我们将我们的估计与经过临床验证的设备估计进行比较。我们的平均绝对误差为 5.24 ml，平均预测每搏输出量与平均真实每搏输出量之间的皮尔逊相关性为 r=0.94，一致性限度内的百分比误差为 11.05%（在每搏输出量测量设备的临床范围内）。这些发现为临床外纵向、可扩展且负担得起的心血管测量打开了大门。

title: A computational framework for designing micron-scale crisscross DNA megastructures
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Crisscross polymerization enables the assembly of hundreds of unique DNA origami ‘slats’ into micron-sized structures with nanoscale precision. To design these megastructures, thousands of handle sequences from a fixed library must be assigned to individual slats to encode the desired binding architecture. This complexity presents two major challenges: handles must be selected to minimize parasitic interactions that compete with desired assembly, and the fabrication of hundreds of unique slats creates a substantial logistical burden. Here, we develop a unified framework that standardizes the design and fabrication of crisscross megastructures. We use an evolutionary algorithm to optimize handle assignment and minimize parasitic binding between slats. Together with an expanded handle library, the algorithm enables the assembly of large, multi-layered megastructures that otherwise would be produced at negligible yields. We have released this framework as #-CAD, an open-source graphical application that integrates these algorithms, streamlines laboratory workflows, and makes crisscross DNA origami more broadly accessible.
title_zh: 用于设计微米级纵横交错 DNA 巨型结构的计算框架
abstract_zh: 十字交叉聚合能够将数百个独特的 DNA 折纸“板条”组装成具有纳米级精度的微米级结构。为了设计这些巨型结构，必须将固定库中的数千个手柄序列分配给各个板条，以编码所需的结合架构。这种复杂性带来了两个主要挑战：必须选择手柄以最大限度地减少与所需组装竞争的寄生相互作用，并且制造数百个独特的板条会造成巨大的后勤负担。在这里，我们开发了一个统一的框架，使纵横交错的巨型结构的设计和制造标准化。我们使用进化算法来优化手柄分配并最大限度地减少板条之间的寄生结合。与扩展的句柄库一起，该算法能够组装大型多层巨型结构，否则这些巨型结构的产量可以忽略不计。我们将此框架发布为#-CAD，这是一个开源图形应用程序，它集成了这些算法，简化了实验室工作流程，并使十字形 DNA 折纸更广泛地可用。

title: Unraveling daily dynamics of supraglacial lakes in response to hydrological pulses and anomalous climate signals
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Mass loss from debris-covered glaciers in High Mountain Asia drives the expansion of small supraglacial lakes (SGLs) and changes the occurrence patterns of hazardous processes including glacial lake outburst floods. Here, we analyse surface area changes of small SGLs ( > 0.045×104 m2) in the Sagarmatha region, Eastern Himalaya, integrating data with daily resolution from 2016 to 2024. The results show SGLs expanded at a mean rate of 5.90 ± 1.49×104 m2·yr⁻¹. Starting from October 2022, SGLs in the study area have exhibited anomalous expansion, with the total lake area reached its maximum during this period, 67.35% higher than during the second peak (2020). The seasonal fluctuations of SGLs are synchronous with short-term variations in global temperature. By mid-century, SGL expansion in High Mountain Asia is expected to continue. Given their rapid response to climate change, small SGLs could support the development of early-warning frameworks for hydrological pulses and extreme climate events.
title_zh: 揭示冰上湖泊响应水文脉冲和异常气候信号的日常动态
abstract_zh: 亚洲高山碎屑覆盖的冰川质量损失推动了小型冰上湖泊（SGL）的扩张，并改变了包括冰川湖溃决洪水在内的危险过程的发生模式。在这里，我们分析了喜马拉雅东部萨加玛塔地区小型SGL（> 0.045×104 m2）的表面积变化，将数据与2016年至2024年的日分辨率进行了整合。结果显示SGL以平均5.90 ± 1.49×104 m2·yr⁻1的速度扩展。从2022年10月开始，研究区水体出现异常扩张，湖泊总面积在此期间达到最大值，比第二次高峰期（2020年）增加了67.35%。 SGL 的季节性波动与全球气温的短期变化同步。到本世纪中叶，西格里在亚洲高山地区的扩张预计将继续。鉴于其对气候变化的快速反应，小型SGL可以支持水文脉冲和极端气候事件预警框架的开发。

title: Ultrafast reset-free integrated polarization tracking enabled by thin-film lithium tantalate
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The rapid growth of artificial-intelligence computing demands high-bandwidth and energy-efficient data-center interconnects. Although self-homodyne coherent (SHC) transmission reduces digital signal-processing complexity, its practical deployment is limited by ultrafast state-of-polarization (SOP) fluctuations that destabilize coherent reception. Here we show an ultrafast adaptive polarization controller (APC) based on thin-film lithium tantalate, enabled by the co-design of a photonic chip, a finite-boundary gradient-descent (FBGD) algorithm, and a low-latency real-time control system. The FBGD algorithm incorporates the finite phase boundary directly into the control strategy, enabling reset-free continuous SOP tracking. The implemented APC is validated through both standalone polarization-tracking measurements and a dual-polarization 16-QAM SHC 400-Gbps transmission system. Stable reset-free operation under continuous polarization disturbances is maintained up to 1 Mrad·s⁻¹. These results establish a previously inaccessible operating regime for integrated polarization control and provide a practical route toward ultrafast and reset-free polarization control in coherent optical interconnects and other polarization-sensitive photonic systems.
title_zh: 由薄膜钽酸锂实现的超快无复位集成偏振跟踪
abstract_zh: 人工智能计算的快速增长需要高带宽和节能的数据中心互连。尽管自零差相干 (SHC) 传输降低了数字信号处理的复杂性，但其实际部署受到超快偏振状态 (SOP) 波动的限制，这种波动会破坏相干接收的稳定性。在这里，我们展示了一种基于薄膜钽酸锂的超快自适应偏振控制器（APC），通过光子芯片、有限边界梯度下降（FBGD）算法和低延迟实时控制系统的协同设计实现。 FBGD 算法将有限相边界直接纳入控制策略，从而实现无重置连续 SOP 跟踪。所实施的 APC 通过独立偏振跟踪测量和双偏振 16-QAM SHC 400-Gbps 传输系统进行了验证。在连续极化扰动下可保持稳定的无复位操作，最高可达 1 Mrad·s⁻1。这些结果为集成偏振控制建立了以前无法实现的操作机制，并为相干光互连和其他偏振敏感光子系统中的超快和无复位偏振控制提供了实用途径。

title: ZnF-UBP domains regulate deubiquitinase activity by relieving ubiquitin product inhibition
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Most ubiquitin specific protease (USP) deubiquitinases (DUBs) combine non-selective catalytic domains with one or multiple ‘exo’-domains that contribute substrate specificity and localisation, but are generally poorly characterised. Zinc-Finger UBP (ZnF-UBP) domains exist in 12 USP DUBs, yet their function is unclear. We here comprehensively analyse human ZnF-UBP domains, and reveal that 8 of 14 bind ubiquitin (Ub) via an unattached Ub C-terminal GlyGly motif. We focus on USP16, a nucleosome DUB with activity for Ub and Ub-like modifiers, and show that its ZnF-UBP domain can bind substrates, but is also a crucial contributor to enzyme kinetics. Slow Ub release from the catalytic domain after cleavage causes product inhibition, which is overcome in cis by ZnF-UBP-mediated product release. Interestingly, supplying a high affinity product-capturing ZnF-UBP domain in trans, activates USP16 and other USP enzymes. Our data shows the importance of product inhibition as a regulatory mechanism in DUBs, and exemplifies the unappreciated role of exo-domains in regulating DUB function beyond substrate binding.
title_zh: ZnF-UBP 结构域通过缓解泛素产物抑制来调节去泛素酶活性
abstract_zh: 大多数泛素特异性蛋白酶 (USP) 去泛素酶 (DUB) 将非选择性催化结构域与一个或多个“外切”结构域结合起来，这些结构域有助于底物特异性和定位，但通常表征较差。锌指 UBP (ZnF-UBP) 结构域存在于 12 个 USP DUB 中，但其功能尚不清楚。我们在这里全面分析了人类 ZnF-UBP 结构域，并揭示了 14 个中的 8 个通过未连接的 Ub C 端 GlyGly 基序结合泛素 (Ub)。我们重点关注 USP16，一种具有 Ub 和 Ub 样修饰剂活性的核小体 DUB，并表明其 ZnF-UBP 结构域可以结合底物，但也是酶动力学的重要贡献者。裂解后 Ub 从催化结构域缓慢释放会导致产物抑制，顺式中可通过 ZnF-UBP 介导的产物释放来克服这种抑制。有趣的是，提供反式高亲和力产物捕获 ZnF-UBP 结构域可激活 USP16 和其他 USP 酶。我们的数据显示了产物抑制作为 DUB 调节机制的重要性，并举例说明了外切结构域在调节底物结合之外的 DUB 功能中未被充分认识的作用。

title: Highly Efficient Methane Electrosynthesis Enabled by Precise, Multifaceted Interface Regulation
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The electrocatalytic reduction of carbon dioxide (CO2) offers a pathway to transform greenhouse gas emissions into fuels and chemicals using renewable electricity. Among possible products, methane (CH4) is particularly attractive due to its high energy density and seamless integration with existing natural gas infrastructure, yet its electrosynthesis is hindered by demanding multi-electron kinetics and mass-transport constraints. Here, we report a four-channel copper tubular penetration electrode (TPE) with a honeycomb-like architecture that fundamentally reshapes the reaction environment for CO2 electroreduction. By precisely controlling electrode cross-sectional thickness, this multi-channel design regulates gas, electron, and electrolyte transport, stabilizing the three-phase interface required for efficient CH4 formation. The optimized TPE achieves a CH4 Faradaic efficiency of 87.5%, a half-cell energy efficiency of 43.46%, and stable operation for 100 hours. Combined experimental and theoretical analyses reveal that rational design of electrode architecture enables precise control over the CO2 adsorption configurations and reaction intermediates, thereby fine-tuning the reaction pathway toward CH4. These findings establish multi-channel TPEs as a powerful platform for efficient CO2 electromethanation.
title_zh: 通过精确、多方面的界面调节实现高效甲烷电合成
abstract_zh: 二氧化碳 (CO2) 的电催化还原提供了一种利用可再生电力将温室气体排放转化为燃料和化学品的途径。在可能的产品中，甲烷（CH4）由于其高能量密度和与现有天然气基础设施的无缝集成而特别有吸引力，但其电合成受到苛刻的多电子动力学和质量传输限制的阻碍。在这里，我们报告了一种具有蜂窝状结构的四通道铜管穿透电极（TPE），它从根本上重塑了二氧化碳电还原的反应环境。通过精确控制电极横截面厚度，这种多通道设计可调节气体、电子和电解质传输，从而稳定高效形成 CH4 所需的三相界面。优化后的TPE，CH4法拉第效率达到87.5%，半片能效达到43.46%，稳定运行100小时。实验和理论分析相结合表明，电极结构的合理设计可以精确控制CO2吸附构型和反应中间体，从而微调CH4的反应路径。这些发现将多通道 TPE 确立为高效二氧化碳电甲烷化的强大平台。

title: Quasi-solitons in Rydberg atom chains
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Solitons—localized wave packets that travel without spreading—play a central role in understanding transport and properties of nonlinear systems. In quantum many-body systems, however, such robust excitations are typically destroyed by thermalization. Here, we theoretically demonstrate the existence of solitonic excitations in high-energy states of Rydberg atom chains in the regime of strong nearest-neighbor Rydberg blockade. These localized wave packets propagate directionally atop a special class of reviving initial states related to quantum many-body scars and are capable of carrying energy. Exhibiting long coherence times, these states constitute a form of non-ergodic quantum dynamics and can be efficiently implemented on Rydberg atom simulators. In this work, in addition to a phenomenological description of solitons, we identify their counterpart in a classical nonlinear dynamical system, demonstrate their potential use in quantum information transfer, and conjecture their relevance for anomalous energy transport reported in numerical studies of Rydberg atom arrays.
title_zh: 里德伯原子链中的准孤子
abstract_zh: 孤子（传播时不扩散的局域波包）在理解非线性系统的传输和特性方面发挥着核心作用。然而，在量子多体系统中，这种强大的激发通常会被热化破坏。在这里，我们从理论上证明了在强最近邻里德伯封锁状态下里德伯原子链高能态中孤子激发的存在。这些局域波包在与量子多体疤痕相关的一类特殊的恢复初始态上定向传播，并且能够携带能量。这些状态具有较长的相干时间，构成了非遍历量子动力学的一种形式，并且可以在里德堡原子模拟器上有效地实现。在这项工作中，除了对孤子的现象学描述之外，我们还确定了它们在经典非线性动力系统中的对应物，证明了它们在量子信息传输中的潜在用途，并推测了它们与里德堡原子阵列数值研究中报告的异常能量传输的相关性。

title: Charge-spin dichotomy in the kagome metal CsCr3Sb5
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Kagome metals host a variety of correlated electronic states, yet the nature of their intertwined orders remains an open question. The recently discovered Cr-based kagome compound CsCr3Sb5 differs from its V-based analogue CsV3Sb5 by exhibiting stronger correlations and a magnetic ground state. While multiple broken symmetries have been reported in CsV3Sb5, only a single transition at T* ≈ 55 K has been identified at ambient pressure in CsCr3Sb5, with its origin unresolved. Here we uncover an additional phase transition above T* through elastoresistivity measurements. Rotational symmetry breaking without divergent nematic susceptibility is identified around T ≈ 64 K, which is most consistently explained as the emergence of charge-density-wave order. Laser-based photoemission-electron microscopy further reveals three-domain structures associated with spin-density-wave order below T*. These findings indicate distinct charge and spin order transitions in CsCr3Sb5, offering crucial insight into the intertwined orders and pressure-induced superconductivity in this system.
title_zh: kagome 金属 CsCr3Sb5 中的电荷自旋二分法
abstract_zh: Kagome 金属具有多种相关的电子态，但它们相互交织的秩序的性质仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。最近发现的 Cr 基 kagome 化合物 CsCr3Sb5 与其 V 基类似物 CsV3Sb5 不同，表现出更强的相关性和磁性基态。虽然 CsV3Sb5 中已报道了多个对称性破缺，但在 CsCr3Sb5 中，在环境压力下仅在 T* ≈ 55 K 处发现了单个跃迁，其起源尚未解决。在这里，我们通过弹性电阻率测量发现了高于 T* 的额外相变。在 T ≈ 64 K 附近，确定了旋转对称性破缺而没有发散向列磁化率，这最一致地解释为电荷密度波序的出现。基于激光的光电子显微镜进一步揭示了与低于 T* 的自旋密度波级相关的三域结构。这些发现表明 CsCr3Sb5 中存在明显的电荷和自旋顺序转变，为了解该系统中相互交织的顺序和压力诱导的超导性提供了重要的见解。

title: Probe the Electron Spin Polarization of the Otherwise Unobservable 3MLCT Triplet State Through Polarization Transfer Accompanying the Intramolecular Triplet–Triplet Energy Transfer in Pt(II)‐Salen Schiff Base Complexes
source: Wiley: Angewandte Chemie International Edition: Table of Contents
abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  
                    The non‐Boltzmann population of the triplet sublevels in Pt(II)‐Schiff base complexes, and other phosphorescent transition metal complexes, exhibits large zero‐field splitting (ZFS, ∼25 cm
                    −1

title: A Multidentate Coordination Complex‐Based Self‐Assembled Monolayer Stabilizes Perovskite Interface
source: Wiley: Angewandte Chemie International Edition: Table of Contents
abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  
                    Self‐assembled monolayers (SAMs) have emerged as promising hole‐selective contacts for buried‐interface engineering in inverted perovskite photovoltaics. However, most reported SAMs rely on a single phosphonic‐acid anchoring group, which is prone to desorption during device fabrication and operation. In addition, their limited affinity for perovskite precursors often leads to poor wettability and non‐ideal interfacial film formation. Here, we report a multidentate Fe(III) porphyrin complex as a co‐SAM component that simultaneously reinforces substrate anchoring and promotes interfacial coupling with the perovskite, thereby stabilizing the buried interface. The four phosphonic‐acid groups on porphyrin enable robust tetradentate chelation with the oxide substrate, increasing the adsorption energy by more than threefold. Meanwhile, the Fe center stabilizes the axial chloride ligand, which interacts with perovskite precursor, increases the apparent surface energy by ∼30%, and reduces the contact angle by ∼40%, thereby promoting high‐quality perovskite crystallization. As a result, small‐area devices achieve a power conversion efficiency of 27.06% (certified 26.82%), while perovskite modules deliver 24.1% efficiency over a 21.54 cm
                    2
                    aperture area, together with substantially improved operational stability. These results establish coordination‐complex‐based SAMs as an effective platform for stabilizing buried interfaces in perovskite photovoltaics.

title: A Carbon‐Induced Surface Reconstruction on an Operating Fischer–Tropsch Catalyst
source: Wiley: Angewandte Chemie International Edition: Table of Contents
abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  
                    Heterogeneous catalysts are often assumed to undergo substantial chemical and morphological changes under reaction conditions. However, obtaining information on the state of a catalyst surface at the usually applied high pressures is difficult. For the Co catalyst used in the industrial Fischer–Tropsch synthesis, a widely held view is that the surface experiences a carbon‐induced roughening that is essential for its activity. We have tested this idea by performing the reaction on a Co(0001) surface with a sacrificial carbide layer. In situ scanning tunneling microscopy experiments at ∼1 bar synthesis gas and 473 K show that, at the increased C coverage, the surface does not undergo the predicted roughening. Instead, a unique carbon‐induced reconstruction forms, consisting of triangular partial stacking faults in which C atoms occupy the fault lines. Density functional theory calculations reveal that the reconstruction is more stable than the roughened state. For the detectable range of C
                    1
                    to C
                    4
                    reaction products, gas chromatography shows no effect of the reconstruction, consistent with the view that the activity is primarily determined by the density of atomic steps, which remains unchanged. These findings can serve as a new basis for describing the Co particles of the industrial catalyst.

ABSTRACT

In this work, we demonstrate that heteroatom substitutions program conformational switching in azole γ‐peptides by tuning intrinsic stereoelectronic effects within heterocyclic γ‐amino acids. Here, permutation of the sulfur and nitrogen atoms within the heterocycle induces a stretched helical structure with alternating
                    C

This unusual topology arises from competition between seven‐membered intra‐residue H‐bonds and attractive S···N electrostatic‐chalcogen interactions. title: Biosynthesis of the Fully Saturated C16 Homosesquiterpene Descartane Through Deprotonation With Cyclopropanation

abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  
                    Non‐canonical terpene biosynthesis expands structural diversity beyond the classical C
                    5n
                    logic. Here we report the discovery of descartane, a C
                    16

Functional characterisation demonstrated that MmTC converts α‐presodorifen pyrophosphate (α‐PSPP) into descartane. The cyclisation cascade was investigated by extensive isotopic labelling experiments and density functional theory (DFT) calculations, revealing a complex pathway involving fragmentation‐recombination, multiple hydride shifts, and cyclopropane formation. These findings establish the biosynthetic origin of descartane and show how subtle changes in the active site can reprogram complex terpene cyclisation cascades.
