abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  In this study, we compare three scanning probe techniques— spectroscopy, field‐emission resonances (FER), and Kelvin probe force spectroscopy (KPFS)—for quantitative local work function measurements. Using Ag(111) as a reference and applying the methods to Ir(111) and Au(111), we find a strong method dependence.  spectroscopy shows substantial uncertainty due to broad data dispersion and is reliable only on flat surfaces. We show that the triangular‐barrier FER extrapolation method lacks robustness, whereas numerical FER analysis based on an image potential‐corrected Schrödinger model yields consistent values. KPFS provides the most direct and reliable work function determination once the tip is calibrated. Applying these methods to superconducting Nb, we extract the work functions of (111) and (110) surfaces and its distinct oxygen‐reconstructed phases.
title_zh: 基于扫描探针显微镜的功函数测量技术的比较分析
abstract_zh:
摘要
                  在这项研究中，我们比较了三种扫描探针技术——光谱、场发射共振（FER）和开尔文探针力光谱（KPFS）——用于定量局部功函数测量。使用 Ag(111) 作为参考并将这些方法应用于 Ir(111) 和 Au(111)，我们发现了很强的方法依赖性。  由于广泛的数据分散，光谱显示出很大的不确定性，并且仅在平坦的表面上可靠。我们表明，三角势垒 FER 外推法缺乏鲁棒性，而基于图像势校正薛定谔模型的数值 FER 分析却得出一致的值。尖端校准后，KPFS 可提供最直接、最可靠的功函数测定。将这些方法应用于超导铌，我们提取了 (111) 和 (110) 表面的功函数及其独特的氧重构相。

title: Oxygen-Driven [2 + 2] Photocycloaddition for In Vivo Chemiluminescence
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Chemiluminescence, the direct conversion of chemical energy into light, offers an exceptionally sensitive platform for molecular imaging. However, its in vivo application is practically hindered by the lack of a biocompatible strategy for generating highly strained cyclic peroxides─the energetic cores of light emission. Herein, we present an in vivo [2 + 2] intermolecular photocycloaddition that harnesses molecular oxygen as a direct reactant to in situ generate high-energy 1,2-dioxetanes within living systems. Rationally designed electron donor-substituted olefins provide oxygen-specific addition sites and exhibit prolonged intermediate lifetimes (25-fold) via bioconfined catalysis, as demonstrated by femtosecond transient absorption spectroscopy. Our de novo designed chemiluminophores, termed as Rubines, emit bright red in vivo luminescence, greatly surpassing conventional luminescent substrates. Rubines enable direct visualization in Biomphalaria snails and living mice, and particularly function as nonradioactive "chemiluminescent nuclides" probes to monitor progressive degradation and self-repair of the blood-brain barrier (BBB) integrity in real time. This work establishes a next-generation, high-brightness in vivo chemiluminescence platform suited for ultrasensitive, noninvasive molecular imaging and diagnostics.
title_zh: 用于体内化学发光的氧驱动 [2 + 2] 光环加成
abstract_zh: 化学发光是将化学能直接转化为光，为分子成像提供了异常灵敏的平台。然而，由于缺乏产生高张力环状过氧化物（光发射的能量核心）的生物相容性策略，其在体内的应用实际上受到阻碍。在此，我们提出了一种体内[2 + 2]分子间光环加成，利用分子氧作为直接反应物在生命系统内原位生成高能1,2-二氧杂环丁烷。合理设计的电子供体取代的烯烃提供了氧特异性加成位点，并通过生物限制催化表现出延长的中间寿命（25倍），如飞秒瞬态吸收光谱所证明的那样。我们从头设计的化学发光体（称为 Rubines）在体内发出亮红色的光，大大超过了传统的发光底物。红宝石能够在双脐螺和活体小鼠中直接可视化，特别是作为非放射性“化学发光核素”探针来实时监测血脑屏障（BBB）完整性的逐渐退化和自我修复。这项工作建立了适合超灵敏、非侵入性分子成像和诊断的下一代高亮度体内化学发光平台。

title: Crystallographic Visualization of the Missing Structural Evolution of Copper Nanoclusters
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Copper nanoclusters have recently garnered immense interest across chemistry and materials science, yet precise control over their growth processes is hindered by a limited fundamental understanding of structural evolution. Here, we unlock atomic-level insights into their structural evolution by determining the structures of six distinct clusters─Cu12, Cu23-a, Cu23-b, Cu25-a, Cu25-b, and Cu61─isolated from a single synthetic system employing a disulfide-mediated protection strategy. By precisely tuning the reaction temperature and time, we strictly control the growth kinetics within this system. Single-crystal X-ray diffraction uncovers that hexameric Cu3S3 and octameric Cu4S4 rings act as versatile modular motifs, which encapsulate well-defined metal kernels to direct the structural evolution of all-thiolate-protected copper nanoclusters. Notably, structural isomerization is observed within this cluster series. By presenting the first experimental evidence from a homologous series of size-incremental copper-thiolate nanoclusters, this work provides atomic-level insights into how fundamental building motifs and surface coordination chemistry cooperatively direct the targeted synthesis of functional copper nanoclusters.
title_zh: 铜纳米团簇缺失结构演化的晶体学可视化
abstract_zh: 铜纳米团簇最近在化学和材料科学领域引起了极大的兴趣，但对结构演化的基本了解有限，阻碍了对其生长过程的精确控制。在这里，我们通过确定六个不同簇（Cu12、Cu23-a、Cu23-b、Cu25-a、Cu25-b 和 Cu61）的结构来解锁其结构演化的原子级见解，这些簇是采用二硫化物介导的保护策略从单个合成系统中分离出来的。通过精确调节反应温度和时间，我们严格控制该系统内的生长动力学。单晶 X 射线衍射揭示了六聚 Cu3S3 和八聚 Cu4S4 环作为多功能模块化图案，封装了明确的金属内核，以指导全硫醇保护的铜纳米团簇的结构演化。值得注意的是，在该簇系列中观察到结构异构化。通过提出来自一系列同源尺寸增量铜硫醇盐纳米团簇的第一个实验证据，这项工作提供了原子水平的见解，了解基本构建图案和表面配位化学如何协同指导功能性铜纳米团簇的靶向合成。

title: Programmable Helicity and Spin Polarization in Pt 6 L 4 Coordination Capsules through Guest-Mediated Chiral Control
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Programmable regulation of spin polarization enables molecular-scale spin filtering, yet reversible control of its sign in supramolecular systems remains challenging. Herein, a chiral-directing strategy modulates multiple helical states of octahedral capsules, enabling programmable and reversible control of chirality-induced spin selectivity (CISS). The strategy transfers (R)-1,1'-bi-2-naphthol chirality to induce capsule helicity, followed by controlled helicity inversion upon introduction of (R)-1,1'-binaphthyl-2,2'-diylhydrogen phosphate via host-guest interactions. Magnetic circular dichroism (MCD) reveals chirality-dependent changes in electronic states, while magnetic conductive atomic force microscopy (mc-AFM) independently demonstrates spin-selective charge transport. Systematic modulation of host-guest electronic coupling enables reversible switching of spin polarization. These results demonstrate that dynamic, chirality-matched host-guest interactions emulate enzymatic stereochemical control, offering molecular-level insight and a general design principle for chiral coordination architectures with programmable spin functions.
title_zh: 通过客体介导的手性控制实现 Pt 6 L 4 配位胶囊中的可编程螺旋度和自旋极化
abstract_zh: 自旋极化的可编程调节使得分子尺度的自旋过滤成为可能，但在超分子系统中对其符号的可逆控制仍然具有挑战性。在此，手性导向策略调节八面体胶囊的多个螺旋态，从而实现手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）的可编程和可逆控制。该策略转移 (R)-1,1'-双-2-萘酚手性以诱导胶囊螺旋性，然后通过主客体相互作用引入 (R)-1,1'-联萘基-2,2'-二基磷酸氢盐后进行受控螺旋性反转。磁圆二色性 (MCD) 揭示了电子态中手性相关的变化，而磁导原子力显微镜 (mc-AFM) 则独立地展示了自旋选择性电荷传输。主客体电子耦合的系统调制能够实现自旋极化的可逆切换。这些结果表明，动态、手性匹配的主客体相互作用模拟了酶立体化学控制，为具有可编程自旋功能的手性配位结构提供了分子水平的洞察和一般设计原理。

title: Supramolecular Seeding-Induced Fibrillar Refinement for High Efficiency and Stable Organic Solar Cells
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Achieving optimal morphology and long-term stability in organic solar cells (OSCs) remains challenging because the donor-acceptor crystallization sequence is often poorly coordinated during solution processing. Here, we develop a supramolecular crystallization seeding strategy by introducing a hydroxyl-terminated, highly crystalline acceptor (Y-OH) into the D18/L8-BO system. By engineering a hierarchical thermodynamic compatibility gradient (χD18/Y-OH > χL8-BO/Y-OH > χD18/L8-BO), Y-OH becomes interface-active and exhibits an interfacial distribution tendency in the multicomponent film. In situ UV-vis measurements reveal that Y-OH undergoes early stage ordering on a time scale closer to the donor, thereby participating in the initial morphology evolution and steering the subsequent organization of L8-BO into a refined interpenetrating fibrillar network with reduced fibril diameters. This morphology simultaneously promotes efficient exciton harvesting/charge generation and enables balanced charge transport, leading to concurrent enhancements in short-circuit current density (JSC) and fill factor (FF). As a result, the optimized ternary devices deliver a PCE of 20.90% (vs 20.05% for the binary control). Moreover, hydroxyl-enabled supramolecular interactions provide noncovalent anchoring that retards thermally driven morphology relaxation, allowing the devices to retain ≈83% of their initial efficiency after 900 h at 65 °C. This work highlights supramolecular crystallization seeding as an effective design principle for simultaneously improving efficiency and thermal stability in OSCs.
title_zh: 超分子晶种诱导原纤维细化，实现高效、稳定的有机太阳能电池
abstract_zh: 在有机太阳能电池（OSC）中实现最佳形态和长期稳定性仍然具有挑战性，因为在溶液处理过程中供体-受体结晶顺序通常协调不佳。在这里，我们通过将羟基封端的高度结晶受体（Y-OH）引入D18/L8-BO系统来开发超分子结晶晶种策略。通过设计分层热力学相容性梯度（χD18/Y-OH > χL8-BO/Y-OH > χD18/L8-BO），Y-OH 变得具有界面活性，并在多组分薄膜中表现出界面分布趋势。原位紫外-可见光测量表明，Y-OH 在更接近供体的时间尺度上经历早期排序，从而参与初始形态演化，并引导 L8-BO 的后续组织形成细化的互穿原纤维网络，原纤维直径减小。这种形态同时促进有效的激子收集/电荷生成并实现平衡的电荷传输，从而同时增强短路电流密度（JSC）和填充因子（FF）。因此，优化的三元器件的 PCE 为 20.90%（而二元控制的 PCE 为 20.05%）。此外，羟基超分子相互作用提供非共价锚定，延缓热驱动的形态松弛，使器件在 65°C 下 900 小时后仍能保持约 83% 的初始效率。这项工作强调了超分子结晶晶种作为一种有效的设计原理，可同时提高效率和热稳定性

title: Ferroelectric Switchable Altermagnetic-Like Compensated Ferrimagnets with Charge Ordering
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Unconventional collinear magnets with almost zero magnetization but prominent nonrelativistic spin splitting, such as altermagnets, can inherit the advantages of both ferromagnets and antiferromagnets. By incorporating more degrees of freedom such as ferroelectricity and charge ordering, these unconventional magnets can be even more interesting and functionalized. With this design principle, the Fe3O5 monolayer is predicted to exhibit a hybrid spin-splitting mechanism, with the superposition of the altermagnetic-like k-path alternating splitting and ferrimagnet-like Zeeman splitting. Benefiting from the hidden magnetoelectricity based on spin-charge coupling, such spin splitting can be fully switched by an electric field. Its conductivity is highly spin-polarized, with a polarization ratio above 99%, comparable to half-metals but with zero magnetization.
title_zh: 具有电荷排序的铁电可切换类交变磁体补偿亚铁磁体
abstract_zh: 磁化强度几乎为零但具有突出的非相对论性自旋分裂的非常规共线磁体，例如交替磁体，可以继承铁磁体和反铁磁体的优点。通过结合更多的自由度，例如铁电性和电荷排序，这些非常规磁体可以变得更加有趣和功能化。根据这一设计原理，Fe3O5 单层预计将表现出混合自旋分裂机制，具有类交变磁 k 路径交替分裂和类亚铁磁体塞曼分裂的叠加。受益于基于自旋电荷耦合的隐藏磁电，这种自旋分裂可以通过电场完全切换。其电导率是高度自旋极化的，极化率超过99%，可与半金属媲美，但磁化强度为零。

title: Low-Voltage Resistive Switching and Synaptic Plasticity in Cs 2 AgBiBr 6 Memristors
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Synaptic devices that can store and process data are imperative to mimic the operation of the human brain. In this work, lead-free double perovskite Cs2AgBiBr6 memristors were fabricated on ITO/glass substrates with thermally evaporated Ag top electrodes and systematically investigated for their resistive switching (RS) and neuromorphic functionalities. The devices exhibit stable, low-voltage (+0.239 ± 0.018 V) volatile resistive switching with good cycle-to-cycle reproducibility. A maximum ON/OFF ratio exceeding 105 is maintained for 24 cycles, while values above 102 persist for 1100 cycles. Electrical analysis reveals that the switching behavior is governed by ion migration-induced filament formation, primarily involving mobile Br- ions, VBr+ vacancies, and Ag+ ions injected from the electrode. A detailed conduction model is proposed based on space charge-limited conduction and ion-induced electric field screening. Furthermore, the volatile RS characteristics enable biologically inspired synaptic functions, including spike amplitude-dependent plasticity (SADP), spike number-dependent plasticity (SNDP), and paired-pulse facilitation (PPF) with a maximum facilitation index of 169%, benchmarking competitively among perovskite memristive synapses. Based on experimentally extracted synaptic weight-update rules, an artificial neural network simulation achieved a peak recognition accuracy of 98%.
title_zh: Cs 2 AgBiBr 6 忆阻器中的低压电阻开关和突触可塑性
abstract_zh: 能够存储和处理数据的突触设备对于模仿人脑的运作至关重要。在这项工作中，在具有热蒸发Ag顶部电极的ITO/玻璃基板上制造了无铅双钙钛矿Cs2AgBiBr6忆阻器，并系统地研究了它们的电阻开关（RS）和神经形态功能。该器件具有稳定的低电压 (+0.239 ± 0.018 V) 易失性电阻开关以及良好的周期再现性。超过 105 的最大开/关比可维持 24 个周期，而高于 102 的值可维持 1100 个周期。电学分析表明，开关行为受离子迁移引起的细丝形成的控制，主要涉及移动的 Br- 离子、VBr+ 空位和从电极注入的 Ag+ 离子。基于空间电荷限制传导和离子感应电场屏蔽，提出了详细的传导模型。此外，不稳定的RS特性能够实现受生物启发的突触功能，包括尖峰幅度依赖性可塑性（SADP）、尖峰数量依赖性可塑性（SNDP）和最大促进指数为169%的配对脉冲促进（PPF），在钙钛矿忆阻突触中具有竞争力。基于实验提取的突触权重更新规则，人工神经网络模拟实现了 98% 的峰值识别准确率。

title: Chiral 3d–4f Clusters with NIR-III Magneto-Optical Activity Driven by Lanthanide f–f Transition
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Chiral molecular materials with strong magneto-optical responses in the near-infrared III (NIR-III, 1600-2500 nm) region are attractive for applications in photonics, biomedicine, and advanced optical materials, but molecular magneto-optical phenomena in this spectral window remain largely unexplored. Here, we report six pairs of chiral 3d-4f molecular clusters, R/S-Ln3Mn4 and R/S-Ln12Mn12 (Ln = HoIII, TbIII, and YIII), and systematically investigate their chiroptical and magneto-optical properties in the NIR-III region. Circular dichroism (CD) and magnetic circular dichroism (MCD) spectroscopy reveal that R/S-Ho3Mn4 and R/S-Ho12Mn12 clusters exhibit pronounced CD and MCD responses in the NIR-III region arising from long-wavelength HoIII f-f transitions, whereas R/S-Tb3Mn4 and R/S-Tb12Mn12 show strong MCD responses but no resolved CD signals. These findings identify long-wavelength lanthanide f-f transitions as the origin of the NIR-III chiroptical and magneto-optical activity. Notably, the R/S-Ln12Mn12 series exhibits larger gMCD values and stronger NIR-III MCD responses than the corresponding R/S-Ln3Mn4 analogues. This enhancement may arise from the change in local LnIII coordination geometry from D4d in Ln3Mn4 to D2d in Ln12Mn12, which favors a stronger Zeeman-perturbed MCD response, along with cooperative LnIII-MnII weak magnetic interactions in Ln12Mn12. This work provides the first molecular example of f-f-transition-driven chiroptical and magneto-optical activity across the NIR-III window and establishes chiral 3d-4f clusters as structurally defined platforms for tuning long-wavelength magneto-optical responses.
title_zh: 具有由镧系元素 f-f 跃迁驱动的 NIR-III 磁光活性的手性 3d-4f 簇
abstract_zh: 在近红外 III（NIR-III，1600-2500 nm）区域具有强磁光响应的手性分子材料对于光子学、生物医学和先进光学材料的应用具有吸引力，但该光谱窗口中的分子磁光现象在很大程度上仍未得到探索。在这里，我们报告了六对手性3d-4f分子簇R/S-Ln3Mn4和R/S-Ln12Mn12（Ln = HoIII、TbIII和YIII），并系统地研究了它们在NIR-III区域的手性光学和磁光特性。圆二色性 (CD) 和磁圆二色性 (MCD) 光谱表明，R/S-Ho3Mn4 和 R/S-Ho12Mn12 团簇在 NIR-III 区域中由于长波长 HoIII f-f 跃迁表现出明显的 CD 和 MCD 响应，而 R/S-Tb3Mn4 和 R/S-Tb12Mn12 显示出强烈的 MCD 响应，但没有解析的 CD 信号。这些发现确定长波长镧系元素 f-f 跃迁是 NIR-III 手性光学和磁光活动的起源。值得注意的是，R/S-Ln12Mn12 系列比相应的 R/S-Ln3Mn4 类似物表现出更大的 gMCD 值和更强的 NIR-III MCD 响应。这种增强可能源于局部 LnIII 配位几何结构从 Ln3Mn4 中的 D4d 到 Ln12Mn12 中的 D2d 的变化，这有利于更强的塞曼扰动 MCD 响应，以及 Ln12Mn12 中协同的 LnIII-MnII 弱磁相互作用。这项工作提供了第一个跨越 NIR-III 窗口的 f-f-跃迁驱动的手性光和磁光活性的分子例子，并建立了手性 3d-4f 簇作为 tun 的结构定义平台。

title: Development of switching-aware model predictive control solutions for fixed-frequency residential air conditioners
source: ScienceDirect Publication: Applied Energy
abstract: Binary ON/OFF actuation in fixed-frequency residential air conditioners creates a practical gap between economic model predictive control and deployable controllers: the controller is expected to reduce operating cost without causing rapid cycling, comfort violations, or excessive computational burden. This paper develops and evaluates five switching-aware model predictive control solutions for fixed-frequency residential air conditioners under dynamic electricity pricing. The studied solutions include three mixed-integer formulations with switching penalties, frequency limits, or minimum ON/OFF durations, and two continuous-relaxation formulations followed by threshold or Delta-Sigma ( Δ - Σ ) quantization. To enable a controlled and reproducible comparison, all controllers are tested with the same system dynamic model (1R1C model), the same BOPTEST BESTEST Hydronic Heat Pump emulator, and evaluation metrics, including cost, discomfort, switching, and computation-time metrics. The implementation settings are made explicit, including a 10-min control step, a 36-step horizon, CVXPY, ECOS_BB for mixed-integer programs, and OSQP for continuous relaxations. The results show that all model predictive control formulations reduce operating cost by 14%–24% relative to a thermostatic baseline while improving thermal comfort. Under the tested assumptions, the soft-constrained formulation provides the most balanced observed trade-off because of its broad tuning-insensitive region, while the Δ - Σ formulation provides a low-latency alternative though with higher tuning sensitivity. These findings provide practical guidance for selecting switching-aware control formulations for resource-constrained residential applications.

title: Heating system decarbonization decisions in homeowner associations: a Bayesian learning agent-based model
source: ScienceDirect Publication: Applied Energy
abstract: Decarbonizing shared heating systems in multi-owned apartment buildings requires collective decisions under uncertainty, in which heterogeneous households repeatedly evaluate the proposal across multiple meetings before a supermajority can pass. This paper develops a stylized agent-based framework of repeated voting in homeowner associations (HOAs / VvEs), in which households parameterized using latent-class discrete-choice estimates update beliefs about heating-system attributes through Bayesian updating with heuristic signal construction. The framework is demonstrated through a Dutch VvE setting comparing a baseline repeated-voting process with a board-mediated information architecture that combines trusted information hubs, intensified information sharing, lower hub uncertainty, and central network position. Across 100 Monte Carlo runs, the board-mediated setting reaches the 70% supermajority threshold in 70 of 100 runs versus 50 of 100 in the baseline, with mean approval rising from 63.2% to 69.0%. A component decomposition shows that the effect arises from the joint operation of the four board components rather than from any individual component. A vote-switching diagnostic based on conditional transition probabilities shows that the board-mediated architecture makes votes stickier in both directions, opponents convert less and supporters defect less, with the reduction in supporter defection robustly the larger of the two. The architecture therefore raises attainment by reducing decision volatility, with a robust supporter-stabilization component, rather than by converting entrenched opponents. The paper contributes a transparent computational framework for studying how heterogeneous preferences, belief updating, and trusted information channels jointly shape repeated collective decisions, and a testable hypothesis: a board-mediated information architecture raises supermajority attainment by reducing decision volatility and accelerating convergence, and stabilizing the pivotal, uncertainty-sensitive household class rather than converting entrenched opponents.
title_zh: 房主协会供暖系统脱碳决策：基于贝叶斯学习代理的模型
abstract_zh: 多户公寓大楼的共享供暖系统脱碳需要在不确定的情况下进行集体决策，其中异构家庭在多次会议上反复评估该提案，然后才能获得绝大多数通过。本文开发了一种基于主体的程式化的房主协会（HOA / VvE）重复投票框架，其中使用潜在类离散选择估计进行参数化的家庭通过启发式信号构建的贝叶斯更新来更新有关供暖系统属性的信念。该框架通过荷兰 VvE 设置进行演示，将基线重复投票过程与董事会介导的信息架构进行比较，该架构结合了受信任的信息中心、强化的信息共享、较低的中心不确定性和中央网络位置。在 100 次蒙特卡罗运行中，董事会介导的设置在 100 次运行中的 70 次中达到了 70% 的绝对多数阈值，而在基线中为 100 次运行中的 50 次，平均认可度从 63.2% 上升到 69.0%。组件分解表明，效果是由四个板组件的联合操作产生的，而不是由任何单独的组件产生的。基于条件转换概率的投票转换诊断表明，以董事会为中介的架构使选票在两个方向上都更具粘性，反对者转换较少，支持者叛逃较少，而支持者叛逃的减少则以两者中较大者为显着。因此，该架构通过减少决策波动性和强大的支持者稳定组件来提高成就，而不是通过沟通

title: Comprehensive system level modeling of anion exchange membrane water electrolysis for high efficiency hydrogen production
source: ScienceDirect Publication: Applied Energy
abstract: Anion exchange membrane water electrolysis (AEMWE) is recognized as a promising route to low cost, high efficiency green hydrogen production. A comprehensive system model was developed and implemented in Aspen Plus®, in which a zero dimensional electrochemical stack was embedded via a Fortran subroutine, along with an iterative solution scheme implemented within the subroutine. The framework reveals the coupled interaction between mass balance and operating conditions governing water management, and quantitatively resolves phenomena that were previously treated conceptually through a numerical method, enabling direct quantification of water transport and predictive analysis of system behavior. The full Balance of Plant (BOP) (separator, heater, heat exchanger, pumps, chiller, condenser, and dryer) was represented, and simulations were performed across various operating conditions (current density, temperature, pressure). The results are analyzed in terms of the cell voltage, hydrogen purity, water transport, and BOP power consumption. Key findings include: (1) the cathode outlet water flow was reduced by 54.62% as current density increased from 0.4 to 1.8 A/cm 2 , underscoring the necessity of cathode water management; (2) hydrogen purity at the condenser varied widely with operating conditions, reaching 99.84% at 0.4 A/cm 2 , 40 °C and 50 bar; and (3) for high hydrogen production with a moderate energy penalty, operating at 80 °C and 25 bar under high current density was identified as preferable. The developed modeling framework is provided as a reliable tool for AEMWE system design and optimization, enabling systematic evaluation of tradeoffs among efficiency, purity, and production rate.
title_zh: 用于高效制氢的阴离子交换膜水电解的综合系统级建模
abstract_zh: 阴离子交换膜水电解（AEMWE）被认为是低成本、高效率绿色制氢的有前途的途径。在 Aspen Plus® 中开发并实现了一个综合系统模型，其中通过 Fortran 子程序嵌入了零维电化学堆栈，并在子程序中实现了迭代解决方案。该框架揭示了质量平衡和控制水管理的运行条件之间的耦合相互作用，并定量解决了以前通过数值方法在概念上处理的现象，从而能够直接量化水输送和系统行为的预测分析。展示了完整的工厂平衡 (BOP)（分离器、加热器、热交换器、泵、冷却器、冷凝器和干燥器），并在各种操作条件（电流密度、温度、压力）下进行了模拟。从电池电压、氢气纯度、水传输和 BOP 功耗方面对结果进行分析。主要发现包括：（1）随着电流密度从0.4增加到1.8 A/cm 2 ，阴极出口水流量减少了54.62%，强调了阴极水管理的必要性； (2)冷凝器的氢气纯度随操作条件变化很大，在0.4 A/cm 2 、40℃和50 bar下达到99.84%； (3) 对于具有适度能量损失的高产氢率，在 80°C 和 25 bar 下高电流密度下操作被认为是优选的。开发的建模框架作为 AEMWE 系统的可靠工具提供

title: Robust optimization for the application strategy of medical waste plasma gasification integrated with other waste treatments
source: ScienceDirect Publication: Applied Energy
abstract: Plasma gasification of medical waste (MW) is a clean and promising waste-to-energy approach that also prevents viral transmission. However, its fluctuating technical efficiency limits effective application. Integrating MW plasma gasification with other waste treatment systems is regarded as an effective strategy for improving treatment efficiency. To support robust and comprehensive decision-making, this study develops a multi-objective dynamic robust optimization model in which municipal solid waste incineration and sludge pyrolysis serve as alternative integration options, with technical efficiency and electricity price treated as uncertain parameters, to obtain robust optimal solutions under a range of operating scenarios. The results show that the robust solution remains feasible and profitable even in the worst case, at the cost of a moderate profit concession. Sludge pyrolysis integration dominates the optimal configuration, whereas municipal solid waste incineration integration arises under specific conditions, such as high-carbon MW feedstock or low decision-maker risk tolerance. Fluctuations in technical efficiency and electricity price can both alter the technology selection. This study provides managers with a transferable tool for MW plasma gasification decision-making.
title_zh: 医疗废物等离子体气化与其他废物处理结合应用策略的鲁棒优化
abstract_zh: 医疗废物的等离子气化（MW）是一种清洁且有前景的废物能源化方法，还可以防止病毒传播。然而，其技术效率的波动限制了其有效应用。将MW等离子体气化与其他废物处理系统集成被认为是提高处理效率的有效策略。为了支持鲁棒和综合的决策，本研究开发了多目标动态鲁棒优化模型，以城市生活垃圾焚烧和污泥热解作为替代集成选项，以技术效率和电价作为不确定参数，在一系列运行场景下获得鲁棒的最优解决方案。结果表明，即使在最坏的情况下，稳健的解决方案仍然可行且有利可图，但代价是适度的利润让步。污泥热解一体化在最优配置中占主导地位，而城市固体废物焚烧一体化则在特定条件下出现，例如高碳MW原料或决策者风险承受能力低。技术效率和电价的波动都会改变技术选择。这项研究为管理者提供了用于兆瓦等离子体气化决策的可转移工具。

title: All-Solid-State, Maskless Electrodeposition of Ag Microstructures Using a Polymer Electrolyte Membrane Stamp
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Ag micro- and nanostructured surfaces play an important role in optoelectronic devices and bio/chemical sensing, particularly in applications that require mechanical flexibility. Conventional patterning methods rely on top-down processes that involve complex lithographic steps, resulting in high material consumption and environmental burden. Bottom-up approaches enable the direct formation of metallic patterns but are limited by insufficient patterning resolution. Herein, we report an all-solid-state electrodeposition process employing a polymer electrolyte membrane (PEM) stamp for the direct fabrication of multiscale Ag patterns on flexible substrates. Ag ions supplied by anodic dissolution at the Ag anode/PEM interface are transported through nanoscale water channels in the PEM, enabling electrodeposition without liquid electrolytes. Electrochemical measurements clarified the interfacial reactions between the PEM and the electrodes. Electron and X-ray analyses confirmed the formation of metallic Ag films at the cathode-PEM interface. Ambient humidity governs pattern formation: low-humidity conditions yield positive patterns via contact-region deposition, whereas high-humidity conditions produce negative patterns through water-assisted Ag+ transport in noncontact regions. Under optimized conditions, Ag patterns with feature sizes ranging from several hundred nanometers to the submillimeter scale were achieved. The deposited Ag films exhibited electrical conductivity, mechanical stability, and enhanced Raman signals, demonstrating their proof-of-concept utility as flexible conductive structures and plasmonic sensing substrates.
title_zh: 使用聚合物电解质膜印模对银微结构进行全固态、无掩模电沉积
abstract_zh: 银微米和纳米结构表面在光电器件和生物/化学传感中发挥着重要作用，特别是在需要机械灵活性的应用中。传统的图案化方法依赖于自上而下的工艺，涉及复杂的光刻步骤，导致高材料消耗和环境负担。自下而上的方法可以直接形成金属图案，但受到图案分辨率不足的限制。在此，我们报告了一种采用聚合物电解质膜（PEM）印模的全固态电沉积工艺，用于在柔性基板上直接制造多尺度银图案。由银阳极/PEM 界面处的阳极溶解提供的银离子通过 PEM 中的纳米级水通道传输，无需液体电解质即可实现电沉积。电化学测量阐明了 PEM 和电极之间的界面反应。电子和 X 射线分析证实了阴极-PEM 界面处形成了金属银薄膜。环境湿度控制图案的形成：低湿度条件通过接触区域沉积产生正图案，而高湿度条件通过非接触区域的水辅助Ag+传输产生负图案。在优化的条件下，获得了特征尺寸从数百纳米到亚毫米级的银图案。沉积的银薄膜表现出导电性、机械稳定性和增强的拉曼信号，证明了其柔性的概念验证实用性

title: Surface Confined Water by Metal Oxide Cluster for Single Lithium-Ion Conduction
source: ACS Energy Letters: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Click to copy section link Section link copied! The innovation of water-in-salt electrolytes (WiSEs) broadens the electrochemical stability window (ESW) while preserving high ionic conductivity. However, the required high Li-salt concentrations incur high cost and device fabrication complexity, and the low Li+ transference number limits long-term stability. Here, we report that sub-nm anionic metal oxide clusters (SiW 12 O 40 4–) enable single Li+ conduction in a low-salt WiSE (∼1 wt % Li loading) with robust antifreeze properties down to –80 °C. Surface nanoconfinement disrupts the hydrogen-bond network of water, accelerating local water relaxation dynamics to achieve high ionic conductivity (0.08 S cm–1 at 30 °C) while hindering water diffusivity to widen ESW to 2.2 V. The anionic clusters form a rigid framework that immobilizes anions, yielding a high Li+ transference number of 0.92. This work establishes an economical and high-performance single-ion WiSE platform and provides a molecular understanding of the structure–property relationship via relaxation dynamics. title: Suppression of sawtooth oscillations by m/n = 2/2 resonant magnetic perturbation
source: Nuclear Fusion - latest papers
abstract: Significant extension of sawtooth control toward higher electron density (ne) and edge safety factor (qa) ranges has been achieved by m/n = 2/2 resonant magnetic perturbation (RMP), which is ∼8 times stronger than the previous RMP generated by saddle-type RMP coils (Li 2020 Nucl. Fusion 60 126002) on J-TEXT. By using the recently installed helical coils, the so-called external rotational transform coils (Li 2024 Fusion Eng. Des. 206 114591) running in resonant field mode with reversed plasma current direction, the 2/2 RMP field can reach a maximal of 234 Gauss on the plasma surface at minor radius a = 22 cm. With the new helical coils, the RMP field with an amplitude of 130 Gauss is strong enough to penetrate at q = 1 surface forming a 2/2 magnetic island at qa as high as 4.3, and ne up to 4 × 1019 m−3, and hence mitigates sawtooth in these parameter ranges. Further, sawtooth suppression has also been successfully carried out in the J-TEXT plasma with electron cyclotron resonance heating (ECRH). Despite the higher electron temperature Te with ECRH, the RMP penetration threshold is smaller than by only ohmically-heating, probably due to the geometrical parameter of the q = 1 surface and RMP coils, induced bootstrap current and slower rotation. Sawtooth control by 2/2 RMP may be realized in larger size devices with large bootstrap and slow rotation by additional heating methods, like Neutral Beam Injection and ECRH.

title: Conceptual design of the Halo Machine
source: Nuclear Fusion - latest papers
abstract: In 1996, when the danger of sideways forces was first recognised, the operational window of the JET tokamak was significantly restricted. Limits were placed on the maximum magnetic field and plasma current to prevent excessive stresses on the vacuum vessel. Despite three decades of research, predictions for the sideways force on the ITER wall remain highly uncertain, ranging from 2 to 60 MN with the upper estimate exceeding the design value of 48 MN, which would result in operational restrictions (operation with potentially affecting ITER’s ultimate fusion performance). To address this issue, the ITPA community launched the dedicated joint experiment MDC-25 in 2018. While substantial progress has been made, recent findings highlight the need for complementary studies on a specialised linear device to investigate plasma–wall currents, key contributors to sideways forces. Here, we propose the first linear device specifically designed to investigate plasma–wall interactions in the presence of kink modes, with the aim of resolving uncertainties related to plasma–wall currents and associated sideways forces. It is expected that the findings obtained with the new device will guide the design of vacuum vessels and plasma facing components for future tokamaks.
title_zh: Halo Machine 的概念设计
abstract_zh: 1996年，当人们首次认识到侧向力的危险时，JET托卡马克的运行窗口受到了极大的限制。对最大磁场和等离子体电流进行限制，以防止真空容器承受过大的应力。尽管经过了三十年的研究，对 ITER 壁上侧向力的预测仍然高度不确定，范围从 2 到 60 MN，估计上限超过了 48 MN 的设计值，这将导致运行限制（可能影响 ITER 最终聚变性能的运行）。为了解决这个问题，ITPA 社区于 2018 年启动了专门的联合实验 MDC-25。虽然已经取得了实质性进展，但最近的研究结果强调需要对专门的线性设备进行补充研究，以研究等离子体壁电流，这是侧向力的关键因素。在这里，我们提出了第一个专门设计用于研究扭结模式存在下的等离子体-壁相互作用的线性装置，目的是解决与等离子体-壁电流和相关侧向力相关的不确定性。预计新设备获得的研究结果将指导未来托卡马克的真空容器和面向等离子体的组件的设计。

title: Vacancy Engineering Enables Ultralow Voltage Hysteresis in NASICON Cathodes for Mg-Metal Batteries
source: ACS Energy Letters: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Click to copy section link Section link copied! Rechargeable Mg-metal batteries are attractive owing to their high volumetric capacity, safety, and resource abundance, yet their development is limited by severe polarization and sluggish cathode kinetics. Herein, a cation-vacancy engineering strategy is achieved through Mg substitution in NASICON-type NaTi 2(PO 4)3. The optimized Mg 0.25 Na 0.5 Ti 2(PO 4)3 cathode exhibits low voltage hysteresis (0.05 V), high rate capability (87% capacity retention at 500 mA g−1), and long-term cycling stability (81% capacity retention after 500 cycles). A proof-of-concept pouch cell delivers a low polarization voltage of 0.067 V. Mechanistic investigations reveal a Mg−Na hybrid-ion storage mechanism, in which Na+ predominantly governs the reversible cathode reaction while Mg metal undergoes reversible stripping/plating at the anode. Vacancy engineering effectively regulates ion transport and structural reversibility, enabling highly stable electrochemical operation. This work demonstrates vacancy engineering as an effective strategy for developing high-performance NASICON cathodes for Mg-metal battery systems. ACS Publications © 2026 American Chemical Society

title: Reclaiming Inactive Lithium with a 2-Iodooctane Electrolyte Additive for Ultrastable Lithium Metal Batteries over a Two-Year Lifespan
source: ACS Energy Letters: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Click to copy section link Section link copied! A primary cause of the energy fading in high-energy-density lithium (Li) metal batteries is the accumulation of inactive Li, including inactive metallic Li caused by Li dendrite growth and Li compounds resulted from side reactions, which reduce anode utilization efficiency and hinder Li-ion transport. Therefore, it is crucial to develop electrolyte additives that can suppress Li dendrite growth and stabilize the interfacial structure. Here, we introduce 2-iodooctane into the electrolyte, which reacts at the anode and is oxidized at the cathode to generate the I 3−/I− redox mediator that converts inactive Li to Li 2 O and recovers Li ions. Owing to the recovered inactive Li, the half-cells exhibit a high Coulombic efficiency of 99.03% with restrained Li dendrite growth. Accordingly, the symmetric cells perform tripled stability with an ultralong lifespan of 730 days at 2 mA cm−2, while the pouch cells retain an over 88% capacity after 100 cycles, demonstrating substantial commercial application potential. title: Multiple hetero-redox centers in a phenazine-ketone scaffold for high-energy-density aqueous flow batteries toward durable energy storage
source: National Science Review Advance Access
abstract: Organic redox flow batteries (RFBs) operating in alkaline media have attracted significant attention for their inherent safety and environmental compatibility. However, conventional quinone- and ketone-based anolytes suffer from low electron-transfer numbers (≤2 e- per molecule), irreversible isomerization, and concentration-dependent side reactions, ultimately limiting their energy density and long-term cycling stability. Here, we introduce a molecular engineering strategy that leverages the conjugation of heterogeneous redox centers to fuse distinct redox-active motifs, thereby creating a new composite phenazine-ketone molecule capable of a 6-electron transfer process. This multi-hetero-redox center fused scaffold not only overcomes the intrinsic limitations of conventional structures but also exhibits robust kinetics and chemical stability in an alkaline electrolyte. The resulting compound delivers a record capacity of 79.3 Ah L-¹, and sustains stable operation over 3500 cycles (198.5 days), offering a viable pathway toward next-generation high-energy-density, durable and sustainable energy storage technologies.

title: De Novo Design of Protein Nanopores: From Minimal Peptides to AI-Driven Design
source: Chemical Reviews: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Protein nanopores offer a powerful platform for analytical applications by directly converting chemical properties into information-rich, single-molecule electrical readouts. However, engineering natural nanopores for sensing remains challenging due to the limited number of available scaffolds and evolutionary constraints on their geometries and chemistries. Recent advances in AI- and data-driven protein design are enabling increasingly complex membrane protein architectures, opening new possibilities for designing synthetic nanopores with tailored folds and functions. This review surveys the evolution of de novo nanopore design, from minimal sequences to AI-supported approaches, highlights emerging strategies, and outlines key challenges─including data scarcity, membrane modeling, and experimental characterization─that must be addressed to realize robust, programmable nanopores for next-generation sensing technologies.

title: Selective Reduction of Carbon Dioxide in Water Using [M(bpy 2+ )(CO) 3 (I)] 2+ (M = Mn, Re) Electrocatalysts with Pendent Cations
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Manganese(I) carbonyl complexes are promising electrocatalysts for CO2 reduction, yet their application in homogeneous aqueous media remains limited by poor solubility and selectivity. Here, we report water-soluble Mn(I) and Re(I) complexes fac-[M(bpy2+)(CO)3X]2+ (X = I or Cl), featuring bipyridine ligands functionalized with -Ph-CH2-(NMe3)+ cationic ammonium groups that integrate water solubility with secondary-sphere stabilization. In a bicarbonate buffer at pH 6.8, the Mn catalyst is completely selective for CO production at a low overpotential (η = 0.3 V), operating by a protonation-first mechanism with observed rates of ∼10 s-1. Pulse radiolysis reveals that the one-electron-reduced Mn species undergoes dimerization in the absence of CO2 but reacts competitively with CO2 through an initial pre-equilibrium followed by fast formation of a dinuclear CO2-bridged species (ΔGo = -12.4 kcal mol-1). At a higher 0.6 V overpotential, a faster reduction-first pathway (∼100 s-1) is available upon reduction of the metallocarboxylic acid intermediate, Mn-CO2H2+; however, this regime is functionally limited by the formation of a resistive, noncatalytic film on the electrode surface. Comparison to the analogous water-soluble Re catalyst (kobs = 440 s-1, η = 0.6 V) highlights the distinct mechanistic advantages of earth-abundant Mn in low-potential catalysis. These results demonstrate how cationic second-sphere design enables selective, homogeneous CO2 reduction in water while revealing competing radical and electrode-mediated processes that govern catalytic performance.
title_zh: 使用带有悬垂阳离子的 [M(bpy 2+ )(CO) 3 (I)] 2+ (M = Mn, Re) 电催化剂选择性还原水中的二氧化碳
abstract_zh: 羰基锰(I)络合物是很有前景的二氧化碳还原电催化剂，但其在均相水介质中的应用仍然因溶解度和选择性差而受到限制。在这里，我们报道了水溶性 Mn(I) 和 Re(I) 配合物 fac-[M(bpy2+)(CO)3X]2+ (X = I 或 Cl)，其特征是用 -Ph-CH2-(NMe3)+ 阳离子铵基团功能化的联吡啶配体，将水溶性与二次球稳定性结合起来。在 pH 6.8 的碳酸氢盐缓冲液中，Mn 催化剂在低过电势（η = 0.3 V）下对 CO 生成具有完全选择性，通过质子化优先机制运行，观察到的速率为 ∼10 s-1。脉冲辐射解表明，单电子还原的 Mn 物质在没有 CO2 的情况下发生二聚化，但通过初始预平衡与 CO2 竞争性反应，随后快速形成双核 CO2 桥接物质 (ΔGo = -12.4 kcal mol-1)。在较高的 0.6 V 过电势下，金属羧酸中间体 Mn-CO2H2+ 的还原可实现更快的先还原途径 (∼100 s-1)；然而，这种状态在功能上受到电极表面上电阻性非催化膜形成的限制。与类似的水溶性铼催化剂（kobs = 440 s-1，η = 0.6 V）的比较凸显了地球丰富的锰在低电势催化中的独特机械优势。这些结果证明了阳离子第二球体设计如何能够选择性、均匀地还原水中的二氧化碳，同时揭示控制催化性能的竞争性自由基和电极介导的过程。

title: Surface Terminations of LaAlO 3 Perovskite Nanoparticles as Viewed by Solid-State Nuclear Magnetic Resonance
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Nanocrystal surfaces generally undergo reconstructions that differentiate them from the bulk structures, often in nontrivial ways. Understanding these terminations is critical across diverse fields, from heterogeneous catalysis to the formation of topological states and the synthesis of semiconductor nanomaterials. Determining surface structures is currently an interdisciplinary task, most often involving high-resolution electron microscopy and surface electron diffraction. These methods, however, do not provide a global view of the ensemble of structures present in a sample. Here, we show how surface-sensitive solid-state nuclear magnetic resonance (SSNMR) spectroscopy methods can bridge this gap. In this context, we investigated the surface structure of lanthanum aluminate (LaAlO3) perovskite nanoparticles. Four distinct surface terminations have previously been observed for this material, but their relative abundances were unknown. Using an array of double- and triple-resonance SSNMR methods probing the relative proximities of surface 1H, 27Al, 17O, and 139La nuclei, we conclude the surface to be majority terminated (80%) by AlOx with substantial (20%) LaOx terminated regions.
title_zh: 固态核磁共振观察 LaAlO 3 钙钛矿纳米粒子的表面终止
abstract_zh: 纳米晶体表面通常会经历重建，通常以非平凡的方式将其与块体结构区分开来。了解这些终止对于不同领域至关重要，从多相催化到拓扑态的形成和半导体纳米材料的合成。确定表面结构目前是一项跨学科任务，通常涉及高分辨率电子显微镜和表面电子衍射。然而，这些方法并没有提供样本中存在的结构整体的全局视图。在这里，我们展示了表面敏感固态核磁共振（SSNMR）光谱方法如何弥补这一差距。在此背景下，我们研究了铝酸镧（LaAlO3）钙钛矿纳米粒子的表面结构。之前已经观察到这种材料的四个不同的表面终端，但它们的相对丰度未知。使用一系列双共振和三共振 SSNMR 方法探测表面 1H、27Al、17O 和 139La 核的相对接近度，我们得出结论，表面大部分由 AlOx 终止（80%），并具有大量（20%）LaOx 终止区域。

title: Decoupled Molecular Motifs and Supramolecular Dimers for Highly Efficient FDCA Synthesis from Neutral Biomass
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Solar-driven biomass valorization is pivotal for defossilizing the chemical industry. The oxidation of abundant, low-cost 5-hydroxymethylfurfural (HMF) to 2,5-furandicarboxylic acid (FDCA)─a key monomer for next-generation bioplastics─is a long-sought goal yet hampered by sluggish kinetics, poor selectivity, and alkaline dependency. Here, spatially decoupled catalytic sites are engineered on two-dimensional carbon nitride (CN): covalently grafted cyanamide (CA) motifs at the edges and π-π stacked J-type nickel phthalocyanine (NiPc) dimers on the planes. This design features spatiotemporally cascaded charge transfer and dual-site catalysis, achieving 54- and 160-fold enhancements in the HMF conversion rate and H2 evolution rate, respectively, versus pristine CN, during HMF reforming in pure water. The FDCA production rate reaches 2.14 mmol g-1 h-1 with 98.2% selectivity, outperforming benchmark systems. Fundamentally, CA motifs steer an ultrafast hole-initiated selective HMF oxidation with a hole transfer rate of 2.4 × 1010 s-1 (an order of magnitude faster than CN). The resulting long-lived electrons are extracted by the bottom-layer NiPc and transferred via its single Ni atom to the top-layer single Ni atom for proton reduction, with an electron transfer rate of 7.4 × 104 s-1. The asymmetric charge kinetics suppresses charge recombination, yielding a charge transfer efficiency of 98.9%.
title_zh: 解偶联分子基序和超分子二聚体，用于中性生物质高效合成 FDCA
abstract_zh: 太阳能驱动的生物质增值对于化学工业去石化至关重要。将丰富、低成本的 5-羟甲基糠醛 (HMF) 氧化为 2,5-呋喃二甲酸 (FDCA)（下一代生物塑料的关键单体）是一个长期追求的目标，但由于动力学缓慢、选择性差和碱性依赖性而受到阻碍。在这里，空间解耦的催化位点被设计在二维氮化碳（CN）上：边缘处的共价接枝氰胺（CA）基序和平面上的π-π堆叠J型镍酞菁（NiPc）二聚体。该设计具有时空级联电荷转移和双位点催化功能，在纯水中 HMF 重整过程中，与原始 CN 相比，HMF 转化率和 H2 析出率分别提高了 54 倍和 160 倍。 FDCA 产率达到 2.14 mmol g-1 h-1，选择性为 98.2%，优于基准系统。从根本上来说，CA 基序引导超快空穴引发的选择性 HMF 氧化，空穴转移速率为 2.4 × 1010 s-1（比 CN 快一个数量级）。由此产生的长寿命电子被底层 NiPc 提取，并通过其单个 Ni 原子转移到顶层单个 Ni 原子进行质子还原，电子转移率为 7.4 × 104 s-1。不对称电荷动力学抑制电荷复合，电荷转移效率高达 98.9%。

title: Catalyst Design for Sustainable Reactions: A Primer toward Knowledge-Driven Innovation
source: Chemical Reviews: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: When aiming at designing performant catalysts for existing or novel (sustainable) reactions, a wide variety of methodologies can be adopted, turning catalyst design into a science on its own. However, fundamental knowledge and clear guidelines for the application of these methodologies for catalyst innovation are lacking, impeding truly efficient and adequate catalyst design, with serendipity still playing too important a role. This review fills this gap by systematically categorizing and reviewing the most relevant methodologies and providing their fundamentals. Despite the strong benefit from systematically collected data incoming from digital laboratories, the main common drawback remains how to design catalysts truly "out of the box"? While various methodologies can serve more humble purposes (e.g., fine-tuning catalyst compositions), truly innovative catalyst design can only be achieved via a knowledge-driven approach, strongly supported by kinetic models in combination with suitable catalysis informatics tools.
title_zh: 可持续反应的催化剂设计：知识驱动创新入门
abstract_zh: 当旨在为现有或新型（可持续）反应设计高性能催化剂时，可以采用多种方法，将催化剂设计本身变成一门科学。然而，缺乏应用这些催化剂创新方法的基础知识和明确的指导方针，阻碍了真正有效和充分的催化剂设计，而偶然性仍然发挥着非常重要的作用。本综述通过系统地分类和回顾最相关的方法并提供其基础知识来填补这一空白。尽管从数字实验室系统收集的数据有很大好处，但主要的共同缺点仍然是如何设计真正“开箱即用”的催化剂？虽然各种方法可以达到更简单的目的（例如微调催化剂组成），但真正创新的催化剂设计只能通过知识驱动的方法来实现，并得到动力学模型与合适的催化信息学工具相结合的大力支持。

title: Crack-Interlocked Metal/Elastomer Interfaces for Preload-Adapted Backside Pressure Sensing
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Flexible pressure sensors capable of resolving small pressure variations under large static loads are desirable for embedded and backside-mounted monitoring, where the sensing layer cannot be directly exposed to the contact surface. However, most highly sensitive pressure sensors are optimized for low-pressure operation, and their sensitivity decreases under preloads. Here, we report a crack-interlocked ridge structure composed of two facing PDMS micro-ridge arrays and a thin Pt conductive layer. The interlocked architecture converts vertical compression into localized tensile deformation at the Pt/elastomer interface, producing a reproducible crack-mediated resistance transition near a designed preload. The resulting sensor exhibits a maximum local sensitivity of 2582.8 kPa-1 within the transition window and maintains repeatable responses over 1000 loading-unloading cycles. By varying the interlayer thickness, the active sensing window can be shifted across 50-700 kPa, enabling preload-adapted pressure-change detection in mechanically biased configurations. As a proof of concept, the sensor detects a small additional load placed on a heavy object in a backside-mounted configuration. This crack-interlocked interface design provides a strategy for mechanically programming the pressure window of flexible resistive sensors for embedded monitoring applications.
title_zh: 用于预载适应背面压力传感的裂纹互锁金属/弹性体接口
abstract_zh: 能够解决大静态负载下的小压力变化的柔性压力传感器对于嵌入式和背面安装的监控来说是理想的，因为传感层不能直接暴露于接触表面。然而，大多数高灵敏度压力传感器都针对低压操作进行了优化，并且它们的灵敏度在预载下会降低。在这里，我们报告了一种由两个相对的 PDMS 微脊阵列和薄 Pt 导电层组成的裂纹互锁脊结构。互锁结构将垂直压缩转化为 Pt/弹性体界面处的局部拉伸变形，在设计预紧力附近产生可重复的裂纹介导的阻力转变。由此产生的传感器在转换窗口内表现出 2582.8 kPa-1 的最大局部灵敏度，并在 1000 个加载-卸载循环中保持可重复响应。通过改变夹层厚度，主动传感窗口可以在 50-700 kPa 范围内移动，从而在机械偏置配置中实现预载自适应压力变化检测。作为概念验证，该传感器在背面安装配置中检测施加在重物上的少量额外负载。这种裂纹互锁接口设计提供了一种对嵌入式监测应用的柔性电阻传感器的压力窗口进行机械编程的策略。

title: Fluorine-free acetonitrile-based electrolytes with anion-reinforced solvation chemistry for sustainable sodium-ion full batteries
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Acetonitrile-based electrolytes have garnered significant attention for sodium-ion batteries due to their high ionic conductivity and favorable oxidation resistance. However, their practical implementation is hindered by an unsatisfactory anti-reduction ability, leading to poor compatibility with hard carbon anode and, consequently, rapid capacity degradation. Herein, we employ a widely used commercial carbonate ester solvent (ethyl methyl carbonate) to modulate the ion-dipole interactions in fluorine-free acetonitrile-based electrolytes. The relatively weak solvation ability of ethyl methyl carbonate facilitates more anions to participate the inner solvation sheath, thereby promoting the formation of robust electrode-electrolyte interface at a wide temperature range. This stabilized interface effectively suppresses continuous electrolyte decomposition, significantly improving the compatibility between fluorine-free acetonitrile-based electrolytes and hard carbon anodes. As a result, the optimized electrolyte enables stable operation of hard carbon ||Prussian blue full cells over a wide temperature range (25-100 °C), demonstrating a capacity retention of 62.5% after 600 cycles at 55 °C and 1.0 C. It is worth noting that Ampere-hour-level hard carbon ||Prussian blue pouch cells deliver consistent electrochemical performance at both 25 °C and 55 °C. This study elucidates the mechanistic role of cosolvent engineering in enhancing the reductive stability of fluorine-free acetonitrile-based electrolytes and provides a viable electrolyte design strategy for their practical implementation in sodium-ion batteries.
title_zh: 用于可持续钠离子全电池的具有阴离子增强溶剂化化学的无氟乙腈基电解质
abstract_zh: 乙腈基电解质由于其高离子电导率和良好的抗氧化性而在钠离子电池中引起了广泛关注。然而，它们的实际应用受到不令人满意的抗还原能力的阻碍，导致与硬碳负极的兼容性差，从而导致容量快速下降。在这里，我们采用广泛使用的商业碳酸酯溶剂（碳酸甲乙酯）来调节无氟乙腈基电解质中的离子偶极相互作用。碳酸甲乙酯相对较弱的溶剂化能力有利于更多的阴离子参与内部溶剂化鞘，从而促进在较宽的温度范围内形成坚固的电极-电解质界面。这种稳定的界面有效地抑制了电解液的连续分解，显着提高了无氟乙腈基电解液与硬碳阳极之间的相容性。因此，优化后的电解质使硬碳||普鲁士蓝全电池能够在较宽的温度范围（25-100°C）内稳定运行，在55°C和1.0°C下循环600次后容量保持率为62.5%。值得注意的是，安时级硬碳||普鲁士蓝软包电池在25°C和55°C下均提供一致的电化学性能。这项研究阐明了共溶剂工程在增强无氟乙腈基电解质的还原稳定性方面的机制作用，并为其实际应用提供了可行的电解质设计策略

title: Engineering bamboo as a multiscale platform for carbon-negative materials
source: Nature Reviews Materials
abstract: Bamboo is a fast-growing lignocellulosic resource that combines high biomass productivity with the ability to sequester atmospheric carbon in long-lived materials. This Review frames bamboo as a multiscale platform for carbon-conscious materials design, linking hierarchical structure, bond-selective chemistry, processing, durability and life-cycle accounting to identify when bamboo-derived products can store carbon, displace emissions and deliver credible climate benefits sustainably at scale.
title_zh: 工程竹子作为负碳材料的多尺度平台
abstract_zh: 竹子是一种快速生长的木质纤维素资源，它结合了高生物质生产力和在长寿命材料中封存大气碳的能力。本综述将竹子视为碳意识材料设计的多尺度平台，将分层结构、键选择性化学、加工、耐用性和生命周期核算联系起来，以确定竹子衍生产品何时可以大规模储存碳、取代排放并提供可靠的气候效益。

title: Platinum Ensemble Heterogeneity Enables Efficient Solvent-Free Hydrogen Production
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Liquid organic hydrogen carriers (LOHCs) based on cycloalkane/aromatic pairs are promising for safe hydrogen storage and transportation, but their practical implementation is limited by sluggish dehydrogenation kinetics and catalyst deactivation under working conditions. Herein, we report a rationally designed platinum catalyst supported on curved graphene-coated nanodiamond (ND@G), in which fully exposed subnanometric Pt clusters (Ptn) and three-dimensional Pt clusters (Ptc) are integrated in close proximity on the support (Ptn+c/ND@G), which delivers remarkably enhanced hydrogen production in the solvent-free dehydrogenation of bicyclohexyl and other representative cycloalkanes, outperforming either single-counterpart catalysts or their physical mixtures while maintaining good recyclability. Mechanistic investigations combined with density functional theory calculations demonstrate that this synergistic effect originates from the cooperation between these respective Pt ensembles: Ptc sites possess higher intrinsic activity for C-H bond activation than Ptn clusters, yet are more susceptible to poisoning. By contrast, Ptn clusters, although less active for substrate activation, remain operative in the presence of aromatic adsorbates. Hydrogen generated on Ptn clusters can weaken product binding on adjacent Ptc sites via support-mediated spillover. As a result, poisoning is mitigated, active Ptc sites are continuously regenerated, and overall dehydrogenation performance is enhanced. These findings provide a general design principle for developing high-performance LOHC dehydrogenation catalysts through Pt ensemble engineering and support-mediated hydrogen management.
title_zh: 铂整体异质性实现高效无溶剂氢气生产
abstract_zh: 基于环烷烃/芳香族对的液态有机氢载体（LOHC）有望用于安全的氢储存和运输，但其实际应用受到脱氢动力学缓慢和工作条件下催化剂失活的限制。在此，我们报告了一种合理设计的负载在弯曲石墨烯涂层纳米金刚石（ND@G）上的铂催化剂，其中完全暴露的亚纳米Pt簇（Ptn）和三维Pt簇（Ptc）紧密集成在载体（Ptn+c/ND@G）上，它在双环己基和其他代表性环烷烃的无溶剂脱氢中显着提高了氢气产量，优于单一对应催化剂或其物理混合物，同时保持良好的可回收性。机理研究与密度泛函理论计算相结合表明，这种协同效应源于这些各自的 Pt 团簇之间的合作：Ptc 位点比 Ptn 团簇具有更高的 C-H 键激活内在活性，但更容易中毒。相比之下，Ptn 簇虽然对底物活化活性较低，但在芳香族吸附物存在的情况下仍然有效。 Ptn 簇上产生的氢可以通过支持介导的溢出来削弱邻近 Ptc 位点上的产物结合。结果，中毒得到缓解，活性 Ptc 位点不断再生，整体脱氢性能得到增强。这些发现为开发高性能 LOHC 脱水机提供了一般设计原则

title: Sensing Synthon Architectures with Hyperfine-Resolved Rotational Spectroscopy
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Supramolecular synthons that engage in noncovalent carbon bonding offer promising routes toward programmable molecular architectures, yet experimental strategies capable of unambiguously resolving their docking geometries remain limited. Here, we show that electric field gradients at nitrogen nuclei─accessed through nuclear quadrupole splittings─provide a uniquely sensitive probe of supramolecular topology. Using hyperfine-resolved broadband rotational spectroscopy in a supersonic jet expansion combined with quantum-chemical calculations, we investigate tetracyanocyclopropane (TCCP), a synthetically accessible synthon bearing four cyano groups that act as local sensors of the electronic environment. Complexes formed between TCCP derivatives and tetrahydrofuran are observed in the jet expansion and shown to dock through a tetrel bond between an sp3-hybridized carbon center and the oxygen lone pair of tetrahydrofuran. While the rotational constants alone struggle to discriminate between candidate docking geometries, the nitrogen nuclear quadrupole coupling constants encode the orientational fingerprint of the complex through their electric field gradients. By exploiting symmetry relationships among the four nitrogen sites and implementing a tailored spectral fitting strategy to disentangle the dense hyperfine manifold, we extract precise rotational parameters that uniquely define the docking arrangements of two TCCP derivatives with different symmetries. These results demonstrate nitrogen electric field gradients as powerful structural sensors of noncovalent interactions and position hyperfine-resolved rotational spectroscopy as a configuration-sensitive approach for identifying supramolecular synthon motifs and guiding the design of nitrogen-rich supramolecular materials.
title_zh: 使用超精细分辨旋转光谱检测 Synthon 架构
abstract_zh: 参与非共价碳键合的超分子合成子为可编程分子结构提供了有希望的途径，但能够明确解析其对接几何形状的实验策略仍然有限。在这里，我们证明氮原子核的电场梯度（通过核四极分裂获得）提供了超分子拓扑的独特灵敏探针。我们利用超音速射流膨胀中的超精细分辨宽带旋转光谱与量子化学计算相结合，研究了四氰基环丙烷（TCCP），这是一种具有四个氰基的合成子，可充当电子环境的本地传感器。在射流膨胀中观察到 TCCP 衍生物和四氢呋喃之间形成的复合物，并显示通过 sp3 杂化碳中心和四氢呋喃的氧孤对对之间的 tetrel 键对接。虽然仅靠旋转常数很难区分候选对接几何形状，但氮核四极耦合常数通过其电场梯度编码复合物的方向指纹。通过利用四个氮位点之间的对称关系并实施定制的光谱拟合策略来解开密集的超精细流形，我们提取了精确的旋转参数，这些参数唯一地定义了具有不同对称性的两个 TCCP 衍生物的对接排列。这些结果证明氮电场梯度是非共价相互作用的强大结构传感器

title: Supramolecular Modulation of Controlled Radical Polymerization
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Controlled radical polymerization has fundamentally transformed polymer science, enabling the synthesis of materials with precisely tailored architectures and predictable molecular weights. However, achieving rapid polymerization while maintaining good control remains a great challenge in controlled radical polymerization. Herein, we report a supramolecular strategy to alleviate this problem in aqueous photoiniferter and reversible addition-fragmentation chain transfer (RAFT) polymerizations through host-guest complexation between cationic thiocarbonylthio-based agents and cucurbit[7]uril (CB[7]). Such encapsulation induces a significant increase in the chain transfer coefficient and photolysis efficiency of the CTA. Spectroscopic and computational analyses reveal that the macrocyclic host promotes triplet-state population via enhanced spin-orbit coupling, while simultaneously lowering fragmentation barriers and facilitating reversible deactivation. This mechanistic synergy enables the synthesis of ultrahigh-molecular-weight polymers (Mn up to 2,190 kg mol-1) and the rapid construction of well-defined 20-block copolymers with excellent end-group fidelity and high initiator efficiency. This supramolecular strategy yields accelerated yet highly controlled polymerizations in aqueous media, providing a promising approach to balancing rate and control using dithiocarbamate-based chain transfer agents.
title_zh: 受控自由基聚合的超分子调控
abstract_zh: 受控自由基聚合从根本上改变了聚合物科学，使得能够合成具有精确定制的结构和可预测的分子量的材料。然而，在保持良好控制的同时实现快速聚合仍然是受控自由基聚合中的巨大挑战。在此，我们报告了一种超分子策略，通过阳离子硫代羰基硫基试剂和葫芦[7]脲（CB[7]）之间的主客体络合来缓解水性光引发转移剂和可逆加成断裂链转移（RAFT）聚合中的这一问题。这种封装导致 CTA 的链转移系数和光解效率显着增加。光谱和计算分析表明，大环主体通过增强的自旋轨道耦合促进三重态布居，同时降低碎片势垒并促进可逆失活。这种机械协同作用能够合成超高分子量聚合物（Mn 高达 2,190 kg mol-1），并快速构建具有优异端基保真度和高引发剂效率的明确的 20 嵌段共聚物。这种超分子策略在水介质中产生加速但高度受控的聚合，为使用二硫代氨基甲酸酯基链转移剂平衡速率和控制提供了一种有前景的方法。

title: Confined water-selective highways in a densified photothermal membrane enable ultrafast purification of complex wastewater
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Solar-driven interfacial evaporation (SDIE) is a sustainable, carbon-neutral approach for freshwater production. Nevertheless, achieving both high evaporation rates and efficient removal remains challenging, especially for wastewater enriched with concentrated ions and strongly polar volatile organic compounds (VOCs) from chemical and electronics manufacturing. Here, we report the confined water-selective highways within a densified photothermal membrane (DPM) for ultrafast purification of such complex wastewater. Through mechanical compression and the rational selection of hydrophilic polymers, DPM’s interlayer nanostructures and chemical environments are engineered with molecular precision. Due to the synergistic effect of steric hindrance and chemical selectivity, this structure enables preferential water transport while effectively excluding highly concentrated ions and strongly polar VOCs. DPM exhibits a high water evaporation rate of 2.58 kg m−2 h−1 under 1 kW m−2. DPM retains stable performance for over 200 h in various near-saturated hypersaline solutions (20 wt% salinity) and enables clean water harvesting from both common (e.g., benzene, toluene, phenol) and strongly polar VOCs (e.g., ethanol, isopropanol, n-butanol) even at very high concentrations. Device integration further demonstrates its scalability for treating complex wastewater, highlighting the significance of molecularly engineered interfacial architectures for efficient SDIE under challenging conditions.
title_zh: 致密光热膜中的承压水选择性高速公路可实现复杂废水的超快速净化
abstract_zh: 太阳能驱动界面蒸发（SDIE）是一种可持续的、碳中和的淡水生产方法。然而，同时实现高蒸发率和高效去除仍然具有挑战性，特别是对于化学和电子制造过程中富含浓离子和强极性挥发性有机化合物 (VOC) 的废水。在这里，我们报告了致密光热膜（DPM）内的受限水选择性高速公路，用于超快速净化此类复杂废水。通过机械压缩和亲水聚合物的合理选择，DPM 的层间纳米结构和化学环境以分子精度进行设计。由于空间位阻和化学选择性的协同作用，这种结构能够优先水传输，同时有效排除高浓度离子和强极性VOC。 DPM 在 1 kW m−2 下表现出 2.58 kg m−2 h−1 的高水蒸发率。 DPM 在各种接近饱和的高盐溶液（20 wt% 盐度）中保持稳定的性能超过 200 小时，即使在非常高的浓度下，也能够从常见（例如苯、甲苯、苯酚）和强极性 VOC（例如乙醇、异丙醇、正丁醇）中收集清洁水。设备集成进一步证明了其处理复杂废水的可扩展性，凸显了分子工程界面结构对于在挑战性条件下高效 SDIE 的重要性。

title: A modifying touch for metal–organic framework glasses
source: Nature Chemistry
abstract: The structure and properties of inorganic glasses can be tuned using simple chemical additives, which has contributed to their widespread use. Now, metal–organic framework glasses have been modified through addition of alkali benzimidazolate salts, enabling the modulation of their properties.

abstract_zh: 无机玻璃的结构和性能可以使用简单的化学添加剂来调节，这有助于其广泛使用。现在，金属有机框架玻璃已通过添加碱性苯并咪唑盐进行改性，从而能够调节其性能。

title: Realization of Giant Negative Thermal Expansion via a Significantly Decreased Local Moment in a Kagome Ferromagnet with Spin Reorientation
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Negative thermal expansion (NTE) materials are significant for a variety of modern advanced applications, yet discovering new NTE materials and understanding the underlying spin-lattice interactions remain challenging. Here, we report a pronounced volumetric NTE with a coefficient of thermal expansion, αV = -32.4 × 10-6 K-1 (100-200 K), in kagome (Sc,Ti)Fe2 with Fe-excess. Neutron diffraction, Mössbauer spectroscopy, and theoretical investigations indicate that the content of scandium affects the antiferromagnetic coupling of kagome layers hosting Fe in 6h lattice position and additional magnetic exchange interaction arising from the excess Fe stabilizes the ferromagnetic magnetic order. A sharp reduction of the magnetic moment of the Fe sublattice thus emerges on heating and yields the NTE. Intriguingly, the transition between ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic stacking of the kagome layers is accompanied by a spin reorientation of Fe from the in-plane direction to the out-of-plane direction. This magnetic reorientation could be the result of a strong competition of the Fe single-site anisotropies on different sublattices and is thus regarded as a hallmark of the high-spin state/low-spin state transition on the frustrated Fe sublattice. This work provides further insight that different magnetic orders in the same material can host NTE and normal thermal expansion behavior.
title_zh: 通过自旋重定向的 Kagome 铁磁体中局部力矩的显着降低实现巨大的负热膨胀
abstract_zh: 负热膨胀 (NTE) 材料对于各种现代先进应用具有重要意义，但发现新的 NTE 材料并了解潜在的自旋晶格相互作用仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们报告了在 Fe 过量的 kagome (Sc,Ti)Fe2 中具有明显的体积 NTE，其热膨胀系数为 αV = -32.4 × 10-6 K-1 (100-200 K)。中子衍射、穆斯堡尔谱和理论研究表明，钪的含量影响在 6h 晶格位置包含 Fe 的 kagome 层的反铁磁耦合，并且过量 Fe 产生的额外磁交换相互作用稳定了铁磁磁序。因此，加热时 Fe 亚晶格的磁矩会急剧减小，并产生 NTE。有趣的是，kagome层的铁磁和反铁磁堆叠之间的转变伴随着Fe从面内方向到面外方向的自旋重新取向。这种磁重新取向可能是不同亚晶格上 Fe 单点各向异性强烈竞争的结果，因此被认为是受挫 Fe 亚晶格上高自旋态/低自旋态转变的标志。这项工作提供了进一步的见解，即同一材料中的不同磁序可以承载 NTE 和正常的热膨胀行为。

title: Extremal elastic metamaterials for robust underwater sound absorption via morphogenesis design
source: Matter
abstract: The static modulus of solids scales with the square of elastic wave speed, constraining underwater sound absorbers that require both high stiffness and slow propagation. Through morphogenesis design, we developed an elastic metamaterial with weakly coupled isotropic-isochoric eigenmodes that decouples modulus from wave speed, achieving a 6.8-fold enhancement over isotropic limits. Integrated with rubber, the composite delivers pressure-invariant absorption (>0.9 average coefficient) across a three-octave low-frequency band up to 4.5 MPa.
title_zh: 通过形态发生设计实现强大水下吸声的极弹性超材料
abstract_zh: 固体的静态模量与弹性波速度的平方成正比，限制了既需要高刚度又需要慢速传播的水下吸声器。通过形态发生设计，我们开发了一种具有弱耦合各向同性-等容本征模式的弹性超材料，可将模量与波速解耦，实现了各向同性极限的 6.8 倍增强。该复合材料与橡胶集成，可在高达 4.5 MPa 的三个八度低频段提供压力不变的吸收（平均系数 >0.9）。

title: Conversion cathodes for batteries towards 1,000 Wh kg−1
source: Matter
abstract: As lithium batteries approach the intrinsic energy density limits of intercalation chemistry, emerging applications such as electric aviation demand fundamentally new electrochemical systems. Using thermodynamic matrix calculations, this perspective identifies interhalogens and transition-metal fluorides as promising conversion cathodes for rechargeable batteries targeting 1,000 Wh kg−1.
title_zh: 将电池阴极转换为 1,000 Wh kg−1
abstract_zh: 随着锂电池接近插层化学的固有能量密度极限，电动航空等新兴应用需要全新的电化学系统。通过热力学矩阵计算，该观点将卤素间化合物和过渡金属氟化物确定为目标为 1,000 Wh kg−1 的可充电电池的有前途的转换阴极。

title: Frozen-State Electrochemistry Enables Proton-Selective Reaction Environments for Deterministic Atomic Construction
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Click to copy section link Section link copied! Electrochemical reactions are conventionally confined to liquid electrolytes, where charge transport and mass migration are intrinsically coupled, defining both the reaction kinetics and structural evolution. Here, we show that frozen acidic electrolytes can serve as proton-conductive, mass-transport-restricted media for electrochemical single-atom construction. Within a defined subzero temperature window, frozen aqueous electrolytes support proton-selective charge transport through hydrogen-bonded ice lattices while suppressing the long-range migration of heavier ionic species. This transport asymmetry enables the charge-programmable, aggregation-suppressed construction of isolated metal sites. The resulting atomic configurations remained stable under electrochemical operation. This frozen-state, proton-selective reaction environment is general across diverse metals and supports, providing a low-temperature electrochemical strategy for single-atom-catalyst construction. title_zh: 冷冻态电化学为确定性原子构建提供质子选择性反应环境
abstract_zh: 单击复制部分链接 部分链接已复制！电化学反应通常局限于液体电解质，其中电荷传输和质量迁移本质上耦合，定义了反应动力学和结构演化。在这里，我们证明冷冻酸性电解质可以作为电化学单原子结构的质子传导、质量传输限制的介质。在规定的零度以下温度范围内，冷冻的水性电解质支持通过氢键冰晶格的质子选择性电荷传输，同时抑制较重离子物质的长程迁移。这种传输不对称性使得隔离金属位点的电荷可编程、聚集抑制构造成为可能。所得的原子构型在电化学操作下保持稳定。这种冷冻态的质子选择性反应环境普遍存在于多种金属和载体中，为单原子催化剂的构建提供了低温电化学策略。 ACS 出版物 © 2026 美国化学会

title: Programmable DNA-Based Dimerization Networks for Dynamic and Competitive Control of Transcription
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Here, we introduce a minimal, experimentally validated DNA-encoded analogue of many-to-many protein dimerization networks to achieve programmable control of cell-free transcription. To do so, we rationally designed DNA monomers bearing orthogonal azide or DBCO handles that assemble via SPAAC chemistry into a combinatorial library of covalent dimers where only a single dimer completes an otherwise inactive promoter and activates transcription of a light-up RNA aptamer. By expanding the network from 2 to 22 monomers, we show that the RNA yield can be finely tuned over more than an order of magnitude, in quantitative agreement with a simple combinatorial model in which the activator dimer fraction decreases as a function of network size. We also designed sequence-defined inputs that selectively sequester monomers to reduce network size and upregulate chosen dimer activators, enabling multiplexed, orthogonal activation of different templates in the same solution from a shared monomer pool. Coupling the dimerization layer to a CRISPR-Cas12a collateral cleavage module, we further show that competitive DNA dimerization transcription logic can be interfaced with downstream enzymatic reactions to convert input sets into amplified cleavage activity. Together, these results establish competitive covalent DNA dimerization networks as a modular and quantitatively predictable platform for implementing competitive many-to-many dimerization logic for controlling cell-free transcription outputs.
title_zh: 用于动态和竞争性转录控制的基于 DNA 的可编程二聚化网络
abstract_zh: 在这里，我们引入了一种最小的、经过实验验证的 DNA 编码的多对多蛋白质二聚化网络类似物，以实现无细胞转录的可编程控制。为此，我们合理设计了带有正交叠氮化物或 DBCO 手柄的 DNA 单体，这些单体通过 SPAAC 化学组装成共价二聚体组合文库，其中只有单个二聚体完成原本不活跃的启动子并激活发光 RNA 适体的转录。通过将网络从 2 个单体扩展到 22 个单体，我们表明 RNA 产量可以在一个数量级以上进行微调，与简单的组合模型定量一致，在该模型中激活剂二聚体分数随着网络大小的函数而减少。我们还设计了序列定义的输入，选择性地隔离单体以减小网络大小并上调所选的二聚体激活剂，从而实现来自共享单体池的同一解决方案中不同模板的多重正交激活。将二聚化层与 CRISPR-Cas12a 旁路切割模块耦合，我们进一步表明竞争性 DNA 二聚化转录逻辑可以与下游酶反应连接，将输入集转换为放大的切割活性。总之，这些结果建立了竞争性共价 DNA 二聚化网络作为模块化和定量可预测的平台，用于实施竞争性多对多二聚化逻辑来控制无细胞转录输出。

title: Hexagonal Close-Packed 2H-Cu Nanocrystals
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Tuning the morphology and structure of Cu nanomaterials could effectively regulate their property, functions, and applications. However, it still remains challenging to directly synthesize Cu nanomaterials with an unconventional phase. Here, we report a one-pot wet-chemical synthesis of Cu nanocrystals (NCs) with a hexagonal close-packed (hcp, 2H type) phase, which is different from their thermodynamically stable face-centered cubic (fcc) phase. Compared to the conventional fcc-Cu NCs, the obtained 2H-Cu NCs exhibit enhanced catalytic activity and selectivity in the electrochemical carbon dioxide reduction reaction (CO2RR), achieving a high Faradaic efficiency (FE) of 73.1% toward multicarbon (C2+) products at 600 mA cm-2 under alkaline conditions in a flow cell. Moreover, in situ characterizations and density functional theory (DFT) calculations reveal that the 2H-Cu NCs can optimize the adsorption of the *CO intermediate, leading to a low energy barrier for the formation of C2+ products. This work not only demonstrates an improvement in CO2RR performance of Cu NCs by using the strategy of phase engineering of nanomaterials (PEN) but also opens up an avenue to explore the intrinsic properties and applications of unconventional-phase nanomaterials.
title_zh: 六方密堆积2H-Cu纳米晶
abstract_zh: 调控铜纳米材料的形貌和结构可以有效调控其性能、功能和应用。然而，直接合成具有非常规相的铜纳米材料仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们报道了具有六方密堆积（hcp，2H型）相的铜纳米晶体（NC）的一锅湿化学合成，该相不同于其热力学稳定的面心立方（fcc）相。与传统的fcc-Cu NCs相比，所获得的2H-Cu NCs在电化学二氧化碳还原反应（CO2RR）中表现出增强的催化活性和选择性，在流通池中的碱性条件下，在600 mA cm-2下对多碳（C2+）产物实现了73.1%的法拉第效率（FE）。此外，原位表征和密度泛函理论（DFT）计算表明，2H-Cu NCs 可以优化 *CO 中间体的吸附，从而降低 C2+ 产物形成的能垒。这项工作不仅证明了利用纳米材料相工程（PEN）策略提高了Cu NCs的CO2RR性能，而且为探索非常规相纳米材料的内在性质和应用开辟了一条途径。

title: Actively Programming Battery Chemistry via Pulse Modulation
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: The advancement of high-energy electrochemical energy storage is increasingly throttled by the kinetic and thermodynamic bottlenecks inherent to steady-state operation. This perspective posits that pulse modulation represents a fundamental paradigm shift, moving beyond empirical charging protocols toward a sophisticated framework for the active, real-time regulation of multiscale battery chemistry. By leveraging nonequilibrium transients, pulsed excitation enables the temporal decoupling of entangled physicochemical processes, including ion solvation sheath reorganization, interfacial charge transfer, and long-range mass transport that remain inaccessible under conventional constant-current conditions. We elucidate the underlying chemical physics of this approach, examining how a high-dimensional parameter space of amplitude, frequency, and waveform morphology dictates the concentration polarization, solid-electrolyte interphase evolution, and metal deposition morphology across micro- to macroscales. Furthermore, this work evaluates the convergence of operando diagnostics with physics-informed machine learning as a strategic route to navigate the vast combinatorial spaces of pulse protocols. By integrating multiphysics modeling with closed-loop control, we outline a roadmap for software-defined chemistry, where adaptive protocols dynamically compensate for state-of-health drift and thermal fluctuations. Ultimately, this perspective advocates for a transition from treating the battery as a passive electrochemical reservoir to an actively modulated system, providing a theoretical foundation for the next-generation, closed-loop battery management capable of multisource-field cooperative regulation of the electrochemical environment.
title_zh: 通过脉冲调制主动编程电池化学
abstract_zh: 高能电化学储能的进步越来越受到稳态运行固有的动力学和热力学瓶颈的限制。这种观点认为，脉冲调制代表了一种基本的范式转变，超越了经验充电协议，转向了主动、实时调节多尺度电池化学的复杂框架。通过利用非平衡瞬态，脉冲激发能够实现纠缠物理化学过程的时间解耦，包括离子溶剂化鞘重组、界面电荷转移和长程质量传输，而这些在传统恒流条件下仍然无法实现。我们阐明了这种方法的基本化学物理原理，研究了振幅、频率和波形形态的高维参数空间如何决定从微观到宏观尺度的浓差极化、固体电解质界面演化和金属沉积形态。此外，这项工作评估了操作诊断与基于物理的机器学习的融合，作为导航脉冲协议的巨大组合空间的战略路线。通过将多物理场建模与闭环控制相结合，我们概述了软件定义化学的路线图，其中自适应协议动态补偿健康状态漂移和热波动。最终，这种观点主张从将电池视为被动电化学储存器过渡到主动调制系统，从而提供了一种理论
