title: Chemically Separable Ruthenium Hydride Isomers with Distinct Hydride Transfer Properties
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Transition metal hydrides are key intermediates in biological and industrial catalysis, where control over hydride donor ability (hydricity) is essential for optimizing reactivity. Herein, we report a series of isomeric ruthenium hydrides in which the ligand trans to the ruthenium hydride bond-either an N-heterocyclic carbene or pyridine-modulates the thermodynamic hydricity by up to 8 kcal mol-1. These hydrides exhibited distinct reactivity toward CO2 and various organic hydride acceptors, enabling detailed kinetic and mechanistic analysis. Stopped-flow experiments, isotopic labeling, and computational studies supported an outer-sphere hydride transfer mechanism. Linear free energy relationships (LFERs) and Marcus relationships were utilized to correlate the changes in thermodynamics and kinetics, revealing that ligands with strong trans effects and trans influence can disrupt conventional scaling relationships, which can be a powerful strategy for promoting new reactivity paradigms in hydride transfer reactions.
title_zh: 可化学分离的氢化钌异构体，具有独特的氢化物转移特性
abstract_zh: 过渡金属氢化物是生物和工业催化中的关键中间体，其中控制氢化物供体能力（氢度）对于优化反应性至关重要。在此，我们报道了一系列异构氢化钌，其中配体反式至氢化钌键（N-杂环卡宾或吡啶）将热力学水度调节高达 8 kcal mol-1。这些氢化物对二氧化碳和各种有机氢化物受体表现出独特的反应性，从而能够进行详细的动力学和机理分析。停流实验、同位素标记和计算研究支持了外球氢化物转移机制。利用线性自由能关系（LFER）和Marcus关系来关联热力学和动力学的变化，揭示具有强反式效应和反式影响的配体可以破坏传统的标度关系，这可以成为促进氢化物转移反应中新反应范式的有力策略。

title: Comparative Metabolomics Reveals the Production of Sulfated Metabolites by Human Gut Bacteria
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: The sulfated metabolome─the collection of sulfate-containing metabolites─is an emerging source of structurally unique bioactive compounds that influence metabolism, immune responses, and neurological function. Recent studies have shown that, in addition to host enzymes, gut bacteria also encode sulfotransferase enzymes (SULTs) that generate sulfated metabolites. However, the substrate scope of characterized gut bacterial SULTs remains narrow, and comprehensive discovery is limited by a lack of methods to detect and assign sulfated metabolites in complex samples. Here, we develop a comparative metabolomics workflow that leverages the universal SULT cofactor 3'-phosphoadenosine-5'-phosphosulfate (PAPS) to incorporate heavy (34S) or light (32S) sulfur into sulfated metabolites, enabling discovery of microbiome-dependent sulfated compounds. By applying this approach in both "bottom-up" bacterial culture and "top-down" in vivo studies, we find that gut bacteria sulfonate hydroxy fatty acids. We identify a gut commensal microbe, Eubacterium ramulus, that performs this transformation, as well as an enzyme in this bacterium that performs this sulfonation, ErSULT. Metagenomic analyses reveal that ErSULT is prevalent across diverse human gut microbiomes. Together, this workflow and its application demonstrate that sulfated metabolite production by gut bacteria is more widespread than previously appreciated and provide a platform for future studies investigating the biosynthesis and biological functions of microbiome-derived sulfated small molecules.
title_zh: 比较代谢组学揭示人类肠道细菌硫酸化代谢物的产生
abstract_zh: 硫酸化代谢组（含硫酸盐代谢物的集合）是结构独特的生物活性化合物的新兴来源，可影响新陈代谢、免疫反应和神经功能。最近的研究表明，除了宿主酶之外，肠道细菌还编码可产生硫酸化代谢物的磺基转移酶（SULT）。然而，特征性肠道细菌 SULT 的底物范围仍然狭窄，并且由于缺乏检测和分配复杂样品中硫酸化代谢物的方法，综合发现受到限制。在这里，我们开发了一个比较代谢组学工作流程，利用通用 SULT 辅因子 3'-磷酸腺苷-5'-磷酸硫酸盐 (PAPS) 将重 (34S) 或轻 (32S) 硫掺入硫酸化代谢物中，从而能够发现微生物组依赖性硫酸化化合物。通过将这种方法应用于“自下而上”的细菌培养和“自上而下”的体内研究，我们发现肠道细菌磺化羟基脂肪酸。我们鉴定出一种肠道共生微生物，即能进行这种转化的真杆菌，以及这种细菌中进行这种磺化作用的酶，ErSULT。宏基因组分析表明，ErSULT 在不同的人类肠道微生物组中普遍存在。总之，该工作流程及其应用表明，肠道细菌产生的硫酸化代谢物比以前认识的更为广泛，并为未来研究微生物组衍生的硫酸化小分子的生物合成和生物功能提供了一个平台。

title: Droplet-Enhanced Asymmetric Catalysis: Squaramide-Derived Pseudopeptide for Enantioselective Addition Reactions
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Droplets formed through phase separation represent an emerging strategy to enhance enzyme-mimetic catalysis, demonstrating significant potential in catalytic science. However, due to the lack of systematic methodologies for precise engineering of chiral microenvironments within droplets, their application to asymmetric catalysis remains largely unexplored. To address this challenge, we integrate l-phenylalanine into an L-tert-leucine-derived squaramide to design the squaramide-derived pseudopeptide droplets. This catalytic system demonstrates remarkably enhanced catalytic performance in the enantioselective conjugate addition of α-nitrosulfone to acrylates and enones, as well as Michael addition of acetylacetone to β-nitroalkenes. Mechanistic investigations reveal that the increased local substrate concentration significantly enhances reactivity, while the engineered favorable chiral microenvironment boosts enantioselectivity. This study establishes a methodological framework for elucidating differentiated catalytic behaviors within the droplets, thereby advancing the design and application of droplet-based asymmetric catalytic systems.
title_zh: 液滴增强的不对称催化：用于对映选择性加成反应的方酰胺衍生的伪肽
abstract_zh: 通过相分离形成的液滴代表了一种增强酶模拟催化的新兴策略，在催化科学中展示了巨大的潜力。然而，由于缺乏精确设计液滴内手性微环境的系统方法，它们在不对称催化中的应用在很大程度上仍未得到探索。为了应对这一挑战，我们将 L-苯丙氨酸整合到 L-叔亮氨酸衍生的方酰胺中，以设计方酰胺衍生的伪肽液滴。该催化体系在α-硝基砜与丙烯酸酯和烯酮的对映选择性共轭加成以及乙酰丙酮与β-硝基烯烃的迈克尔加成中表现出显着增强的催化性能。机理研究表明，局部底物浓度的增加显着增强了反应活性，而工程化的有利手性微环境则提高了对映选择性。这项研究建立了一个方法框架来阐明液滴内的差异化催化行为，从而推进基于液滴的不对称催化系统的设计和应用。

title: Smart Charge Buffer-Modulated Multitime Scale Chemistry for Photocatalysis
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Photocatalysis offers a compelling platform for green chemical synthesis driven by solar energy. However, a fundamental bottleneck arises from the temporal mismatch between ultrafast exciton-carrier kinetics and comparatively sluggish surface reaction dynamics, ranging from picoseconds to seconds, which significantly limits the overall efficiency. Here, we address this longstanding bottleneck by introducing a self-modulating "time scale coordination" strategy, which integrates ferrocene carboxaldehyde (FcCHO) molecules as a smart charge buffer onto energy-level-matched photocatalysts. Combining in situ femtosecond transient absorption spectroscopy and DRIFTS, we uncover that the FcCHO enables multitime scale interfacial chemistry through reversible switching between electron-accepting and electron-donating states across disparate time scales: rapid electron capture from photoexcited photocatalysts occurs within picoseconds, while controlled electron release to drive interfacial CO2 reduction is kinetically delayed to the second time scale. This dual-time scale, self-regulated charge buffering behavior enables rapid charge sequestration and demand-driven charge release, which weakens the exciton binding energy by 39.0% and markedly suppresses electron-hole recombination by 62.8%. Importantly, this time scale coordination strategy is generalizable and can be extended to diverse photocatalytic systems, establishing a universal design principle for synchronizing fast charge dynamics with slow interfacial reaction kinetics for green carbon conversion.
title_zh: 用于光催化的智能电荷缓冲器调制多时间尺度化学
abstract_zh: 光催化为太阳能驱动的绿色化学合成提供了一个引人注目的平台。然而，一个根本的瓶颈来自于超快激子载流子动力学和相对缓慢的表面反应动力学（从皮秒到秒）之间的时间不匹配，这极大地限制了整体效率。在这里，我们通过引入自调节“时间尺度协调”策略来解决这个长期存在的瓶颈，该策略将二茂铁甲醛（FcCHO）分子作为智能电荷缓冲器集成到能级匹配的光催化剂上。结合原位飞秒瞬态吸收光谱和DRIFTS，我们发现FcCHO通过在不同时间尺度的受电子状态和给电子状态之间可逆切换来实现多时间尺度的界面化学：光激发光催化剂的快速电子捕获发生在皮秒内，而驱动界面CO2还原的受控电子释放在动力学上延迟到第二时间尺度。这种双时间尺度的自调节电荷缓冲行为能够实现快速电荷隔离和需求驱动的电荷释放，从而将激子结合能减弱39.0%，并显着抑制电子空穴复合62.8%。重要的是，这种时间尺度的协调策略是可推广的，可以扩展到不同的光催化系统，建立一个通用的设计原理，用于同步快速电荷动力学与慢速界面反应动力学以实现绿色碳转化。

title: Robust Hexagonal 2D COF Single Crystals for the Construction of Porous Moiré Superstructures
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: We report a series of two-dimensional (2D) covalent organic framework (COF) single crystals with hexagonal pores and their exfoliation into single-crystalline thin films for the construction of porous Moiré superstructures. These 2D COF single crystals, COF-600, COF-660, and COF-666, with sizes up to 120 μm, exhibited isoreticular structure under the P65 space group, as determined by single-crystal X-ray diffraction (SCXRD) and electron diffraction (ED) with a resolution of up to 0.9 Å. A high density of weak interactions at the nodes of the 2D framework was key to maintain the structural integrity and porosity after exfoliation, allowing for the trapping of inorganic clusters within the pores. The thickness of the exfoliated films was tuned systematically from 50 nm to 1.5 μm. A transmission electron microscope (TEM) was used to unveil the porous structures of both the exfoliated films and the corresponding Moiré superstructures, with a resolution of up to 1.72 Å. Twisted angles covering the range from 2.1° to 30° were observed, among which the one with a twist angle of 30° gave a quasiperiodic Moiré pattern with 12-fold symmetry. The use of robust porous 2D COF single crystals for the construction of Moiré superstructures points to a new way to create 2D porous materials with hierarchical order. Such porous superstructures are likely to trigger the emergence of new physical and chemical properties.
title_zh: 用于构建多孔莫尔超结构的坚固六方二维 COF 单晶
abstract_zh: 我们报告了一系列具有六角形孔的二维（2D）共价有机骨架（COF）单晶及其剥离成单晶薄膜，用于构建多孔莫尔超结构。这些二维 COF 单晶 COF-600、COF-660 和 COF-666 尺寸高达 120 μm，通过单晶 X 射线衍射 (SCXRD) 和电子衍射 (ED) 测定，分辨率高达 0.9 Å，在 P65 空间群下呈现出等网状结构。二维框架节点处的高密度弱相互作用是剥离后保持结构完整性和孔隙率的关键，从而可以将无机簇捕获在孔隙内。剥离膜的厚度从 50 nm 系统调整到 1.5 μm。使用透射电子显微镜 (TEM) 揭示了剥离薄膜的多孔结构和相应的莫尔超结构，分辨率高达 1.72 Å。观察到扭曲角覆盖2.1°至30°范围，其中扭曲角为30°的扭曲角给出了具有12重对称性的准周期莫尔图案。使用坚固的多孔 2D COF 单晶来构建莫尔超结构，指出了一种创建具有分层顺序的 2D 多孔材料的新方法。这种多孔的上层结构可能会引发新的物理和化学性质的出现。

title: Conformation-Guided Remote C–H Functionalization of Aromatic Compounds
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Achieving site-selective C-H functionalization at remote, unbiased positions of the aromatic ring remains a major challenge in the field. We report a conformational control strategy that enables remote meta-selective C-H borylation of mono- and 1,2-disubstituted (poly)arenes via arene π-complexation with Cr(CO)3. The chromium tripod adopts a preferred conformation, exposing the meta-C-H bond, while a tailored iridium catalyst bearing 2-aminophenanthroline ligands reinforces this effect and overrides intrinsic substrate bias. In polyaromatics, the chromium tripod acts as both a conformational director and an electronic modulator, enabling site- and ring-selectivity, which is inaccessible with existing nondirected methods. Computational studies at a state-of-the-art DFT theoretical level support a cooperative origin of selectivity arising from the interplay between arene π-complexation and the catalyst.
title_zh: 芳香族化合物的构象引导远程 C-H 官能化
abstract_zh: 在芳香环的远程、无偏位置实现位点选择性 C-H 官能化仍然是该领域的主要挑战。我们报告了一种构象控制策略，该策略能够通过芳烃与 Cr(CO)3 的 π 络合，实现单取代和 1,2-二取代（多）芳烃的远程元选择性 C-H 硼化。铬三脚架采用优选的构象，暴露间位-C-H键，而带有2-氨基菲咯啉配体的定制铱催化剂增强了这种效应并克服了固有的底物偏差。在聚芳烃中，铬三脚架既充当构象导向器又充当电子调制器，实现了位点选择性和环选择性，这是现有非定向方法无法实现的。最先进的 DFT 理论水平的计算研究支持芳烃 π 络合和催化剂之间相互作用产生的选择性的合作起源。

title: Ladder-shaped molecules for the masses
source: Nature Chemistry
abstract: Strain-releasing transformations of bicyclo(2.2.0)hexanes (‘ladderanes’) are underexplored because of their difficult synthetic accessibility. Now, a method provides easier access to this class of molecules and demonstrates their utility in cycloaddition reactions to produce useful structures for medicinal chemistry.
title_zh: 适合大众的梯形分子
abstract_zh: 双环（2.2.0）己烷（“梯烷”）的应变释放转化尚未得到充分研究，因为它们难以合成。现在，一种方法可以更容易地获得此类分子，并证明它们在环加成反应中的实用性，以产生药物化学有用的结构。

title: Heteroatom Doping Restructures Interfacial H 2 O to Resolve Mechanistic Contradictions in CO 2 Electroreduction
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Interfacial H2O is increasingly recognized as an active participant in electrocatalysis, yet a central challenge remains: how to deliberately and predictably program its microscopic structure to steer proton-coupled electron transfer (PCET) and selectivity. Here we introduce nonmetal doping as a materials-encoded handle to tune interfacial hydration on a model SnO2 catalyst without changing its bulk phase. Across N, P and S dopants, S uniquely stabilizes a disordered, predominantly H-down hydration motif at the catalyst-electrolyte boundary, which promotes H2O activation and directional proton delivery, accelerating PCET toward formate formation. Notably, this enhancement arises despite weaker binding of CO2-derived intermediates, revealing a solution-structure-controlled selectivity lever that can override conventional binding-energy-based expectations. By establishing a causal link between a doping-defined hydration motif and reaction kinetics, this work elevates interfacial H2O from a "context" to a designable variable, and suggests a broadly applicable strategy for optimizing PCET-governed transformations via interfacial solvation engineering.
title_zh: 杂原子掺杂重构界面H 2 O以解决CO 2 电还原中的机理矛盾
abstract_zh: 界面 H2O 越来越被认为是电催化的积极参与者，但核心挑战仍然存在：如何有意且可预测地编程其微观结构以引导质子耦合电子转移 (PCET) 和选择性。在这里，我们引入非金属掺杂作为材料编码手柄来调整模型 SnO2 催化剂上的界面水合，而不改变其本体相。在 N、P 和 S 掺杂剂中，S 独特地稳定了催化剂-电解质边界处无序的、主要是 H 下降的水合基序，从而促进 H2O 活化和定向质子传递，加速 PCET 形成甲酸盐。值得注意的是，尽管二氧化碳衍生中间体的结合较弱，但这种增强仍然出现，揭示了一种溶液结构控制的选择性杠杆，可以超越传统的基于结合能的预期。通过建立掺杂定义的水合基序和反应动力学之间的因果关系，这项工作将界面 H2O 从“背景”提升为可设计的变量，并提出了一种广泛适用的策略，通过界面溶剂化工程优化 PCET 控制的转化。

title: ATR-SEIRAS Studies of Butadiene Electrocarboxylation in Aprotic Media
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: The electrocarboxylation of butadiene (BD) offers a sustainable route to hexenedioate synthesis through CO2 utilization. Hexenedioate can be converted into adipic acid, the main precursor to Nylon, which is currently produced from fossil-based feedstocks. However, key aspects of BD electrocarboxylation remain unclear, particularly the involvement of surface-bound intermediates and competing interfacial reactions, such as the CO2 reduction reaction (CO2RR). Herein, we employ in situ Attenuated Total Reflectance Surface Enhanced Infrared Absorption Spectroscopy (ATR-SEIRAS), electrolysis experiments with product analysis and density functional theory (DFT) to investigate BD electrocarboxylation on Au, Cu, and Pt. ATR-SEIRAS tracks the evolution of interfacial species and shows that BD suppresses the CO adsorption band on Cu but remains unchanged on Pt, consistent with DFT predictions that result from its preferential binding and the destabilization of BD chemisorption at increasingly cathodic potentials. Electrolysis experiments reveal higher hexenedioate Faradaic efficiency on Au, followed by Cu and Pt, while CO selectivity shows the opposite trend (Pt > Cu > Au), providing complementary evidence for metal-dependent trends observed in the spectroscopic measurements. Although CO still forms in the presence of BD, part of the CO2•- is consumed by BD to generate electrocarboxylation products, and the CO that is produced does not adsorb on Cu because BD or BD-derived species outcompete and displace it. These findings highlight the effect of BD adsorption and potential-dependent radical competition in shaping electrocarboxylation reactions, emphasizing the importance of considering interfacial contributions in the electrochemical process.
title_zh: 非质子介质中丁二烯电羧化的 ATR-SEIRAS 研究
abstract_zh: 丁二烯 (BD) 的电羧化为利用二氧化碳合成己烯二酸酯提供了一条可持续的途径。己烯二酸酯可以转化为己二酸，这是尼龙的主要前体，目前尼龙是由化石原料生产的。然而，BD 电羧化的关键方面仍不清楚，特别是表面结合中间体和竞争性界面反应的参与，例如 CO2 还原反应 (CO2RR)。在此，我们采用原位衰减全反射表面增强红外吸收光谱（ATR-SEIRAS）、产物分析电解实验和密度泛函理论（DFT）来研究金、铜和铂的 BD 电羧化。 ATR-SEIRAS 跟踪界面物种的演变，并表明 BD 抑制 Cu 上的 CO 吸附带，但在 Pt 上保持不变，这与 DFT 预测一致，该预测是由于其优先结合和 BD 化学吸附在阴极电位增加时不稳定所致。电解实验表明，Au 上的己烯二酸法拉第效率较高，其次是 Cu 和 Pt，而 CO 选择性则显示出相反的趋势（Pt > Cu > Au），为光谱测量中观察到的金属依赖性趋势提供了补充证据。尽管在 BD 存在的情况下仍会形成 CO，但部分 CO2•- 被 BD 消耗以生成电羧化产物，并且产生的 CO 不会吸附在 Cu 上，因为 BD 或 BD 衍生物质在竞争中胜出并取代了它。这些发现强调了 BD 吸附的影响和电位依赖性

title: Precision Synthesis of I–III–VI Ternary Semiconductor Nanoclusters via Self-Limiting Cation Exchange
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Ternary I-III-VI semiconductors are important materials because of their environmental compatibility and broad tunability. However, achieving atomic-level control of multinary semiconductor materials remains a major challenge. Here, we report the precision synthesis of ternary nanoclusters with atomically defined stoichiometry, structure, and surface via self-limiting cation exchange. Specifically, the reaction between a Cu26Se13(PR3)14 template cluster and an InCl3-PR'3 complex produces a partially exchanged Cu6In8Se13Cl4(PR'3)12 cluster in high purity and near-unity yield. The ternary cluster retains the icosahedral Se13 anion framework, with In3+ and Cu+ cations self-assembled into a pseudo-core/shell heterostructure. All the phosphines bind to the outer-edge Cu+, while all the chlorides coordinate to the inner-facet In3+. The reaction is further generalized to Ga3+, producing an analogous Cu6Ga8Se13Cl4(PR3)12 cluster. Such self-limiting cation exchange and precise assembly of multinary cations and ligands can be attributed to charge, coordination, steric, and symmetry factors. Theoretical calculations reveal that Cu+ and In3+/Ga3+ contribute significantly to the occupied and unoccupied frontier orbitals, respectively, leading to a broad absorption band with charge-transfer character. The clusters can be sintered to form bulk semiconductors with well-controlled stoichiometry, demonstrating their potential as precise precursors for solution processing of multinary semiconductors. We expect that atomically defined cation-exchange reactions will open opportunities for precision engineering of complex multinary semiconductor materials.
title_zh: 自限性阳离子交换精密合成 I-III-VI 三元半导体纳米团簇
abstract_zh: 三元 I-III-VI 半导体因其环境兼容性和广泛的可调性而成为重要材料。然而，实现多元半导体材料的原子级控制仍然是一个重大挑战。在这里，我们报告了通过自限制阳离子交换精确合成具有原子定义的化学计量、结构和表面的三元纳米团簇。具体来说，Cu26Se13(PR3)14 模板簇和 InCl3-PR'3 络合物之间的反应产生部分交换的 Cu6In8Se13Cl4(PR'3)12 簇，纯度高且产率接近一致。三元簇保留了二十面体Se13阴离子框架，In3+和Cu+阳离子自组装成假核/壳异质结构。所有膦均与外边缘 Cu+ 结合，而所有氯化物则与内面 In3+ 配位。该反应进一步推广到 Ga3+，产生类似的 Cu6Ga8Se13Cl4(PR3)12 簇。这种自限制性阳离子交换以及多元阳离子和配体的精确组装可归因于电荷、配位、空间和对称因素。理论计算表明，Cu+ 和 In3+/Ga3+ 分别对占据和未占据的前沿轨道有显着贡献，从而产生具有电荷转移特性的宽吸收带。这些团簇可以烧结形成具有良好控制的化学计量的块状半导体，这证明了它们作为多元半导体溶液加工的精确前体的潜力。我们预计原子定义的阳离子交换反应将为精确的阳离子交换反应提供机会。

title: Catalytic Asymmetric Cationic Geranyl Cyclizations
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Cyclogeranyl motifs are important in natural products and terpene synthesis, yet their asymmetric formation from acyclic dienes remains challenging. Here, we report a general catalytic asymmetric cyclization of geranyl derivatives using confined chiral imidodiphosphorimidate (IDPi) Brønsted acids. In combination with fluorinated alcohol additives, the reaction proceeds under mild conditions with high efficiency and excellent regio- and enantioselectivity. The method accommodates diverse substrates, enabling access to fragrance-relevant scaffolds, retinal precursors, complex polycyclic terpenes, and even selective squalene cyclization. Mechanistic studies support a cooperative catalyst-additive hydrogen-bonding network and an asynchronous concerted, enzyme-like transition state within a confined chiral environment. This work provides a general solution for asymmetric geranyl cyclizations and expands the utility of confined Brønsted acid catalysis in biomimetic terpene synthesis.
title_zh: 催化不对称阳离子香叶基环化
abstract_zh: 环香叶基基序在天然产物和萜烯合成中很重要，但从无环二烯中不对称形成环香叶基基序仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们报告了使用受限手性亚胺二磷酸亚胺酯（IDPi）布朗斯台德酸对香叶基衍生物进行一般催化不对称环化。与氟化醇添加剂结合，反应在温和的条件下进行，具有高效率和优异的区域选择性和对映选择性。该方法适用于多种底物，能够获得与香料相关的支架、视网膜前体、复杂的多环萜烯，甚至选择性角鲨烯环化。机理研究支持协同催化剂添加剂氢键网络和受限手性环境内的异步协同、类酶过渡态。这项工作为不对称香叶基环化提供了通用的解决方案，并扩展了限域布朗斯台德酸催化在仿生萜烯合成中的应用。

title: Diameter-Controlled Synthesis of Horizontally Aligned Carbon Nanotube Arrays via S-Apphire Interface Engineering
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Click to copy section link Section link copied! Precise control over the size and dispersion of supported metal nanoparticles is a fundamental issue in heterogeneous catalysis, governing both reaction activity and selectivity. However, regulating these parameters remains challenging due to thermodynamically driven sintering, particularly under high-temperature conditions. This challenge is acutely exemplified in the growth of horizontally aligned carbon nanotube (HACNT) arrays, where the catalyst size dictates the CNT diameter, and consequently the electronic properties for integrated circuit applications. Here, we report a deterministic sulfur-modified sapphire (S-apphire) interface engineering strategy to regulate catalyst dispersion and the resulting CNT diameter. We establish cohesive energy ( E coh) as a quantitative descriptor of metal–metal versus metal–support interactions and show that sulfur modification selectively tunes E coh to control nanoparticle size predictably. This strategy achieves a diameter reduction to ∼1.26 nm using Ti catalysts, meeting the requirements for the 3 nm technology node of CNT integrated circuits, while preserving high array density and good alignment. Top-gated field-effect transistors fabricated on these arrays exhibit on/off current ratios approaching 10 7, superior to devices with uncontrolled diameters. Beyond CNT electronics, this work offers a generalizable thermodynamic framework for designing stable, size-controlled metal nanostructures via interface engineering. title_zh: 通过 S-Apphire 界面工程直径控制合成水平排列碳纳米管阵列
abstract_zh: 单击复制部分链接 部分链接已复制！精确控制负载金属纳米颗粒的尺寸和分散度是多相催化中的一个基本问题，控制着反应活性和选择性。然而，由于热力学驱动的烧结，特别是在高温条件下，调节这些参数仍然具有挑战性。这一挑战在水平排列碳纳米管 (HACNT) 阵列的生长中得到了尖锐的体现，其中催化剂尺寸决定了 CNT 直径，从而决定了集成电路应用的电子特性。在这里，我们报告了一种确定性的硫改性蓝宝石（S-apphire）界面工程策略来调节催化剂分散和所得的碳纳米管直径。我们将内聚能 (E coh) 作为金属-金属与金属-载体相互作用的定量描述符，并表明硫改性选择性地调节 E coh 以可预测地控制纳米颗粒尺寸。该策略使用Ti催化剂实现了直径减小至~1.26 nm，满足CNT集成电路3 nm技术节点的要求，同时保持高阵列密度和良好的对准。在这些阵列上制造的顶栅场效应晶体管表现出接近 10 7 的开/关电流比，优于具有不受控制直径的器件。除了碳纳米管电子学之外，这项工作还提供了一个通用的热力学框架，用于通过界面工程设计稳定、尺寸可控的金属纳米结构。 ACS 出版物 © 2026 美国化学会

title: Vibrating membrane bioreactors enhance nutrient removal and energy efficiency in municipal wastewater treatment
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Membrane bioreactors (MBRs) are widely applied in municipal wastewater treatment, yet their broader adoption has been constrained by energy-intensive aeration and membrane fouling. Here, we report approximately 800 consecutive days of full-scale (7500 m3 d−1) parallel operation of the vibrating MBR (VMBR) and the conventional aerated MBR (AMBR) systems, systematically comparing their pollutant removal performance, long-term filtration stability, membrane fouling mechanisms, and full life cycle environmental impacts. Results showed that the VMBR demonstrated enhanced nutrient removal, lowering effluent total nitrogen by 22% and reducing the chemical dosage for phosphorus removal by 40% compared with the AMBR. It also exhibited enhanced fouling resistance, with a 20% higher average specific flux than that of the AMBR throughout the operation. Mechanism analysis revealed that the VMBR generated effective, uniform shear at the membrane surface while preserving the sludge floc structure, thereby mitigating membrane fouling. Consequently, the VMBR reduced specific energy consumption for fouling control by 75% and the overall carbon footprint by 30%. We validate that VMBRs represent a scalable, energy-efficient and sustainable technology for future wastewater treatment.
title_zh: 振动膜生物反应器增强城市废水处理中的营养物去除和能源效率
abstract_zh: 膜生物反应器（MBR）广泛应用于城市污水处理，但其广泛采用受到能源密集型曝气和膜污染的限制。在这里，我们报告了振动 MBR (VMBR) 和传统曝气 MBR (AMBR) 系统连续大约 800 天的全尺寸（7500 m3 d−1）并行运行，系统地比较了它们的污染物去除性能、长期过滤稳定性、膜污染机制和全生命周期环境影响。结果表明，与 AMBR 相比，VMBR 增强了营养物去除效果，出水总氮降低了 22%，除磷化学剂量降低了 40%。它还表现出增强的抗污染性，在整个运行过程中平均比通量比 AMBR 高 20%。机理分析表明，VMBR 在膜表面产生有效、均匀的剪切力，同时保留污泥絮体结构，从而减轻膜污染。因此，VMBR 将结垢控制的具体能耗降低了 75%，将总体碳足迹降低了 30%。我们验证 VMBR 代表了未来废水处理的可扩展、节能和可持续的技术。

title: Revealing and Controlling Atomic-Scale Stacking Disorder in SAPO-34 for Enhanced MTO Performance
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: SAPO-34 is the benchmark catalyst for the methanol-to-olefins (MTO) process, yet its catalytic lifetime remains limited, attracting increasing attention from both academia and industry. Here, we identify a previously unrecognized origin of SAPO-34 deactivation: stacking disorder, which is a type of structural defect difficult to detect by conventional PXRD, particularly in nanosized crystals. By combining advanced three-dimensional electron diffraction (3D ED), integrated differential phase-contrast scanning transmission electron microscopy (iDPC-STEM), and electron ptychography based on four-dimensional (4D) STEM data, we uncover atomic-level hidden stacking disorders in SAPO-34 synthesized using the conventional tetraethylammonium (TEA+) as the organic structure directing agent (OSDA). These disorders promote the formation of smaller aei cages, thereby accelerating catalyst deactivation. Guided by these structural insights, we identify a larger OSDA, N,N,N-trimethyladamantan-1-aminium (TMAda+), that suppresses aei-cage formation and yields stacking-disorder-free SAPO-34 with a markedly extended MTO lifetime. Furthermore, to circumvent the high cost of TMAda+, we develop a series of low-cost amine OSDAs that reproduce its structure-directing behavior, yielding SAPO-34 catalysts free of stacking disorder and with MTO performance comparable to that of TMAda+-directed catalyst, as confirmed by 3D ED and iDPC-STEM characterization. Among these catalysts, SAPO-34 directed by N,N-dimethylcyclohexylamine shows the highest catalytic durability. This work establishes a structural design strategy for producing stacking-disorder-free SAPO-34 with substantially enhanced MTO stability.
title_zh: 揭示和控制 SAPO-34 中的原子级堆积无序以增强 MTO 性能
abstract_zh: SAPO-34是甲醇制烯烃（MTO）工艺的基准催化剂，但其催化寿命仍然有限，越来越受到学术界和工业界的关注。在这里，我们确定了 SAPO-34 失活的一个先前未被识别的根源：堆积无序，这是一种难以通过传统 PXRD 检测的结构缺陷，特别是在纳米尺寸晶体中。通过结合先进的三维电子衍射 (3D ED)、集成微分相衬扫描透射电子显微镜 (iDPC-STEM) 和基于四维 (4D) STEM 数据的电子叠层描记术，我们发现了使用传统四乙铵 (TEA+) 作为有机结构导向剂 (OSDA) 合成的 SAPO-34 中原子级隐藏的堆积紊乱。这些紊乱促进较小的 aei 笼的形成，从而加速催化剂失活。在这些结构见解的指导下，我们确定了一个更大的 OSDA，N,N,N-三甲基金刚烷-1-铵 (TMAda+)，它可以抑制 aei-cage 的形成并产生无堆积无序的 SAPO-34，并显着延长 MTO 寿命。此外，为了规避 TMAda+ 的高成本，我们开发了一系列低成本的胺 OSDA，可重现其结构导向行为，产生无堆积无序的 SAPO-34 催化剂，且 MTO 性能与 TMAda+ 导向催化剂相当，经 3D ED 和 iDPC-STEM 表征证实。在这些催化剂中，N,N-二甲基环己胺引导的SAPO-34表现出最高的催化耐久性。这项工作建立了一个结构性的d

title: Neural dynamics of temporal interference stimulation monitoring by soft liquid metal interfaces across neural systems
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Neuromodulation is widely employed to enhance neural activity and restore impaired circuitry, yet current methods suffer from invasiveness, limited depth, or poor spatial resolution. Temporal interference stimulation (TIS) has emerged as a non-invasive approach to modulate deep brain regions via interference of high-frequency electric fields, achieving spatial selectivity. Despite its potential, the physiological effects remain unexplored. Here, we present a customized liquid metal-based neural interface to record electrophysiological responses to TIS across diverse neural tissues, from brain organoids to mouse brains. The softness of the interface minimizes invasiveness while ensuring stable access to deep neural regions. Electrophysiological analyses reveal TIS-induced dynamics in neurodevelopment and functional connectivity. Furthermore, we investigated latent neural dynamics, presenting population-level neural activity, to compare responses across models of differing complexity and maturity. By combining soft neural interfaces with multi-scale analyses, this study uncovers how neuromodulation shapes neural dynamics and supports the development of future therapeutic strategies.
title_zh: 跨神经系统的软液态金属接口监测时间干扰刺激的神经动力学
abstract_zh: 神经调节被广泛用于增强神经活动和恢复受损的电路，但目前的方法存在侵入性、深度有限或空间分辨率差的问题。时间干扰刺激（TIS）已成为一种非侵入性方法，通过高频电场的干扰来调节大脑深部区域，从而实现空间选择性。尽管它具有潜力，但其生理效应仍未被探索。在这里，我们提出了一种定制的基于液态金属的神经接口，用于记录从大脑类器官到小鼠大脑等不同神经组织对 TIS 的电生理反应。界面的柔软性最大限度地减少了侵入性，同时确保稳定地进入深层神经区域。电生理学分析揭示了 TIS 诱导的神经发育和功能连接动力学。此外，我们研究了潜在的神经动力学，呈现群体水平的神经活动，以比较不同复杂性和成熟度的模型的反应。通过将软神经接口与多尺度分析相结合，这项研究揭示了神经调节如何塑造神经动力学并支持未来治疗策略的发展。

title: Viral syncytia evolve to resist interferon
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: SARS-CoV-2, like many viruses, generates syncytia but the role of syncytia formation in viral evolution remains unknown. Using SARS-CoV-2 and SARS-CoV-2 Spike (S) replacement vesicular stomatitis (VSV), we show that S-mediated syncytia impair the antiviral effects of interferons in cultured cells, human lung cell cultures, and hACE2 transgenic mice. Amino acid substitutions that modulate syncytia formation in Delta- and Omicron-encoded S have parallel effects on viral interferon resistance. S-mediated syncytia compromise antibody-mediated virus neutralization in cultured cells. We recapitulate interferon and neutralizing antibody resistance in syncytia generated by the orthoreovirus p14 fusion-associated small transmembrane (FAST) protein in VSV, influenza virus, and seasonal coronavirus OC43 infections. These findings explain selection of SARS-CoV-2 fusogenic variants in humans and, more generally, the evolution of fusogenic viruses driven by adaptive and innate immunity.
title_zh: 病毒合胞体进化以抵抗干扰素
abstract_zh: 与许多病毒一样，SARS-CoV-2 会产生合胞体，但合胞体形成在病毒进化中的作用仍不清楚。使用 SARS-CoV-2 和 SARS-CoV-2 Spike (S) 替代性水泡性口炎 (VSV)，我们发现 S 介导的合胞体会损害培养细胞、人肺细胞培养物和 hACE2 转基因小鼠中干扰素的抗病毒作用。调节 Delta 和 Omicron 编码的 S 中合胞体形成的氨基酸取代对病毒干扰素抗性具有平行作用。 S介导的合胞体损害培养细胞中抗体介导的病毒中和作用。我们概括了 VSV、流感病毒和季节性冠状病毒 OC43 感染中正呼肠孤病毒 p14 融合相关小跨膜 (FAST) 蛋白产生的合胞体中的干扰素和中和抗体抗性。这些发现解释了人类中 SARS-CoV-2 融合变异的选择，以及更普遍的解释了由适应性和先天免疫驱动的融合病毒的进化。

title: Wireless light-gated photoelectrochemical microneedle wearables for zero-bias longitudinal monitoring in interstitial fluid
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Wearable chemical sensors could enable continuous health monitoring, but long-term measurements in interstitial fluid are limited by power consumption, electrochemical interference and signal drift during wear. Here we show a light-gated photoelectrochemical microneedle wearable for zero-bias chemical monitoring in subcutaneous interstitial fluid. The device combines a swelling-tolerant conductive hydrogel microneedle array, a plasmon-enhanced photoelectrode and a miniaturized module for light excitation, current recording and Bluetooth transmission. Visible light drives oxygen-mediated redox chemistry without an applied bias, reducing interfering electrochemical reactions and power demand. Using uric acid as a representative analyte, the wearable provides wireless readout under hydration and mechanical deformation. In vivo disease-model validation was performed in male rats and mice, where the device tracked uric acid dynamics in chronic kidney disease, diabetic hyperuricemia and bacterial treatment, with trends correlating with blood measurements. This light-gated microneedle architecture offers a modular route for longitudinal monitoring of interstitial-fluid chemistry.
title_zh: 用于间质液零偏差纵向监测的无线光门控光电化学微针可穿戴设备
abstract_zh: 可穿戴化学传感器可以实现持续的健康监测，但间质液的长期测量受到功耗、电化学干扰和穿戴期间信号漂移的限制。在这里，我们展示了一种可穿戴的光控光电化学微针，用于皮下间质液中的零偏差化学监测。该装置结合了耐膨胀的导电水凝胶微针阵列、等离子体增强光电极和用于光激发、电流记录和蓝牙传输的小型化模块。可见光无需施加偏压即可驱动氧介导的氧化还原化学反应，从而减少电化学反应的干扰和电力需求。该可穿戴设备使用尿酸作为代表性分析物，在水合和机械变形下提供无线读数。在雄性大鼠和小鼠中进行了体内疾病模型验证，其中该设备跟踪慢性肾病、糖尿病高尿酸血症和细菌治疗中的尿酸动态，其趋势与血液测量值相关。这种光控微针架构为组织间液化学的纵向监测提供了模块化途径。

title: Synthesis of poly(4HB-co-PhLA) and poly(3HB-co-4HB-co-PhLA) as sustainable hot-melt adhesives using engineered Escherichia coli
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Conventional petroleum-based adhesives are non-biodegradable and raise environmental concerns. Polyhydroxyalkanoates (PHAs), bacterial polyesters synthesized from renewable carbon sources, are promising adhesive candidates due to biodegradability and structural diversity. Here, we report aromatic PHA copolymers, poly[4-hydroxybutyrate(4HB)-co-phenyllactate(PhLA)] and poly[3-hydroxybutyrate(3HB)-co-4HB-co-PhLA], exhibiting thermal stability and hot-melt adhesive (HMA) properties. Escherichia coli strains are engineered to produce these polymers from glucose and polymer biosynthesis is enhanced by optimizing heterologous expression, introducing additional CoA transferases and temporally regulating gene expression. We applied in silico simulations to systematically identify engineering targets that improve the synthesis of multiple monomers. The final engineered strains produce 10.2 g l−1 of poly(32.7 mol% 4HB-co-PhLA) and 52.8 g l−1 of poly(3HB-co-2.7 mol% 4HB-co-5.6 mol% PhLA). The resulting polymers demonstrate adhesive performance and reusability, expanding the available polymer property portfolio. Overall, we present a sustainable and expandable strategy for the microbial production of reusable, bio-based HMAs with tunable adhesive properties and practical application potential.
title_zh: 使用工程大肠杆菌合成聚（4HB-co-PhLA）和聚（3HB-co-4HB-co-PhLA）作为可持续热熔粘合剂
abstract_zh: 传统的石油基粘合剂是不可生物降解的，会引起环境问题。聚羟基脂肪酸酯（PHA）是由可再生碳源合成的细菌聚酯，由于可生物降解性和结构多样性，是有前途的粘合剂候选者。在这里，我们报道了芳香族PHA共聚物，聚[4-羟基丁酸酯（4HB）-co-苯基乳酸（PhLA）]和聚[3-羟基丁酸酯（3HB）-co-4HB-co-PhLA]，表现出热稳定性和热熔胶（HMA）性能。大肠杆菌菌株经过工程改造，可以从葡萄糖生产这些聚合物，并且通过优化异源表达、引入额外的 CoA 转移酶和暂时调节基因表达来增强聚合物的生物合成。我们应用计算机模拟来系统地识别改善多种单体合成的工程目标。最终的工程菌株产生 10.2 g l−1 的聚（32.7 mol% 4HB-co-PhLA）和 52.8 g l−1 的聚（3HB-co-2.7 mol% 4HB-co-5.6 mol% PhLA）。所得聚合物表现出粘合性能和可重复使用性，扩展了可用的聚合物性能组合。总体而言，我们提出了一种可持续且可扩展的策略，用于微生物生产可重复使用的生物基 HMA，具有可调的粘合性能和实际应用潜力。

title: Structural basis of PLPP3-mediated lipid phosphate dephosphorylation and its role in melanoma
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Lipid phosphates serve as signaling molecules involved in diverse cellular processes such as cell proliferation, migration, angiogenesis, inflammation, immunity and cancer progression. Phospholipid phosphatases (PLPPs) modulate these signals by catalyzing the dephosphorylation of lipid phosphates. Here, we report the cryo-EM structure of PLPP3, revealing a tetrameric assembly. PLPP3 contains six transmembrane helices (TMs) and an extracellular domain that contains two extracellular loops. TMs 1–4 create a hydrophobic cleft that holds the tails of a phospholipid while the extracellular domain forms a positively charged pocket to accommodate the polar head group. Two conserved catalytic histidine residues in this pocket coordinate a putative zinc ion previously identified as a PLPP3 inhibitor. Structural mapping of somatic mutations with functional analysis reveals that PLPP3 acts as a tumor suppressor in melanoma. Together, our findings provide critical insights into the structure, substrate engagement, inhibitory mechanism, and cancer-related function of PLPP3.
title_zh: PLPP3介导的磷酸脂去磷酸化的结构基础及其在黑色素瘤中的作用
abstract_zh: 磷酸脂作为信号分子参与多种细胞过程，如细胞增殖、迁移、血管生成、炎症、免疫和癌症进展。磷脂磷酸酶 (PLPP) 通过催化脂质磷酸盐的去磷酸化来调节这些信号。在这里，我们报告了 PLPP3 的冷冻电镜结构，揭示了四聚体组装。 PLPP3 包含六个跨膜螺旋 (TM) 和一个包含两个细胞外环的细胞外结构域。 TM 1-4 形成一个疏水裂缝，用于固定磷脂的尾部，而胞外结构域则形成一个带正电荷的口袋，以容纳极性头基。该口袋中的两个保守的催化组氨酸残基与先前鉴定为 PLPP3 抑制剂的推定锌离子相配。体细胞突变的结构图谱与功能分析表明 PLPP3 在黑色素瘤中充当肿瘤抑制因子。总之，我们的研究结果为 PLPP3 的结构、底物参与、抑制机制和癌症相关功能提供了重要的见解。

title: Accurate, sensitive, and efficient chromatin accessibility quantification at target loci using UNIChro-seq
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Recent progress in statistical and experimental fine mapping of disease risk variants prompts us to focus on specific target loci for functional investigation. However, current genetics is hindered by a limited toolbox for target-loci analysis. To address this, we present UNIChro-seq, a method that digitally counts accessible chromatin molecules at target loci. UNIChro-seq allows for accurate, sensitive, and efficient quantification of allelic effects compared to conventional methods. Using UNIChro-seq, we investigate the effects of 57 autoimmunity risk alleles on chromatin accessibility and estimate the causal effects of 20 artificial variants generated through genome editing. As a caveat, a non-negligible fraction of the edited alleles exhibits a falsely positive effect on chromatin accessibility, which can be effectively distinguished from the true causal effect through bi-directional genome editing. Finally, functional dissection of a fine-mapped risk variant at the LEF1 locus illuminates its relevance to T cell dysregulation in rheumatoid arthritis. Together, these findings underscore the utility of combining UNIChro-seq with genome editing technology to enable precise and scalable functional analysis of disease-associated loci.
title_zh: 使用 UNIChro-seq 对目标位点进行准确、灵敏且高效的染色质可及性定量
abstract_zh: 疾病风险变异的统计和实验精细绘图的最新进展促使我们关注特定目标位点进行功能研究。然而，当前的遗传学受到目标基因座分析工具箱有限的阻碍。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 UNIChro-seq，一种对目标位点上可访问的染色质分子进行数字计数的方法。与传统方法相比，UNIChro-seq 可以准确、灵敏且高效地量化等位基因效应。使用 UNIChro-seq，我们研究了 57 个自身免疫风险等位基因对染色质可及性的影响，并估计了通过基因组编辑生成的 20 个人工变异的因果影响。需要注意的是，编辑的等位基因的一个不可忽略的部分对染色质可及性表现出错误的积极影响，可以通过双向基因组编辑将其与真正的因果效应有效地区分开来。最后，对 LEF1 基因座的精细定位风险变异的功能剖析阐明了其与类风湿性关节炎中 T 细胞失调的相关性。总之，这些发现强调了将 UNIChro-seq 与基因组编辑技术相结合的实用性，可以对疾病相关位点进行精确且可扩展的功能分析。

title: Robustly enhancing crop genomic prediction accuracy through ensemble learning and iterative optimization
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: With climate change and global population growth, accelerating the breeding of superior crop varieties is essential for food security. Genomic prediction, which uses genome-wide genetic markers to predict crop traits, plays an important role in intelligent crop breeding. However, existing methods often lack stable and accurate performance across crops and traits. Here, we propose GEG2P, a genetic algorithm-based ensemble learning method for genotype-to-phenotype prediction, integrates 20 base learners, dynamically selects their combinations through an iterative optimization strategy, and optimizes their weights using the genetic algorithm. Compared with the best-performing single base learners, GEG2P improves prediction accuracy by 4.02% on average across maize, wheat, rice, chickpea, and soybean. We use SHAP to quantify the contribution of SNPs to phenotype prediction and find that SNPs with large effects captured by different base learners are functionally complementary. This study provides a robust and accurate genomic prediction method for crop breeding.
title_zh: 通过集成学习和迭代优化，大力提高作物基因组预测的准确性
abstract_zh: 随着气候变化和全球人口增长，加快优质作物品种的培育对于粮食安全至关重要。基因组预测利用全基因组遗传标记来预测作物性状，在作物智能育种中发挥着重要作用。然而，现有方法往往缺乏跨作物和性状的稳定和准确的性能。在这里，我们提出了GEG2P，一种基于遗传算法的基因型到表型预测的集成学习方法，集成了20个基础学习器，通过迭代优化策略动态选择它们的组合，并使用遗传算法优化它们的权重。与表现最佳的单基学习器相比，GEG2P 对玉米、小麦、水稻、鹰嘴豆和大豆的预测准确率平均提高了 4.02%。我们使用SHAP来量化SNP对表型预测的贡献，发现不同基础学习器捕获的具有较大影响的SNP在功能上是互补的。这项研究为作物育种提供了一种稳健且准确的基因组预测方法。

title: Redundant prefrontal hemispheres adapt storage strategy to working memory demands
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The prefrontal hemispheres must coordinate dynamically to maintain a unified representation of visual space. Recently, two opposing theories using distinct storage strategies have been proposed: A high-capacity specialized architecture, where each hemisphere governs contralateral behavior, and a fail-safe redundant one, where both hemispheres jointly guide behavior across the visual space. Here, we analyzed simultaneous bilateral prefrontal cortex recordings from three male macaque monkeys performing a visuo-spatial working memory task. Both hemispheres equally predicted behavioral imprecision, decoding errors were weakly correlated between hemispheres, and serial dependence remained local within hemispheres, suggesting a redundant, weakly coupled organization. Attractor network simulations showed that redundancy improved precision when task demands were below memory capacity, while weak interhemispheric coupling increased capacity in more demanding tasks by allowing hemispheric specialization. These predicted patterns were validated in human and monkey data, reconciling previous findings and revealing a versatile interhemispheric architecture that adapts to varying cognitive demands.
title_zh: 冗余的前额半球使存储策略适应工作记忆需求
abstract_zh: 前额半球必须动态协调以维持视觉空间的统一表示。最近，提出了两种使用不同存储策略的相反理论：一种高容量专用架构，其中每个半球控制对侧行为；另一种是故障安全冗余理论，其中两个半球共同引导整个视觉空间的行为。在这里，我们分析了三只执行视觉空间工作记忆任务的雄性猕猴的同时双侧前额皮质记录。两个半球同样预测了行为不精确性，解码错误在半球之间的相关性较弱，并且序列依赖性在半球内仍然是局部的，这表明存在冗余、弱耦合的组织。吸引子网络模拟表明，当任务需求低于内存容量时，冗余可以提高精度，而弱半球间耦合通过允许半球专门化来提高要求更高的任务的容量。这些预测模式在人类和猴子数据中得到了验证，与之前的发现相一致，并揭示了一种适应不同认知需求的多功能半球间结构。

title: Incorporating AI-optimized zinc finger proteins enhances the efficiencies and targeting ranges of miniature base editors
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The therapeutic application of base editors is limited by their large sizes, which are beyond the packaging capabilities of adeno-associated viral (AAV) vectors. Despite recent progress that has identified many compact CRISPR proteins, the resulting miniature base editors often exhibit reduced activities and limited targeting scope. Here, we introduce a zinc finger protein (ZFP)-enhanced miniature base editor (zmBE), which integrates programmable ZFPs to improve efficiencies and targeting scopes of miniature base editors, including those based on Un1Cas12f1 and OgeuIscB. Utilizing protein language models to optimize ZFPs designed by modular assembly further simplifies the development of zmBEs. Leveraging these methodologies, we engineer a zmBE that effectively induces the SMN2 exon 7 T:A(6) > C:G conversion, restores the exon 7 inclusion, and improves spinal muscular atrophy in a murine model after being delivered via a single AAV vector. Our study provides a versatile platform for developing miniature base editors for in vivo therapeutic applications.
title_zh: 结合人工智能优化的锌指蛋白可提高微型碱基编辑器的效率和靶向范围
abstract_zh: 碱基编辑器的治疗应用因其尺寸较大而受到限制，超出了腺相关病毒（AAV）载体的包装能力。尽管最近已鉴定出许多紧凑的 CRISPR 蛋白，但由此产生的微型碱基编辑器通常表现出活性降低和靶向范围有限。在这里，我们介绍了一种锌指蛋白 (ZFP) 增强型微型碱基编辑器 (zmBE)，它集成了可编程 ZFP，以提高微型碱基编辑器的效率和目标范围，包括基于 Un1Cas12f1 和 OgeuIscB 的微型碱基编辑器。利用蛋白质语言模型来优化模块化组装设计的ZFP，进一步简化了zmBE的开发。利用这些方法，我们设计了一种 zmBE，它可以有效诱导 SMN2 外显子 7 T:A(6) > C:G 转换，恢复外显子 7 包含，并在通过单个 AAV 载体递送后改善小鼠模型中的脊髓性肌萎缩症。我们的研究为开发用于体内治疗应用的微型碱基编辑器提供了一个多功能平台。

title: Evolutionary trajectory of microbial sulfur oxidation pathways recapitulates Earth’s oxygenation history
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Dissimilatory sulfur oxidation mediated by the microbial sulfur-oxidizing (Sox) multienzyme complex has played a central role in Earth’s oxidative sulfur cycle. However, the evolutionary trajectory leading to its current complexity remains poorly understood. Here, we integrated expanded genomic records with geochemical evidence to reconstruct the natural history of the Sox system along a geological timeline. Our analyses traced the origin of the truncated Sox system (SoxABXYZ) prior to the Great Oxidation Event (GOE). This early form was later assembled with reverse dissimilatory sulfite reductases (rDsr), facilitating a primitive pathway for sulfate formation during the anoxic Archean eon. Following the post-GOE atmospheric oxygen rise, the truncated system incorporated SoxCD components, evolving into a more fine-tuned, oxygen-adapted pathway compared to the rDsr-coupled alternative. The subsequent spread of these Sox pathway variants was constrained by the oxygen requirements and phylogenetic backgrounds of their prokaryotic hosts, shaping the modern ecological landscape of microbial sulfur oxidation. The viral recruitment of auxiliary Sox components marked the latest evolutionary events, enabling direct manipulation of sulfur cycling over centuries-to-millennia timescales. Collectively, the reconstructed molecular timeline offers deeper insights into the evolutionary dynamics of the global oxidative sulfur cycle and its billion-year interplay with Earth’s changing environments.
title_zh: 微生物硫氧化途径的进化轨迹概括了地球的氧化历史
abstract_zh: 由微生物硫氧化（Sox）多酶复合物介导的异化硫氧化在地球的氧化硫循环中发挥着核心作用。然而，导致其当前复杂性的进化轨迹仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们将扩展的基因组记录与地球化学证据相结合，以沿着地质时间线重建 Sox 系统的自然历史。我们的分析追踪了大氧化事件 (GOE) 之前截断的 Sox 系统 (SoxABXYZ) 的起源。这种早期形式后来与逆异化亚硫酸盐还原酶（rDsr）组装在一起，促进了缺氧太古宙期间硫酸盐形成的原始途径。随着 GOE 后大气中氧气的上升，截短的系统纳入了 SoxCD 组件，与 rDsr 耦合替代方案相比，演变成一种更微调、更适应氧气的途径。这些 Sox 途径变体随后的传播受到原核宿主的氧气需求和系统发育背景的限制，塑造了微生物硫氧化的现代生态景观。辅助 Sox 成分的病毒招募标志着最新的进化事件，使得能够在数百年至数千年的时间尺度上直接操纵硫循环。总的来说，重建的分子时间线为全球氧化硫循环的进化动力学及其与地球不断变化的环境数十亿年的相互作用提供了更深入的见解。

title: Global variation of plant nitrogen acquisition strategies and their responses to decreasing nitrogen availability
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Plants employ three N acquisition strategies to support productivity: root uptake from soils, symbiotic fixation, and resorption from senescing leaves. However, their global variation and coordination remain poorly understood. Here, we compile 3,193 field observations and use machine learning to map the three strategies and quantify their relative contributions. We estimate that global nitrogen uptake, fixation, and resorption amount to 559.2 ± 56.5 (mean ± standard deviation), 125.5 ± 7.2, and 279.3 ± 5.0 Tg N yr−1, respectively, representing 58%, 13%, and 29% of total plant N acquisition. Their global variations are primarily determined by temperature and water conditions. Nitrogen uptake dominates globally, especially in warm, humid low–latitude regions, while resorption is more prevalent in arid and cold environments. In contrast, fixation contributes relatively little, with some hotspots in tropical regions and northern high latitudes. Notably, we find significant shifts in N acquisition strategies—from uptake to fixation and resorption—along gradients of decreasing nitrogen availability. These results suggest a spatially coordinated adjustment of plant nitrogen acquisition strategies in response to changing N conditions and offer insights into how coordinated nitrogen strategies shape terrestrial nitrogen cycling and its coupling with the carbon sink.
title_zh: 植物氮获取策略的全球变化及其对氮可用性下降的反应
abstract_zh: 植物采用三种氮获取策略来支持生产力：根部从土壤中吸收、共生固定以及衰老叶子的再吸收。然而，它们的全球变化和协调仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们汇总了 3,193 个现场观察结果，并使用机器学习来绘制这三种策略并量化它们的相对贡献。我们估计全球氮吸收、固定和再吸收分别为 559.2 ± 56.5（平均值 ± 标准差）、125.5 ± 7.2 和 279.3 ± 5.0 Tg N yr−1，分别占植物总氮获取的 58%、13% 和 29%。它们的全球变化主要由温度和水条件决定。氮吸收在全球范围内占主导地位，特别是在温暖、潮湿的低纬度地区，而吸收在干旱和寒冷的环境中更为普遍。相比之下，固定的贡献相对较小，一些热点地区位于热带地区和北部高纬度地区。值得注意的是，我们发现氮获取策略发生了显着变化——从吸收到固定和再吸收——沿着氮可用性下降的梯度。这些结果表明植物氮获取策略在空间上协调调整以响应不断变化的氮条件，并为协调氮策略如何塑造陆地氮循环及其与碳汇的耦合提供了见解。

title: Amine-linked heteroporous covalent organic framework for synergistic anti-infective therapy of post-traumatic osteomyelitis
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The treatment of post-traumatic osteomyelitis (PTO) is impeded by bacterial biofilms and disruption of drug delivery systems in acidic lesions. Here, we develop an acid-resistant amine-linked heteroporous covalent organic framework (ARCOF) using a reductive amination strategy. This approach overcomes the insufficient chemical stability and drug delivery capacity of conventional COFs arising from the trade-off between high bond strength and crystalline reversibility. The pre-designed hetero-environmental channels of ARCOF enable synergistic loading of vancomycin and the anti-biofilm agent felodipine. When combined with calcium phosphate cement, both drugs exhibit sustained release over 240 h under inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic efficacy is evaluated in a rat PTO model, where the co-delivery system significantly enhances antibacterial efficacy by disrupting biofilm integrity and concurrently modulates the local inflammatory microenvironment to support bone tissue recovery. This strategy provides an integrated local delivery approach to overcome pharmacokinetic barriers and biofilm resistance in osteomyelitis treatment.
title_zh: 胺连接的异孔共价有机框架用于协同抗感染治疗创伤后骨髓炎
abstract_zh: 酸性病变中的细菌生物膜和药物输送系统的破坏阻碍了创伤后骨髓炎（PTO）的治疗。在这里，我们使用还原胺化策略开发了一种耐酸胺连接的异孔共价有机框架（ARCOF）。这种方法克服了传统COF由于高键合强度和结晶可逆性之间的权衡而导致的化学稳定性和药物输送能力不足的问题。 ARCOF 预先设计的异环境通道能够协同加载万古霉素和抗生物膜剂非洛地平。当与磷酸钙骨水泥结合时，两种药物在炎症条件下均表现出持续释放超过 240 小时。在大鼠 PTO 模型中评估治疗效果，其中共传递系统通过破坏生物膜完整性来显着增强抗菌功效，同时调节局部炎症微环境以支持骨组织恢复。该策略提供了一种综合的局部递送方法，以克服骨髓炎治疗中的药代动力学障碍和生物膜耐药性。

title: Spinal cord regeneration deploys cell-type specific developmental and non-developmental strategies to restore neuron diversity
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: A major goal of spinal cord injury research is to develop a path to endogenous regeneration. This approach has been heavily informed by animal models of natural regeneration. An unresolved question is whether these models rebuild the spinal cord exclusively by accessing developmental mechanisms of neuron differentiation. To address this question, we contrasted single-cell gene expression during regeneration with stage-matched controls in the conditionally regenerative frog Xenopus tropicalis. We generated an expanded atlas of neuronal diversity, annotating several previously unidentified neuron classes. From this atlas, we found that the neuron composition of the developing and regenerating spinal cord differ. So do the strategies employed, which favor waves of cell-type specific neurite projection and guidance then proliferative neurogenesis during regeneration. Low levels of early neurogenesis are then compensated by movement of post-mitotic neurons. Our work highlights the contributions of distinct developmental versus regenerative paths to heal post-injury.
title_zh: 脊髓再生采用细胞类型特异性发育和非发育策略来恢复神经元多样性
abstract_zh: 脊髓损伤研究的一个主要目标是开发内源性再生的途径。这种方法深受自然再生动物模型的启发。一个未解决的问题是这些模型是否仅通过访问神经元分化的发育机制来重建脊髓。为了解决这个问题，我们将条件再生青蛙热带爪蟾再生过程中的单细胞基因表达与阶段匹配的对照进行了对比。我们生成了神经元多样性的扩展图集，注释了几个先前未识别的神经元类别。从该图谱中，我们发现发育中和再生中的脊髓的神经元组成不同。所采用的策略也是如此，这些策略有利于细胞类型特异性神经突投射和引导，然后在再生过程中促进增殖性神经发生。然后，早期神经发生的低水平通过有丝分裂后神经元的运动来补偿。我们的工作强调了不同的发育路径与再生路径对损伤后愈合的贡献。

title: Esterase-Responsive Self-Assembled Torkinib Prodrug Nanoparticles Alleviate Atherosclerosis via Macrophage mTOR Inhibition
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Atherosclerosis remains a major threat to human health due to unresolved plaque inflammation and macrophage dysfunction. Although stimuli-responsive nanocarriers (e.g., pH- or ROS-sensitive systems) have been exploited for targeted drug delivery, they suffer from modest signal gradients, spatial heterogeneity, or unpredictable release in atherosclerotic lesions. Herein, we report an esterase-responsive, carrier-free self-assembling prodrug nano-platform (LPNP) that exploits the unique pathological microenvironment of atherosclerotic plaques for targeted mTOR inhibition in lesional macrophages. The dual mTORC1/2 inhibitor Torkinib (PP242) was covalently conjugated to linoleic acid (LA) via a labile ester bond, enabling spontaneous nanoparticle formation without exogenous carriers. This ester bond remains stable during systemic circulation but is efficiently cleaved by intracellular esterases-highly active in macrophage-derived foam cells-enabling lesion-specific drug release. In vitro, LPNPs were readily internalized by macrophages, where they suppressed S6K phosphorylation, activated autophagy, reduced ROS levels, and upregulated ABCA1/ABCG1-mediated cholesterol efflux, thereby reducing lipid droplet accumulation and promoting M1-to-M2 repolarization. In an ApoE-/- mouse model, LPNP administration significantly reduced plaque burden, increased collagen deposition, and enhanced plaque stability without altering systemic lipid profiles or causing overt toxicity. Collectively, this esterase-responsive prodrug strategy couples carrier-free self-assembly with macrophage-associated intracellular activation, providing a promising approach to enhance lesional macrophage mTOR inhibition for atherosclerosis treatment.
title_zh: 酯酶响应自组装 Torkinib 前药纳米颗粒通过巨噬细胞 mTOR 抑制减轻动脉粥样硬化
abstract_zh: 由于未解决的斑块炎症和巨噬细胞功能障碍，动脉粥样硬化仍然是对人类健康的主要威胁。尽管刺激响应纳米载体（例如 pH 或 ROS 敏感系统）已被用于靶向药物输送，但它们在动脉粥样硬化病变中存在信号梯度适中、空间异质性或不可预测的释放等问题。在此，我们报道了一种酯酶响应、无载体自组装前药纳米平台（LPNP），该平台利用动脉粥样硬化斑块独特的病理微环境来靶向抑制病变巨噬细胞中的 mTOR。 mTORC1/2 双重抑制剂 Torkinib (PP242) 通过不稳定的酯键与亚油酸 (LA) 共价结合，无需外源载体即可自发形成纳米颗粒。这种酯键在体循环期间保持稳定，但可以被细胞内酯酶有效裂解（在巨噬细胞衍生的泡沫细胞中高度活跃），从而实现病变特异性药物释放。在体外，LPNP很容易被巨噬细胞内化，抑制S6K磷酸化，激活自噬，降低ROS水平，上调ABCA1/ABCG1介导的胆固醇流出，从而减少脂滴积累并促进M1到M2复极化。在 ApoE-/- 小鼠模型中，LPNP 给药可显着减少斑块负荷、增加胶原蛋白沉积并增强斑块稳定性，而不会改变全身脂质分布或引起明显的毒性。总的来说，这种酯酶响应性前药策略将无载体自组装与巨噬细胞关联结合起来

title: Ultrasmooth Sliding Contact Interfaces Driven by Vanadium in WS 2 –V/MAC Gel Hybrid Systems toward Enhanced Vacuum Lubrication
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Contact interfaces fundamentally govern the friction behavior and wear mechanisms of tribological systems through their inherent physical and chemical characteristics. This work presents an interfacial engineering strategy that constructs an ultrasmooth and adaptive sliding contact interface by synergistically combining vanadium-doped tungsten disulfide (WS2-V) films with a multialkylated cyclopentanes (MACs) gel. We demonstrate that vanadium doping acts not merely as a microstructural modifier but as a crucial driver for creating a chemically active and mechanically robust interface. Optimal V doping (∼10 at. %) transforms the WS2 film from a porous, columnar architecture into a dense nanocomposite, while simultaneously introducing V-S species that enhance interfacial compatibility. This V-modified WS2 surface exhibits exceptional adsorption and retention of the MACs oil molecules and gelator. Under vacuum conditions, this dynamic interface exhibits self-smoothing capabilities, effectively healing surface asperities and maintaining an ultralow shear plane with an areal arithmetic mean roughness (Sa) as low as 2.0 nm. The optimal hybrid system (WS2-10%V/MACs gel) achieves a stable friction coefficient of 0.051 and reduces the wear rate to 1.1 × 10-8 mm3/(N·m). This work establishes a dopant-mediated paradigm for actively engineering solid-gel contact interfaces, providing a foundational design principle for next-generation lubrication in space mechanisms.
title_zh: WS 2 –V/MAC 凝胶混合系统中由钒驱动的超光滑滑动接触界面可增强真空润滑
abstract_zh: 接触界面通过其固有的物理和化学特性从根本上控制摩擦系统的摩擦行为和磨损机制。这项工作提出了一种界面工程策略，通过将掺钒二硫化钨（WS2-V）薄膜与多烷基环戊烷（MAC）凝胶协同结合，构建超光滑和自适应滑动接触界面。我们证明，钒掺杂不仅可以作为微观结构改性剂，而且可以作为创建化学活性和机械鲁棒界面的关键驱动因素。最佳 V 掺杂 (∼10 at.%) 将 WS2 薄膜从多孔柱状结构转变为致密的纳米复合材料，同时引入 V-S 物质以增强界面相容性。这种 V 改性 WS2 表面对 MAC 油分子和胶凝剂具有出色的吸附和保留能力。在真空条件下，该动态界面表现出自平滑能力，有效修复表面粗糙度并保持超低剪切面，面积算术平均粗糙度 (Sa) 低至 2.0 nm。最佳混合系统（WS2-10%V/MACs凝胶）实现了0.051的稳定摩擦系数，并将磨损率降低至1.1×10-8 mm3/（N·m）。这项工作为主动设计固体凝胶接触界面建立了掺杂剂介导的范例，为空间机构中的下一代润滑提供了基础设计原理。

title: High Sensitivity and Wide Detection Range MXene/PDMS Flexible Piezoresistive Sensor with Microdome Array for Cervical Posture Recognition
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Flexible pressure sensors that simultaneously deliver high sensitivity and a broad detection range are highly desirable for wearable electronics but remain constrained by inherent trade-offs. Here, we present a high-performance flexible piezoresistive pressure sensor with microdome-structured MXene/PDMS composites. The sensing mechanism is elucidated through in-situ optical microscopy combined with finite element analysis, which directly visualizes the progressive evolution of the interfacial contact area during microdome deformation under compression. This progressive contact modulation effectively alleviates the sensitivity-range bottleneck. Consequently, the sensor achieves an exceptional sensitivity of 314 kPa-1 in the low-pressure regime while maintaining robust sensing performance across an extended working range (up to 390 kPa). Furthermore, it exhibits fast response and recovery times (31/34 ms) and superior long-term durability over 3000 loading-unloading cycles. This outstanding electromechanical performance enables comprehensive multiscale physiological monitoring, capable of capturing small pressure variations down to 1 kPa including respiratory patterns and arterial pulses, as well as high-load scenarios such as joint flexion and gait monitoring. Building upon these capabilities, a real-time cervical posture recognition system was implemented as a representative paradigm of intelligent health management. By integrating a logistic regression machine learning classifier, the system attained a classification accuracy of 98.5% on the test set. This work proposes a rational structural engineering strategy, providing a versatile and dependable sensing platform for next-generation intelligent health monitoring and human-machine interfaces.
title_zh: 高灵敏度、宽检测范围 MXene/PDMS 柔性压阻传感器，带微圆顶阵列，用于颈椎姿势识别
abstract_zh: 同时提供高灵敏度和宽检测范围的柔性压力传感器对于可穿戴电子产品来说是非常理想的，但仍然受到固有的权衡的限制。在这里，我们提出了一种采用微圆顶结构 MXene/PDMS 复合材料的高性能柔性压阻式压力传感器。通过原位光学显微镜结合有限元分析阐明了传感机制，直接可视化压缩下微圆顶变形过程中界面接触面积的逐渐演变。这种渐进式接触调制有效缓解了灵敏度范围瓶颈。因此，该传感器在低压状态下实现了 314 kPa-1 的卓越灵敏度，同时在扩展的工作范围（高达 390 kPa）内保持稳健的传感性能。此外，它还具有快速响应和恢复时间 (31/34 ms) 以及超过 3000 个加载-卸载循环的卓越长期耐用性。这种出色的机电性能可实现全面的多尺度生理监测，能够捕获低至 1 kPa 的微小压力变化，包括呼吸模式和动脉搏动，以及关节屈曲和步态监测等高负荷场景。基于这些功能，实时颈椎姿势识别系统被实现作为智能健康管理的代表性范例。通过集成逻辑回归机器学习分类器，系统在测试集上获得了 98.5% 的分类准确率。这项工作提出了一个

title: Bias-Tunable Plasmonic Ga 2 O 3 /GaN Photodetectors for Reconfigurable Logic, Encryption, and Ultraviolet Imaging
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Thermally oxidized Ga2O3/GaN heterojunctions offer a cost-effective route for ultraviolet (UV) detection. However, their application is often hindered by the high driving voltage required for effective near-UV (365 nm) response due to the transparency of the top wide-bandgap layer. Herein, a high-performance dual-band UV photodetector fabricated by decorating Ag nanoparticles (Ag NPs) onto an in situ thermally oxidized Ga2O3/GaN heterojunction is proposed. The Ag NPs, introduced via a solid-state dewetting process, induce a localized surface plasmon resonance (LSPR) effect that yields a dual-gain mechanism. Specifically, it enhances solar-blind (254 nm) responsivity through local field amplification and enables sensitive 365 nm detection at low bias via a hot-electron injection pathway. Leveraging this unique bias-tunable spectral response, reconfigurable optoelectronic logic gates (OR, NOR, and XNOR) are successfully constructed within a single device, overcoming the rigidity of traditional single-function logic units. Furthermore, a basic hardware-based optical encryption scheme based on XNOR logic and high-contrast single-pixel dual-color UV imaging are successfully realized. This work not only presents a strategy for low-power, high-performance UV detection but also paves the way for developing intelligent, secure, and in-sensor computing optoelectronic systems.
title_zh: 用于可重构逻辑、加密和紫外成像的偏置可调谐等离子 Ga 2 O 3 /GaN 光电探测器
abstract_zh: 热氧化 Ga2O3/GaN 异质结为紫外 (UV) 检测提供了一种经济有效的途径。然而，由于顶部宽带隙层的透明度，它们的应用常常受到有效近紫外（365 nm）响应所需的高驱动电压的阻碍。在此，提出了一种通过将银纳米粒子（Ag NPs）修饰到原位热氧化的Ga2O3/GaN异质结上而制造的高性能双波段紫外光电探测器。通过固态去湿过程引入的银纳米颗粒会引发局域表面等离子共振 (LSPR) 效应，从而产生双增益机制。具体来说，它通过局部场放大增强日盲 (254 nm) 响应度，并通过热电子注入路径在低偏置下实现灵敏的 365 nm 检测。利用这种独特的偏置可调光谱响应，可重构光电逻辑门（OR、NOR和XNOR）成功地在单个器件中构建，克服了传统单功能逻辑单元的刚性。此外，成功实现了基于XNOR逻辑和高对比度单像素双色紫外成像的基本硬件光学加密方案。这项工作不仅提出了低功耗、高性能紫外线检测的策略，而且为开发智能、安全和传感器内计算光电系统铺平了道路。

title: Dual-Band Photoelectric Memristor Based on Zinc Oxide and Vanadium Oxide with Non-Volatile Optoelectronic Behavior
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Integrating optical sensing and memory within a unitary semiconductor architecture is pivotal for circumventing the von Neumann bottleneck. Although conventional photonic memristors offer a promising solution, they are frequently constrained by a narrow spectral response and volatile memory. Herein, we report a ZnO/VO2 memristor that combines multi-wavelength sensing with non-volatile resistive switching dual functions. The bandgap difference between ZnO (3.2 eV) and VO2 (0.6 eV) endows the device with the ability to respond to ultraviolet (UV) and near-infrared (NIR) light. Ions in ZnO and VO2 can be regulated and redistributed by an electric field. Photogenerated carriers can reinforce charge accumulation, forming conductive filaments, and the increment of filaments can be partially retained after light excitation, forming non-volatile resistance. Under a 1 V bias and dual-band (365 nm UV/760 nm NIR, each 0.01 mW/cm2), the device achieves robust non-volatility (>2 h) and a switching ratio of ∼103, which is an order of magnitude superior to single-layer counterparts. This work offers a robust strategy for advancing the application of photoelectric memristors.
title_zh: 基于氧化锌和氧化钒的具有非易失性光电行为的双波段光电忆阻器
abstract_zh: 将光学传感和存储器集成在单一半导体架构中对于规避冯·诺依曼瓶颈至关重要。尽管传统的光子忆阻器提供了一种有前途的解决方案，但它们经常受到窄光谱响应和易失性存储器的限制。在此，我们报告了一种结合了多波长传感和非易失性电阻开关双重功能的 ZnO/VO2 忆阻器。 ZnO (3.2 eV) 和 VO2 (0.6 eV) 之间的带隙差异赋予该器件响应紫外 (UV) 和近红外 (NIR) 光的能力。 ZnO 和 VO2 中的离子可以通过电场调节和重新分布。光生载流子可以加强电荷积累，形成导电细丝，光激发后细丝的增量可以部分保留，形成非易失性电阻。在 1 V 偏置和双波段（365 nm UV/760 nm NIR，每个 0.01 mW/cm2）下，该器件实现了稳健的非易失性（>2 h）和 ~103 的开关比，比单层同类产品高出一个数量级。这项工作为推进光电忆阻器的应用提供了强有力的策略。

title: High-Strength, Tunable Thermoresponsive, Biocompatible, and Highly Sensitive Sensing Properties of Freeze-Thaw-Regulated Poly(acrylic acid)/Hydroxypropyl Cellulose Hydrogels
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: A physically crosslinked multifunctional hydrogel based on poly(acrylic acid)/hydroxypropyl cellulose/aluminum chloride (PAA/HPC/AlCl3) was developed for flexible sensing applications. The network, constructed solely through hydrogen bonds and Al3+ coordination bonds, exhibits stretchability, adhesiveness, and reversible thermochromism. Freeze-thaw cycling serves as a green physical strategy to regulate performance: after treatment, tensile strength increased from 0.11 to 3.60 MPa, hysteresis strain decreased from 35 to 9.5%, and dissipated energy rose from 7.839 to 53.699 MJ·m-3. Low-field NMR reveals that freeze-thaw promotes water redistribution and chain aggregation, strengthening non-covalent interactions without introducing chemical crosslinkers. By adjusting Al3+ content and freeze-thaw cycles, the upper critical solution temperature (UCST) can be synergistically tuned between 15 and 54 °C, enabling reversible thermochromism. Before freeze-thaw, the hydrogel exhibits excellent adhesion, high strain sensitivity (GF = 5.4, 3-500%), high temperature sensitivity (TCR = -0.019/°C, detection limit 0.1 °C), and electromechanical self-healing, allowing accurate detection from human motion to Morse code. Post freeze-thaw, hydrogels combine high strength with stable thermoresponsive properties. In vitro hemolysis and CCK-8 assays confirmed the hydrogel's hemocompatibility and cytocompatibility. A preliminary in vivo wound contact test on rats revealed only mild, fully reversible irritation with no persistent damage. This work achieves differentiated performance regulation in a single system through a simple and environmentally friendly processing method, offering a sustainable design approach for flexible sensors.
title_zh: 冻融调节聚丙烯酸/羟丙基纤维素水凝胶的高强度、可调热响应、生物相容性和高灵敏传感特性
abstract_zh: 开发了一种基于聚丙烯酸/羟丙基纤维素/氯化铝 (PAA/HPC/AlCl3) 的物理交联多功能水凝胶，用于灵活的传感应用。该网络仅通过氢键和Al3+配位键构建，具有拉伸性、粘合性和可逆热致变色性。冻融循环作为调节性能的绿色物理策略：处理后，拉伸强度从0.11增加到3.60 MPa，滞后应变从35%下降到9.5%，耗散能从7.839增加到53.699 MJ·m-3。低场核磁共振表明，冻融会促进水的重新分布和链聚集，从而在不引入化学交联剂的情况下加强非共价相互作用。通过调整 Al3+ 含量和冻融循环，可以在 15 至 54 °C 之间协同调节上临界溶液温度 (UCST)，从而实现可逆热致变色。冻融前，水凝胶表现出优异的粘附性、高应变灵敏度（GF = 5.4，3-500%）、高温灵敏度（TCR = -0.019/°C，检测限0.1°C）和机电自修复能力，可实现从人体运动到莫尔斯电码的精确检测。冻融后，水凝胶结合了高强度和稳定的热响应特性。体外溶血和 CCK-8 测定证实了水凝胶的血液相容性和细胞相容性。对大鼠进行的初步体内伤口接触测试显示，只有轻微的、完全可逆的刺激，没有持续性损伤。这项工作实现了差异化的绩效监管

title: Biomass Acid Synergistically Regulated Hydrogel Electrolyte and Electrode-Protective Layer for Dendrite-Free Zinc-Ion Hybrid Supercapacitors
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Zinc-ion hybrid supercapacitors hold great promise for energy storage due to economic viability, environmental friendliness, and safety. However, their application is restricted by issues such as Zn dendrites, corrosion, and hydrogen evolution. Herein, a biomass acid, malic acid (MA), was used as both a hydrogel electrolyte additive and an acid etchant. By simultaneously optimizing the electrolyte component and inducing the formation of an artificial solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) layer via etching the Zn anode, significantly enhancing the stability of the Zn anode. The MA-modified hydrogel electrolyte regulates Zn2+ solvation structure and reduces Zn2+ desolvation energy, increasing the Zn2+ transference number from 0.303 to 0.598. In addition, the MA-Zn artificial SEI layer isolates the Zn anode from water, minimizing parasitic reactions and homogenizing the electric field. Based on the dual-regulation mechanism, the lifespan of a Zn anode in the Zn//Zn symmetric cell is prolonged from 82 h to over 900 h at 10 mA cm-2. Besides, the assembled zinc-ion hybrid supercapacitor exhibits a homogeneous and smooth Zn deposition layer after 5000 cycles with a capacitance retention of 87.8%. Furthermore, because the MA-modified hydrogel electrolyte demonstrates excellent mechanical flexibility and strong adhesion to the electrodes, the supercapacitor could operate reliably under multiple mechanical stresses such as bending and compression. The coordinated regulation strategy provides a promising solution for enhancing the cycling stability of zinc energy storage devices.
title_zh: 用于无枝晶锌离子混合超级电容器的生物质酸协同调节水凝胶电解质和电极保护层
abstract_zh: 由于经济可行性、环境友好性和安全性，锌离子混合超级电容器在储能领域具有广阔的前景。然而，它们的应用受到锌枝晶、腐蚀和析氢等问题的限制。在此，生物质酸苹果酸（MA）被用作水凝胶电解质添加剂和酸蚀刻剂。通过同时优化电解质成分并通过蚀刻锌阳极诱导人工固体电解质中间相（SEI）层的形成，显着增强了锌阳极的稳定性。 MA修饰的水凝胶电解质调节Zn2+溶剂化结构并降低Zn2+去溶剂化能，将Zn2+迁移数从0.303增加到0.598。此外，MA-Zn 人造 SEI 层将锌阳极与水隔离，最大限度地减少寄生反应并使电场均匀化。基于双重调节机制，Zn//Zn对称电池中锌阳极的寿命在10 mA cm-2下从82小时延长至900小时以上。此外，组装的锌离子混合超级电容器在5000次循环后表现出均匀光滑的锌沉积层，电容保持率为87.8%。此外，由于MA改性水凝胶电解质表现出优异的机械柔韧性和对电极的强附着力，超级电容器可以在弯曲和压缩等多种机械应力下可靠运行。协调调节策略为增强锌储能装置的循环稳定性提供了一种有前途的解决方案。

title: Orally Delivered Nanotherapeutics with miRNA-497 Supplying for Inflammatory Bowel Disease
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: The excessive generation of reactive oxygen species (ROS) contributes to the inflammatory process in inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), and ROS-scavenging therapy, which can promote tissue repair, has emerged as a promising therapeutic strategy for managing IBD and other inflammatory diseases. Although ROS-scavenging therapy holds significant therapeutic potential for the management of IBD, systemic off-target effects remain a major limitation. Recent studies have identified microRNA-497 (miR-497) as a promising therapeutic target for IBD as it can polarize proinflammatory M1 macrophages to a tissue-repair phenotype, promoting the clearance of ROS and potentially alleviating the symptoms of IBD. Despite its therapeutic potential, the poor stability and limited cellular uptake of miR-497 pose significant barriers to its clinical use. To address these limitations, a delivery strategy based on manganese-doped metal-organic framework (Mn-MOF) nanoparticles labeled with miR-497 (Mn-MOF@miR-497) was developed to effectively inhibit the production of proinflammatory cytokines and restore immunological tolerance in enterocytes disrupted by proinflammatory stimuli. The topical administration of Mn-MOF@miR-497 exhibited significant therapeutic efficacy in a murine model of IBD induced by dextran sulfate sodium (DSS) without any observable toxicity. This innovative nanotherapeutic strategy demonstrates remarkable potential as a targeted treatment approach for IBD, holding promise for exploring innovative therapeutic regimens for IBD management.
title_zh: 含有 miRNA-497 的口服纳米疗法可治疗炎症性肠病
abstract_zh: 活性氧（ROS）的过度产生会导致炎症性肠病（IBD）的炎症过程，而ROS清除疗法可以促进组织修复，已成为治疗IBD和其他炎症性疾病的一种有前途的治疗策略。尽管ROS清除疗法对于IBD的治疗具有显着的治疗潜力，但全身性脱靶效应仍然是一个主要限制。最近的研究发现 microRNA-497 (miR-497) 是 IBD 有前景的治疗靶点，因为它可以将促炎性 M1 巨噬细胞极化为组织修复表型，促进 ROS 的清除，并有可能减轻 IBD 的症状。尽管具有治疗潜力，但 miR-497 的稳定性差和细胞摄取有限，对其临床应用构成了重大障碍。为了解决这些局限性，开发了一种基于标记有 miR-497 的锰掺杂金属有机框架 (Mn-MOF) 纳米粒子 (Mn-MOF@miR-497) 的递送策略，以有效抑制促炎细胞因子的产生并恢复被促炎刺激破坏的肠细胞的免疫耐受性。 Mn-MOF@miR-497 的局部给药在葡聚糖硫酸钠 (DSS) 诱导的 IBD 小鼠模型中表现出显着的治疗效果，且没有任何可观察到的毒性。这种创新的纳米治疗策略显示出作为 IBD 靶向治疗方法的巨大潜力，有望探索 IBD 管理的创新治疗方案。

title: Anisotropic Luminophore Emission for Enhanced Light Trapping in Luminescent Solar Concentrator Waveguides
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Control over the concentration of light is of great importance for many optical systems. Light-emitting diodes (LEDs), lasers, and optical amplifiers necessitate control over the emission of light inside and out of the system. Optical sensors, detectors, and photovoltaic systems typically benefit from light trapping. To achieve enhanced light trapping in an optical waveguide, we demonstrate anisotropic luminophore emission in a luminescent solar concentrator (LSC) waveguide geometry. By embedding CdSe-CdZnS nanoplatelet emitters into high-index TiO2 nanocylinders, we alter their angular emission profile to increase emission into total internal reflection (TIR) angles. The emission direction can be controlled by optimizing Mie-like multipolar resonances in the individual nanocylinders and the interaction with the lattice. Angle-resolved photoluminescence measurements on the fabricated nanocylinder arrays corroborate this understanding. By optimizing the cylinder shape and lattice spacing, we show an increase in emission into TIR angles from 75% (isotropic emission) to 83.5%. This novel approach to the integration of nanoscale photonic structures and emitters paves the way for enhanced emission control in photovoltaic systems, as well as in solid-state lighting and smart displays.
title_zh: 用于增强发光太阳能聚光器波导中的光捕获的各向异性发光体发射
abstract_zh: 控制光的集中度对于许多光学系统来说非常重要。发光二极管 (LED)、激光器和光学放大器需要对系统内部和外部的光发射进行控制。光学传感器、探测器和光伏系统通常受益于光捕获。为了在光波导中实现增强的光捕获，我们在发光太阳能聚光器（LSC）波导几何结构中演示了各向异性发光体发射。通过将 CdSe-CdZnS 纳米片发射器嵌入高折射率 TiO2 纳米圆柱体中，我们改变了它们的发射角轮廓，以增加全内反射 (TIR) 角的发射。可以通过优化各个纳米圆柱体中的类米氏多极共振以及与晶格的相互作用来控制发射方向。对所制造的纳米圆柱阵列进行的角度分辨光致发光测量证实了这一理解。通过优化圆柱体形状和晶格间距，我们发现 TIR 角的发射从 75%（各向同性发射）增加到 83.5%。这种集成纳米级光子结构和发射器的新颖方法为增强光伏系统以及固态照明和智能显示器中的排放控制铺平了道路。

title: Superior Hydrogenation Performance of Mg-Ni-Y Alloys at a Moderate Temperature with Lanthanum-Functionalized MXene-Derived Catalysts
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: The practical deployment of magnesium-based alloys, despite their attractive hydrogen-storage capacity and economical advantage, faces critical barriers in the form of high dehydrogenation temperatures and inadequate sorption kinetics. To overcome these barriers, a two-dimensional layered Lax@Ti3C2-derived catalyst was therefore developed, which exhibits high catalytic activity toward the Mg-4Ni-2Y alloy. The Mg-4Ni-2Y + 10 wt % La0.2@Ti3C2 composite not only lowered the onset absorption/desorption temperatures to 23.3 °C and 265.5 °C but also enabled the composite to achieve superior sorption kinetics, absorbing 4.80 wt % H2 in 1 min at 150 °C and releasing 5.16 wt % H2 in 4 min at 350 °C. Furthermore, the apparent activation energy (Ea) was substantially reduced to 85.22 ± 2.38 kJ/mol for the composite, thereby decreasing the dehydrogenation temperature and accelerating the kinetics. Systematic analysis suggests that the catalytic enhancement is primarily associated with highly dispersed Ti0 species, which are proposed to act as the primary active sites for hydrogen dissociation and recombination. La decoration is suggested to serve as an electronic promoter, modulating the electronic structure of Ti sites and stabilizing the interfacial environment. This synergistic Ti-La interaction facilitates hydrogen activation and interfacial transfer without altering the intrinsic Mg/MgH2 thermodynamics, thereby significantly accelerating hydrogen sorption kinetics.
title_zh: 使用镧功能化 MXene 衍生催化剂在中温下实现 Mg-Ni-Y 合金的优异加氢性能
abstract_zh: 尽管镁基合金具有有吸引力的储氢能力和经济优势，但其实际应用仍面临脱氢温度高和吸附动力学不足等关键障碍。为了克服这些障碍，开发了一种二维层状 Lax@Ti3C2 衍生催化剂，它对 Mg-4Ni-2Y 合金表现出高催化活性。 Mg-4Ni-2Y + 10 wt% La0.2@Ti3C2 复合材料不仅将起始吸收/解吸温度降低至 23.3 °C 和 265.5 °C，而且使复合材料能够实现优异的吸附动力学，在 150 °C 下 1 分钟内吸收 4.80 wt% H2，并在 350 °C 下 4 分钟内释放 5.16 wt% H2。 °C。此外，复合材料的表观活化能（Ea）大幅降低至85.22±2.38 kJ/mol，从而降低了脱氢温度并加速了动力学。系统分析表明，催化增强主要与高度分散的 TiO 物质有关，这些物质被认为是氢解离和重组的主要活性位点。 La装饰被认为作为电子促进剂，调节Ti位点的电子结构并稳定界面环境。这种协同的 Ti-La 相互作用促进氢活化和界面转移，而不改变固有的 Mg/MgH2 热力学，从而显着加速氢吸附动力学。

title: B-type host stars revealed by exoplanets around massive secondary-clump giant stars
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Exoplanets around massive young stars, including hot spectral-class B (B-type) stars, are rare but important for understanding how planets form and survive. Most known examples are either very distant companions found by direct imaging or extremely close-in planets found by transit surveys, leaving planets at intermediate orbital distances largely unexplored. Here, we show that this missing population can be revealed through evolved stars. Using space-based stellar oscillations and stellar-evolution models, we identify four known planet-hosting catalogue stars, HD 2952, HD 120084, HIP 65891, and HIP 67537 (Henry Draper and Hipparcos catalogue identifiers), as massive helium-burning giant stars. We reconstruct their birth properties and find that all four were originally B-type stars hosting giant planets at intermediate orbital distances. Orbital-evolution calculations show that the present systems can survive the expansion of their host stars after the main sequence. These systems uncover a hidden population of planets around B-type stars and extend tests of planet formation and survival into a previously inaccessible regime.
title_zh: 巨大次生团块巨星周围的系外行星揭示了 B 型主星
abstract_zh: 围绕大质量年轻恒星（包括热光谱级 B（B 型）恒星）的系外行星很少见，但对于了解行星如何形成和生存非常重要。大多数已知的例子要么是通过直接成像发现的非常遥远的伴星，要么是通过凌日巡天发现的非常接近的行星，而处于中等轨道距离的行星基本上未被探索过。在这里，我们表明可以通过演化的恒星来揭示这个缺失的种群。利用基于太空的恒星振荡和恒星演化模型，我们确定了四颗已知的行星目录恒星：HD 2952、HD 120084、HIP 65891 和 HIP 67537（亨利·德雷珀和依巴谷星表标识符），它们是大质量的氦燃烧巨星。我们重建了它们的诞生特性，发现这四颗恒星最初都是 B 型恒星，在中等轨道距离上拥有巨行星。轨道演化计算表明，当前的系统可以在主序带之后主星的膨胀中幸存下来。这些系统揭示了 B 型恒星周围隐藏的行星群，并将行星形成和生存的测试扩展到以前无法到达的区域。

title: Ultra-Low Thermal Conductivity in a GeTeC Nanocomposite Thin Film: Implications for Memory and Thermoelectric Applications
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Click to copy section link Section link copied! Achieving ultra-low thermal conductivity in phase-change materials is a key challenge for reducing power consumption in memory devices while preserving functional performance. Here, we report a crystalline GeTe–amorphous carbon nanocomposite thin film exhibiting an exceptionally low thermal conductivity, reduced by up to 80% at room temperature compared to pure GeTe. The thermal conductivity remains remarkably low and is weakly temperature-dependent, increasing only from 0.62(5) to 0.82(4) W m–1 K–1 between 300 and 660 K. This drastic suppression originates from the combined reduction of both phononic and electronic heat transport. Enhanced phonon scattering at GeTe/C interfaces, driven by strong elastic contrast, is complemented by reduced hole mobility due to scattering from Ge vacancies and amorphous carbon regions. Despite a degradation in the power factor, the ultra-low thermal conductivity compensates for this effect, resulting in a thermoelectric figure of merit only slightly lower than that of pure GeTe. The unique combination of suppressed thermal transport, high crystallization temperature, and preserved thermoelectric performance makes this nanocomposite a promising candidate for low-power phase-change memory (PCM) applications with reduced programming currents.
