title: Unraveling the Chemical and Enzymatic Logic of Cytokinin Biosynthesis and Inactivation in Fusarium
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: As a core family of hormone regulating plant growth and development, the biosynthesis and inactivation mechanisms of cytokinins (CKs) have been well studied in plants. However, these processes remain largely uncharacterized in other organisms, particularly fungal phytopathogens. Here, we identify a distinct pathway of CKs from Fusarium and unravel the chemical and enzymatic logic of biosynthesis and inactivation, which mainly includes: (1) the IPT-LOG fusion enzyme FexA catalyzes N6-dimethylallylation of AMP and cleavage of the C1″-N9 bond to form iP (1); (2) the CYP450 FexB not only hydroxylates 1 to generate the canonical plant-type CKs trans-zeatin (tZ, 2) and cis-zeatin (cZ, 3), but also sequentially catalyzes C4'-N6 cyclization to produce a pyrrole derivative (6); (3) the BBE-like oxidase FexC independently mediates oxidative cleavage of compounds 1-3 and unexpectedly converts 1 to C1'-keto-iP (16); (4) FexC and the NmrA-like SDR FexD cooperate to catalyze double bond isomerization, yielding two novel CKs (17 and 19), where FexD functions as a rare NADPH-dependent 1,4-reductase. Biological activity assays demonstrate that the noncanonical fungus-specific compounds 6, 17, and 19 represent new inactive CK forms for plants, whereas 16 exhibits unexpectedly high activity. Importantly, unlike plants, Fusarium employ double bond isomerization and pyrrole formation as novel strategies for CK inactivation. Our findings uncover unusual functions of fungal CK enzymes and reveal the molecular basis underlying CK biosynthesis and inactivation in plant pathogenic fungi, which provide new insights into the discovery and application of CK derivatives.

title: Causal inference framework for smart grids with application to demand response
source: ScienceDirect Publication: Applied Energy
abstract: Smart grids generate extensive data, yet much analysis remains association-based and cannot reliably inform decisions about the effects of interventions in planning and operations. Randomized trials provide strong causal evidence but are costly and limited in scope, predictive models cannot isolate intervention effects from confounding factors, and existing causal studies in smart grids each focus on a single aspect, such as market allocation, network evolution, or temporal dependencies, without covering the complete workflow from problem formulation to decision-making. This paper introduces a domain-specific causal inference framework for smart grids that integrates established causal modeling, identification, and validation techniques into a structured workflow tailored to energy-system analysis. The framework is organized into seven phases: causal problem framing, causal model construction, data collection and preparation, causal discovery, causal inference, refutation tests and validation, and intervention evaluation and recommendation. To support adaptation across settings, the paper categorizes common causal problems in smart grids into three types (confounder-intensive, temporally structured, and real-time decision problems) and shows how the framework maps to each, with the confounder-intensive case demonstrated in detail. The framework is demonstrated through a demand response case study assessing the causal impact of pricing schemes on household electricity consumption. Using real-world data, we apply three representative causal inference methods (Backdoor Adjustment, Difference in Differences, and Double Machine Learning), benchmarked against an association-based baseline. The results show that factors influential under association can become negligible or even reverse under causal estimation, while seemingly minor factors emerge as plausible levers for decision-making under the stated identification assumptions.

title: Inhibiting Iodide Oxidation and Regulating Crystallization Synergistically Enable Efficient and Stable Air-Processed CsPbI 2 Br Perovskite Solar Cells
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: The fabrication of perovskite solar cells under ambient conditions is more compatible with industrial production and commercial applications. Nevertheless, the iodide oxidation triggered by oxygen and uncontrolled perovskite crystallization pose major challenges to achieving satisfactory performance for the air-processed perovskite solar cell. Herein, we introduce pentaerythrityl tetrakis(3-mercaptopropionate) (PETMP) into the CsPbI2Br precursor solution to simultaneously inhibit the iodide oxidation and regulate perovskite crystallization for assembling high-performance CsPbI2Br perovskite solar cells in ambient air. The coordination interaction between PETMP and CsPbI2Br precursor stabilizes the precursor and slows perovskite crystallization. Moreover, the reductive -SH groups of PETMP convert the formed molecular iodine into iodide, effectively suppressing the iodide oxidation in the precursor solution and during the perovskite crystallization process. Upon PETMP addition, we fabricate a high-quality CsPbI2Br perovskite film with enlarged grains and decreased defect density in ambient air. Consequently, the air-processed CsPbI2Br perovskite solar cell without a hole-transport layer delivers an attractive efficiency of 15.20%, on a par with those of state-of-the-art counterparts assembled under a nitrogen atmosphere. In addition, the unencapsulated air-processed cell preserves 88.7% of its original efficiency after 1200 h of storage under ambient conditions.
title_zh: 抑制碘化物氧化和调节结晶协同实现高效稳定的空气处理 CsPbI 2 Br 钙钛矿太阳能电池
abstract_zh: 常温条件下制备钙钛矿太阳能电池更适合工业生产和商业应用。然而，由氧气引发的碘化物氧化和不受控制的钙钛矿结晶对空气处理钙钛矿太阳能电池实现令人满意的性能提出了重大挑战。在此，我们将季戊四醇四（3-巯基丙酸酯）（PETMP）引入到CsPbI2Br前驱体溶液中，同时抑制碘化物氧化并调节钙钛矿结晶，从而在环境空气中组装高性能CsPbI2Br钙钛矿太阳能电池。 PETMP 和 CsPbI2Br 前驱体之间的配位相互作用稳定了前驱体并减缓了钙钛矿结晶。此外，PETMP的还原性-SH基团将形成的分子碘转化为碘化物，有效抑制前驱体溶液中和钙钛矿结晶过程中碘化物的氧化。添加 PETMP 后，我们制备了高质量的 CsPbI2Br 钙钛矿薄膜，该薄膜在环境空气中具有增大的晶粒和降低的缺陷密度。因此，没有空穴传输层的空气处理 CsPbI2Br 钙钛矿太阳能电池具有 15.20% 的诱人效率，与在氮气气氛下组装的最先进的同类产品相当。此外，未封装的空气处理电池在环境条件下储存 1200 小时后仍保持其原始效率的 88.7%。

title: MXene-Modified Forward Osmosis Membrane with Enhanced Water Flux and PFAS Rejection from Landfill Leachate
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Forward osmosis (FO) is a promising membrane technology for removing emerging contaminants in water, whereas its applications remain limited by low water flux, internal concentration polarization (ICP), and fouling. To address these issues, in this study, thin-film composite (TFC) membranes were fabricated by incorporating MXene nanosheets, a two-dimensional transition metal carbide, into the polyethersulfone (PES) support layer, followed by interfacial polymerization to form a polyamide active layer. The membranes were characterized using FTIR, FESEM, EDX mapping, AFM, zeta potential analysis, and water contact angle measurements to evaluate their chemical structure, surface morphology, MXene distribution, surface roughness, surface charge, and hydrophilicity. MXene addition (0.25-2 wt %) increased porosity, pore size, and hydrophilicity of the support layer, while excessive loading (4 wt %) resulted in pore blockage and compromised support-layer properties. The optimized TFC membrane (TFC-MX2, 2 wt %) achieved a water flux of 27.4 L·m-2·h-1, 201.1% higher than that of the unmodified membrane (TFC-Pristine), while maintaining a low reverse salt flux of ∼3.14 g·m-2·h-1 in normal FO mode. The structural parameter decreased by 72.5%, suggesting reduced ICP effects and improved support-layer transport characteristics. The TFC-MX2 membrane achieved 97.8 and 96.6% average rejection of perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), as model micropollutants, in synthetic PFAS solutions and landfill leachate, respectively, while exhibiting reduced fouling propensity compared with TFC-Pristine. Overall, the findings demonstrate that MXene-modified FO membranes represent a promising approach for enhancing PFAS rejection in FO applications.

title: A photogenerated triplet aura-nitrene for gold-mediated nitrene transfer
source: Nature Chemistry
abstract:
Abstract
                  
                    The isolation and characterization of metal-stabilized, low-valent nitrogen species remain central challenges in advancing nitrogen-atom transfer chemistry. Although gold has emerged as a powerful catalyst in C–N bond formation, proposed mechanisms have consistently bypassed gold nitrenes as key intermediates—leaving their chemistry largely uncharted. Here we report the characterization of a bona fide aura-nitrene, formed via photochemical N

                    2

title: A Carrier-Free Peptide Nanomedicine Orchestrates Dual Redox Therapy via Ferroptosis and Disulfidptosis
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Carrier-free nanomedicines offer a promising strategy to simplify formulation while maximizing therapeutic function. Here, we report a disulfide-containing self-assembling peptide, Fmoc-Cys(StBu)-Phe-Phe-Tyr-Lys-Cys(StBu) (Fmoc-S-S), as a minimalist nanomedicine for dual redox cancer therapy. Fmoc-S-S spontaneously formed uniform spherical nanoparticles with favorable hemocompatibility, glutathione-responsive structural transformation, and enhanced tumor accumulation in vivo. Mechanistically, Fmoc-S-S disrupted intracellular redox homeostasis by depleting glutathione, altering the NADP+/NADPH balance, suppressing SLC7A11 and GPX4, promoting lipid peroxidation, and reducing mitochondrial membrane potential, consistent with ferroptosis induction. Meanwhile, biochemical evidence of intracellular disulfide stress, including decreased cysteine levels, together with partial rescue by dithiothreitol and marked F-actin disruption, supported the involvement of disulfidptosis. In MC38 tumor-bearing mice, Fmoc-S-S nanoparticles significantly inhibited tumor growth without obvious systemic toxicity. Proteomic analysis further revealed coordinated dysregulation of pathways associated with glutathione metabolism, mitochondrial function, oxidative phosphorylation, and cytoskeletal organization. Together, this work presents a self-assembled peptide biomaterial that integrates nanostructure formation, tumor delivery, and dual induction of ferroptosis and disulfidptosis within a single carrier-free system, providing a new strategy for redox-directed cancer therapy.
title_zh: 无载体肽纳米药物通过铁死亡和二硫死亡协调双重氧化还原疗法
abstract_zh: 无载体纳米药物提供了一种有前途的策略，可以简化配方，同时最大化治疗功能。在这里，我们报道了一种含二硫键的自组装肽，Fmoc-Cys(StBu)-Phe-Phe-Tyr-Lys-Cys(StBu) (Fmoc-S-S)，作为双重氧化还原癌症治疗的极简纳米药物。 Fmoc-S-S 自发形成均匀的球形纳米粒子，具有良好的血液相容性、谷胱甘肽响应性结构转变和增强体内肿瘤积累。从机制上讲，Fmoc-S-S 通过消耗谷胱甘肽、改变 NADP+/NADPH 平衡、抑制 SLC7A11 和 GPX4、促进脂质过氧化和降低线粒体膜电位来破坏细胞内氧化还原稳态，与铁死亡诱导一致。同时，细胞内二硫键应激的生化证据，包括半胱氨酸水平降低，以及二硫苏糖醇的部分拯救和显着的F-肌动蛋白破坏，支持二硫键下垂的参与。在MC38荷瘤小鼠中，Fmoc-S-S纳米颗粒显着抑制肿瘤生长，且没有明显的全身毒性。蛋白质组学分析进一步揭示了与谷胱甘肽代谢、线粒体功能、氧化磷酸化和细胞骨架组织相关途径的协调失调。总之，这项工作提出了一种自组装肽生物材料，该材料将纳米结构形成、肿瘤递送以及铁死亡和二硫下垂的双重诱导集成在单个无载体系统中，为氧化还原导向的癌症治疗提供了新策略。

title: Spin-Vibronic Coupling in Indenoindenodibenzothiophene Diradicaloids
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Click to copy section link Section link copied! Understanding how molecular structure governs photoinduced spin evolution in organic diradicals is essential for the rational design of spin-responsive molecular materials. Here, we investigate temperature-dependent excited-state relaxation dynamics of syn - and anti -indenoindenodibenzothiophene ( IIDBT ) diradicaloids using variable-temperature steady-state and transient absorption spectroscopies. Vibronic progressions in the high-energy, nonfrontier-orbital π–π transition absorptions and low-energy frontier-orbital transition absorptions prompt strong couplings between electronic excitation, on one hand, and molecular vibrations, on the other hand. With the help of ultrafast spectroscopy, we identified multistep excited-state relaxation pathways including a “hot” singlet excited state, an intermediate state of mixed electronic and spin character, and a long-lived triplet excited state, following either low- or high-energy excitations. Notably, intersystem crossing (ISC) in IIDBT diradicaloids is enabled by vibrationally activated spin–orbit coupling, in which spin-vibronic coupling enhances singlet–triplet mixing along nuclear coordinates, leading to a fast and efficient interconversion between singlet and triplet excited states. Molecular control over both the vibronic coupling strength and spin evolution is also emphasized. This work establishes a clear experimental link between molecular vibration and spin-dependent excited-state dynamics in organic diradicals, providing a general framework for understanding and controlling ISC in open-shell organic systems. abstract_zh: 单击复制部分链接 部分链接已复制！了解分子结构如何控制有机双自由基中的光诱导自旋演化对于自旋响应分子材料的合理设计至关重要。在这里，我们使用变温稳态和瞬态吸收光谱研究了顺式和反式茚并二苯并噻吩 ( IIDBT ) 双自由基的温度依赖性激发态弛豫动力学。高能非前沿轨道 π-π 跃迁吸收和低能前沿轨道跃迁吸收中的电子振动级数一方面促使电子激发与分子振动之​​间的强耦合。在超快光谱的帮助下，我们确定了多步激发态弛豫途径，包括低能或高能激发后的“热”单重激发态、混合电子和自旋特征的中间态以及长寿命的三重激发态。值得注意的是，IIDBT双基类中的系间跨越（ISC）是通过振动激活的自旋轨道耦合实现的，其中自旋振动耦合增强了沿核坐标的单重态-三重态混合，从而导致单重态和三重态激发态之间快速有效的相互转换。还强调了对电子振动耦合强度和自旋演化的分子控制。这项工作在有机双自由基中的分子振动和自旋依赖性激发态动力学之间建立了清晰的实验联系，为理解和控制提供了一个通用框架。

title: Bioorthogonal Regulation of Negatively Charged Protein Side Chains in Living Systems
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Negatively charged amino acid side chains are essential determinants of protein structure and function, yet their precise temporal regulation in living systems remains challenging. Although coupling the genetic code expansion strategy with bioorthogonal decaging reaction has enabled conditional control over various residues, the regulation of negatively charged aspartic acid and glutamic acid side chains has primarily relied on light-triggered photodecaging, while complementary chemical-decaging methods remain limited for applications involving limited light penetration or concerns regarding potential photodamage. Here, we developed para-azidobenzyl aspartate (PABD) through the combination of computationally guided molecular design and directed evolution, establishing a small molecule-triggered, bioorthogonal approach for site-specific regulation of negative charges across diverse biological contexts. PABD-mediated decaging provides efficient and traceless restoration of native aspartate side chains under physiological conditions at molecular, cellular, and organismal levels. Using this strategy, we demonstrate chemical regulation of Cas9-mediated genome editing and ALKBH1-dependent RNA epigenetic modification in mammalian cells, and even the controlled activation of an enzyme in live animals. This work provides a generalizable bioorthogonal platform for manipulating negatively charged protein side chains, offering a versatile chemical tool for gain-of-function studies in complex biological environments.
title_zh: 生命系统中带负电的蛋白质侧链的生物正交调节
abstract_zh: 带负电的氨基酸侧链是蛋白质结构和功能的重要决定因素，但它们在生命系统中的精确时间调节仍然具有挑战性。尽管将遗传密码扩展策略与生物正交脱腐反应相结合已经能够对各种残基进行条件控制，但带负电的天冬氨酸和谷氨酸侧链的调节主要依赖于光触发的光脱腐，而补充化学脱腐方法对于涉及有限光穿透或潜在光损伤问题的应用仍然有限。在这里，我们通过计算引导的分子设计和定向进化的结合开发了对叠氮基天冬氨酸酯（PABD），建立了一种小分子触发的生物正交方法，用于跨不同生物环境的负电荷的位点特异性调节。 PABD 介导的解降解可在生理条件下在分子、细胞和生物体水平上有效且无痕地恢复天然天冬氨酸侧链。利用这种策略，我们证明了哺乳动物细胞中 Cas9 介导的基因组编辑和 ALKBH1 依赖性 RNA 表观遗传修饰的化学调节，甚至是活体动物中酶的受控激活。这项工作提供了一个可推广的生物正交平台，用于操纵带负电的蛋白质侧链，为复杂生物环境中的功能获得研究提供了多功能化学工具。

title: Coupling High-Throughput Density Functional Theory, Automated Experimentation, and Adaptive Experimental Design To Achieve Selective Rare-Earth Element Separations
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Developing new separation technologies for rare-earth elements is essential for sustaining the critical materials supply chain. Toward this end, we developed a pH-controlled solvent extraction strategy employing an aqueous-phase holdback agent to enable selective lanthanide separations, using an integrated computational, machine learning, and automated experimental high-throughput workflow. Database screening, density functional theory (DFT) calculations, and initial experimental evaluation identified oxaloacetic acid as a promising holdback agent that enhanced selective extraction of four lanthanides (Nd, Eu, Dy, Ho) when paired with the di(2-ethylhexyl)phosphoric acid (HDEHP or D2EHPA) extractant. Within this framework, the dependence of lanthanide solvent extraction was determined across a multidimensional chemical matrix (pH, extractant concentration, holdback agent concentration, and salt concentration) using automated, high-throughput experiments coupled with multi-objective Bayesian Optimization. Through efficient exploration of a large experimental space, we discovered Eu, Dy, and Ho could be selectively extracted over Nd in acidic media at pH ∼2.0, while a modest decrease in pH to ∼0.5 shifted the selectivity to enable Eu separation from Dy and Ho. The use of multi-objective Bayesian Optimization quickly yielded a 4-fold increase in separation factors compared to our HDEHP-only system, eliminating the need for a complete grid-based, exhaustive sampling approach. Overall, this work establishes a hierarchical and data-driven framework to identify selective separation conditions and provides a foundation for accelerating separations discovery and design.
title_zh: 耦合高通量密度泛函理论、自动化实验和自适应实验设计，实现稀土元素的选择性分离
abstract_zh: 开发新的稀土元素分离技术对于维持关键材料供应链至关重要。为此，我们开发了一种 pH 控制的溶剂萃取策略，采用水相阻滞剂，通过集成计算、机器学习和自动化实验高通量工作流程实现选择性镧系元素分离。数据库筛选、密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算和初步实验评估确定草酰乙酸是一种有前景的阻滞剂，与二（2-乙基己基）磷酸（HDEHP 或 D2EHPA）萃取剂配合使用时，可增强四种镧系元素（Nd、Eu、Dy、Ho）的选择性萃取。在此框架内，使用自动化、高通量实验与多目标贝叶斯优化相结合，确定了跨多维化学基质（pH、萃取剂浓度、阻滞剂浓度和盐浓度）的镧系元素溶剂萃取的依赖性。通过对大型实验空间的有效探索，我们发现在 pH ～ 2.0 的酸性介质中，Eu、Dy 和 Ho 可以比 Nd 被选择性萃取，而 pH 值适度降低至 ～ 0.5 会改变选择性，从而使 Eu 与 Dy 和 Ho 分离。与我们仅使用 HDEHP 的系统相比，使用多目标贝叶斯优化很快就能将分离因子提高 4 倍，从而无需采用完整的基于网格的详尽采样方法。总的来说，这项工作建立了一个分层和数据驱动的框架来识别选择性分离

title: Site-Selective Trimodular Polymerization to Amino Acid-Based Poly(ether amide)s with Divergent Properties
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Amido groups are ubiquitous in natural and synthetic polymers and impart critical physiological and physicochemical properties. Conventional access to backbone-amido polymers, polyamides, generally relies on harsh conditions or highly reactive monomers to form amide bonds during polymerization. Here, we report a mild and atom-economic pathway to poly(ether amide)s (PEAs) through the linear step polymerization of diepoxides and amide-bearing primary diols formed in situ by amino alcohols, mostly derived from natural amino acids, and a reactive solvent, γ-butyrolactone. The unique chemoselectivity of the Lewis pair (organo)catalyst enables preferential activation of primary hydroxyl groups toward epoxy ring opening in this multiprotonic system containing secondary/tertiary hydroxyl and amido groups. The trimodular synthesis and abundant starting materials can be well-utilized for structural diversification and property refinement of PEAs, as showcased by their high interfacial performance in two divergent directions: (1) broad-spectrum protein resistance for the more hydrophilic ones, and (2) robust adhesion on various substrates even after 10 reuse cycles or at liquid nitrogen temperature, for the more hydrophobic ones.
title_zh: 具有不同性能的氨基酸基聚醚酰胺的位点选择性三模聚合
abstract_zh: 酰胺基团普遍存在于天然和合成聚合物中，并赋予重要的生理和物理化学性质。传统的主链酰胺聚合物（聚酰胺）通常依赖于恶劣的条件或高反应性单体在聚合过程中形成酰胺键。在这里，我们报告了一种温和且原子经济的聚（醚酰胺）（PEA）途径，通过由氨基醇（主要衍生自天然氨基酸）和反应性溶剂γ-丁内酯原位形成的二环氧化合物和带有酰胺的伯二醇的线性步骤聚合。路易斯对（有机）催化剂独特的化学选择性使得伯羟基能够在含有仲/叔羟基和酰胺基的多质子系统中优先活化伯羟基以实现环氧环开环。三模块合成和丰富的起始材料可以很好地用于PEA的结构多样化和性能细化，正如它们在两个不同方向上的高界面性能所展示的那样：（1）对于较亲水的PEA具有广谱蛋白质耐受性，以及（2）对于较疏水的PEA，即使经过10次重复使用循环或在液氮温度下，在各种基材上仍具有牢固的粘附力。

title: Light-Driven Deaminative Formal Nucleophilic Substitution Via C(sp 3 )–N Bond Cleavage: Nucleophilic Transamination of Alkyl Amines
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Herein, we report a photoredox-enabled catalytic transamination strategy that enables direct amine-to-amine interconversion without prefunctionalization. The reaction proceeds via a polarity inversion pathway, in which one amine is converted into an electrophilic iminium intermediate that couples with a second amine nucleophile. The method exhibits broad scope across benzylic, unactivated, and tertiary amines. Mechanistic studies support the intermediacy of iminium species and reveal that selectivity is governed by two key principles: reaction directionality is controlled by relative nucleophilicity, while site selectivity in C(sp3)-N bond cleavage is dictated by electronic activation or steric accessibility. This work establishes a direct catalytic transamination strategy for native amines, with potential applications in the late-stage modification of complex and bioactive molecules.
title_zh: 通过 C(sp 3 )–N 键断裂的光驱动脱氨正式亲核取代：烷基胺的亲核转氨基作用
abstract_zh: 在此，我们报告了一种光氧化还原催化氨基转移策略，该策略能够实现胺与胺的直接互变，而无需预功能化。该反应通过极性反转途径进行，其中一种胺转化为与第二种胺亲核试剂偶联的亲电亚胺中间体。该方法适用于苄胺、未活化胺和叔胺。机理研究支持亚胺物种的中介作用，并揭示选择性受两个关键原则控制：反应方向性由相对亲核性控制，而 C(sp3)-N 键断裂的位点选择性由电子活化或空间可达性决定。这项工作建立了天然胺的直接催化转氨基策略，在复杂和生物活性分子的后期修饰中具有潜在的应用。

title: Designing Triazine-Based Aminal-Linked Porous Organic Polymers for Efficient CO 2 Capture and Conversion
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: The steady rise in atmospheric CO2 levels has led to a serious environmental threat in the form of global warming and climate change. Therefore, the development of efficient porous nanomaterials as adsorbent and catalyst that simultaneously capture CO2 and catalytically convert it into value-added chemicals is a very challenging area of research today. Herein, we report the synthesis of three nitrogen-rich, aminal-linked porous organic polymers (POPs), namely, TBAL-POP-3, TBAL-POP-4, and TBAL-POP-5, constructed via extended Schiff-base condensation reaction under solvothermal conditions. Among the three polymers, TBAL-POP-5 exhibits the highest specific surface area (1053 m2 g-1), highest fraction of hierarchical mesopores (84%), and high CO2 uptake capacity of 1.92 mmol g-1 at 273 K and 1 bar and good CO2/N2 selectivity 43.82/32.03 at 273/298 K. The enhanced gas adsorption performance of TBAL-POP-5 is attributed to its mesopore-enriched hierarchical structure, which facilitates efficient mass transfer and active site accessibility. Furthermore, these materials demonstrated good catalytic activity toward the formylation of amines using CO2 as a sustainable C1 source in the presence of dimethylamine borane as a green reducing agent. This work highlights the dual functionality of nitrogen-rich porous polymers as multifunctional platforms for integrated CO2 capture and its reductive valorization.
title_zh: 设计基于三嗪的缩醛胺连接多孔有机聚合物以实现高效 CO 2 捕获和转化
abstract_zh: 大气中二氧化碳含量的稳步上升导致了全球变暖和气候变化等严重的环境威胁。因此，开发高效的多孔纳米材料作为吸附剂和催化剂，同时捕获二氧化碳并将其催化转化为增值化学品是当今一个非常具有挑战性的研究领域。在此，我们报告了三种富氮、缩醛胺连接的多孔有机聚合物（POP）的合成，即TBAL-POP-3、TBAL-POP-4和TBAL-POP-5，它们是通过在溶剂热条件下扩展席夫碱缩合反应构建的。在这三种聚合物中，TBAL-POP-5表现出最高的比表面积（1053 m2 g-1）、最高的分级介孔分数（84%），以及在273 K和1 bar下1.92 mmol g-1的高CO2吸收容量以及在273/298 K下良好的CO2/N2选择性43.82/32.03。 TBAL-POP-5 归因于其富含介孔的分级结构，有利于有效的传质和活性位点的可及性。此外，这些材料在二甲胺硼烷作为绿色还原剂的存在下，使用 CO2 作为可持续的 C1 源，对胺的甲酰化表现出良好的催化活性。这项工作强调了富氮多孔聚合物作为集成二氧化碳捕获及其还原增值的多功能平台的双重功能。

title: Synergistic Active Sites in a Defect-Engineered FeMoO 4 /CeS 2 Diphase for Highly Efficient Ambient Electrocatalytic Ammonia Synthesis
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: The development of efficient electrocatalysts for the ambient nitrogen reduction reaction (NRR) remains challenging due to sluggish N2 activation and the competing hydrogen evolution reaction (HER). Here, we report a defect-engineered FeMoO4/CeS2 diphase grown directly on nickel foam (NF) for efficient electrochemical ammonia synthesis under ambient conditions. Systematic tuning of the Fe/Mo/Ce molar ratio establishes a clear composition-activity relationship, with the optimized FeMoCe (2:4:1) (2-FeMoCe) catalyst delivering an NH3 yield rate of 5124 μg cm-2 h-1 (1139 μg mgcat-1 h-1) and a Faradaic efficiency (FE) of 46% at -0.70 V vs RHE in neutral 0.5 M Na2SO4. In a membrane-separated single stack-cell configuration, the catalyst maintains strong performance, achieving 2451 μg cm-2 h-1 (613 μg mgcat-1 h-1) with an FE of 35.01%, highlighting its practical relevance. Comprehensive structural and electronic analyses reveal a defect-rich oxide-sulfide diphase featuring abundant oxygen vacancies (VO2+), mixed-valence Fe2+/Fe3+ and Ce3+/Ce4+ species, and enhanced interfacial electronic coupling. Spectroscopic and electrochemical results confirm defect enrichment upon Fe incorporation, accompanied by increased electrochemically active surface area and lower charge-transfer resistance (Rct). In situ vibrational analysis identifies surface-bound -NHx intermediates, consistent with the sequential hydrogenation of adsorbed nitrogen species toward NH3 formation. The superior NRR performance is attributed to synergistic interfacial active sites that promote defect-mediated N2 activation, facilitate charge redistribution, and suppress HER. This work demonstrates that rational defects and diphase engineering are an effective strategy for advancing sustainable ammonia electrosynthesis.
title_zh: 缺陷工程 FeMoO 4 /CeS 2 双相中的协同活性位点用于高效常温电催化氨合成
abstract_zh: 由于氮气活化缓慢和竞争性析氢反应（HER），开发用于环境氮还原反应（NRR）的高效电催化剂仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们报告了直接在泡沫镍（NF）上生长的缺陷工程 FeMoO4/CeS2 双相，用于在环境条件下高效电化学氨合成。 Fe/Mo/Ce 摩尔比的系统调节建立了清晰的成分-活性关系，优化的 FeMoCe (2:4:1) (2-FeMoCe) 催化剂可提供 5124 μg cm-2 h-1 (1139 μg mgcat-1 h-1) 的 NH3 产率，-0.70 V 时的法拉第效率 (FE) 为 46%（相对于中性 0.5 M 的 RHE）硫酸钠。在膜分离的单堆电池配置中，催化剂保持了强大的性能，达到 2451 μg cm-2 h-1 (613 μg mgcat-1 h-1)，FE 为 35.01%，突出了其实际相关性。全面的结构和电子分析揭示了一种富含缺陷的氧化物-硫化物双相，具有丰富的氧空位 (VO2+)、混合价 Fe2+/Fe3+ 和 Ce3+/Ce4+ 物质以及增强的界面电子耦合。光谱和电化学结果证实了 Fe 掺入后缺陷富集，伴随着电化学活性表面积的增加和电荷转移电阻 (Rct) 的降低。原位振动分析识别了表面结合的 -NHx 中间体，与吸附的氮物质向 NH3 形成的顺序氢化一致。卓越的 NRR 性能归因于协同界面活性位点，可促进缺陷介导的 N2 激活

title: Multifunctional Nb 2 C MXene-Enhanced 3D Porous Si 3 N 4 Scaffolds for Bone Regeneration and Photothermal Tumor Therapy
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Bone tumor treatment often involves surgical resection, which can lead to critical bone defects requiring structural implants for functional and aesthetic restoration. However, the development of scaffolds capable of accurately eliminating residual tumor cells while simultaneously driving bone defect reconstruction remains a significant clinical challenge. To address this dual need, we engineered a biomimetic, multifunctional porous silicon nitride (Si3N4) scaffold integrated with ultrathin niobium carbide (Nb2C) MXene nanosheets. Specifically, this Nb2C MXene-coated porous Si3N4 scaffold (MPSNS) was created by attaching Nb2C MXene nanosheets onto three dimensional (3D)-printed Si3N4 scaffolds, thereby altering its surface physicochemical properties, improving its biological interactions, and enabling targeted tumor ablation. This scaffold exhibits a highly stable, hydrophilic bio-interface that confers excellent biocompatibility and superior osteoinductive activity. Furthermore, the photothermal conversion properties of the Nb2C MXene nanocoating enable targeted tumor ablation and suppression while concurrently promoting bone defect repair. Collectively, this comprehensive study highlights the transformative potential of integrating Nb2C MXene nanosheets with 3D-printed Si3N4 ceramics. By exhibiting superior mechanical integrity, biocompatibility, osteogenic performance, and photothermal tumoricidal efficacy, the MPSNS establishes a promising advanced biomaterial platform for regenerative medicine.
title_zh: 用于骨再生和光热肿瘤治疗的多功能 Nb 2 C MXene 增强型 3D 多孔 Si 3 N 4 支架
abstract_zh: 骨肿瘤治疗通常涉及手术切除，这可能导致严重的骨缺损，需要结构性植入物来恢复功能和美观。然而，开发能够准确消除残留肿瘤细胞同时驱动骨缺损重建的支架仍然是一个重大的临床挑战。为了满足这一双重需求，我们设计了一种仿生多功能多孔氮化硅 (Si3N4) 支架，与超薄碳化铌 (Nb2C) MXene 纳米片集成。具体来说，这种 Nb2C MXene 涂层多孔 Si3N4 支架 (MPSNS) 是通过将 Nb2C MXene 纳米片附着到三维 (3D) 打印的 Si3N4 支架上而创建的，从而改变其表面理化性质，改善其生物相互作用，并实现靶向肿瘤消融。该支架具有高度稳定的亲水性生物界面，具有优异的生物相容性和卓越的骨诱导活性。此外，Nb2C MXene 纳米涂层的光热转换特性能够实现靶向肿瘤消融和抑制，同时促进骨缺损修复。总的来说，这项综合研究凸显了将 Nb2C MXene 纳米片与 3D 打印 Si3N4 陶瓷相结合的变革潜力。通过表现出卓越的机械完整性、生物相容性、成骨性能和光热杀肿瘤功效，MPSNS 为再生医学建立了一个有前景的先进生物材料平台。

title: Ion-Modulated Ostwald Ripening Dynamics of Nitrogen Nanobubble Pairs
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Understanding the stability of bulk nanobubbles, especially how electrolyte ions influence their coarsening dynamics, holds significant importance for widespread practical applications, but the fundamental microscopic mechanisms remain not fully understood and warrant further investigation. In this work, using machine-learning molecular dynamics simulations, we captured the Ostwald ripening of bulk nanobubbles, which is consistent with experimental observations, and systematically investigated its behavior under neutral, acidic, alkaline, and saline conditions. Notably, the ripening rates exhibit a system-dependent order: acidic > alkaline ≈ pure water > saline. Further analyses reveal that counterions critically regulate the orientational alignment and hydrogen bonding of interfacial water molecules and ions through hydration and electrostatic effects. Furthermore, in the saline system, the coupling of Na+ and Cl- ions leads to the enrichment of "lying-flat" ion pairs near the interface, forming a dense hydration layer. Based on how these interfacial structural alterations regulate gas diffusion to impact the bubble ripening rate, we established an ion-modulated microscopic mechanism grounded in the relative dominance of enthalpy and entropy. This framework, which incorporates specific-ion effects, provides a self-consistent explanation for the divergent ripening rates observed across various environments. Ultimately, these findings bridge atomistic interfacial restructuring with thermodynamic principles, providing a comprehensive physicochemical landscape for understanding ion-modulated nanobubble coarsening dynamics.
title_zh: 氮纳米气泡对的离子调制奥斯特瓦尔德成熟动力学
abstract_zh: 了解块状纳米气泡的稳定性，特别是电解质离子如何影响其粗化动力学，对于广泛的实际应用具有重要意义，但基本的微观机制仍未完全理解，需要进一步研究。在这项工作中，我们利用机器学习分子动力学模拟，捕获了块状纳米气泡的奥斯特瓦尔德熟化，这与实验观察结果一致，并系统地研究了其在中性、酸性、碱性和盐水条件下的行为。值得注意的是，成熟率呈现出依赖于系统的顺序：酸性>碱性≈纯水>盐水。进一步的分析表明，反离子通过水合和静电效应关键地调节界面水分子和离子的取向排列和氢键。此外，在盐水体系中，Na+和Cl-离子的耦合导致界面附近“平躺”离子对的富集，形成致密的水化层。基于这些界面结构变化如何调节气体扩散以影响气泡成熟速率，我们建立了一种基于焓和熵的相对主导地位的离子调制微观机制。该框架结合了特定离子效应，为在不同环境中观察到的不同成熟率提供了自洽的解释。最终，这些发现将原子界面重组与热力学原理联系起来，为理解原子界面重组提供了全面的物理化学景观。

title: Proton trap engineered electric swing adsorption for scalable and cost-effective direct air capture
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Direct air capture (DAC) is critical to achieve carbon neutrality, yet current technologies face significant barriers to widespread, cost-effective deployment. Amine-based electric swing adsorption (ESA) offers a promising low-energy, steam-free pathway, but its efficiency is fundamentally limited by an inherent 2:1 amine-to-CO2 stoichiometric penalty. Here, we overcome this bottleneck by engineering a point defect-mediated proton trapping network into ESA sorbents, enabling a 1:1 amine-CO2 stoichiometry. Our engineered sorbent achieves a CO2 uptake of 6.57 mmol g−1 from 400 ppm CO2, a 28.8% improvement over the state-of-the-art sorbents. Regeneration is achieved with a low energy input of 3.4 GJ t−1 and exhibits a CO2 release rate 48% faster than conventional thermal methods. N5-dGA remains stable under 0-80% relative humidity fluctuations and at a gas velocity of 1 m s−1. Techno-economic analysis projects DAC operating costs of $48-62 t−1 using renewable electricity, up to 78% lower than temperature swing adsorption DAC and below the $100 t−1 CO2 target. This work presents a sorbent design and ESA process, establishing a scientifically rigorous and economically viable pathway towards gigaton-scale DAC deployment.
title_zh: 质子阱设计的电动摆动吸附可实现可扩展且具有成本效益的直接空气捕获
abstract_zh: 直接空气捕获（DAC）对于实现碳中和至关重要，但目前的技术在广泛、经济高效的部署方面面临着重大障碍。基于胺的电变吸附 (ESA) 提供了一种有前景的低能量、无蒸汽途径，但其效率从根本上受到固有的 2:1 胺与 CO2 化学计量损失的限制。在这里，我们通过在 ESA 吸附剂中设计一个点缺陷介导的质子捕获网络来克服这一瓶颈，从而实现 1:1 的胺-CO2 化学计量。我们的工程吸附剂可从 400 ppm CO2 中吸收 6.57 mmol g−1 的 CO2，比最先进的吸附剂提高了 28.8%。只需 3.4 GJ t−1 的低能量输入即可实现再生，并且二氧化碳释放率比传统热法快 48%。 N5-dGA 在 0-80% 相对湿度波动和 1 m s−1 气体速度下保持稳定。技术经济分析预计，使用可再生电力的 DAC 运营成本为 48-62 t−1 美元，比变温吸附 DAC 低 78%，低于 100 t−1 美元的二氧化碳排放目标。这项工作提出了吸附剂设计和 ESA 流程，为十亿吨级 DAC 部署建立了科学严谨且经济可行的途径。

title: Programmable Triple Functionalization of Benzenes by Merging Dearomative Functionalization and Skeletal Editing
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Polysubstituted benzenes are ubiquitous in bioactive molecules and functional materials, yet their direct and selective construction from unadorned benzene remains elusive. Herein, we report a programmable triple functionalization of simple arenes by merging dearomative functionalization with double-atom swap. Each of the three newly installed substituents can be altered independently, and the regioselectivity is predictably governed by electronic effects. Diverse arenes, nucleophiles, and dienophiles are tolerated without preinstalled activating or directing groups, efficiently delivering tri- to hexa-substituted benzene derivatives. Its utility is further highlighted by the concise synthesis of a novel lactone-type hexabenzocoronene nanographene that exhibits a large Stokes shift and enhanced fluorescence. Isolation of key intermediates and isotopic labeling experiments support a cascade involving dearomative functionalization, cycloaddition, and cycloreversion. By overcoming the long-standing limitation of prefunctionalized handles, this work provides a step-economic and programmable 1,2,3-trifunctionalization platform for densely functionalized arenes of interest to medicinal chemistry and materials science.
title_zh: 通过合并脱芳香功能化和骨架编辑对苯进行可编程三重功能化
abstract_zh: 多取代苯在生物活性分子和功能材料中普遍存在，但从未修饰的苯中直接选择性地构建它们仍然难以捉摸。在此，我们通过将脱芳香功能化与双原子交换相结合，报告了简单芳烃的可编程三重功能化。三个新安装的取代基中的每一个都可以独立改变，并且区域选择性可预见地受到电子效应的控制。无需预先安装活化或导向基团，即可耐受多种芳烃、亲核试剂和亲二烯试剂，从而有效地递送三至六取代的苯衍生物。通过简洁合成新型内酯型六苯并晕烯纳米石墨烯，该纳米石墨烯表现出较大的斯托克斯位移和增强的荧光，进一步凸显了其实用性。关键中间体的分离和同位素标记实验支持涉及脱芳香官能化、环加成和环化回复的级联反应。通过克服预功能化手柄的长期限制，这项工作为药物化学和材料科学感兴趣的密集功能化领域提供了一种经济且可编程的1,2,3-三功能化平台。

title: De Novo Designed Porphyrin-Binding Proteins Photocatalyze the Nitrogen Reduction Reaction
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: In this work, we de novo designed a two-helix α-helical protein capable of forming dimers, which features a central cavity that accommodates porphyrin molecules. The resulting porphyrin-binding protein, formed by mixing the porphyrin with the dimer protein, exhibits visible-light-driven catalytic activity for the nitrogen reduction reaction. To further optimize the protein, we selected three mutation layers and predicted their structures. From these, we identified seven mutants that retained the original protein folding structure, which are used for the photocatalytic ammonia production from nitrogen after binding porphyrin. Among them, the best-performing mutant achieved a catalytic rate of 9.704 mg gcat-1 h-1 for ammonia synthesis, which is higher than most of the current reported artificial catalysts. This work provides a promising strategy for the de novo design of porphyrin-binding proteins as catalysts for nitrogen fixation under mild conditions.
title_zh: 从头设计的卟啉结合蛋白光催化氮还原反应
abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们从头设计了一种能够形成二聚体的双螺旋α-螺旋蛋白，其具有容纳卟啉分子的中心空腔。通过将卟啉与二聚体蛋白混合形成的卟啉结合蛋白表现出可见光驱动的氮还原反应催化活性。为了进一步优化蛋白质，我们选择了三个突变层并预测了它们的结构。由此，我们鉴定了七个保留了原始蛋白质折叠结构的突变体，这些突变体用于在结合卟啉后从氮光催化生产氨。其中，表现最好的突变体对氨合成的催化率为9.704 mg gcat-1 h-1，高于目前报道的大多数人工催化剂。这项工作为从头设计卟啉结合蛋白作为温和条件下固氮催化剂提供了一种有前途的策略。

title: Electric and Photovoltaic Switching by Ionic Migration with a Magnetic Record
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Combining optical and magnetic functionalities into memristors is an attractive option to expand applications into image recognition, information storage, and low power processing. Here, we have fabricated ferromagnetic-fullerene-manganese oxide structures that display a hysteretic, nonlinear I-V characteristic and a photovoltaic effect with a photocurrent dependent on the relative alignment of the magnetization and the light polarization vector. Reversible, voltage-induced oxygen migration from manganese oxide into the molecular layer reduces the resistivity of the device by several orders of magnitude, eliminates the nonlinear transport, and quenches the photovoltaic response, giving rise to an optically sensitive memristor where the photocurrent is dependent on both the electrical and magnetic history of the device. Density functional theory calculations attribute the origin of these effects to changes in the electronic structure at the Fermi level and a reduction of the interface dipole upon ionic migration. These results open research pathways towards single-molecule scale memristive memories with optical excitation, electrical readout and magnetic sensing functionalities.
title_zh: 通过磁记录离子迁移进行电和光伏开关
abstract_zh: 将光学和磁性功能组合到忆阻器中是将应用扩展到图像识别、信息存储和低功耗处理的一个有吸引力的选择。在这里，我们制造了铁磁-富勒烯-锰氧化物结构，该结构表现出磁滞、非线性 I-V 特性和光伏效应，其光电流取决于磁化强度和光偏振矢量的相对排列。可逆的、电压诱导的氧从氧化锰迁移到分子层中，使器件的电阻率降低了几个数量级，消除了非线性传输，并淬灭了光伏响应，从而产生了光敏忆阻器，其中光电流取决于器件的电历史和磁历史。密度泛函理论计算将这些效应的根源归因于费米能级电子结构的变化以及离子迁移时界面偶极子的减少。这些结果为具有光激发、电读出和磁传感功能的单分子级忆阻存储器开辟了研究途径。

title: High Power Factor in Polycrystalline InGaSb Thin Films via Nanoscale Compositional Fluctuations
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: III-V compound semiconductors are promising candidates for thin-film thermoelectric materials because their narrow-bandgap alloys can exhibit a thermoelectric response near room temperature. In this study, we systematically investigated polycrystalline InGaSb thin films deposited on glass substrates and identified the deposition temperature and In flux as key parameters governing phase competition and nanoscale compositional fluctuations. By modulating the In supply, discontinuous In-rich precipitates were formed while the matrix composition was systematically tuned. Variation of the deposition temperature further enabled control of structural disorder and nanoscale features, as evaluated by Raman analyses. At the highest deposition temperature (560 °C) that maintained continuous films, increased disorder correlated with an enhanced Seebeck coefficient without a significant reduction in electrical conductivity. As a result, a high power factor of 1200 µW m-1 K-2 was achieved near room temperature. These findings demonstrate that growth-parameter-driven microstructure and phase control provide an effective strategy for enhancing thermoelectric performance in multicomponent polycrystalline III-V thin films.
title_zh: 通过纳米级成分波动实现多晶 InGaSb 薄膜的高功率因数
abstract_zh: III-V族化合物半导体是薄膜热电材料的有希望的候选者，因为它们的窄带隙合金可以在接近室温时表现出热电响应。在这项研究中，我们系统地研究了玻璃基板上沉积的多晶 InGaSb 薄膜，并将沉积温度和 In 通量确定为控制相竞争和纳米级成分波动的关键参数。通过调节 In 的供应，形成不连续的富 In 沉淀物，同时系统地调整基体成分。通过拉曼分析评估，沉积温度的变化进一步能够控制结构无序和纳米级特征。在维持连续薄膜的最高沉积温度（560°C）下，无序性增加与塞贝克系数增强相关，而电导率没有显着降低。结果，在室温附近实现了 1200 µW m-1 K-2 的高功率因数。这些发现表明，生长参数驱动的微结构和相控制为增强多组分多晶 III-V 薄膜的热电性能提供了有效的策略。

title: Activity Convergence between Continuous- and Pulsed-Deposition NiFe Hydroxide Anodes in Liquid Alkaline Electrolyzers
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Improving the activity of anodes for the alkaline oxygen evolution reaction (OER) is of interest because of the importance of the reaction in electrochemical technology. There is an abundance of studies which confirm that NiFe hydroxide, often prepared by electrodeposition, is the most active catalyst for the alkaline OER. This relatively high level of confidence in the optimal OER catalyst chemistry suggests that exploration of methods which improve on features besides the chemistry of the films, such as their microstructure, could access new heights of activity. In this study, the possible benefits of pulsed current deposition relative to the conventional continuous current approach to the deposition of NiFe hydroxides were investigated. Pulsed deposition densified the film surfaces by preventing metal ion depletion at the electrode surface during film formation. The Fe content, redox reversibility, and OER activity were higher for the pulsed deposition films relative to their continuous deposition counterparts. Though pulsed deposition imparted a higher OER performance of the films compared to continuous deposition at the three-electrode level, this improved performance was not retained during electrolyzer operation. Rather, a convergence of the cell performance is seen irrespective of the deposition approach. This phenomenon was attributed to the way electrolyzer conditions─relatively high temperature, base concentration, and current density─can drive alternate mechanisms for observed performance.
title_zh: 液体碱性电解槽中连续沉积和脉冲沉积氢氧化镍铁阳极的活性收敛
abstract_zh: 由于碱性析氧反应（OER）在电化学技术中的重要性，提高阳极的活性引起了人们的兴趣。大量研究证实，通常通过电沉积制备的氢氧化镍铁是碱性 OER 中最活跃的催化剂。对最佳 OER 催化剂化学的这种相对较高的信心表明，探索改进薄膜化学以外的特征（例如其微观结构）的方法可以达到新的活性高度。在本研究中，研究了脉冲电流沉积相对于传统连续电流沉积 NiFe 氢氧化物的可能优势。脉冲沉积通过防止成膜过程中电极表面的金属离子耗尽来使薄膜表面致密化。相对于连续沉积薄膜，脉冲沉积薄膜的 Fe 含量、氧化还原可逆性和 OER 活性更高。尽管与三电极水平的连续沉积相比，脉冲沉积赋予了薄膜更高的 OER 性能，但这种改进的性能在电解槽操作期间并未保留。相反，无论沉积方法如何，都可以看到电池性能的收敛。这种现象归因于电解槽条件（相对较高的温度、碱浓度和电流密度）可以驱动观察到的性能的替代机制。

title: Model-Assisted Prioritization of Gelatin Methacryloyl (GelMA) Hydrogel Formulations for Three-Dimensional Cell Culture
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Owing to highly tunable mechanics, gelatin methacryloyl (GelMA) hydrogels are widely exploited for three-dimensional (3D) cell culture, whereas limited experimental sampling restricts efficient formulation screening. In this work, we developed a BNN-based modeling pipeline to map GelMA hydrogels with various cross-linking parameters toward linear viscoelastic moduli and nonlinear critical stress, thereby categorizing all tested formulations into low/intermediate/high stable mechanical windows. Calibration on C2C12 myoblast morphologies confirmed that nonlinear critical stress complements linear rheological parameters to refine the screening priority of cell-compatible hydrogel recipes. Subsequent validation with primary cardiomyocytes demonstrated consistent morphological trends matching the predefined mechanical windows, alongside ambiguous boundary formulations. Our findings construct a bounded prioritization strategy to rapidly select GelMA compositions under sparse experimental conditions, with further prospective validations demanded before generalized predictive use for diverse tissue engineering scenarios.
title_zh: 用于三维细胞培养的明胶甲基丙烯酰 (GelMA) 水凝胶制剂的模型辅助优先级排序
abstract_zh: 由于力学性能高度可调，甲基丙烯酰明胶 (GelMA) 水凝胶被广泛用于三维 (3D) 细胞培养，而有限的实验采样限制了有效的配方筛选。在这项工作中，我们开发了一种基于 BNN 的建模流程，将具有各种交联参数的 GelMA 水凝胶映射到线性粘弹性模量和非线性临界应力，从而将所有测试的配方分类为低/中/高稳定机械窗口。 C2C12 成肌细胞形态的校准证实，非线性临界应力补充了线性流变参数，以完善细胞相容性水凝胶配方的筛选优先级。随后对原代心肌细胞的验证表明，形态学趋势与预定义的机械窗口相匹配，并且边界公式不明确。我们的研究结果构建了一种有限的优先策略，以在稀疏的实验条件下快速选择 GelMA 组合物，在广泛预测用于不同的组织工程场景之前需要进一步的前瞻性验证。

title: Flexible Inorganic Nanofibers: Mechanisms, Regulation Strategies, and Evaluation Methods
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Flexible inorganic nanofibers, leveraging the synergistic advantages of the inherent stability of inorganic materials and the flexible functionality conferred on the nanoscale, have demonstrated significant application potential in high-end fields such as thermal insulation, optoelectronics, catalysis, and biomedicine, emerging as a research hotspot in interdisciplinary science. However, the origin of their flexibility involves multiscale structural coupling and the synergistic action of multiple mechanisms. Existing research has yet to establish a universal theoretical system, which restricts the precise design and industrial application of flexible inorganic materials. This paper systematically reviews the intrinsic mechanisms of flexible inorganic nanofibers (defect regulation, dynamic interfacial regulation, surface atomic reconstruction, and microscopic bond distortion). It elucidates the logical framework for constructing flexible materials, which is "based on the cornerstones of nanoscale surface/interface effects, supported by the four intrinsic mechanisms listed above, and realized through multi-scale regulation strategies". Two core strategies for flexibility regulation, namely, intrinsic structure tailoring and interfacial engineering modulation, are summarized, along with an overview of the current state of flexibility evaluation and testing methods. This review aims to construct an integrated cognitive framework of "mechanism-regulation-evaluation" to provide theoretical support for the high-performance design and application breakthroughs of flexible inorganic nanofibers. Furthermore, future development directions are discussed, including interdisciplinary integration, innovation in in situ characterization techniques, and the establishment of standardized evaluation systems.
title_zh: 柔性无机纳米纤维：机理、调控策略和评价方法
abstract_zh: 柔性无机纳米纤维利用无机材料固有的稳定性和纳米尺度赋予的柔性功能的协同优势，在隔热、光电子、催化、生物医学等高端领域展现出巨大的应用潜力，成为交叉学科的研究热点。然而，其灵活性的根源涉及多尺度结构耦合和多种机制的协同作用。现有研究尚未建立通用的理论体系，制约了柔性无机材料的精准设计和工业化应用。本文系统综述了柔性无机纳米纤维的内在机制（缺陷调节、动态界面调节、表面原子重构和微观键变形）。它阐明了构建柔性材料的逻辑框架，该框架“基于纳米级表面/界面效应的基石，以上述四种内在机制为支撑，并通过多尺度调控策略来实现”。总结了柔性调节的两个核心策略，即内在结构定制和界面工程调制，并概述了柔性评估和测试方法的现状。本文旨在构建“机制-调控-评价”的一体化认知框架，为柔性无机材料的高性能设计和应用突破提供理论支撑。

title: NiSe 2 Cocatalyst-Modified WO 3 for Efficient Photoelectrochemical Water Splitting
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Photoanodes that can absorb sufficient visible light, separate photogenerated charge carriers efficiently, and transport them quickly to the surface remain the primary obstacles to achieving high-efficiency water splitting. Herein, a NiSe2 nanoparticle-cocatalyst-modified WO3 is demonstrated as a photoanode with outstanding photoelectrochemical (PEC) water splitting performance, owing to a heterojunction between the WO3 semiconductor and metallic NiSe2. With an optimal NiSe2 loading, the WO3/NiSe2 photoanode exhibits a photocurrent density of 1.66 mA cm-2 at 1.23 V versus RHE under irradiation, surpassing the performance of the pristine WO3 photoanode by over seven-fold. The superior PEC performance of WO3/NiSe2 is ascribed to improved charge-carrier transfer at the electrode/electrolyte interface and enhanced charge-carrier separation and migration resulting from the heterojunction, as corroborated by experimental data and density functional theory (DFT) calculations. The DFT study shows a lower Gibbs free energy change for the potential-determining step (*O → *OOH) on the WO3/NiSe2 heterostructure, as compared to WO3, suggesting efficient oxygen evolution reaction activity and consequently enhanced water splitting performance. Additionally, the hybrid catalyst exhibits an excellent Faradaic efficiency of 94.4% for hydrogen generation and notable structural stability. This work outlines a simple technique for achieving the desired cocatalyst/semiconductor coupling toward highly efficient solar water splitting.
title_zh: 用于高效光电化学水分解的 NiSe 2 助催化剂改性 WO 3
abstract_zh: 能够吸收足够的可见光、有效分离光生电荷载流子并将其快速传输到表面的光阳极仍然是实现高效水分解的主要障碍。在此，由于 WO3 半导体和金属 NiSe2 之间的异质结，NiSe2 纳米颗粒助催化剂修饰的 WO3 被证明是具有出色光电化学（PEC）水分解性能的光阳极。凭借最佳的 NiSe2 负载量，WO3/NiSe2 光阳极在 1.23 V 照射下相对于 RHE 的光电流密度为 1.66 mA cm-2，超过原始 WO3 光阳极的性能七倍以上。 WO3/NiSe2 优异的 PEC 性能归因于电极/电解质界面处电荷载流子传输的改善以及异质结导致的电荷载流子分离和迁移的增强，实验数据和密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算证实了这一点。 DFT 研究表明，与 WO3 相比，WO3/NiSe2 异质结构上的电势决定步骤 (*O → *OOH) 的吉布斯自由能变化较低，表明高效的析氧反应活性，从而增强了水分解性能。此外，该混合催化剂具有优异的法拉第制氢效率（94.4%）和显着的结构稳定性。这项工作概述了一种简单的技术，可实现高效太阳能水分解所需的助催化剂/半导体耦合。

title: Nitrocellulose-Based Membranes for Electrocatalytic Bicarbonate-to-Formate Conversion via In Situ Generated CO 2
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: CO2 conversion using aqueous carbonate and bicarbonate solutions is a promising route for reactive CO2 capture, but sustaining high Faradaic efficiency (FE) over a broad pH range remains challenging. Introducing a mixed cellulose ester (MCE) porous membrane between the proton exchange membrane (PEM) and the bismuth cathode electrocatalyst enhances the FE for formate production during bicarbonate-fed electrolysis. In this configuration, bicarbonate ions (HCO3-) are protonated within the electrolyzer, enabling direct utilization of in situ-generated CO2 (i-CO2) for electroreduction. Here, we investigate the role of the intermediate porous membrane and the effects of different cellulose materials on electrolysis performance at current densities above 100 mA cm-2. Although direct contact between the cathode and PEM significantly decreases formate FE with increasing pH, incorporating the MCE membrane enhanced formate FE across all pH values, maintaining 78% even at pH 9.2 (2.0 mol L-1 KHCO3 + 0.5 mol L-1 K2CO3), demonstrating its effectiveness in sustaining i-CO2 generation. In contrast, α-cellulose and acetyl cellulose exhibit lower formate FE and higher full-cell voltage owing to increased cell resistance. Operando electrochemical impedance spectroscopy and real-time visualization of the bubble formation reveal that these celluloses produced large CO2 bubbles, whereas i-CO2 remained predominantly dissolved when using the MCE membrane, which is mainly composed of nitrocellulose. These results indicate that nitrate ester groups facilitate i-CO2 generation and its transport to the cathode catalyst. Furthermore, a 3.0 mol L-1 KOH solution that captures CO2 gas achieves 91% formate FE at 100 mA cm-2, with a full-cell voltage of 1.5 V and 80% i-CO2 utilization, highlighting the potential of this MCE-based electrolyzer design for reactive CO2 capture and utilization.
title_zh: 用于通过原位产生的 CO 2 电催化碳酸氢盐至甲酸盐转化的硝化纤维素膜
abstract_zh: 使用碳酸盐和碳酸氢盐水溶液进行 CO2 转化是反应性 CO2 捕获的一种有前途的途径，但在广泛的 pH 范围内维持高法拉第效率 (FE) 仍然具有挑战性。在质子交换膜 (PEM) 和铋阴极电催化剂之间引入混合纤维素酯 (MCE) 多孔膜可增强碳酸氢盐供给电解过程中甲酸盐生产的 FE。在此配置中，碳酸氢根离子 (HCO3-) 在电解槽内质子化，从而能够直接利用原位产生的 CO2 (i-CO2) 进行电解还原。在这里，我们研究了中间多孔膜的作用以及不同纤维素材料在电流密度高于 100 mA cm-2 时对电解性能的影响。虽然随着 pH 值的增加，阴极和 PEM 之间的直接接触会显着降低甲酸 FE，但加入 MCE 膜可增强所有 pH 值下的甲酸 FE，即使在 pH 9.2 下也能保持 78%（2.0 mol L-1 KHCO3 + 0.5 mol L-1 K2CO3），这证明了其在维持 i-CO2 生成方面的有效性。相比之下，α-纤维素和乙酰纤维素由于电池电阻增加而表现出较低的甲酸盐 FE 和较高的全电池电压。操作电化学阻抗谱和气泡形成的实时可视化表明，这些纤维素产生了大的 CO2 气泡，而当使用主要由硝化纤维素组成的 MCE 膜时，i-CO2 仍然主要保持溶解状态。这些结果表明硝酸酯基团促进 i-CO2 的产生及其运输到

title: Enhancing Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma Immunotherapy under Stress through Sympathetic Nerve–T cell Interaction Blockade via Co-delivery of β-Blockers and aTIM-3 with Ultrasound-Responsive Bionic Nanoparticles
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC), a refractory cold tumor, is characterized by a dense extracellular matrix (ECM) and stress-triggered neuroimmune crosstalk, which cause T cell exhaustion and poor efficacy of anti-T cell immunoglobulin and mucin domain-3 antibody (aTIM-3) monotherapy. Here, we report a sucrose-hybridized, Pan02 pancreatic tumor cell membrane-coated ultrasound (US)-responsive biomimetic nanocarrier (CT@SM) co-loading carvedilol (β-blocker) and aTIM-3. The Pan02 tumor cell membrane shell enables homologous tumor targeting, prolonged circulation, and reduced off-target distribution, while intercalated sucrose modulates vesicle acoustic impedance to generate US-triggered inertial cavitation. US activates cavitation to disrupt the ECM and co-releases cargos deep in tumors: carvedilol relieves norepinephrine-mediated T cell exhaustion, and aTIM-3 suppresses M2-type tumor-associated macrophages. Consequently, compared to free aTIM-3, up to an 11.23-fold increase of aTIM-3 in the tumor region was obtained in the CT@SM + US group. Immunotherapy efficacy was significantly enhanced by reactivating T cells, leading to suppressed tumor growth and prolonged survival in the PDAC mice stress model. Overall, this study offers a promising strategy based on a dual-modified biomimetic acoustic delivery platform for immunotherapy in PDAC and other cold tumors.
title_zh: 通过联合递送 β 受体阻滞剂和 aTIM-3 与超声响应仿生纳米颗粒，通过交感神经-T 细胞相互作用阻断，增强压力下胰腺导管腺癌的免疫治疗
abstract_zh: 胰腺导管腺癌 (PDAC) 是一种难治性冷肿瘤，其特点是致密的细胞外基质 (ECM) 和应激触发的神经免疫串扰，导致 T 细胞耗竭，抗 T 细胞免疫球蛋白和粘蛋白结构域 3 抗体 (aTIM-3) 单一疗法疗效不佳。在这里，我们报道了一种蔗糖杂交、Pan02胰腺肿瘤细胞膜涂层超声（US）响应仿生纳米载体（CT@SM），共同负载卡维地洛（β-阻滞剂）和aTIM-3。 Pan02肿瘤细胞膜壳能够实现同源肿瘤靶向、延长循环并减少脱靶分布，而插入的蔗糖调节囊泡声阻抗以产生超声触发的惯性空化。 US 激活空化作用，破坏 ECM 并在肿瘤深处共同释放物质：卡维地洛缓解去甲肾上腺素介导的 T 细胞耗竭，aTIM-3 抑制 M2 型肿瘤相关巨噬细胞。因此，与游离的aTIM-3相比，CT@SM + US组中肿瘤区域的aTIM-3增加了高达11.23倍。通过重新激活 T 细胞，免疫治疗效果显着增强，从而抑制 PDAC 小鼠应激模型中的肿瘤生长并延长生存期。总体而言，这项研究为 PDAC 和其他冷肿瘤的免疫治疗提供了一种基于双改良仿生声学传递平台的有前途的策略。

title: Defect-Selective Etching Engineering of Reduced Graphene Oxide Membranes
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Two-dimensional laminar membranes hold great promise for advanced water treatment but are inherently limited by a permeability-selectivity trade-off. Herein, we report a nanoscale "defect-excavation" strategy to overcome this limitation in reduced graphene oxide (rGO) membranes by engineering dual transport pathways at the molecular level. Vertical nanopores created by mild KOH etching selectively targeted defect-prone sp3-hybridized carbon domains, carving high-speed shortcuts through the laminar structure. To complement the kinetic nanoetching, we also introduced a thermodynamic stabilization step involving ionic-liquid intercalation, wherein these supramolecular rivets anchor expanded interlayer spacings through robust cation-π interactions. This synergistic integration created a dual nanoscale transport network that reshaped the transport of water molecules within confined two-dimensional nanochannels. The optimized membrane (KOH-IL-rGO membrane) exhibited an ultrahigh water permeance of 455 L m-2 h-1 bar-1 and a methylene blue rejection of 99.68%. Molecular dynamics simulations further elucidated the cooperative transport mechanism, which provided critical quantitative insights: the vertical shortcuts significantly enhanced the overall water permeance, and the expanded interlayer spacing induced directly underpins the ultrahigh permeance and selective rejection observed. Overall, this work provides a rational materials design approach for constructing high-performance, energy-efficient membranes for sustainable water purification and recovery.
title_zh: 还原氧化石墨烯膜的缺陷选择性刻蚀工程
abstract_zh: 二维层状膜在先进水处理方面具有广阔的前景，但本质上受到渗透性与选择性权衡的限制。在此，我们报告了一种纳米级“缺陷挖掘”策略，通过在分子水平上设计双重运输途径来克服还原氧化石墨烯（rGO）膜的这一限制。通过温和的 KOH 蚀刻产生的垂直纳米孔选择性地针对容易出现缺陷的 sp3 杂化碳域，在层状结构中开辟高速捷径。为了补充动力学纳米蚀刻，我们还引入了涉及离子液体嵌入的热力学稳定步骤，其中这些超分子铆钉通过强大的阳离子-π相互作用锚定扩大的层间距。这种协同整合创建了一个双纳米级传输网络，重塑了受限二维纳米通道内水分子的传输。优化后的膜（KOH-IL-rGO膜）表现出455 L m-2 h-1 bar-1的超高透水性和99.68%的亚甲基蓝截留率。分子动力学模拟进一步阐明了协同传输机制，提供了关键的定量见解：垂直捷径显着增强了整体水渗透性，而引起的扩大的层间距直接支撑了观察到的超高渗透性和选择性排斥。总体而言，这项工作提供了一种合理的材料设计方法，用于构建高性能、节能的膜，以实现可持续的水净化和回收。

title: Low-Temperature LiCoO 2 ||Graphite Batteries Enabled by Multi-Salt and Acetone–Ester Solvent Regulation
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: The performance of lithium-ion batteries at low temperatures is severely constrained by sluggish desolvation kinetics and unstable electrode interfaces. Here, we develop a fluorinated-solvent-free, low-temperature electrolyte, FBN-442, composed of 1.0 m salts (LiFSI/LiODFB = 7:3) and 0.15 m LiNO3 additive dissolved in a mixed solvent of acetone (DMK), methyl acetate (MA), and vinylene carbonate (VC). Guided by theoretical calculations and comprehensive experimental analyses, we construct a tailored solvation structure, in which DMK promotes salt dissociation, MA provides moderate Li+ affinity and a low melting point, and VC contributes effective film formation. This optimized solvation environment balances bulk ion transport with interfacial charge-transfer kinetics and drives the formation of dense, inorganic-rich interphase layers. As a result, graphite and LiCoO2 electrodes exhibit markedly improved low-temperature and high-rate performance. The effectiveness of the electrolyte is further validated in pouch cells, which retain 78% of their room-temperature capacity even at -40 °C (0.85 Ah vs 1.1 Ah at 30 °C). These results highlight the critical role of solvation-structure regulation in enabling high-energy lithium-ion batteries to operate reliably across wide temperature ranges.
title_zh: 通过多盐和丙酮-酯溶剂调节实现低温 LiCoO 2 ||石墨电池
abstract_zh: 锂离子电池在低温下的性能受到缓慢的去溶剂化动力学和不稳定的电极界面的严重限制。在此，我们开发了一种无氟化溶剂的低温电解质 FBN-442，由溶解在丙酮 (DMK)、乙酸甲酯 (MA) 和碳酸亚乙烯酯 (VC) 混合溶剂中的 1.0 m 盐 (LiFSI/LiODFB = 7:3) 和 0.15 m LiNO3 添加剂组成。在理论计算和综合实验分析的指导下，我们构建了定制的溶剂化结构，其中DMK促进盐解离，MA提供适度的Li+亲和力和低熔点，VC有助于有效的成膜。这种优化的溶剂化环境平衡了本体离子传输与界面电荷转移动力学，并驱动致密、富含无机物的界面层的形成。因此，石墨和LiCoO2电极表现出显着改善的低温和高倍率性能。电解质的有效性在软包电池中得到了进一步验证，即使在 -40 °C 下，软包电池仍保留 78% 的室温容量（30 °C 时为 0.85 Ah 与 1.1 Ah）。这些结果凸显了溶剂化结构调节在使高能锂离子电池在宽温度范围内可靠运行方面的关键作用。

title: Photosystem-Based Biophotoelectrodes for Solar Energy Conversion
source: Chemical Reviews: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Photosystem-modified electrodes have been developed as alternatives to classical semiconductor-based systems for solar energy conversion into chemicals or electricity. Photosystems, the photoactive proteins of natural photosynthesis, offer exceptional light-harvesting efficiency and large charge separation and are composed entirely of earth-abundant elements. Their main limitations remain their limited robustness and difficulty of efficiently interfacing them with electrodes. Here, we review the strategies for integrating the three major classes of photosystems (photosystem II, photosystem I, and bacterial reaction centers) into functional devices. We examine electrode architectures such as biophotoanodes and biophotocathodes as well as their assembly into biased and bias-free biophotoelectrochemical cells using various protein immobilization approaches aimed at maximizing photocurrent and energy efficiency. Particular emphasis is placed on understanding electron-transfer pathways between electrodes and photosystems, including potential short-circuiting pathways. Finally, we highlight key characterization tools and performance metrics that are essential for identifying bottlenecks and guiding optimization.
title_zh: 用于太阳能转换的基于光系统的生物光电极
abstract_zh: 光系统改良电极已被开发为经典半导体系统的替代品，用于将太阳能转化为化学品或电力。光系统是自然光合作用的光活性蛋白质，具有卓越的光捕获效率和大电荷分离能力，并且完全由地球上丰富的元素组成。它们的主要局限性仍然是其有限的稳健性以及难以与电极有效连接。在这里，我们回顾了将三大类光系统（光系统 II、光系统 I 和细菌反应中心）集成到功能器件中的策略。我们研究了生物光阳极和生物光阴极等电极结构，以及使用各种旨在最大化光电流和能量效率的蛋白质固定方法将它们组装成有偏压和无偏压生物光电化学电池。特别强调了解电极和光系统之间的电子转移途径，包括潜在的短路途径。最后，我们重点介绍对于识别瓶颈和指导优化至关重要的关键表征工具和性能指标。

title: Toward Flexible Neuromorphic Spintronics: Field-Free Switching of Synthetic Antiferromagnets on Polyimide Substrates
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Achieving fully electrically controlled magnetization switching of magnetically compensated synthetic antiferromagnets grown on flexible substrates would significantly advance high-density wearable memory and neuromorphic spintronic applications. Here, we illustrate the field-free spin-orbit-torque (SOT)-driven perpendicular magnetization switching in high-quality Pt/CoPt/Ru/CoTb synthetic antiferromagnets grown on polyimide substrates, which exhibit room-temperature compensated magnetization and enhanced anomalous Hall resistance at remanence. A 3% tensile strain induces a 390 Oe shift in the interlayer exchange coupling field and reduces the field-free SOT switching ratio to ∼28%. Crucially, the near-linear nonvolatile synaptic plasticity and neuronal nonlinearity of this field-free SOT switching are preserved under bending, stretching, and tensile fatigue. Leveraging these experimentally measured synaptic and neuronal characteristics, we computationally implemented a fully connected neural network, achieving simulated recognition accuracies exceeding 95.8% for handwritten digits and 86.2% for fashion products. These results offer an effective method for developing flexible spintronic devices.
title_zh: 迈向灵活的神经形态自旋电子学：聚酰亚胺基底上合成反铁磁体的无场切换
abstract_zh: 实现在柔性基板上生长的磁补偿合成反铁磁体的完全电控磁化切换将显着推进高密度可穿戴存储器和神经形态自旋电子应用。在这里，我们展示了在聚酰亚胺基底上生长的高质量 Pt/CoPt/Ru/CoTb 合成反铁磁体中的无场自旋轨道扭矩 (SOT) 驱动的垂直磁化开关，该磁体表现出室温补偿磁化强度和增强的剩磁反常霍尔电阻。 3% 的拉伸应变会导致层间交换耦合场发生 390 Oe 的偏移，并将无场 SOT 切换率降低至~28%。至关重要的是，这种无场 SOT 切换的近线性非易失性突触可塑性和神经元非线性在弯曲、拉伸和拉伸疲劳下得以保留。利用这些实验测量的突触和神经元特征，我们通过计算实现了一个完全连接的神经网络，实现了手写数字的模拟识别准确率超过 95.8%，时尚产品的模拟识别准确率超过 86.2%。这些结果为开发柔性自旋电子器件提供了一种有效的方法。

title: Quantifying UK coastal flood exposure under future sea-level rise to 2300
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The latest Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change assessment report highlighted the potential for more than 15 m of global sea-level rise by 2300. In this study, we explore the implications for UK coastal flood exposure by combining national-scale flood modelling with physically-based storylines of UK sea-level rise. By 2100 all storylines show broadly similar results with at least an additional 0.5 million people exposed to the 1-in-200 year undefended flood extent, which represents a 25% increase compared to present day. Under the most pessimistic storyline by 2300 involving significant ice-sheet instability, an additional 13 million people could be exposed to the 1-in-200 year undefended flood event. This would imply the potential need for large-scale movement of populations and settlements away from the coast in the coming centuries. Given current global emissions pledges, exposure increases by 1.7 million people by 2300, however up to 1 million could be avoided if Paris Agreement targets for greenhouse gas emissions are met.

title: 2-Alkyl Furans Undergo Radiolytic Oxidative Protein Cross-Linking
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Induced covalent bond formation, or cross-linking, is a powerful strategy for interrogating and modulating biological systems. Current strategies rely largely on photochemical processes, which generally restrict their use to cellular or other optically accessible settings. Broadening the chemistry underlying the cross-linking-initiating event could extend these approaches to more complex biological systems. Ionizing radiation─a cornerstone of cancer therapy─is an attractive but unexplored trigger for covalent chemistry. Here, we detail the systematic comparison of a series of rationally designed radiolytic cross-linking candidates. These studies reveal that 2-alkyl furans efficiently label a representative protein in a radiation dose-dependent manner. Mechanistic analyses suggest that radiolysis induces hydroxyl radical-mediated oxidation of the furan, generating an electrophilic dicarbonyl intermediate that reacts with lysine residues to form stable adducts. We apply this strategy to enforce the covalent capture of an otherwise reversible small-molecule-protein interaction in cells. Together, these findings establish ionizing radiation as an effective trigger for covalent chemistry, expanding the scope of radiolytic chemistry to include bond formation. This work provides a foundation for future applications leveraging spatially targeted radiation for target identification or the development of next-generation therapeutic strategies.
title_zh: 2-烷基呋喃经历放射分解氧化蛋白交联
abstract_zh: 诱导共价键形成或交联是询问和调节生物系统的强大策略。目前的策略主要依赖于光化学过程，这通常限制其在细胞或其他光学可访问环境中的使用。拓宽交联引发事件的化学基础可以将这些方法扩展到更复杂的生物系统。电离辐射——癌症治疗的基石——是共价化学的一个有吸引力但未经探索的触发因素。在这里，我们详细介绍了一系列合理设计的放射解交联候选物的系统比较。这些研究表明，2-烷基呋喃以辐射剂量依赖性方式有效地标记代表性蛋白质。机理分析表明，辐射分解诱导羟基自由基介导的呋喃氧化，产生亲电二羰基中间体，该中间体与赖氨酸残基反应形成稳定的加合物。我们应用这种策略来强制共价捕获细胞中原本可逆的小分子-蛋白质相互作用。总之，这些发现确立了电离辐射作为共价化学的有效触发因素，扩大了放射分解化学的范围，包括键的形成。这项工作为未来利用空间定向辐射进行目标识别或开发下一代治疗策略的应用奠定了基础。

title: Non-Abelian statistics for bosonic symmetry-protected topological phases
source: National Science Review Advance Access
abstract: Symmetry-protected non-Abelian (SPNA) statistics opens new frontiers in quantum statistics and enriches the schemes for topological quantum computing. In this work, we propose a new paradigm of SPNA statistics in one-dimensional correlated bosonic symmetry-protected topological (SPT) phases and uncover exotic universal features from a systematic investigation. In particular, we show that for generic bosonic SPT phases described by real Hamiltonians, the SPNA statistics of topological zero modes fall into two distinct classes. The first class exhibits conventional braiding of hard-core bosonic zero modes. Furthermore, we discover a second class of unconventional braiding statistics characterized by a nonlinear transformation, featuring a fractionalization of the first class and reminiscent of the non-Abelian statistics of symmetry-protected Majorana pairs. The two distinct classes of statistics have topological origin in classifying non-Abelian Berry phases for braiding processes of real-Hamiltonian systems, distinguished by whether the holonomy involves a reflection operation. To illustrate, we focus on a specific bosonic SPT phase with particle-hole symmetry, and demonstrate that both classes of braiding statistics can be feasibly realized in tri-junctions with and without the aid of a controlled defect, respectively. Analytic and numerical results are given. We demonstrate how to encode logical qubits and implement both single- and two-qubit gates using the two classes of SPNA statistics. Finally, we propose feasible experimental schemes to observe these predictions and identify the parameter regimes for the high-fidelity braiding, paving the way for the experimental observation of our results in the near future.

title: Synthesis of the Elusive Bulk Iodide Double-Perovskite Semiconductor, Cs 2 AgBiI 6 : Microcrystals and Photoconductive Films
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Click to copy section link Section link copied! Three-dimensional (3D) iodide double-perovskite (elpasolite) semiconductors have attracted interest as potential lead-free metal-halide absorber layers for solar applications. Although studied extensively by computational methods, they have remained largely inaccessible synthetically, consistent with their predicted thermodynamic instability. Here, we report the first synthesis of bulk Cs 2 AgBiI 6, demonstrating both microcrystalline and thin-film forms. Microcrystalline powders of Cs 2 AgBiI 6 were prepared via anion exchange from phase-pure Cs 2 AgBiBr 6 microcrystals. The resulting iodide elpasolite shows broad absorption throughout the visible with a 1.70 ± 0.05 eV optical bandgap and near-infrared photoluminescence centered at 1.03 eV. We identify the elimination of trace moisture in bulk Cs 2 AgBiBr 6 as the critical factor enabling complete halide exchange and isolation of bulk Cs 2 AgBiI 6 with phase purity. In inert atmosphere, microcrystalline Cs 2 AgBiI 6 shows no decomposition when stored for months at room temperature or heated to ∼70 °C, and it appears equally stable in dry air. Building upon these insights, we then demonstrate the preparation of phase-pure Cs 2 AgBiI 6 films by flash thermal evaporation of Cs 2 AgBiBr 6 followed by anion exchange. Photoconductivity measurements on such Cs 2 AgBiI 6 films demonstrate photocarrier generation and transport, marking the first optoelectronic measurement on this elusive 3D iodide double perovskite. title: Chiral Quantum-Cutting
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Near-infrared circularly polarized luminescence (NIR-CPL) holds great promise for advanced photonic applications, however, simultaneously achieving both high photoluminescence quantum yield (PLQY) and large asymmetry factor (glum) in the NIR region remains challenging owing to the energy-gap law. Herein, we propose a chiral quantum-cutting strategy based on rare-earth ion-doped chiral perovskite quantum dots (PeQDs). Specifically, the obtained chiral PeQDs exhibit strong NIR-CPL at 985 nm with both a large glum of 0.092 and high PLQY of 157.2%, resulting in an exceptional figure of merit (FM = |glum| × PLQY) of 0.145, representing the highest value among the reported chiral perovskites. The femtosecond-transient absorption spectra confirmed an ultrafast energy transfer accompanied by efficient spin preservation owing to the chirality-induced spin selectivity (CISS) effect, which resulted in the imbalanced spin population of Yb3+ ions and enabled efficient NIR-CPL. Therefore, for the first time, we proposed and demonstrated the concept of chiral quantum-cutting effect and revealed the mechanism of spin flip and preservation during energy and chirality transfer based on the CISS effect. Our work provides a novel strategy for designing efficient NIR-CPL materials with large glum and high PLQY, opening new avenues for developing high-performance chiral optoelectronic and spintronic devices in the NIR region.
title_zh: 手性量子切割
abstract_zh: 近红外圆偏振发光（NIR-CPL）为先进光子应用带来了巨大前景，然而，由于能隙定律，在近红外区域同时实现高光致发光量子产率（PLQY）和大不对称因子（glum）仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们提出了一种基于稀土离子掺杂手性钙钛矿量子点（PeQD）的手性量子切割策略。具体来说，所获得的手性PeQD在985 nm处表现出很强的NIR-CPL，具有0.092的大glum和157.2%的高PLQY，导致优异的品质因数（FM = |glum| × PLQY）为0.145，代表了已报道的手性钙钛矿中的最高值。飞秒瞬态吸收光谱证实，由于手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）效应，超快的能量转移伴随着有效的自旋保存，从而导致 Yb3+ 离子的自旋群体不平衡，从而实现高效的 NIR-CPL。因此，我们首次提出并论证了手性量子切割效应的概念，并基于CISS效应揭示了能量和手性转移过程中自旋翻转和保存的机制。我们的工作为设计具有大glum和高PLQY的高效NIR-CPL材料提供了一种新颖的策略，为在NIR区域开发高性能手性光电和自旋电子器件开辟了新途径。

title: An “AND” Logic Gated Near-Infrared Fluorescent Probe Simultaneously Sensing Superoxide Anion and Viscosity Enables Early Atherosclerosis Monitoring
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Early stages of atherosclerosis (AS) involve macrophage lipid uptake and oxidative stress, creating a dynamic microenvironment that drives plaque initiation. Monitoring the complex chemical and physical changes in the lesion is essential for understanding disease and developing early diagnostic strategies. However, real-time and specific monitoring of key molecular events remain challenging. Here, we constructed a near-infrared (NIR) dual-locked fluorescent probe, PLAQ-SCAN (Plaque Localization and Qualification via Superoxide and Viscosity Co-activated Analysis). The fluorescence turn on depends on the coexistence of both stimuli, precisely matching the "dual dysregulation" microenvironment of early AS and effectively avoiding false positive signals induced by a single stimulus. The results demonstrated that PLAQ-SCAN exhibits strong fluorescence only in the presence of both signals and successfully monitors the dysregulation of superoxide anion (O2•-) and viscosity during macrophage foam formation. Notably, PLAQ-SCAN was able to track the AS progression of aortic plaques and detect serum signals changes as week 8, preceding conventional histopathological evidence. In summary, PLAQ-SCAN provides a powerful platform to real-time monitor O2•- and viscosity during pathogenesis, enabling early AS monitoring and synergistic mechanistic exploration.
title_zh: “AND”逻辑门控近红外荧光探针同时感应超氧阴离子和粘度，可实现早期动脉粥样硬化监测
abstract_zh: 动脉粥样硬化 (AS) 的早期阶段涉及巨噬细胞脂质摄取和氧化应激，创造了一个驱动斑块形成的动态微环境。监测病变中复杂的化学和物理变化对于了解疾病和制定早期诊断策略至关重要。然而，对关键分子事件的实时和特异性监测仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们构建了一种近红外 (NIR) 双锁荧光探针 PLAQ-SCAN（通过超氧化物和粘度共激活分析进行斑块定位和鉴定）。荧光的开启依赖于两种刺激的共存，精确匹配早期AS的“双重失调”微环境，有效避免单一刺激诱发的假阳性信号。结果表明，PLAQ-SCAN 仅在两种信号均存在的情况下才表现出强荧光，并成功监测巨噬细胞泡沫形成过程中超氧阴离子 (O2•-) 和粘度的失调。值得注意的是，PLAQ-SCAN 能够追踪主动脉斑块的 AS 进展，并在第 8 周检测血清信号变化，先于传统的组织病理学证据。总之，PLAQ-SCAN 提供了一个强大的平台来实时监测发病过程中的 O2•- 和粘度，从而实现早期 AS 监测和协同机制探索。
