title: Exploiting Electrolyzer Flexibility across Multiscale Energy Markets
source: ACS Energy Letters: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Click to copy section link Section link copied! Electricity cost and equipment degradation remain key barriers to competitive hydrogen production via water electrolysis. Current electrolyzers are typically optimized within a single electricity market, leaving unresolved how cross-market coordination affects their degradation behavior and techno-economic performance. Here, we show that flexible proton exchange membrane (PEM) electrolyzers can reduce hydrogen production costs by coordinating participation in day-ahead and real-time markets. We develop a multiscale model predictive control framework that jointly optimizes electricity procurement and electrolyzer operation while explicitly accounting for high-fidelity electrochemical behavior and membrane degradation. The controller aligns hourly day-ahead commitments with high-frequency real-time adjustments, enabling exploitation of intermarket price differentials under rigorous operational and durability constraints. Using year-long Texas grid data, we demonstrate electricity cost reductions up to fourfold. Moreover, degradation-aware operation shifts electrolyzer loading toward low-wear regimes, showing that dynamic market-responsive operation can simultaneously lower costs and extend component lifetime. title: Potential-Gated Transient Zn Single Adatoms on the Inverse Zn 1 O x /Cu Catalyst Steer Efficient Electroreduction of CO 2
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: The inverse ZnOx/Cu catalysts exhibit exceptional activity for the electrochemical CO2 reduction reaction (eCO2RR). However, identifying the atomistic origin of their structure-activity relationship is hindered by the dynamic nature of the active sites under operando conditions. Herein, we combine grand-canonical ensemble density functional theory and explicit-solvent ab initio molecular dynamics to reveal a potential-gated transient single-adatom mechanism in the atomically dispersed inverse Zn1Ox/Cu catalyst. We demonstrate that the O-coordinated Zn sites on Cu surfaces undergo in situ reduction at cathodic potentials, transforming into transient metallic Zn single adatoms, which are robustly stabilized via Zn-Cu electronic coupling and interfacial solvent confinement. This transient single adatom structurally preorganizes the chemisorbed CO2 intermediate via asymmetric polarization and redirects protonation toward a solvent-exposed oxygen, thereby creating a geometry-enabled pathway unavailable on pristine Cu or with embedded Zn single atoms. This distinct reaction geometry lowers the rate-determining protonation barrier while avoiding the promotion of the competing hydrogen evolution reaction. These findings suggest electrochemically gated transient single adatoms as a design strategy for highly efficient and selective electrocatalysis.
title_zh: 反 Zn 1 O x /Cu 催化剂上的电势门控瞬态 Zn 单吸附原子引导 CO 2 的高效电还原
abstract_zh: 反相 ZnOx/Cu 催化剂在电化学 CO2 还原反应 (eCO2RR) 中表现出卓越的活性。然而，操作条件下活性位点的动态性质阻碍了识别其结构-活性关系的原子起源。在此，我们结合大正则系综密度泛函理论和显式溶剂从头算分子动力学，揭示了原子分散反相 Zn1Ox/Cu 催化剂中的势门控瞬态单吸附原子机制。我们证明，Cu 表面上的 O 配位 Zn 位点在阴极电位下发生原位还原，转变为瞬态金属 Zn 单吸附原子，并通过 Zn-Cu 电子耦合和界面溶剂限制实现稳定稳定。这种瞬态单个吸附原子通过不对称极化在结构上预组织化学吸附的 CO2 中间体，并将质子化重定向到暴露于溶剂的氧，从而创建了原始 Cu 或嵌入 Zn 单原子上无法实现的几何路径。这种独特的反应几何结构降低了决定速率的质子化势垒，同时避免促进竞争性析氢反应。这些发现表明电化学门控瞬态单吸附原子可作为高效和选择性电催化的设计策略。

title: Reprogramming Glutathione-Binding Proteins into Artificial Photoenzymes by Engineered Glutathione-Type Cofactors
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Energy transfer (EnT) photocatalysis provides access to excited-state reactivity beyond thermal processes, yet highly enantioselective cycloadditions of sulfonamide-containing substrates remain challenging. Here we report a cofactor engineering strategy that reprograms glutathione S-transferases (GSTs) into artificial photoenzymes for enantioselective intramolecular [2 + 2] photocycloadditions to furnish chiral bicyclic sultam scaffolds. A photoactive glutathione-derived cofactor bearing a benzophenone photosensitizer (GS-Bp1) is prepared and reversibly assembled within GST scaffolds through native cofactor-like molecule-protein interactions. Screening and directed evolution of human GST A1-1 yield an optimized artificial photoenzyme that delivers a range of bicyclic sultams with moderate to excellent yields and enantioselectivities (up to 99% ee and up to 480 TONs), surpassing small-molecule benzophenone photocatalysts by more than 2 orders of magnitude in efficiency. Combined spectroscopic and computational studies reveal that directed evolution enhances stereocontrol by rebalancing π-π stacking and dispersion interactions in the transition state. Together with our previous NAD+-derived artificial cofactor systems, this work establishes cofactor engineering as a general strategy for reprogramming native protein families using canonical cofactors or cofactor-like molecules, enabling enantioselective photochemical transformations beyond those found in nature.
title_zh: 通过工程谷胱甘肽型辅因子将谷胱甘肽结合蛋白重编程为人工光酶
abstract_zh: 能量转移（EnT）光催化提供了热过程之外的激发态反应性，但含磺酰胺底物的高度对映选择性环加成仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们报告了一种辅因子工程策略，将谷胱甘肽S-转移酶（GST）重新编程为人工光酶，用于对映选择性分子内[2 + 2]光环加成，以提供手性双环磺内酰胺支架。制备了带有二苯甲酮光敏剂的光活性谷胱甘肽衍生辅助因子 (GS-Bp1)，并通过天然辅助因子样分子-蛋白质相互作用在 GST 支架内可逆组装。人类 GST A1-1 的筛选和定向进化产生了一种优化的人工光酶，可产生一系列双环磺内酰胺，具有中等至优异的产率和对映选择性（高达 99% ee 和高达 480 吨），效率超过小分子二苯甲酮光催化剂 2 个数量级以上。结合光谱和计算研究表明，定向进化通过重新平衡过渡态中的 π-π 堆积和色散相互作用来增强立体控制。与我们之前的 NAD+ 衍生的人工辅因子系统一起，这项工作将辅因子工程确立为使用经典辅因子或辅因子样分子重新编程天然蛋白质家族的通用策略，从而实现超越自然界中发现的对映选择性光化学转化。

title: Enzyme-Inspired Design of Well-Defined Dual-Metal-Site Pairs Confined within Metal–Organic Frameworks for Tailoring Photocatalytic Microenvironments
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Activity-selectivity trade-off remains a grand challenge and crucial issue in artificial photosynthesis. As for the natural enzyme system, bimetallic clusters confined in protein-folding chains enable regulating the activity-selectivity equilibrium for photosynthesis. However, current artificial photocatalysts lack the precisely synergistic control over active site configuration and catalytic microenvironments, causing the compromised trade-off between activity and specificity. Herein, we developed a "ship-in-bottle" strategy to confine well-defined dual-metal-site pairs (DMSPs) Co2L2 in the cage of amino-functionalized metal-organic framework UiO-67-(NH2)2, aiming at synergistic regulation of selectivity and activity for photocatalytic CO2 reduction. The as-synthesized Co2L2@UiO-67-(NH2)2 realized the highest syngas yield with CO/H2 ≈ 1/1, whereas only H2 but no CO was detected for original Co2L2. It was demonstrated that the tailored microenvironment around DMSPs enhanced the specific adsorption of CO2 like that in enzymes. Furthermore, the electron consumption rate of Co2L2@UiO-67-(NH2)2 (11078.00 μmol·gDMSP-1·h-1) was 63-fold higher than that of the Co2L2+UiO-67-(NH2)2 physical mixture counterpart (174.30 μmol·gDMSP-1·h-1), ascribing to the synergistic catalytic effect of DMSPs and improved charge transfer. As a proof of concept, this work integrates dual-metal-site catalysts with local microenvironment engineering to suppress the kinetically favored hydrogen evolution pathway and accelerate the CO2 reduction reaction process, providing a novel and feasible approach for optimizing artificial photosynthesis.

title: Synergistic Doping and Stabilization of Magnetically Tunable Ln Ti 3 (Sb,Sn) 4 ( Ln : Ce–Gd) Kagome Metals
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Here, we present our synthesis and characterization of the LnTi3(Sb,Sn)4 (Ln: Ce, Pr, Nd, Sm, Gd) family of cleavable kagome metals. While these materials are isostructural to the LnTi3Bi4 family, they only form as (Sb,Sn) solid-solutions with no corresponding LnTi3Sb4 or LnTi3Sn4 phases. We use a combination of first-principles density functional theory (DFT) and crystal orbital Hamilton population (COHP) calculations to show that (Sb,Sn) alloying has a stabilizing effect on the structure by adjusting the Fermi level, filling bonding states, depopulating antibonding states, and adjusting the density of states (DOS) toward local minima, an effect we call "synergistic doping." Through a detailed characterization of the SmTi3(Sb,Sn)4 series, we further demonstrate that the tunable Fermi level has a profound effect on the physical properties. We observe multiple magnetic phases that stem from a competition between antiferromagnetic (AFM) and ferromagnetic-like (FM) ground states. Furthermore, the (Sb,Sn) ratio allows us to tune from direct AFM-FM competition toward a complex admixture with properties reminiscent of the recently discovered TbTi3Bi4. Ultimately, our work demonstrates how the concept of synergistic doping provides a means to stabilize new structures while developing systems with intrinsically tunable chemical, magnetic, and electronic properties.
title_zh: 磁可调 Ln Ti 3 (Sb,Sn) 4 (Ln : Ce–Gd) Kagome 金属的协同掺杂和稳定化
abstract_zh: 在这里，我们介绍了可裂解 kagome 金属 LnTi3(Sb,Sn)4 (Ln: Ce, Pr, Nd, Sm, Gd) 系列的合成和表征。虽然这些材料与 LnTi3Bi4 系列具有同构结构，但它们仅形成 (Sb,Sn) 固溶体，没有相应的 LnTi3Sb4 或 LnTi3Sn4 相。我们结合第一性原理密度泛函理论 (DFT) 和晶体轨道哈密顿布居 (COHP) 计算，证明 (Sb,Sn) 合金化通过调整费米能级、填充键合态、减少反键合态以及将态密度 (DOS) 调整至局部最小值，对结构具有稳定作用，我们将这种效应称为“协同掺杂”。通过对SmTi3(Sb,Sn)4系列的详细表征，我们进一步证明了可调谐费米能级对其物理性质具有深远的影响。我们观察到源自反铁磁（AFM）和类铁磁（FM）基态之间竞争的多个磁相。此外，(Sb,Sn) 比率使我们能够从直接的 AFM-FM 竞争转向复杂的混合物，其特性让人想起最近发现的 TbTi3Bi4。最终，我们的工作展示了协同掺杂的概念如何提供一种稳定新结构的方法，同时开发具有本质上可调的化学、磁性和电子特性的系统。

title: Divergent Pyridine-to-Pyrazole Conversion via Carbon-Retentive Skeletal Editing
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Regioselective pyrazole synthesis remains a longstanding challenge in medicinal chemistry due to difficulties controlling N-differentiation during ring construction or functionalization. We address this through carbon-retentive skeletal editing that preserves molecular complexity while encoding regioselectivity during framework reorganization. From a single pyridine, mechanistically divergent pathways deliver structurally distinct pyrazoles: photochemical radical deconstruction-rearrangement yields aldehyde- or amine-substituted products; thermal polar reorganization with hydrazines provides orthogonal substitution patterns. Both proceed under mild, one-pot conditions and accommodate complex pharmaceuticals. This divergent platform enables predictable access to complementary pyrazole architectures from common pyridines, circumventing the regioselectivity limitations of peripheral functionalization and expanding accessible chemical space for drug discovery.
title_zh: 通过碳保留骨架编辑实现不同的吡啶到吡唑的转化
abstract_zh: 由于在环构建或功能化过程中控制 N-分化的困难，区域选择性吡唑合成仍然是药物化学中长期存在的挑战。我们通过碳保留骨架编辑来解决这个问题，该编辑保留分子复杂性，同时在框架重组过程中编码区域选择性。从单个吡啶，机械上不同的途径产生结构不同的吡唑：光化学自由基解构重排产生醛或胺取代的产物；用肼进行热极性重组提供了正交取代模式。两者都在温和的一锅条件下进行，并可容纳复杂的药物。这种不同的平台能够从常见的吡啶中可预测地获得互补的吡唑结构，从而规避了外围功能化的区域选择性限制，并扩大了药物发现的可利用化学空间。

title: Probing the Thermal Stability of the In Situ Ring-Opening Polymerized Solid Polymer Electrolytes
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Ring-opening polymerization (ROP) is widely employed for the in situ construction of solid polymer electrolytes (SPEs) in batteries due to the absence of byproducts. However, the thermal stability of such SPEs has long been overlooked. Here, we systematically investigate the thermal stability of two types of the most popular in situ ROP-prepared SPEs, including ether-based poly(1,3-dioxolane) (PDOL) and poly(1,3,5-trioxane) (PTXE), as well as ester-based poly(valerolactone) (PVL) and poly(trimethylene carbonate) (PTMC). Given the essential role of Li-salts in SPEs and the impossibility of removing ROP catalysts during in situ polymerization in cells, the thermal stability of ROP-prepared SPEs was evaluated in the presence of both components. The in situ ROP-prepared PDOL- and PTXE-based SPEs undergo rapid degradation into gases at 100 °C. The ROP and pyrolysis of PDOL/PTXE are demonstrated to share the same chemical mechanism and coexist in a temperature-dependent equilibrium, in which ROP is dominant at room temperature, while pyrolysis prevails at elevated temperatures and produces gases. The decomposition temperature of in situ ROP-prepared PVL and PTMC is around 180 °C, which is, however, decreased to 110 °C in the presence of Li-metal. This work reveals the challenges to the thermal stability of ROP-prepared SPEs and brings attention to the development of safer SPEs in solid-state batteries.
title_zh: 原位开环聚合固体聚合物电解质的热稳定性探讨
abstract_zh: 由于不存在副产物，开环聚合（ROP）被广泛用于电池中固体聚合物电解质（SPE）的原位构建。然而，此类固相萃取的热稳定性长期以来一直被忽视。在这里，我们系统地研究了两种最流行的原位 ROP 制备的 SPE 的热稳定性，包括醚基聚（1,3-二氧戊环）（PDOL）和聚（1,3,5-三恶烷）（PTXE），以及酯基聚（戊内酯）（PVL）和聚（三亚甲基碳酸酯）（PTMC）。鉴于锂盐在 SPE 中的重要作用以及在电池原位聚合过程中不可能去除 ROP 催化剂，因此在两种组分存在的情况下评估了 ROP 制备的 SPE 的热稳定性。原位 ROP 制备的基于 PDOL 和 PTXE 的 SPE 在 100 °C 下快速降解为气体。 PDOL/PTXE 的 ROP 和热解被证明具有相同的化学机制，并以依赖于温度的平衡共存，其中 ROP 在室温下占主导地位，而热解在高温下占主导地位并产生气体。原位 ROP 制备的 PVL 和 PTMC 的分解温度约为 180 °C，然而，在锂金属存在下，分解温度降至 110 °C。这项工作揭示了 ROP 制备的 SPE 的热稳定性面临的挑战，并引起人们对固态电池中更安全的 SPE 开发的关注。

title: Predicting Enantioselectivity of Ruthenium-Catalyzed Ketone Hydrogenation with 3D Structure-Based Deep Learning
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: We report machine-learning (ML) models that predict with high accuracy the enantioselectivity of ketone hydrogenation with Noyori-type diphosphine-diamine catalysts. To mitigate bias in published data, we combined a data set curated from the literature with >1,000 examples from our own high-throughput experimentation. We demonstrate that 3D graph neural networks, trained on 3D representations derived from the enantiodetermining transition state, outperform models based on 2D graphs, molecular fingerprints, and descriptors derived from semiempirical quantum calculations. These results indicate that models trained on 3D structural representations that reflect catalyst-substrate interactions relevant to enantioselectivity can accurately extrapolate to structures distinct from those in the training set.
title_zh: 利用基于 3D 结构的深度学习预测钌催化酮氢化的对映选择性
abstract_zh: 我们报告了机器学习（ML）模型，该模型可以高精度预测野依型二膦二胺催化剂的酮氢化的对映选择性。为了减少已发表数据中的偏差，我们将文献中整理的数据集与我们自己的高通量实验中的超过 1,000 个示例相结合。我们证明，根据对映决定过渡态派生的 3D 表示进行训练的 3D 图神经网络，优于基于 2D 图、分子指纹和半经验量子计算派生的描述符的模型。这些结果表明，在反映与对映选择性相关的催化剂-底物相互作用的 3D 结构表征上训练的模型可以准确地推断出与训练集中的结构不同的结构。

title: Interfacial Ligand Engineering Breaks the Activity-Selectivity Trade-Off in Electrochemical Alkynol Semihydrogenation and -Deuteration
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Electrochemical alkynol semihydrogenation and -deuteration uses water as the hydrogen source, offering a green alternative to thermocatalytic routes. However, its potential is constrained by an inherent activity-selectivity trade-off. Here, we demonstrate an interfacial ligand engineering strategy to break this seesaw effect. Through theoretical and experimental screening, cysteine, featuring both a thiol group and hydrophilic moieties, is identified as the optimal ligand. The cysteine-modified Cu (Cu-Cys) interface achieves concurrent gains in selectivity, conversion rate, and energy efficiency in electrochemical alkynol semihydrogenation and -deuteration. Using the electrochemical semihydrogenation of 2-methyl-3-butyn-2-ol (MBY) to 2-methyl-3-buten-2-ol (MBE) as a representative case, mechanistic studies reveal that the adsorbed cysteine ligands promote interfacial water transfer and dissociation to generate reactive hydrogen for boosting MBY semihydrogenation, while the thiol-mediated Cu surface facilitates MBE desorption and inhibits overhydrogenation, collectively accounting for the simultaneous enhancement in both conversion and selectivity. To demonstrate the practical potential, a flow cell incorporating the Cu-Cys catalyst exhibits stable performance for over 1000 h. The Cu-Cys catalyst compared to bare Cu reduces the power consumption for MBE electrosynthesis from ∼4.55 to ∼3.63 kWh kg-1. Furthermore, a customized scaled-up electrolysis system equipped with a 400 cm2 Cu-Cys electrode delivers near-complete MBY conversion while maintaining over 90% MBE selectivity at an applied current of 40 A.
title_zh: 界面配体工程打破了电化学炔醇半氢化和氘化中的活性与选择性权衡
abstract_zh: 电化学炔醇半氢化和氘化使用水作为氢源，为热催化路线提供了绿色替代方案。然而，其潜力受到固有的活性-选择性权衡的限制。在这里，我们展示了一种界面配体工程策略来打破这种跷跷板效应。通过理论和实验筛选，同时具有硫醇基和亲水部分的半胱氨酸被确定为最佳配体。半胱氨酸修饰的 Cu (Cu-Cys) 界面在电化学炔醇半氢化和氘化中同时实现了选择性、转化率和能量效率的提高。以2-甲基-3-丁炔-2-醇（MBY）电化学半氢化为2-甲基-3-丁烯-2-醇（MBE）为代表，机理研究表明，吸附的半胱氨酸配体促进界面水转移和解离，产生活性氢，促进MBY半氢化，而硫醇介导的Cu表面促进MBE解吸并抑制过度氢化，共同解释了同时提高转化率和选择性。为了证明其实际潜力，采用 Cu-Cys 催化剂的流通池表现出超过 1000 小时的稳定性能。与裸铜相比，Cu-Cys 催化剂将 MBE 电合成的功耗从~4.55 kWh kg-1 降低到~3.63 kWh kg-1。此外，配备 400 cm2 Cu-Cys 电极的定制放大电解系统可实现近乎完全的 MBY 转化，同时保持超过 90% 的 MBE 选择性

title: Formal Markovnikov Hydroazolation of Alkenes via Reductive Activation of Alkylthianthrenium Salts
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Herein, we introduce a new synthetic protocol for azole alkylation. Our strategy first engages azoles using alkenylthianthrenium electrophiles to provide 1,2-azolothianthrenium salts, then selectively excises the sulfonium moiety via single electron transfer (SET). Given that alkenylthianthrenium salts can be readily accessed from alkenes, the net azole addition-hydrogenolysis sequence unlocks a versatile approach to formal Markovnikov alkene hydroazolation. Moreover, the key radical intermediate formed after reduction can be engaged in reactions beyond hydrogen atom transfer (HAT), providing access to carboazolation products that would be otherwise prohibitively difficult to prepare. Mechanistic studies into the reduction of the alkylthianthrenium electrophile implicate an unusual silyl radical attack on DMF that generates a strong SET reductant in situ under otherwise exceedingly mild conditions. Overall, this work introduces new approaches to transform alkylsulfonium building blocks and immediately expands the range of N-alkyl azole molecules that can be readily prepared and studied.
title_zh: 通过烷基噻啉鎓盐的还原活化进行烯烃的正式马尔可夫尼科夫氢唑化
abstract_zh: 在这里，我们介绍了一种新的唑类烷基化合成方案。我们的策略首先使用烯基噻蒽亲电子试剂与唑类结合以提供 1,2-偶氮噻啉盐，然后通过单电子转移 (SET) 选择性切除锍部分。鉴于烯基噻蒽鎓盐可以很容易地从烯烃中获得，净唑加成-氢解序列解锁了一种正式马尔可夫尼科夫烯烃氢唑化的通用方法。此外，还原后形成的关键自由基中间体可以参与氢原子转移（HAT）以外的反应，从而提供了获得咔唑化产物的途径，否则这些产物将很难制备。对烷基噻啉亲电子试剂还原的机理研究表明，DMF 受到不寻常的甲硅烷基自由基攻击，在极其温和的条件下原位产生强 SET 还原剂。总的来说，这项工作引入了转化烷基锍结构单元的新方法，并立即扩大了易于制备和研究的 N-烷基唑分子的范围。

title: Hybrid Hydrogen-Bond Networks Steer Proton-Coupled Pathway for Acidic CO 2 -To-Ethanol Electrosynthesis
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Acidic CO2 reduction prevents carbonate loss but is limited by uncontrolled interfacial proton dynamics that trigger hydrogen evolution and favor ethylene. Here, we demonstrate that an adaptive hybrid ionomer interface steers proton-coupled pathways to achieve highly selective ethanol electrosynthesis. Through surface-limited oxidative reconstruction, the interphase evolves into a robust hydrogen-bonding network paired with an intact cationic sublayer. This architecture limits solvated proton diffusion, effectively suppressing the disruptive Eley-Rideal (ER) pathway toward ethylene. Instead, it dynamically shifts the reaction toward the Langmuir-Hinshelwood (LH) mechanism, optimizing surface-bound *H availability within a fixed mildly alkaline microenvironment (pH ≈ 10.5). Consequently, our membrane electrode assembly achieves >64% ethanol Faradaic efficiency at 200 mA cm-2 with >350 h of stability in pH = 1 electrolyte. This elucidates the pivotal role of interfacial hydrogen-bond networks in dictating proton-coupling mechanisms, offering a paradigm for pathway-specific acidic electrosynthesis.
title_zh: 混合氢键网络引导酸性CO 2 电合成的质子耦合途径
abstract_zh: 酸性二氧化碳还原可防止碳酸盐损失，但受到不受控制的界面质子动力学的限制，界面质子动力学会引发氢析出并有利于乙烯。在这里，我们证明了自适应混合离聚物界面可引导质子耦合途径以实现高选择性乙醇电合成。通过表面限制的氧化重建，界面演变成一个与完整的阳离子亚层配对的强大的氢键网络。这种结构限制了溶剂化质子扩散，有效抑制了通往乙烯的破坏性 Eley-Rideal (ER) 途径。相反，它动态地将反应转向 Langmuir-Hinshelwood (LH) 机制，在固定的弱碱性微环境 (pH ≈ 10.5) 内优化表面结合 *H 的可用性。因此，我们的膜电极组件在 200 mA cm-2 下实现了 >64% 的乙醇法拉第效率，在 pH = 1 电解液中稳定性 >350 小时。这阐明了界面氢键网络在决定质子偶联机制中的关键作用，为途径特异性酸性电合成提供了范例。

title: Balancing N 2 Activation in Two-Dimensional Electrides for Ammonia Synthesis
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Two-dimensional (2D) electrides, featuring interlayer-delocalized anionic electrons, hold promise for N2 activation but face challenges in catalytic ammonia synthesis due to structural instability under reaction conditions. Here, we introduce a dual-site catalyst using the robust 2D metal carbide Y2C electride as a platform, where N2 is activated at electron-rich interlayers and H2 dissociates on supported Ni nanoparticles, enabling efficient and stable ammonia production. Through Raman spectroscopy, XPS, and DFT calculations, we uncover a scaling relationship for N2 activation in 2D electrides: intermediate N2 binding strength correlates with the formation of reactive (N2)δ- intermediates, crucial for efficient NH3 production. Leveraging this insight, La-doped Y2C (La-Y2C) optimizes N2 activation, and the Ni/La-Y2C catalyst achieves an exceptional activity of 34.6 mmol·g-1·h-1 at 400 °C and 1.0 MPa, surpassing reported Ni-based catalysts, the benchmark Cs-Ru/MgO, and industrial wüstite-based Fe under identical conditions. These findings provide a rational framework for designing advanced 2D electrides for controllable N2 activation and sustainable ammonia synthesis.
title_zh: 平衡氨合成二维电子化合物中的 N 2 活化
abstract_zh: 二维（2D）电子化合物具有层间离域阴离子电子，有望用于 N2 活化，但由于反应条件下的结构不稳定，在催化氨合成中面临挑战。在这里，我们引入了一种双中心催化剂，使用坚固的二维金属碳化物Y2C电子化合物作为平台，其中N2在富电子夹层上被激活，H2在负载的Ni纳米粒子上解离，从而实现高效稳定的氨生产。通过拉曼光谱、XPS 和 DFT 计算，我们揭示了二维电子化合物中 N2 活化的比例关系：中间 N2 结合强度与反应性 (N2)δ- 中间体的形成相关，这对于高效 NH3 生产至关重要。利用这一见解，La掺杂Y2C (La-Y2C)优化了N2活化，并且Ni/La-Y2C催化剂在400 °C和1.0 MPa下实现了34.6 mmol·g-1·h-1的优异活性，在相同条件下超越了报道的镍基催化剂、基准Cs-Ru/MgO和工业方铁矿基Fe。这些发现为设计先进的二维电子化合物以实现可控氮气活化和可持续氨合成提供了合理的框架。

title: Fluorination of White Phosphorus with Fluoride Salts and Quinone Oxidants
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: We report the synthesis of hexafluorophosphate (PF6-) salts directly from white phosphorus (P4) and simple fluorides MF (M = Li, Na, K, Cs, NMe4) in a single step. The utilization of p-quinones, such as 2,3-dichloro-4,5-dicyano-1,4-benzoquinone (DDQ) offers a selective fluorination pathway, which affords MPF6 salts in up to 95% yield in acetonitrile (MeCN). NMR investigations of the DDQ-mediated P4 fluorination reaction revealed the formation of PF3 and PF5·MeCN as key reaction intermediates. Donor-acceptor interactions between DDQ and fluoride are critical, effectively increasing the fluoride concentration and enabling efficient fluorination to PF6-. Tetraethylene glycol (TEG) selectively stops the reaction at the adduct K[PF5·TEG]. In contrast, noncoordinating dichloromethane (DCM) favors PF3 formation by suppressing EDA interactions through low fluoride solubility, possibly via the tris(hydroquinonyl)phosphite P(DDQH)3, underscoring the critical role of fluoride solubility. This work demonstrates that quinone-fluoride interactions can be exploited for oxidative fluorination chemistry, establishing a new conceptual framework for P4 fluorination.
title_zh: 用氟化物盐和醌氧化剂氟化白磷
abstract_zh: 我们报告了直接从白磷 (P4) 和简单氟化物 MF（M = Li、Na、K、Cs、NMe4）一步合成六氟磷酸盐 (PF6-) 盐。对醌的利用，如 2,3-二氯-4,5-二氰基-1,4-苯醌 (DDQ) 提供了一种选择性氟化途径，在乙腈 (MeCN) 中以高达 95% 的产率提供 MPF6 盐。 DDQ 介导的 P4 氟化反应的 NMR 研究揭示了 PF3 和 PF5·MeCN 作为关键反应中间体的形成。 DDQ 和氟化物之间的供体-受体相互作用至关重要，可有效提高氟化物浓度并实现高效氟化为 PF6-。四乙二醇 (TEG) 选择性地终止加合物 K[PF5·TEG] 处的反应。相比之下，非配位二氯甲烷 (DCM) 通过低氟化物溶解度（可能通过三（氢醌基）亚磷酸酯 P(DDQH)3）抑制 EDA 相互作用，从而有利于 PF3 的形成，这强调了氟化物溶解度的关键作用。这项工作表明，醌-氟化物相互作用可用于氧化氟化化学，为 P4 氟化建立了新的概念框架。

title: Few-femtosecond photoelectron spectroscopy reveals fundamental photodynamics of the carbon-carbon double bond in ethylene
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Conjugated π-systems, often composed of carbon-carbon double bonds as key structural units, are among the most important organic chromophores and serve as prototypical systems for studying ππ* excitation. Their ultrafast excited-state dynamics govern the outcomes of fundamental photochemical processes, including vision, photoisomerization, photosynthesis, and solar energy conversion. Here, we investigate the ultrafast dynamics of the simplest isolated C=C chromophore, ethylene, and its per-deuterated isotopologue using broadly tunable sub-4 femtosecond pulses in the 150-200 nm range combined with time-resolved photoelectron spectroscopy. Supported by advanced quantum dynamics calculations, our results reveal the important role of the 1B3g(σπ*) state, which is strongly coupled through torsional motion to the optically populated 1B1u(ππ*) state. These findings establish a revised framework for understanding and controlling photochemical reaction in conjugated molecular systems.
title_zh: 几飞秒光电子能谱揭示了乙烯中碳-碳双键的基本光动力学
abstract_zh: 共轭 π 系统通常由碳-碳双键作为关键结构单元组成，是最重要的有机发色团之一，是研究 ππ* 激发的原型系统。它们的超快激发态动力学控制着基本光化学过程的结果，包括视觉、光异构化、光合作用和太阳能转换。在这里，我们使用 150-200 nm 范围内广泛可调的亚 4 飞秒脉冲与时间分辨光电子能谱相结合，研究了最简单的分离 C=C 发色团、乙烯及其全氘化同位素体的超快动力学。在先进的量子动力学计算的支持下，我们的结果揭示了 1B3g(σπ*) 态的重要作用，它通过扭转运动与光学填充的 1B1u(ππ*) 态强耦合。这些发现为理解和控制共轭分子系统中的光化学反应建立了一个修订的框架。

title: Immunostimulatory lipogel implant enhances cancer immunotherapy
source: Nature Nanotechnology
abstract: Cancer stem-like cells contribute to innate tumour immunoresistance and an immunosuppressive tumour microenvironment, leading to poor responses to immune checkpoint inhibitors. Chemotherapeutic agents can elicit tumour immunogenicity by inducing immunogenic cell death to reinforce the therapeutic efficacies of immune checkpoint inhibitors, but suffer from inefficient immunogenic cell death activation in highly resistant cancer stem-like cells. Here we report an immunostimulatory lyotropic liquid-crystal-based lipogel for localized co-delivery of all-trans retinoic acid, a differentiation-inducing drug, and doxorubicin, an immunogenic-cell-death-inducing chemotherapeutic agent with distinct release kinetics. The lipogel is tailored to release the combinatorial drugs in a differential and sustained manner, which fulfils the requirement for enhanced drug synergism in promoting the immunogenic cell death of cancer stem-like cells. Local implantation of the immunostimulatory lipogel elicits an antitumour immune response that is further augmented by an immune checkpoint inhibitor to suppress tumour growth and metastasis, as well as to prevent post-surgical recurrence in murine models of high-stemness tumours.
title_zh: 免疫刺激脂质凝胶植入物增强癌症免疫治疗
abstract_zh: 癌症干细胞样细胞有助于先天性肿瘤免疫抵抗和免疫抑制肿瘤微环境，导致对免疫检查点抑制剂的反应不佳。化疗药物可以通过诱导免疫原性细胞死亡来引发肿瘤免疫原性，以增强免疫检查点抑制剂的治疗效果，但在高度耐药的癌症干细胞样细胞中，免疫原性细胞死亡激活效率较低。在这里，我们报道了一种基于免疫刺激溶致液晶的脂质凝胶，用于局部共同递送全反式视黄酸（一种分化诱导药物）和多柔比星（一种具有不同释放动力学的免疫原性细胞死亡诱导化疗剂）。脂质凝胶经过定制，以差异化和持续的方式释放组合药物，满足增强药物协同作用以促进癌症干细胞样细胞的免疫原性细胞死亡的要求。免疫刺激脂质凝胶的局部植入会引发抗肿瘤免疫反应，免疫检查点抑制剂进一步增强该反应，以抑制肿瘤生长和转移，并防止高干细胞肿瘤小鼠模型的术后复发。

title: Mafic-ultramafic igneous rocks as a source of reactive phosphorus for the origin of life
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Phosphite and pyrophosphate—reduced and polymerized forms of phosphorus—may have played a central role in prebiotic chemistry owing to their higher reactivity and solubility, yet their geological sources remain uncertain. Here we show that mafic–ultramafic rocks on the early Earth could have provided a sustained source of reactive phosphorus through seafloor weathering. Rock analyses from 15 localities reveal phosphite comprising up to 7%, 24%, 17%, and 0.6% of total phosphorus in olivine separates, peridotite, komatiite, and basalt, respectively, while pyrophosphate accounts for up to 5% and 0.4% in komatiite and basalt. Box-model calculations indicate phosphite concentrations reaching up to 1 µM in the deep ocean and up to 67 µM in lakes under low-UV conditions. We suggest that reactive phosphorus released from mafic–ultramafic rocks could have fuelled prebiotic phosphorylation and supplied phosphate to emerging life on Earth, a process that may also enhance the habitability of other planetary bodies.
title_zh: 镁铁质-超镁铁质火成岩作为生命起源的活性磷来源
abstract_zh: 亚磷酸盐和焦磷酸盐（磷的还原形式和聚合形式）由于其较高的反应性和溶解度，可能在生命起源化学中发挥着核心作用，但它们的地质来源仍然不确定。在这里，我们表明，早期地球上的镁铁质-超镁铁质岩石可能通过海底风化提供了活性磷的持续来源。 15 个地点的岩石分析显示，橄榄石分离物、橄榄岩、科马提岩和玄武岩中，亚磷酸盐含量分别高达 7%、24%、17% 和 0.6%，而焦磷酸盐在科马提岩和玄武岩中的含量分别高达 5% 和 0.4%。盒模型计算表明，在低紫外线条件下，深海中的亚磷酸盐浓度高达 1 µM，湖泊中的亚磷酸盐浓度高达 67 µM。我们认为，镁铁质-超镁铁质岩石释放的活性磷可能促进了生命前的磷酸化，并为地球上的新兴生命提供磷酸盐，这一过程也可能增强其他行星体的宜居性。

title: Anisotropic core–shell ceramic nanofibrous membrane with improved optical reflectivity and thermal insulation for high-energy laser protection
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The development of multifunctionally coupled materials that can adapt to complex thermophotonic environments is increasingly critical for next-generation aerospace, defense, and high-energy laser applications. Ceramic nanofibers, though inherently robust, often struggle to reconcile optical reflectivity with directional thermal management under extreme conditions. Here, we present a core–shell ceramic nanofibrous membrane, comprising a mesoporous silica shell and a crystalline boron nitride core, which exhibits dynamic thermal-optical functionality tailored to high-flux laser exposure. By virtue of dual-channel electrospinning and calcination, the structure achieves high reflectivity (≈ 100% at 1064 nm) while enabling anisotropic thermal conduction—rapidly dissipating heat in the membrane plane while insulating through its thickness. This functional decoupling at the single-fiber level empowers the membrane to maintain mechanical and structural integrity above 1500 °C, outperforming conventional ceramic or polymer systems in both laser shielding and thermal resilience. Moreover, the membrane demonstrates a compressive elasticity of 95% strain, a tensile strength of ≈ 20 MPa, and structural stability under a real-time laser impact. By introducing a design strategy that couples optical scattering with spatially controlled heat flow, this work provides an effective pathway for designing adaptive ceramic nanofiber systems engineered to thrive in complex, coupled-mechanism environments.
title_zh: 具有改进的光学反射率和隔热性的各向异性核壳陶瓷纳米纤维膜，用于高能激光防护
abstract_zh: 开发能够适应复杂热光子环境的多功能耦合材料对于下一代航空航天、国防和高能激光应用越来越重要。陶瓷纳米纤维虽然本质上很坚固，但在极端条件下往往很难协调光学反射率与定向热管理。在这里，我们提出了一种核壳陶瓷纳米纤维膜，由介孔二氧化硅壳和结晶氮化硼核组成，它表现出适合高通量激光曝光的动态热光功能。凭借双通道静电纺丝和煅烧，该结构实现了高反射率（在 1064 nm 处约为 100%），同时实现各向异性热传导，即在膜平面中快速散热，同时通过其厚度进行绝缘。这种单纤维水平的功能解耦使膜能够在 1500°C 以上保持机械和结构完整性，在激光屏蔽和热弹性方面优于传统陶瓷或聚合物系统。此外，该膜表现出95%应变的压缩弹性、约20 MPa的拉伸强度以及实时激光冲击下的结构稳定性。通过引入将光学散射与空间控制热流耦合的设计策略，这项工作为设计自适应陶瓷纳米纤维系统提供了一条有效的途径，该系统旨在在复杂的耦合机制环境中蓬勃发展。

title: Nanofiber-like polar configurations enable ultrahigh energy storage in relaxor ferroelectrics via high-entropy design
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Dielectric capacitors are highly promising for advanced power electronics due to their superior power density. However, their widespread application has been limited by inadequate energy storage performance. In this work, we propose a distinct strategy, centered on creating a nanofiber-like polar configuration, to achieve ultrahigh energy storage performance in relaxor ferroelectrics. This is realized through a high-entropy composition design in NaNbO3-based perovskites, where multiple cations with significant ferroelectric activity and ionic radius differences are introduced at both A- and B-sites. This approach effectively disrupts the long-range ferroelectric and antiferrodistortive orders simultaneously. The resulting nanofiber-like domain structure, which features several nanometers in length but only a few unit cells in width, exhibits a low-hysteresis and nearly linear polarization response to applied electric field (E). Consequently, an exceptional energy storage density (Wrec) of ~19.3 J cm−3, a high efficiency (η) of ~95.2%, and an impressive Wrec/E coefficient of 208 J kV mm−3 are simultaneously achieved in the NaNbO3-(Bi0.5Li0.5)(Ti0.8Zr0.1Sn0.1)O3 multilayer ceramic capacitors. These results underscore the immense potential of the nanofiber-like polar configuration strategy for developing high-performance dielectric energy storage materials.
title_zh: 类似纳米纤维的极性配置通过高熵设计在弛豫铁电体中实现超高能量存储
abstract_zh: 介电电容器由于其卓越的功率密度而在先进电力电子领域非常有前景。然而，它们的广泛应用受到储能性能不足的限制。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种独特的策略，以创建类似纳米纤维的极性配置为中心，以实现弛豫铁电体的超高储能性能。这是通过 NaNbO3 基钙钛矿的高熵成分设计实现的，其中在 A 和 B 位点引入具有显着铁电活性和离子半径差异的多种阳离子。这种方法有效地同时破坏了长程铁电和反铁畸变秩序。由此产生的纳米纤维状域结构，其长度为几纳米，但宽度只有几个晶胞，对施加的电场（E）表现出低磁滞和近线性偏振响应。因此，NaNbO3-(Bi0.5Li0.5)(Ti0.8Zr0.1Sn0.1)O3多层陶瓷电容器同时实现了~19.3 J cm−3的优异能量存储密度(Wrec)、~95.2%的高效率(η)和208 J kV mm−3的令人印象深刻的Wrec/E系数。这些结果强调了类纳米纤维极性配置策略在开发高性能介电储能材料方面的巨大潜力。

title: Structural inequality shapes the daily rhythm of stationarity and mobility
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Human mobility exhibits rhythmic patterns that shape economic activity, social interactions, and access to essential services. Yet, while prior studies focus on spatial movement, the temporal structure of people’s stationarity—the act of dwelling—remains underexplored. Here, we introduce the Stationarity Sinusoidal Stability (STASIS) model to quantify the daily pulse of physical presence. Using three parameters—range, phase angle, and baseline—we show that majority-Black census block groups (CBGs) have smaller daily stationarity ranges, later activity peaks, and lower average home-presence baselines than majority-White and majority-Hispanic CBGs. The Rhythm Stability Index further indicates greater variability in activity timing among CBGs with higher proportions of Black residents, and this variability is associated with CBG-level economic precarity. Using COVID-19 as a stress test, our findings show that temporal stability in daily mobility rhythms differs across CBGs with different racial and Hispanic-origin compositions.
title_zh: 结构性不平等塑造了固定性和流动性的日常节奏
abstract_zh: 人员流动呈现出影响经济活动、社会互动和获得基本服务的节奏模式。然而，虽然先前的研究集中在空间运动，但人们静止性的时间结构（居住行为）仍然没有得到充分探索。在这里，我们引入平稳正弦稳定性 (STASIS) 模型来量化物理存在的每日脉动。使用范围、相位角和基线这三个参数，我们发现黑人占多数的人口普查区块组 (CBG) 比白人和西班牙裔占多数的人口普查区块组 (CBG) 具有更小的每日平稳性范围、更晚的活动峰值以及更低的平均家庭存在基线。节奏稳定性指数进一步表明，黑人居民比例较高的 CBG 之间的活动时间变异性更大，并且这种变异性与 CBG 水平的经济不稳定相关。使用 COVID-19 作为压力测试，我们的研究结果表明，具有不同种族和西班牙裔血统的 CBG 的每日流动节律的时间稳定性有所不同。

title: Miniature Dungey-like cycle at Mars
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: With its non-uniform distribution of crustal magnetic fields, Mars exhibits complex and highly variable auroral patterns related to both planetary rotation and solar wind conditions. Using in situ electron, ion, and magnetic field data from the Mars Atmospheric and Volatile EvolutioN (MAVEN) mission, we show that auroral processes associated with these small-scale crustal magnetic fields can be understood in terms of a miniature cycle of magnetic flux and plasma circulations that resemble a miniature version of what occurs at the Earth. However, at Earth, this Dungey cycle, named after its discoverer, operates in the presence of a global intrinsic dipole field with a strength approximately 100 times stronger and spatial scales roughly 20 times larger. From a universal perspective, the current finding adds an entry to the zoo of auroral concepts that enriches our understanding of the diversity of (exo)planetary plasma and our understanding of how planets interact with their space environments.
title_zh: 火星上的微型邓吉循环
abstract_zh: 由于地壳磁场分布不均匀，火星呈现出与行星自转和太阳风条件相关的复杂且高度可变的极光模式。利用来自火星大气和挥发物演化（MAVEN）任务的原位电子、离子和磁场数据，我们表明，与这些小规模地壳磁场相关的极光过程可以用磁通量和等离子体循环的微型循环来理解，类似于地球上发生的情况的微型版本。然而，在地球上，这个以其发现者命名的邓吉循环是在全球固有偶极场的存在下运行的，该偶极场的强度大约是原来的 100 倍，空间尺度大约是原来的 20 倍。从普遍的角度来看，当前的发现为极光概念的动物园增加了一个入口，丰富了我们对（外）行星等离子体多样性的理解，以及我们对行星如何与其空间环境相互作用的理解。

title: Electronically coupled Co single atoms with Co-Pd alloy catalyst for high-performance rechargeable hydrazine-assisted Zn−Air batteries
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Zinc−air batteries are promising devices for use in safe and cost-effective energy storage applications. However, their practical utility is hindered by sluggish oxygen evolution and oxygen reduction reactions. We show that hybridizing electronically coupled Co single atoms and a CoPd alloy within a three-dimensional macroporous N-doped carbon (CoPd/Co@3D NC) enables high-performance N2H4-assisted zinc−air batteries, where the oxygen evolution reaction is replaced with the thermodynamically more favorable hydrazine oxidation reaction. Experimental and theoretical data reveal that electronic coupling between the Co single atoms and the CoPd alloy mutually modifies their electronic structures, which, in turn, weakens oxygen adsorption on the Co single atoms and enhances N2H4 adsorption on the Pd sites. The electronic-coupling effect accelerates the rate-limiting steps of the oxygen evolution and hydrazine oxidation reactions. Consequently, N2H4-assisted zinc−air batteries employing CoPd/Co@3D NC exhibit a small charging/discharging voltage gap of 0.52 V at 100 mA cm−2, a peak specific power of 151 mW cm−2, and a specific capacity of 810 mAh g−1 at 10 mA cm−2; these values are competitive when compared to those exhibited by conventional zinc−air batteries.
title_zh: Co-Pd合金催化剂电子耦合Co单原子用于高性能可充电肼辅助锌空气电池
abstract_zh: 锌空气电池是用于安全且具有成本效益的储能应用的有前途的设备。然而，它们的实际用途受到缓慢的析氧和氧还原反应的阻碍。我们证明，在三维大孔氮掺杂碳（CoPd/Co@3D NC）中混合电子耦合的Co单原子和CoPd合金可以实现高性能N2H4辅助的锌空气电池，其中析氧反应被热力学上更有利的肼氧化反应所取代。实验和理论数据表明，Co单原子和CoPd合金之间的电子耦合相互改变了它们的电子结构，从而削弱了Co单原子上的氧吸附，增强了Pd位点上的N2H4吸附。电子耦合效应加速了析氧和肼氧化反应的限速步骤。因此，采用CoPd/Co@3D NC的N2H4辅助锌空气电池在100 mA cm−2下表现出0.52 V的小充放电电压间隙，在10 mA cm−2下表现出151 mW cm−2的峰值比功率和810 mAh g−1的比容量；与传统的锌空气电池相比，这些值具有竞争力。

title: Entanglement-enhanced learning of quantum processes at scale
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Learning unknown noise processes in quantum systems reveals their physical origin and informs error suppression, mitigation, and correction. Characterizing a general quantum process requires exponentially many parameters inferred from noncommuting measurements. Because these measurements cannot be performed simultaneously, the sample complexity grows exponentially. For Pauli channels, quantum memory and entangling operations can transform this task into measurements of commuting observables, reducing complexity exponentially. However, noise in these resources increases the overhead, leaving open whether any advantage remains in realistic devices. Here, we introduce error-mitigated entanglement-enhanced learning, analyze it theoretically, and demonstrate it experimentally. We quantify the noise-induced overhead, perform hypothesis testing with up to 64 qubits, and learn intrinsic noise in parallel-gate layers using up to 16 qubits of a superconducting processor. We show that noisy quantum memory provides a learning advantage, with a current experimental overhead of 1.33 ± 0.05 per qubit, below the no-entanglement lower bound of 2.
title_zh: 大规模量子过程的纠缠增强学习
abstract_zh: 学习量子系统中的未知噪声过程揭示了它们的物理起源并告知错误抑制、减轻和纠正。表征一般量子过程需要从非交换测量中推断出指数级的许多参数。由于这些测量不能同时进行，样本的复杂性呈指数级增长。对于泡利通道，量子存储和纠缠操作可以将这项任务转化为对通勤可观测量的测量，从而以指数方式降低复杂性。然而，这些资源中的噪声会增加开销，从而使实际设备是否仍具有任何优势尚不确定。在这里，我们介绍了误差减轻纠缠增强学习，对其进行了理论分析，并进行了实验演示。我们量化噪声引起的开销，使用最多 64 个量子位执行假设检验，并使用最多 16 个量子位的超导处理器学习并行门层中的固有噪声。我们证明，噪声量子存储器具有学习优势，当前实验开销为每量子位 1.33 ± 0.05，低于无纠缠下限 2。

title: A programmable living force sensor fabricated with surface engineered microbial network
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Engineered living materials have recently expanded into the field of bioelectronics when incorporating the rationally rewired microbes inside. Integrating living materials with force sensing provides an alternative route to overcome limitations of traditional sensors, such as fragility and stretching-sensitivity. Here, we present a programmable living force sensor fabricated by surface engineered microbial network with a bottom-up design for human-machine interfaces. Bacterial cells are genetically rewired to display surface-anchored affinity pairs that mediate the assembly of bacteria to macroscale. Functioning as the conductive and sensing layer, the microbial network is encapsulated in elastic tubes to fabricate the macroscopic force sensor. The resulting living sensor features a tunable measuring range, rapid self-recovery capacity within tens of milliseconds, and remarkably, excellent stretching-insensitivity with only ~30% increase in resistance under 800% of elongation. This bio-integrated approach enables microbes to prepare robust and reconfigurable force sensor suitable for tensile, dynamic and extreme mechanical conditions.
title_zh: 采用表面工程微生物网络制造的可编程生命力传感器
abstract_zh: 工程活性材料最近已扩展到生物电子领域，因为其中包含了合理重新布线的微生物。将生物材料与力传感相结合，提供了一种克服传统传感器局限性（例如脆弱性和拉伸敏感性）的替代途径。在这里，我们提出了一种由表面工程微生物网络制造的可编程生命力传感器，具有自下而上的人机界面设计。细菌细胞经过基因重组，以显示表面锚定的亲和对，介导细菌的宏观组装。作为导电和传感层，微生物网络被封装在弹性管中以制造宏观力传感器。由此产生的活体传感器具有可调节的测量范围、数十毫秒内的快速自我恢复能力以及出色的拉伸不敏感性，在 800% 伸长率下电阻仅增加约 30%。这种生物集成方法使微生物能够制备出坚固且可重构的力传感器，适用于拉伸、动态和极端机械条件。

title: Key role of continental inorganic halogens in the evolution of global air quality
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Halogen (chlorine, bromine, and iodine) species actively interact with other atmospheric constituents such as nitrogen oxides, organic gases, and ozone. Previous field observations confirmed the ubiquitous existence of halogens in various environments and modeling simulations quantified halogen impacts on air pollutants at present time. However, the abundance and impacts of continental inorganic halogens (CIH) on global air quality throughout history remain unexplored. Here, we present a global inventory of CIH emissions from anthropogenic and biomass-burning sources from 1970 to 2015, with average fluxes of 4302, 207, and 98 kt/yr for chlorine, bromine, and iodine, respectively, representing ~15%, 5-10%, and ~3% of the corresponding global short-lived chlorine, bromine, and iodine emissions. Incorporating these emissions into a global chemistry-climate model reveals a substantial increase ( > 50%) in inorganic halogen levels over continents, helping to reproduce the observed halogen levels. Our results also suggest substantial effects of CIH on air pollutant concentrations with significant spatio-temporal variations, e.g., the largest perturbations in nitrogen oxides and secondary aerosols migrating from Europe and North America in the 1980s-1990s, to East Asia in the 2000s, then to South Asia in the 2010s, suggesting a movement of CIH-associated air quality impact hotspots from the developed regions to the developing areas. This study highlights the under-appreciated role of halogen chemistry in air quality and its evolution in the recent four decades and calls for attention to the potential CIH impacts in emerging regions where field observations are not yet available.
title_zh: 大陆无机卤素在全球空气质量演变中的关键作用
abstract_zh: 卤素（氯、溴和碘）与氮氧化物、有机气体和臭氧等其他大气成分发生积极的相互作用。先前的现场观察证实了卤素在各种环境中普遍存在，并且建模模拟量化了目前卤素对空气污染物的影响。然而，历史上大陆无机卤素 (CIH) 的丰度及其对全球空气质量的影响仍未得到探索。在这里，我们列出了 1970 年至 2015 年人为和生物质燃烧来源的 CIH 排放清单，其中氯、溴和碘的平均通量分别为 4302、207 和 98 kt/年，分别占相应全球短期氯、溴和碘排放量的约 15%、5-10% 和约 3%。将这些排放纳入全球化学气候模型显示各大洲无机卤素水平大幅增加（> 50%），有助于重现观测到的卤素水平。我们的研究结果还表明，CIH对空气污染物浓度的显着影响具有显着的时空变化，例如，氮氧化物和二次气溶胶的最大扰动在1980年代至1990年代从欧洲和北美迁移到2000年代东亚，然后在2010年代迁移到南亚，这表明与CIH相关的空气质量影响热点从发达地区向发展中地区移动。这项研究强调了卤素化学在空气质量中未被充分认识的作用及其近四十年来的演变，并呼吁关注

title: Controllable patterning of magnetic bits with atomically sharp boundaries
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Magnetic information bits in magnetic media are approaching their fundamental thermodynamic limits, creating an urgent need for high-precision nanoscale fabrication methods. Here we establish a proof-of-concept demonstration for fabricating, controlling, and testing closely spaced individual magnetic bits at the nanometre scale. An aberration-corrected atomic-sized electron probe directly sculpts ferrimagnetic (FM) spinel NiFe2O4 bits within an antiferromagnetic (AFM) rock-salt spacer by beam-induced phase transition. Through in situ nanobeam electron magnetic circular dichroism (EMCD), which probes the out-of-plane magnetization component, we perform single-domain magnetometry. This demonstrates detectable magnetic signals from a domain with a lateral width of ~4 nm, thermodynamically supported by the surrounding AFM matrix via exchange bias coupling. Furthermore, we achieve the deterministic writing of binary information (“1” and “0”) by reversing the localized magnetization direction of individual FM bits under an applied external magnetic field. By establishing a complete, closed-loop workflow from atomic-scale fabrication to single-bit magnetic readout, this study demonstrates a pathway toward engineering future high-density magnetic architectures.
title_zh: 具有原子级尖锐边界的磁性位的可控图案
abstract_zh: 磁性介质中的磁性信息位正在接近其基本热力学极限，迫切需要高精度纳米级制造方法。在这里，我们建立了一个概念验证演示，用于在纳米尺度上制造、控制和测试紧密间隔的单个磁性位。像差校正的原子尺寸电子探针通过束诱导相变直接在反铁磁 (AFM) 岩盐垫片内雕刻亚铁磁 (FM) 尖晶石 NiFe2O4 钻头。通过原位纳米束电子磁圆二色性（EMCD）探测平面外磁化分量，我们进行了单域磁力测量。这表明来自横向宽度约为 4 nm 的域的可检测磁信号，通过交换偏置耦合由周围 AFM 矩阵提供热力学支持。此外，我们通过在施加的外部磁场下反转各个FM位的局部磁化方向来实现二进制信息（“1”和“0”）的确定性写入。通过建立从原子级制造到单位磁读出的完整闭环工作流程，这项研究展示了设计未来高密度磁性架构的途径。

title: Ultrafast reconfigurable topological-modulators-based photonic processing accelerator
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The rise of artificial intelligence has triggered exponential growth in data volume, demanding rapid and efficient processing. High-speed, energy-efficient, and parallel-scalable computing hardware is thus increasingly critical. We demonstrate a wafer-scale non-volatile photonic computing chip using topological modulators. Leveraging the GHz-speed electro-optic response and nonvolatility of ferroelectric lead zirconate titanate (PZT) thin films via topological photonic confinement, our chip enables 1,000× accelerated reconfiguration, near-zero static-power operation, and a computational density of 266 trillion operations per second per square millimeter (TOPS/mm²). A 16-channel wavelength-space multiplexed chip delivers 1.92 TOPS throughput with 95.64% digit-recognition accuracy and 94.5% precision for solving time-varying partial differential equations. Additionally, the chip supports functional reconfiguration for high bandwidth density optical I/O. This work establishes ferroelectric topological photonics for efficient high-speed photonic tensor processing.
title_zh: 基于超快可重构拓扑调制器的光子处理加速器
abstract_zh: 人工智能的兴起引发了数据量的指数级增长，需要快速高效的处理。因此，高速、节能且可并行扩展的计算硬件变得越来越重要。我们展示了使用拓扑调制器的晶圆级非易失性光子计算芯片。通过拓扑光子限制，利用铁电锆钛酸铅 (PZT) 薄膜的 GHz 速度电光响应和非易失性，我们的芯片可实现 1,000 倍加速重构、近零静态功耗操作以及每平方毫米每秒 266 万亿次操作 (TOPS/mm²) 的计算密度。 16 通道波长空间复用芯片可提供 1.92 TOPS 的吞吐量、95.64% 的数字识别精度和 94.5% 的时变偏微分方程求解精度。此外，该芯片还支持高带宽密度光纤 I/O 的功能重新配置。这项工作建立了铁电拓扑光子学，以实现高效的高速光子张量处理。

title: A bioorthogonal nanoconcentrisome system for epigenetic and immunometabolic reprogramming of tissue regeneration in aged female rats
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Stem cell–based therapies show promise for tissue regeneration but are limited by therapeutic instability, particularly in aged tissues. Here, multi-omics profiling of regenerating bone reveals marked depletion of S-adenosylmethionine (SAM), indicating epigenetic dysregulation associated with impaired repair. To address this, we develop a spatially compartmentalized, fusogenic nanovesicle system (SMNV), termed a “nanoconcentrisome,” composed of SAM-loaded fusogenic liposomes encapsulating mesenchymal stem cell–derived nanovesicles (MNV). This dual-compartment architecture facilitates cytosolic delivery of cargos through membrane fusion with limited lysosomal involvement. In macrophages, SMNV attenuates inflammatory activation and promotes efferocytosis and metabolic reprogramming, while in senescent stem cells it enhances epigenetic integrity, mitochondrial function and osteogenic differentiation. Through coordinated modulation of immune and progenitor cell states, SMNV significantly enhances tissue regeneration and effectively repairs bone defects in aged female rats, highlighting a precision nanomedicine platform that integrates metabolic–epigenetic regulation with cell-free regenerative signaling to counteract ageing-associated regenerative decline.
title_zh: 用于老年雌性大鼠组织再生的表观遗传和免疫代谢重编程的生物正交纳米中心体系统
abstract_zh: 基于干细胞的疗法显示出组织再生的希望，但受到治疗不稳定的限制，特别是在老化组织中。在这里，再生骨的多组学分析揭示了 S-腺苷甲硫氨酸 (SAM) 的显着消耗，表明与修复受损相关的表观遗传失调。为了解决这个问题，我们开发了一种空间分隔的融合纳米囊泡系统（SMNV），称为“纳米中心体”，由装载 SAM 的融合脂质体组成，封装间充质干细胞衍生的纳米囊泡（MNV）。这种双室结构有利于通过膜融合在细胞质中传递货物，而溶酶体的参与有限。在巨噬细胞中，SMNV 减弱炎症激活并促进胞吞作用和代谢重编程，而在衰老干细胞中，它增强表观遗传完整性、线粒体功能和成骨分化。通过协调调节免疫和祖细胞状态，SMNV 显着增强组织再生并有效修复老年雌性大鼠的骨缺损，突出了一个精密纳米医学平台，该平台将代谢表观遗传调节与无细胞再生信号传导相结合，以抵消与衰老相关的再生衰退。

title: A fully integrated smart ring for daily biochemical monitoring
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Biochemical analysis complements biophysical measurements by capturing the underlying molecular and metabolic changes that drive physiological health. Here, we introduce a compact, fully integrated smart ring capable of simultaneously monitoring multiple chemical biomarkers in real-time — marking a true biochemical counterpart to existing smart rings. Our ring can continuously measure glucose, ketone, ascorbic acid, uric acid, lactate, and alcohol from passive osmotically extracted sweat, is powered by custom-built high-capacity flexible Zn-AgO batteries, and comprises ultra-compact, energy-efficient electronics for data processing and wireless transmission. It can support ~12 hours of continuous monitoring and preserves personalized calibration stability for ~2 months. The simultaneous biomarker monitoring was validated under diverse daily settings. Reliable, continuous monitoring of glucose and ketone levels showed strong agreement with commercial blood meters and continuous glucose monitors in both healthy and type 1 diabetic individuals, confirming the ring’s accuracy even for at-risk population. Overall, our ring extends beyond commercial smart rings focusing on only biophysical signals, by enabling continuous assessment of biochemical changes and advancing the development of next generation personalized and miniaturized healthcare technologies.
title_zh: 用于日常生化监测的完全集成智能环
abstract_zh: 生化分析通过捕获驱动生理健康的潜在分子和代谢变化来补充生物物理测量。在这里，我们推出了一款紧凑、完全集成的智能环，能够同时实时监测多种化学生物标记物，这标志着现有智能环真正的生化对应物。我们的环可以连续测量被动渗透提取汗液中的葡萄糖、酮、抗坏血酸、尿酸、乳酸和酒精，由定制的高容量柔性 Zn-AgO 电池供电，并包含用于数据处理和无线传输的超紧凑、节能电子设备。它可以支持约 12 小时的连续监测，并保持个性化校准稳定性约 2 个月。同步生物标志物监测在不同的日常环境下得到了验证。对健康和 1 型糖尿病患者的葡萄糖和酮水平进行可靠、连续的监测，结果与商用血仪和连续血糖监测仪的结果非常一致，证实了该环的准确性，即使对于高危人群也是如此。总体而言，我们的环超越了仅关注生物物理信号的商业智能环，能够持续评估生化变化并推动下一代个性化和小型医疗保健技术的开发。

title: Bioinspired porous metal-amino acid nanozymes enable multi-pathway treatment of atherosclerosis through anti-oxidation and pro-efferocytosis
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Atherosclerosis is characterized by chronic inflammation, persistent oxidative stress, intimal lipid accumulation, and impaired efferocytosis within plaques. Here, we develop a copper-based porous nanozyme assembled through metal-amino acid coordination (MAzyme) for loading an inhibitor of the antiphagocytic CD47-SIRPα signaling pathway and cloaking with macropahge membrane. The resulting biomimetic nanoplatform (MMAzyme-S) inherits both the multi-enzymatic activities of the porous nanozyme and the inflammation-homing features of the biomembranes. The prominent antioxidant effects of MAzyme, comparable to those of natural superoxide dismutase, enable efficient inflammatory resolution via the elimination of reactive oxygen species. Our findings also demonstrate that MMAzyme-S can block CD47-mediated anti-phagocytosis to restore impaired efferocytosis in lesional macrophages, thereby boosting the phagocytic clearance of apoptotic cells. Additionally, cholesterol transport pathways are strengthened through synergistic antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, which profoundly reduce foam cell formation and plaque burden. Consequently, with the distinctive advantages of homologous inflammation targeting and multilink intervention in pathogenesis, MMAzyme-S reduces atherosclerotic plaque burden in male ApoE−/− mice. This study highlights the potential of biomimetic porous MAzyme with combined antioxidant and pro-efferocytosis activities as a multifaceted intervention strategy against atherosclerosis.
title_zh: 仿生多孔金属氨基酸纳米酶通过抗氧化和促胞吞作用实现动脉粥样硬化的多途径治疗
abstract_zh: 动脉粥样硬化的特征是慢性炎症、持续的氧化应激、内膜脂质积累和斑块内胞吞作用受损。在这里，我们开发了一种通过金属-氨基酸配位组装的铜基多孔纳米酶（MAzyme），用于负载抗吞噬细胞 CD47-SIRPα 信号通路的抑制剂并用巨噬细胞膜包裹。由此产生的仿生纳米平台（MMAzyme-S）继承了多孔纳米酶的多酶活性和生物膜的炎症归巢特征。 MAzyme 具有与天然超氧化物歧化酶相当的显着抗氧化作用，可通过消除活性氧来有效解决炎症。我们的研究结果还表明，MMAzyme-S 可以阻断 CD47 介导的抗吞噬作用，以恢复病变巨噬细胞中受损的胞吞作用，从而促进凋亡细胞的吞噬清除。此外，通过协同抗氧化和抗炎作用，胆固醇转运途径得到加强，从而大大减少泡沫细胞的形成和斑块负担。因此，MMAzyme-S 凭借同源炎症靶向和发病机制多环节干预的独特优势，减少了雄性 ApoE−/− 小鼠的动脉粥样硬化斑块负担。这项研究强调了具有抗氧化和促细胞作用活性的仿生多孔 MAzyme 作为对抗动脉粥样硬化的多方面干预策略的潜力。

title: Electroluminescence and Current Rectification in Plasmonic Nanosphere-on-Mirror Tunnel Junctions
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Robust inelastic electron tunneling electroluminescence (EL) and current rectification represent two key milestones in molecular electronics. We report strongly rectified EL and current (rectification ratio up to 102-103) in bottom-up fabricated tunnel junctions where a noble-metal nanosphere (20-200 nm) is bridged to a planar metal thin film by structurally symmetric molecules (1,4-benzenedithiol or 1,4-diethynylbenzene). Both electrodes are made of the same noble metal (M = Ag or Au), so the junctions are compositionally symmetric. The rectification ratio is strongly dependent on the electrode geometry and linker chemistry: The rectification behavior is strongly suppressed when the nanosphere is replaced by a nanocube of comparable size or when the nanosphere diameter increases from 20 to 200 nm. Pronounced rectification occurs with dithiol (M-S) and diethynyl (M-C≡C) linkers but not with diisocyanide (M-CN). These observations cannot be explained by simple electrostatic asymmetry of electrodes but instead arise from curvature-dependent metal-molecule coupling, specifically the enhanced electronic coupling at under-coordinated surface atoms of the nanosphere. Overall, the results show that a structurally symmetric molecule can rectify when placed between compositionally identical but geometrically inequivalent electrodes. These findings open a new route to scalable, bottom-up molecular optoelectronic diodes whose function is encoded in the geometry and chemistry of nominally symmetric junctions.
title_zh: 镜上等离激元纳米球隧道结中的电致发光和电流整流
abstract_zh: 鲁棒非弹性电子隧道电致发光（EL）和电流整流代表了分子电子学的两个关键里程碑。我们报告了自下而上制造的隧道结中的强整流 EL 和电流（整流比高达 102-103），其中贵金属纳米球（20-200 nm）通过结构对称分子（1,4-苯二硫醇或 1,4-二乙炔基苯）桥接到平面金属薄膜。两个电极均由相同的贵金属（M = Ag 或 Au）制成，因此结在成分上是对称的。整流比很大程度上取决于电极几何形状和连接体化学：当纳米球被同等尺寸的纳米立方体取代或当纳米球直径从 20 nm 增加到 200 nm 时，整流行为会受到强烈抑制。二硫醇 (M-S) 和二乙炔基 (M-C≡C) 连接体会发生明显的整流，但二异氰化物 (M-CN) 则不会。这些观察结果不能用电极的简单静电不对称性来解释，而是由曲率相关的金属分子耦合产生，特别是纳米球的欠配位表面原子处增强的电子耦合。总体而言，结果表明，当结构对称的分子放置在成分相同但几何形状不相等的电极之间时，可以进行整流。这些发现为可扩展、自下而上的分子光电二极管开辟了一条新途径，其功能被编码在名义对称结的几何形状和化学中。

title: Polyperinaphthalene and Carbon Thin Films Prepared by Direct Laser Writing of 3,4,9,10-Perylene Tetracarboxylic Acid: Processing, Structure, and Electrical and Thermoelectric Property Investigation
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: By leveraging the limited solubility of 3,4,9,10-perylene tetracarboxylic acid (PTCA) in dimethyl sulfoxide, we develop a direct laser writing (DLW) process for fabricating the narrow-bandgap conducting polymer-polyperinaphthalene (PPN) as well as carbon thin films under 1 μm thickness. The effects of CO2 laser power and precursor thickness on the structure, morphology, and electrical/thermoelectric properties of the resultant DLW products are investigated. The compounding role of laser power and precursor thickness on PPN-to-carbon transition is revealed. Under the optimal processing conditions, the resultant DLW film achieves excellent electrical conductivity of 120 S·cm-1 with a Seebeck coefficient of 8.5 μV·K-1 and a power factor of 0.96 μW·m-1·K-2. Last, the PTCA-derived DLW thin film is demonstrated for self-powered sensing applications in laser power monitoring and as a flexible, wearable thermoelectric sensor for temperature sensing. The present study paves a way for low-cost fabricating high-performance PPN and carbon thin films that may offer a versatile platform for a wide range of applications.
title_zh: 3,4,9,10-苝四甲酸直接激光写入制备聚萘二萘和碳薄膜：加工、结构以及电学和热电性能研究
abstract_zh: 利用3,4,9,10-苝四甲酸（PTCA）在二甲亚砜中的有限溶解度，我们开发了一种直接激光写入（DLW）工艺，用于制造窄带隙导电聚合物聚萘二甲酸（PPN）以及1μm厚度以下的碳薄膜。研究了 CO2 激光功率和前驱体厚度对所得 DLW 产品的结构、形貌和电/热电性能的影响。揭示了激光功率和前驱体厚度对 PPN 到碳转变的复合作用。在最佳工艺条件下，所得DLW薄膜的电导率高达120 S·cm-1，塞贝克系数为8.5 μV·K-1，功率因数为0.96 μW·m-1·K-2。最后，PTCA 衍生的 DLW 薄膜被证明可用于激光功率监测中的自供电传感应用，以及作为用于温度传感的灵活、可穿戴热电传感器。本研究为低成本制造高性能 PPN 和碳薄膜铺平了道路，可为广泛的应用提供多功能平台。
