title: Low-temperature oxide-ion conduction in Aurivillius-type ((Na0.5Bi0.5)n–1TinO3n)(Bi2O2) phases
source: Nature Energy
abstract: Solid oxide-ion conductors are essential for high-temperature electrochemical technologies, yet few materials maintain sufficient ion mobility at lower temperatures, where degradation is reduced and a broader range of materials can be used for auxiliary components. Here the authors introduce Aurivillius-type thin-film conductors that form periodic fast ion channels and achieve promising conductivity at 350 °C.
title_zh: Aurivilius 型 ((Na0.5Bi0.5)n–1TinO3n)(Bi2O2) 相中的低温氧化物离子传导
abstract_zh: 固体氧化物离子导体对于高温电化学技术至关重要，但很少有材料能够在较低温度下保持足够的离子迁移率，从而减少降解，并且可以使用更广泛的材料作为辅助组件。在这里，作者介绍了 Aurivillius 型薄膜导体，它形成周期性快离子通道，并在 350 °C 下实现有前景的导电性。

title: Polyesterification-assisted interface engineering of carboxylate metal-organic frameworks membranes for selective gas separation
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) are promising membrane materials for molecular separations because of their well-defined porosity and tunable chemistry. However, their separation performance is often limited by grain boundaries and interfacial defects that introduce non-selective transport pathways. Here, we proposed an in-situ interfacial polyesterification-assisted bonding strategy for constructing MOF-rich self-standing membranes using triethanolamine (TEOA) in the UiO-66 system. Under thermal treatment, TEOA is proposed to induce localized interfacial reactions that generate anchored polyester species at MOF-MOF contacts, thereby enhancing particle bonding and suppressing non-selective interface defects. The resulting UiO-66 polyester membrane exhibits 92.7 wt% UiO-66 loading, a CO2 permeance of 1310 GPU, and a CO2/N2 selectivity of 38, surpassing the upper bound for this gas pair, with the selectivity arising primarily from solubility-selective transport. In addition, the UiO-66 polyester membrane shows good moisture tolerance and performance regenerability, further suggesting that the polyesterified interface helped mitigate humidity-induced interfacial deterioration and suppress particle-interface defects. A similar strategy is also demonstrated in the MOF-808, UiO-67, and MIL-101 systems, indicating representative applicability within a subset of carboxylate-based MOFs. These results highlight the importance of interfacial chemical engineering in constructing defect-suppressed, highly MOF-rich separation membranes.
title_zh: 用于选择性气体分离的羧酸盐金属有机骨架膜的聚酯化辅助界面工程
abstract_zh: 金属有机框架（MOF）因其明确的孔隙率和可调节的化学性质而成为用于分子分离的有前途的膜材料。然而，它们的分离性能通常受到引入非选择性传输途径的晶界和界面缺陷的限制。在这里，我们提出了一种原位界面聚酯化辅助粘合策略，用于在 UiO-66 系统中使用三乙醇胺 (TEOA) 构建富含 MOF 的自支撑膜。在热处理下，TEOA 被提议诱导局部界面反应，在 MOF-MOF 接触处产生锚定聚酯物质，从而增强颗粒结合并抑制非选择性界面缺陷。所得 UiO-66 聚酯膜的 UiO-66 负载量为 92.7 wt%，CO2 渗透率为 1310 GPU，CO2/N2 选择性为 38，超过了该气体对的上限，选择性主要来自溶解度选择性传输。此外，UiO-66聚酯膜表现出良好的耐湿性和性能再生性，进一步表明聚酯化界面有助于减轻湿度引起的界面劣化并抑制颗粒界面缺陷。 MOF-808、UiO-67 和 MIL-101 系统也证明了类似的策略，表明在基于羧酸盐的 MOF 子集中具有代表性的适用性。这些结果凸显了界面化学工程在构建缺陷抑制、高度富含 MOF 的分离膜中的重要性。

title: Disproportionate exposure to extreme floods in historically redlined U.S. communities
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Extreme floods and historical public policies both leave lasting impacts. We analyzed flood exposure across the neighborhoods of 202 US cities historically assessed for lending risk by the Home Owners’ Loan Corporation on a scale from ‘best (A) to ‘hazardous’ (D). Using high-resolution flood modeling and dasymetric population mapping, we found that D-graded neighborhoods bear a disproportionate flood burden in roughly three-quarters of cities. This inequality follows a systematic gradient: A- and B-graded neighborhoods are underrepresented in the flooded population, C-graded neighborhoods are proportionately represented, and D-graded neighborhoods are overrepresented. A greater fraction of D-graded residents are exposed to the 100-yr flood (6.4%) than A-graded residents to the 1000-yr flood (5.9%) with the gap widening at higher-magnitude floods. Flood disparities are most pronounced in the Midwest and Mid-Atlantic regions, aligning with the historical concentration of industrial labor and redlined neighborhoods along waterways. However, we find that proximity to waterways alone does not explain the observed inequality: flood disparities persist even among neighborhoods far from major rivers and coasts, implicating infrastructure deficits as a compounding factor. Neighborhoods marked as ‘hazardous’ nearly a century ago remain disproportionately vulnerable today, underscoring the need for equitable urban planning.
title_zh: 美国历史上的红线社区遭受极端洪水的比例过高
abstract_zh: 极端洪水和历史公共政策都会留下持久的影响。我们分析了 202 个美国城市社区的洪水风险，历史上由房主贷款公司按照从“最佳”(A) 到“危险”(D) 的等级进行贷款风险评估。利用高分辨率洪水模型和测绘人口测绘，我们发现大约四分之三的城市中 D 级社区承受着不成比例的洪水负担。这种不平等遵循系统梯度：A 级和 B 级社区在洪水人口中所占比例不足，C 级社区所占比例较高，而 D 级社区所占比例过高。遭受100年一遇洪水的D级居民（6.4%）比遭受1000年一遇洪水的A级居民（5.9%）要多，而且在更高强度的洪水中，差距会扩大。洪水差异在中西部和中大西洋地区最为明显，这与历史上工业劳动力的集中和水道沿线的红线社区一致。然而，我们发现，仅靠近水道并不能解释所观察到的不平等：即使在远离主要河流和海岸的社区中，洪水差异也持续存在，这意味着基础设施赤字是一个复合因素。近一个世纪前被标记为“危险”的社区如今仍然极其脆弱，这凸显了公平城市规划的必要性。

title: Versatile electronic phases enabled by intertwined multiple frustrations in an antiferromagnetic two-dimensional semimetal
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Following the discovery of graphene, van der Waals materials have become a major platform for quantum matter, yet strongly interacting phases beyond graphene remain elusive. Using scanning tunneling microscopy and spectroscopy, we uncover three competing stripe- and checkerboard-type multiple-q antiferromagnetic charge-ordered states in the van der Waals semimetal CeTe3, beyond the conventional charge density wave. These field-tunable states exhibit propagation vectors of (0.33, 0), (0, 0.08), and (0.19, ±0.19), and are controlled by a modest in-plane magnetic field (~1.5 T). Quasiparticle-interference imaging identifies corresponding three distinct nesting channels and associated Fermi-surface reconstructions. At the same time, spectroscopy reveals a broad electronic reconstruction extending to ±30 meV around the Fermi level, beyond a simple Kondo-coupling picture. Our results establish CeTe3 as a platform for tunable nanoscale antiferromagnetic electronic phases characterized by intertwined correlations, exotic symmetry-breaking, and nontrivial topology.
title_zh: 通过反铁磁二维半金属中相互交织的多重挫败实现多功能电子相
abstract_zh: 随着石墨烯的发现，范德华材料已成为量子物质的主要平台，但石墨烯之外的强相互作用相仍然难以捉摸。利用扫描隧道显微镜和光谱学，我们在范德华半金属 CeTe3 中发现了三种相互竞争的条纹型和棋盘型多 q 反铁磁电荷有序态，超出了传统的电荷密度波。这些场可调状态的传播矢量为 (0.33, 0)、(0, 0.08) 和 (0.19, ±0.19)，并由适度的面内磁场 (~1.5 T) 控制。准粒子干涉成像识别出相应的三个不同的嵌套通道和相关的费米表面重建。同时，光谱学揭示了在费米能级周围延伸至 ±30 meV 的广泛电子重建，超出了简单的近藤耦合图像。我们的结果将 CeTe3 确立为可调谐纳米级反铁磁电子相的平台，其特征是相互交织的相关性、奇特的对称性破缺和非平凡的拓扑结构。

title: Scalable phase-change fibres with record thermo-mechanical properties for cooling textiles
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Efficient thermal regulation in clothing is critical for comfort, safety, and energy conservation, yet achieving it without active cooling remains a major challenge. Phase-change materials (PCMs), which store and release heat during solid–liquid transitions, offer a promising route toward passive and durable temperature control in everyday apparel. Embedding liquid-state PCMs into fibres (PCFs) is inherently challenging due to the instability of micro-scale liquid cores and the inability of conventional microfluidics to sustain continuous injection beyond centimetre lengths, limiting scalable fibre production. We overcome these barriers through a size-reduction and speed-matching strategy during thermal and cold fibre drawing, yielding uniform 35 m-long, 200 µm-thin core–shell PCFs. The fibres exhibit low supercooling (4.2 ± 0.3 °C), high latent enthalpy (122.6 ± 1.5 J g⁻¹), and record-level mechanical performance (32.1 ± 0.8 MPa strength, 671 ± 10.2% elongation). Fabrics incorporating 50% PCFs achieve sustained temperature reductions of 3–6 °C under realistic conditions, passively dissipating heat from sunlight and battery-generated hotspots while outperforming conventional cotton. These findings pave the way for scalable, high-performance textiles that provide passive thermal regulation, offering a practical strategy to reduce energy demand and mitigate environmental impact.
title_zh: 可扩展的相变纤维具有创纪录的热机械性能，可用于冷却纺织品
abstract_zh: 服装的有效热调节对于舒适、安全和节能至关重要，但在没有主动冷却的情况下实现这一目标仍然是一个重大挑战。相变材料（PCM）在固液转变过程中储存和释放热量，为日常服装中的被动和持久温度控制提供了一条有前途的途径。由于微尺度液芯的不稳定性以及传统微流体无法维持超过厘米长度的连续注入，因此将液态相变材料嵌入纤维（PCF）本身就具有挑战性，从而限制了可扩展的纤维生产。我们在热拉丝和冷拉丝过程中通过尺寸减小和速度匹配策略克服了这些障碍，产生了均匀的 35 m 长、200 µm 薄的核壳 PCF。该纤维表现出低过冷度（4.2±0.3℃）、高潜热（122.6±1.5Jg⁻1）和创纪录的机械性能（32.1±0.8MPa强度，671±10.2%伸长率）。含有 50% PCF 的织物在实际条件下可实现持续降低 3-6 °C 的温度，被动地散发阳光和电池产生的热点产生的热量，同时性能优于传统棉。这些发现为可提供被动热调节的可扩展、高性能纺织品铺平了道路，提供了减少能源需求和减轻环境影响的实用策略。

title: Hierarchical Self-Assembly, Nanoarchitectonics, and Emerging Functionalities of Chiral π-Amphiphiles
source: Chemical Reviews: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Rational design of functional building blocks and precise control over their hierarchical self-assembly form the cornerstones of supramolecular chemistry and materials science. Amphiphilic molecules, with their inherent hydrophilic-hydrophobic duality, serve as critical building blocks across several disciplines. Integrating additional functionalities such as π-conjugation and chirality significantly expands the design space and utility of common amphiphiles, giving rise to a new class of building blocks: chiral π-amphiphiles. Typically, a synthetic chiral π-amphiphile consists of two functionally distinct segments, i.e., a hydrophobic π-extended chromophore and a hydrophilic chiral unit, covalently linked via common chemical linkers. The integration of chirality, functional π-systems, and amphiphilicity offers distinct advantages, such as chirality-guided directional π-stacking and superior chiroptical properties arising from their hierarchical chiral architectures in both organic and aqueous phases. Emerging chiral functions of chiral π-amphiphiles including circularly polarized luminescence, chiral recognition and separation, chiral biomedicine, and spin electronics have witnessed groundbreaking progress in recent years, which we believe will contribute to the development of novel chiral materials through molecular self-assembly approaches. This review systematically summarizes and discusses the definition, molecular design strategies, classification, nanostructures, applications, and future perspectives of chiral π-amphiphiles, aiming to help scientists evaluate the cutting-edge field of chirality science via diverse supramolecular technologies and systematic molecular engineering.
title_zh: 手性 π-两亲物的分层自组装、纳米结构和新兴功能
abstract_zh: 功能构件的合理设计和对其分层自组装的精确控制构成了超分子化学和材料科学的基石。两亲性分子具有固有的亲水-疏水二元性，可作为跨多个学科的关键组成部分。集成π-共轭和手性等附加功能显着扩展了常见两亲物的设计空间和实用性，从而产生了一类新的结构单元：手性π-两亲物。通常，合成的手性 π-两亲物由两个功能不同的片段组成，即疏水性 π-延伸发色团和亲水性手性单元，通过常见的化学接头共价连接。手性、功能性 π 系统和两亲性的整合提供了独特的优势，例如手性引导的定向 π 堆积以及有机相和水相中的分层手性结构产生的优异手性光学性质。手性π-两亲物的新兴手性功能，包括圆偏振发光、手性识别与分离、手性生物医学和自旋电子学等，近年来取得了突破性进展，我们相信这将有助于通过分子自组装方法开发新型手性材料。本文系统地总结和讨论了手性π-两亲物的定义、分子设计策略、分类、纳米结构、应用以及未来展望，旨在帮助科学家们评估其手性π-两亲物的性能。

title: Molecular Additive Engineering for Process-Humidity Robustness and Reproducible Fabrication of Perovskite Solar Cells and Modules
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: The commercialization of perovskite solar cells (PSCs) faces significant challenges due to their sensitivity to environmental humidity, which compromises film crystallization and device stability. Here, we introduce diphenylvinylphosphine (DPVP) as a Lewis base additive that enhances the performance and reproducibility of PSCs fabricated under ambient-air conditions. DPVP suppresses moisture-induced defect formation and stabilizes crystallization within realistic process-humidity ranges (20-40% relative humidity) commonly encountered in laboratory and pilot-scale manufacturing environments. It improves film uniformity, reduces trap densities, and yields highly reproducible device performance, enabling champion PCEs of 24.2% in small-area devices and 20.5% in blade-coated 12 cm2 mini-modules. Furthermore, DPVP-assisted modules exhibit enhanced stability, retaining over 85% of their initial efficiency after 900 h of maximum power point tracking (MPPT) at 65 °C. This study demonstrates a humidity-resilient and scalable additive strategy for ambient-air perovskite photovoltaic manufacturing.
title_zh: 钙钛矿太阳能电池和模块的工艺湿度鲁棒性和可重复制造的分子增材工程
abstract_zh: 钙钛矿太阳能电池（PSC）的商业化面临着重大挑战，因为它们对环境湿度敏感，这会影响薄膜结晶和器件稳定性。在这里，我们引入二苯基乙烯基膦 (DPVP) 作为路易斯碱添加剂，可提高在环境空气条件下制造的 PSC 的性能和再现性。 DPVP 可抑制水分引起的缺陷形成，并在实验室和中试规模制造环境中常见的实际工艺湿度范围（20-40% 相对湿度）内稳定结晶。它提高了薄膜均匀性，降低了陷阱密度，并产生高度可重复的器件性能，使小面积器件中的冠军 PCE 达到 24.2%，在刀片涂层的 12 cm2 迷你模块中达到 20.5%。此外，DPVP 辅助模块表现出增强的稳定性，在 65 °C 的最大功率点跟踪 (MPPT) 900 小时后仍保持超过 85% 的初始效率。这项研究展示了一种用于环境空气钙钛矿光伏制造的耐湿且可扩展的添加剂策略。

title: Tunable yielding and emergent rheology in amorphous solids with active particle doping
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Mechanically stable glasses, notably well-annealed and ultrastable ones, typically exhibit brittle failure through shear-band formation. Whether this localization is an inevitable consequence of annealing or can be dynamically controlled remains unknown. We address this by doping amorphous solids with self-propelled particles that perform run-and-tumble or active Brownian dynamics. Through extensive simulations of a polydisperse model, we show that shear-band formation and propagation are governed by a competition among three timescales: the imposed shear time 1/γ˙" role="presentation">1/γ˙1/\dot{\gamma }, the activity persistence time τp, and the intrinsic time for a shear band to span the system. At low persistence time, active doping progressively converts a single system-spanning shear band into a network of shear bands, yielding continuously with increased yield stress and yield strain, and inter-band spacing that decreases as a power law with active force. Interestingly, we uncover a universal compensatory relationship between active forces and global shear rates: a rise in one offsets a decline in the other, arising from isomorphic-like behavior across force–strain-rate combinations. We further identify a non-monotonic relationship between yielding and persistence time: while the yield stress increases at small τp with increasing active forces, it tends to decrease at large τp. Under creep, increasing active force reduces the steady-state strain rate and delays fluidization, extending the compensation to the stress-controlled regime. These results establish that shear localization in brittle glasses is not dictated solely by preparation history but can be dynamically altered through internal activity, with broad implications for yielding in living and synthetic active matter.
title_zh: 通过活性粒子掺杂实现无定形固体中可调节的屈服和突现流变学
abstract_zh: 机械稳定的玻璃，特别是退火良好和超稳定的玻璃，通常会通过剪切带形成而表现出脆性破坏。这种局域化是退火不可避免的结果还是可以动态控制仍然未知。我们通过在非晶固体中掺杂自驱动粒子来解决这个问题，这些粒子可以执行运行和翻滚或活跃的布朗动力学。通过对多分散模型的广泛模拟，我们表明剪切带的形成和传播受三个时间尺度之间的竞争控制：施加的剪切时间 1/γ˙" role="presentation">1/γ˙1/\dot{\gamma }、活性持续时间 τp 以及剪切带跨越系统的固有时间。在低持续时间下，活性掺杂逐渐将单个系统跨越剪切带转换为剪切带网络，产生有趣的是，我们发现了主动力和整体剪切速率之间的普遍补偿关系：一个的上升抵消了另一个的下降，这是由力-应变率组合的同构行为引起的：屈服应力在小 τp 时随着主动力的增加而增加，但在大 τp 时往往会减少。蠕变，增加主动力会降低稳态应变率并延迟流化，将补偿范围扩大到应力控制范围。这些结果已建立。

title: Kinetic inductance of few-layer NbSe2 in the two-dimensional limit
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Van der Waals (vdW) superconductors remain superconducting down to the monolayer limit, enabling the exploration of emergent physical phenomena and functionality driven by reduced dimensionality. Here, we report the characterization of the kinetic inductance of atomically thin NbSe2, a two-dimensional van der Waals superconductor, using superconducting coplanar waveguides and microwave measurement techniques familiar to circuit quantum electrodynamics (cQED). The kinetic inductance scales inversely with the number of NbSe2 layers, reaching 1.2 nH/□ in the monolayer limit. Furthermore, the measured kinetic inductance exhibits a thickness-dependent crossover from clean- to dirty-limit behavior, with enhanced dirty-limit contributions emerging in the ultra-thin regime. These effects are likely driven by increased surface scattering, multi-band superconductivity, and geometric confinement. Additionally, the self-Kerr nonlinearity of the NbSe2 films ranges from K/2π = −0.006 to −14.7 Hz/photon, indicating its strong potential in applications requiring compact, nearly linear, high-inductance superconducting quantum devices and detectors. The fabrication and characterization techniques demonstrated here are extensible to the investigation of other two-dimensional superconductors.
title_zh: 二维极限下少层NbSe2的动感
abstract_zh: 范德瓦尔斯 (vdW) 超导体在低至单层极限的情况下仍保持超导性，从而能够探索由降维驱动的新兴物理现象和功能。在这里，我们使用电路量子电动力学 (cQED) 熟悉的超导共面波导和微波测量技术，报告了原子薄 NbSe2（一种二维范德华超导体）的动态电感的表征。动态电感与 NbSe2 层数成反比，在单层极限下达到 1.2 nH/□。此外，测量的动态电感表现出从清洁极限到脏极限行为的厚度依赖性交叉，并且在超薄区域中出现了增强的脏极限贡献。这些效应可能是由表面散射增加、多带超导性和几何限制驱动的。此外，NbSe2薄膜的自克尔非线性范围为K/2π = -0.006至-14.7 Hz/光子，表明其在需要紧凑、近线性、高电感超导量子器件和探测器的应用中具有强大的潜力。这里演示的制造和表征技术可以扩展到其他二维超导体的研究。

title: Dual-space visible light authentication toward high security physical unclonable function
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Random pattern generation by nondeterministic self-assembly offers physical unclonable function (PUF) for hardware-based information security system. However, authenticating intricate signals from randomized disordered structures is challenging without time-consuming, expensive characterization. Here, we present easily authenticatable, highly secure self-assembly-based PUF system enabled by synergistic authentication mechanism exploiting dual-space visible signals. Polycrystalline monolayer morphology of colloidal self-assembled pattern, consisting of a virtual 3D space defined by 2D spatial coordinates and crystal orientation, can be effectively authenticated by combining real-space Bragg reflection and reciprocal-space diffraction signals in visible wavelength regime. Notably, polycrystalline patterned structures composed of hexagonal close-packed colloidal grains are highly beneficial for practical PUF labels, while providing unpredictable reciprocal lattice information with a high degree of freedom for easy authentication with a vast number of encryption keys. Our PUF solely based on structural information can serve for versatile templates for mechanically flexible, renewable, concealable, medium-independent, and biocompatible purposes.
title_zh: 双空间可见光认证实现高安全物理不可克隆功能
abstract_zh: 通过非确定性自组装生成随机模式为基于硬件的信息安全系统提供物理不可克隆功能（PUF）。然而，如果没有耗时、昂贵的表征，验证来自随机无序结构的复杂信号是具有挑战性的。在这里，我们提出了易于认证、高度安全的基于自组装的 PUF 系统，该系统通过利用双空间可见信号的协同认证机制来实现。胶体自组装图案的多晶单层形态由2D空间坐标和晶体取向定义的虚拟3D空间组成，可以通过结合可见光波长范围内的实空间布拉格反射和倒易空间衍射信号来有效地验证。值得注意的是，由六方密堆积胶体颗粒组成的多晶图案结构对于实用的PUF标签非常有益，同时提供不可预测的倒易晶格信息，具有高度的自由度，便于使用大量加密密钥进行身份验证。我们的 PUF 仅基于结构信息，可用于多功能模板，用于机械灵活、可再生、可隐藏、介质独立和生物相容性目的。

title: Elucidation of the intrinsic electronic mechanism governing interfacial chemical bonding in metal-polymer hybrids
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Integrating metals and polymers is pivotal for advanced functional applications, yet their intrinsic electronic bonding origin remains elusive due to material mismatch. Combining density functional theory (DFT) calculations and experiments, this study establishes a unified interfacial electron donor-acceptor framework. We demonstrate that interfacial metal oxides and polymer carboxyl groups facilitate μ₂-bridging coordination, driven by p-p σ hybridization between metal vacant 3p and oxygen lone-pair 2p orbitals, which is verified by valence band spectra. Furthermore, introducing surface oxygen vacancies enhances the electron-accepting capability of metal sites, enabling the coordinated interface to resist thermodynamic fluctuations, thereby improving the tensile-shear strength by over 400%. Cross-system validations across various cation valence states (+1 to +4) and polymer heteroatoms successfully demonstrate the general applicability of this theory-guided acceptor mechanism among diverse structural alloys and thermoplastics. This work provides a predictive electronic-structure foundation for the rational design of high-performance multi-material hybrid interfaces beyond specific systems.
title_zh: 阐明控制金属-聚合物杂化物中界面化学键合的内在电子机制
abstract_zh: 集成金属和聚合物对于先进功能应用至关重要，但由于材料不匹配，它们固有的电子键合起源仍然难以捉摸。本研究结合密度泛函理论（DFT）计算和实验，建立了统一的界面电子供体-受体框架。我们证明，金属空位 3p 轨道和氧孤对电子 2p 轨道之间的 p-p σ 杂化驱动界面金属氧化物和聚合物羧基促进 μ2 桥联配位，这一点已通过价带谱得到验证。此外，引入表面氧空位增强了金属位点的电子接受能力，使配位界面能够抵抗热力学波动，从而将拉伸剪切强度提高了400%以上。跨各种阳离子价态（+1 至 +4）和聚合物杂原子的跨系统验证成功证明了这种理论指导的受体机制在不同结构合金和热塑性塑料中的普遍适用性。这项工作为特定系统之外的高性能多材料混合接口的合理设计提供了预测电子结构基础。

title: High-Strength, Self-Sensing Multiphase Hydrogels for Load-Bearing Actuation and Logical Human–Machine Interaction
source: Nano-Micro Letters
abstract: Stimuli-responsive shape-changing hydrogels are the most competitive candidates for artificial muscles, electronic skins, and soft robotics. However, existing actuating hydrogels often suffer a trade-off between actuation performance and mechanical strength, which greatly limits their application prospects as actuators under external force loads. Here, we adopt a cascade polymerization strategy to successively introduce electrical sensing and mechanically enhanced polymer network phases into sponge-like PNIPAM hydrogels to achieve PNIPAM-based photothermal-responsive actuating hydrogels with fast response, high strength, and self-sensing performance. The as-prepared hydrogel actuator can execute rapid actuation missions even under external loading far exceeding its own mass and generate differentiated electrical sensing signals according to the magnitude of the external load. Based on the corresponding relationship between the mass of the load and the actuation behavior (such as "0/1" encoding), we develop a novel material-based binary information encoding system. Furthermore, by manufacturing logic gates to analyze differentiated feedback sensing signals and integrating them with Internet of Things technology, a closed-loop logic control system is established for remote logic-based interactive communication. This study fills the gap of traditional hydrogels in load-bearing actuation and complex interactive applications and opens up a new direction for the next generation of smart soft materials. Highlights:1 The cascade polymerization synergistic toughening mechanism overcomes the problem of mutual constraints between "mechanical strength and response speed" of traditional hydrogels and realizes load-bearing actuation.2 The “mass–deformation” dynamic coding law was established, enabling a hydrogel-based 0/1 binary information encoding system derived from mechanical actuation responses.3 Actuation–perception integrated logic-gate units were developed to enable intelligent soft robotics through a closed-loop “light-triggered actuation–signal feedback–logic processing–robotic action” control system.
title_zh: 用于承载驱动和逻辑人机交互的高强度、自感知多相水凝胶
abstract_zh: 刺激响应变形水凝胶是人造肌肉、电子皮肤和软机器人领域最具竞争力的候选材料。然而，现有的驱动水凝胶经常在驱动性能和机械强度之间进行权衡，这极大地限制了它们作为外力负载下的驱动器的应用前景。在这里，我们采用级联聚合策略，将电传感和机械增强的聚合物网络相相继引入海绵状PNIPAM水凝胶中，以实现具有快速响应、高强度和自传感性能的基于PNIPAM的光热响应驱动水凝胶。所制备的水凝胶致动器即使在远远超过其自身质量的外部载荷下也可以执行快速致动任务，并根据外部载荷的大小产生差异化的电传感信号。基于负载质量和驱动行为之间的对应关系（例如“0/1”编码），我们开发了一种新颖的基于材料的二进制信息编码系统。此外，通过制造逻辑门来分析差异化的反馈传感信号，并将其与物联网技术相结合，建立闭环逻辑控制系统，用于基于逻辑的远程交互通信。该研究填补了传统水凝胶在承载驱动和复杂交互应用方面的空白，为下一代智能软材料开辟了新方向。亮点：1 级联聚合协同增韧机理全面

title: A Recyclable Biomimetic Flexible Sensor Based on Gallium-Based Liquid Metal for Real-Time ECG Signal Monitoring
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Gallium-based liquid metal (Ga-LM) has high electrical conductivity, excellent deformability, recyclability, and biocompatibility, simultaneously satisfying the core requirements of stretchable ECG sensors: high signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), low interfacial impedance, and conformability. A recyclable biomimetic flexible sensor based on Ga-LM was prepared in this study. Nanofiber membranes were fabricated as flexible substrates via electrospinning. Concurrently, conductive inks were obtained by mechanical shearing and ultrasonication. The biomimetic spider-web-structured sensor was ultimately constructed by printing the conductive ink onto the flexible substrate. Experimental results showed that the flexible sensor exhibited a relative resistance change of less than 50% after 700 tensile cycles, demonstrating excellent tensile and electrical stability. The sensor exhibited high recyclability, with an average Ga-LM recovery rate of 95.88%, and demonstrated self-healing capability. In addition, the sensor had favorable biocompatibility, and its air and moisture permeability supported skin-contact wearable applications. In real-time ECG signal monitoring, the sensor achieved a high SNR of 34.88 dB, comparable to that of traditional sensors while offering advantages in flexibility, recyclability, durability, and wearability. This study offers new insights into ECG-monitoring smart clothing, where biomimetic design and material recycling facilitate the sustainable development of flexible sensors.
title_zh: 一种基于镓基液态金属的可回收仿生柔性传感器，用于实时心电信号监测
abstract_zh: 镓基液态金属（Ga-LM）具有高导电性、优异的变形性、可回收性和生物相容性，同时满足可拉伸心电图传感器的核心要求：高信噪比（SNR）、低界面阻抗和顺应性。本研究制备了一种基于Ga-LM的可回收仿生柔性传感器。通过静电纺丝将纳米纤维膜制成柔性基材。同时，通过机械剪切和超声处理获得导电油墨。最终通过将导电墨水印刷到柔性基板上来构建仿生蜘蛛网结构传感器。实验结果表明，柔性传感器在700次拉伸循环后表现出小于50%的相对电阻变化，表现出优异的拉伸和电稳定性。该传感器具有较高的可回收性，平均Ga-LM回收率为95.88%，并具有自愈能力。此外，该传感器具有良好的生物相容性，其透气性和透湿性支持皮肤接触式可穿戴应用。在实时心电信号监测中，该传感器实现了34.88 dB的高信噪比，与传统传感器相当，同时具有灵活性、可回收性、耐用性和耐磨性等优势。这项研究为心电图监测智能服装提供了新的见解，其中仿生设计和材料回收促进了柔性传感器的可持续发展。

title: Chiral Organo-Soluble Carbon Nanocolloids with Dual-Mode Optical Responsiveness: From Nonpolar Enantioselective Sensing to Lead−Halide Perovskite Passivation
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: A major challenge in chiral carbon nanoparticles is to create materials whose chirality persists outside aqueous environments and remains functional under organic synthesis, interfacial engineering, and device fabrication conditions. We overcome this barrier by developing intrinsically chiral, organo-soluble carbon nanocolloids (CNCs) through solvent-free thermal condensation of enantiopure α-methylbenzylamine with formamidinium salts at 180 °C. Unlike conventional surface-functionalized chiral carbon dots, these CNCs form amorphous carbon-nitrogen-oxygen networks with covalently embedded chiral amidinium chromophores, as confirmed by experimental studies and molecular dynamics simulations. The resulting nanoparticles (5-10 nm in size) are easily dispersible in both polar and nonpolar solvents while maintaining their structural integrity, which is demonstrated by retention of nonvibrational photoluminescence bands in Cl-containing solvents. Chiral CNCs display both bright blue emission (quantum yield up to 40%) and distinct circular dichroism signals (|g| = 3.1-3.7 × 10-4) spanning 250-450 nm in spectral range. Using these CNCs, we demonstrate enantioselective sensing of chiral amines in toluene via dual modulation of photoluminescence and circular dichroism, and passivation of CsPbBr3 perovskite films, which simultaneously enhances their emission intensity and ambient stability. This study introduces a novel class of intrinsically chiral CNCs bridging molecular stereochemical precision with nanoscale colloidal stability for advanced chiral optoelectronics and sensing in organic media.
title_zh: 具有双模光学响应的​​手性有机可溶性碳纳米胶体：从非极性对映选择性传感到卤化铅钙钛矿钝化
abstract_zh: 手性碳纳米粒子的一个主要挑战是创造出手性在水环境之外持续存在并在有机合成、界面工程和器件制造条件下保持功能的材料。我们克服了这一障碍，通过对映体纯 α-甲基苄胺与甲脒盐在 180 °C 下无溶剂热缩合，开发了本质手性、有机可溶的碳纳米胶体 (CNC)。与传统的表面功能化手性碳点不同，这些 CNC 形成具有共价嵌入手性脒发色团的无定形碳-氮-氧网络，实验研究和分子动力学模拟证实了这一点。所得纳米颗粒（尺寸为 5-10 nm）很容易分散在极性和非极性溶剂中，同时保持其结构完整性，这一点可以通过在含 Cl 溶剂中保留非振动光致发光带来证明。手性 CNC 显示出明亮的蓝色发射（量子产率高达 40%）和明显的圆二色性信号（|g| = 3.1-3.7 × 10-4），光谱范围跨越 250-450 nm。使用这些 CNC，我们展示了通过光致发光和圆二色性的双重调制以及 CsPbBr3 钙钛矿薄膜的钝化对甲苯中的手性胺进行对映选择性传感，这同时增强了其发射强度和环境稳定性。这项研究介绍了一类新型的本质手性 CNC，它将分子立体化学精度与纳米级胶体稳定性结合起来，用于先进的手性光电和传感

title: Sustainable Visible-Light Photoinitiation Enabled by a Bio-Based Photosensitizer/Oxime Ester Combination via Triplet–Triplet Energy Transfer
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: AC:AC:Visible-light photopolymerization offers safer processing, lower energy input, and broader compatibility with advanced manufacturing than thermally initiated curing or short-wavelength UV processes. However, sustainable photoinitiating systems that operate efficiently under visible light remain limited. Here, a sustainable two-component strategy is reported by combining bio-derived oxime esters with natural or bio-inspired photosensitizers for 405 nm curing. Among the systems investigated, the synthesized oxime ester (OXE1) and menadione (MD, vitamin K3) pair show the best performance, enabling rapid photopolymerization of TMPTA with good formulation homogeneity, low coloration, and good storage stability. Electrochemical analysis and excited-state energetics indicate that direct single-electron transfer between MD and OXE1 is thermodynamically unfavorable. In contrast, steady-state photolysis, laser flash photolysis, CO2 evolution, and ESR spin trapping support a triplet-triplet energy transfer pathway, followed by N-O bond cleavage and decarboxylation, to generate initiating radicals. This work establishes a simple sensitization principle for converting UV-responsive bio-derived oxime esters into visible-light photoinitiators and provides a sustainable design strategy for photopolymerization and 3D microfabrication.
title_zh: 生物基光敏剂/肟酯组合通过三重态-三重态能量转移实现可持续的可见光光引发
abstract_zh: AC：AC：与热引发固化或短波长紫外线工艺相比，可见光光聚合可提供更安全的加工、更低的能量输入以及与先进制造更广泛的兼容性。然而，在可见光下有效运行的可持续光引发系统仍然有限。在此，报道了一种可持续的双组分策略，将生物源肟酯与天然或生物启发的光敏剂相结合，进行 405 nm 固化。在所研究的系统中，合成的肟酯（OXE1）和甲萘醌（MD，维生素K3）对表现出最佳性能，能够实现TMPTA的快速光聚合，具有良好的配方均匀性、低着色和良好的储存稳定性。电化学分析和激发态能量学表明，MD 和 OXE1 之间的直接单电子转移在热力学上是不利的。相比之下，稳态光解、激光闪光光解、CO2释放和ESR自旋捕获支持三重态-三重态能量转移途径，随后进行N-O键断裂和脱羧，以产生引发自由基。这项工作建立了一种简单的敏化原理，用于将紫外线响应型生物源肟酯转化为可见光光引发剂，并为光聚合和 3D 微加工提供了可持续的设计策略。

title: Discrete distributions are learnable from metastable samples
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Physically motivated stochastic dynamics are widely used to sample from high-dimensional distributions. However, such samplers often get trapped in metastable states, approximately sampling from a distribution that differs significantly from the desired stationary state. We rigorously show that for multivariable discrete distributions, the true stationary model can nevertheless be recovered from these metastable samples. This relies on a fundamental observation: for distributions satisfying a strong metastability condition, their single-variable conditional probabilities are on average extremely close to those of the true stationary distribution. This remains true even when the two distributions are far apart under global metrics such as Kullback-Leibler divergence. Consequently, we can effectively learn the true model using a conditional-likelihood estimator even when the samples are drawn from a restricted state space. Extending these general results to Ising models, we prove rigorous parameter and structure learning guarantees. Finally, we demonstrate this phenomenon numerically on higher-alphabet spin glass models.
title_zh: 离散分布可以从亚稳态样本中学习
abstract_zh: 物理驱动的随机动力学被广泛用于从高维分布中进行采样。然而，此类采样器经常陷入亚稳态，近似从与所需稳态显着不同的分布进行采样。我们严格证明，对于多变量离散分布，真正的平稳模型仍然可以从这些亚稳态样本中恢复。这依赖于一个基本观察：对于满足强亚稳态条件的分布，它们的单变量条件概率平均非常接近真正的平稳分布。即使两个分布在库尔贝克-莱布勒散度等全局指标下相距甚远，情况仍然如此。因此，即使样本是从受限状态空间中抽取的，我们也可以使用条件似然估计器有效地学习真实模型。将这些一般结果扩展到伊辛模型，我们证明了严格的参数和结构学习保证。最后，我们在更高字母的自旋玻璃模型上以数值方式证明了这种现象。

title: Polymeric Delivery Vehicles for Nucleic Acid Vaccines: Design Strategies and Biological Barriers
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Nucleic acid vaccines have emerged as revolutionary platforms for infectious disease prevention and cancer immunotherapy. However, their clinical translation is significantly hindered by sequential biological barriers, necessitating highly efficient delivery systems. Biomedical polymers, owing to their tunable physicochemical properties, versatile structural engineering, and robust biocompatibility, have become a cornerstone in the development of nucleic acid nanocarriers. This review provides a comprehensive overview of polymeric delivery vehicles for nucleic acid vaccines, with a specific focus on rational design strategies tailored to overcome complex physiological barriers. We systematically dissect how functional polymer engineering-including interfacial shielding, targeted ligand modification, membrane perturbation, and stimuli-responsive disassembly-facilitates systemic circulation, antigen-presenting cell uptake, endosomal escape, and intracellular cargo release. Furthermore, we critically examine the persistent bottlenecks in current delivery platforms, such as the restricted uptake in primary immune cells and the fundamental inefficiencies of endosomal escape, while outlining future perspectives for the development of next-generation, clinically translatable polymeric nucleic acid vaccines.
title_zh: 核酸疫苗聚合物递送载体：设计策略和生物屏障
abstract_zh: 核酸疫苗已成为传染病预防和癌症免疫治疗的革命性平台。然而，它们的临床转化受到连续生物屏障的严重阻碍，需要高效的递送系统。生物医用聚合物由于其可调节的物理化学性质、多功能的结构工程和强大的生物相容性，已成为核酸纳米载体开发的基石。本综述对核酸疫苗的聚合物递送载体进行了全面概述，特别关注为克服复杂的生理障碍而定制的合理设计策略。我们系统地剖析了功能性聚合物工程（包括界面屏蔽、靶向配体修饰、膜扰动和刺激响应性分解）如何促进全身循环、抗原呈递细胞摄取、内体逃逸和细胞内货物释放。此外，我们批判性地研究了当前递送平台中持续存在的瓶颈，例如初级免疫细胞的摄取受限和内体逃逸的基本低效，同时概述了下一代临床可翻译聚合核酸疫苗的开发的未来前景。

title: Graphene-Enabled Vapor-Phase SERS Detection of Lithium-Ion Battery Electrolytes on Periodic Ag Nanoparticle Multimer Arrays
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Early detection of lithium-ion battery (LIB) electrolyte leakage in the vapor phase is important for battery safety, yet vapor-phase surface-enhanced Raman spectroscopy (SERS) remains challenging because weak gas-surface interactions limit analyte residence within plasmonic hot spots. Here, we report a hybrid graphene/plasmonic SERS platform for vapor-phase detection of LIB electrolyte components based on periodic Ag nanoparticle (AgNP) multimer arrays integrated with a monolayer graphene overlayer. The substrate is fabricated by capillary-assisted particle assembly (CAPA) followed by a unified poly(vinyl alcohol) (PVA)-assisted hot-press transfer process, enabling both the transfer of ordered AgNP arrays to glass and spatially selective graphene integration. This approach preserves nanoscale ordering while creating a four-region architecture on a single chip, allowing the individual and combined contributions of graphene and the plasmonic array to be evaluated under identical vapor-exposure conditions. Optical characterization shows a broadband plasmonic response dominated by interparticle coupling within AgNP multimers, with spectral overlap across the 532 nm excitation and Raman-scattering window. Upon exposure to vapors from a commercial LiPF6 electrolyte containing ethylene carbonate (EC) and ethyl methyl carbonate (EMC), no analyte-attributable Raman features are observed from bare glass, graphene on glass, or the AgNP array alone. In contrast, the graphene-coated AgNP region yields clear vapor-phase Raman signatures assignable to both EC and EMC. These results show that detectable vapor-phase electrolyte signatures emerge only from the combined graphene-plasmonic architecture, consistent with a hybrid interfacial effect in which graphene may increase the local surface population of volatile molecules while the AgNP multimers provide localized electromagnetic enhancement. This work establishes a scalable hybrid-transfer strategy for ordered vapor-phase SERS substrates and highlights graphene-coated plasmonic arrays as promising material platforms for molecularly specific LIB leak detection.
title_zh: 周期性银纳米颗粒多聚体阵列上石墨烯气相 SERS 检测锂离子电池电解质
abstract_zh: 早期检测气相锂离子电池 (LIB) 电解液泄漏对于电池安全非常重要，但气相表面增强拉曼光谱 (SERS) 仍然具有挑战性，因为微弱的气体-表面相互作用限制了分析物在等离子体热点内的停留。在这里，我们报告了一种混合石墨烯/等离子体SERS平台，用于基于与单层石墨烯覆盖层集成的周期性银纳米颗粒（AgNP）多聚体阵列，对LIB电解质成分进行气相检测。该基板通过毛细管辅助颗粒组装（CAPA）制造，然后采用统一的聚乙烯醇（PVA）辅助热压转移工艺，既可以将有序的AgNP阵列转移到玻璃上，又可以实现空间选择性的石墨烯集成。这种方法保留了纳米级有序性，同时在单个芯片上创建了四区域架构，从而允许在相同的蒸气暴露条件下评估石墨烯和等离子体阵列的单独和组合贡献。光学表征显示宽带等离子体响应由 AgNP 多聚体内的颗粒间耦合主导，在 532 nm 激发和拉曼散射窗口上光谱重叠。当暴露于含有碳酸亚乙酯 (EC) 和碳酸甲乙酯 (EMC) 的商用 LiPF6 电解质的蒸气时，从裸露玻璃、玻璃上的石墨烯或单独的 AgNP 阵列中没有观察到可归因于分析物的拉曼特征。相比之下，石墨烯涂层的 AgNP 区域产生清晰的气相拉曼特征，可分配给 EC 和 EMC。这些结果表明

title: Exosome-Laden 3D Composite Mesh Attenuates Stress Concentration and Promotes Collagen Regeneration toward Pelvic Organ Prolapse Repair
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Pelvic organ prolapse is a prevalent condition that impairs the quality of life in middle-aged and elderly women. Traditional polypropylene (PP) surgical meshes often lead to long-term complications due to mechanical mismatch and biological inertness, manifesting as stress concentration and chronic inflammation. To concurrently address these dual challenges, this study designed and fabricated a multifunctional composite mesh. The mesh incorporates a clinical-grade PP base for mechanical support, integrated with a three-dimensional printed polycaprolactone (PCL) biomimetic network modified by quaternized chitosan (QCS). Human umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cell-derived exosomes (Exos) were further loaded onto this network via electrostatic adsorption. The PP/PCL/QCS composite mesh demonstrated structural integrity and stable degradation. Finite element analysis verified its unique stress-buffering and redistribution capability, which effectively mitigates interfacial stress concentration. Biologically, the PP/PCL/QCS/Exos mesh promoted cell proliferation and adhesion in vitro and showed good biocompatibility in vivo. It actively modulated the repair microenvironment, leading to a rapidly resolved inflammatory response, reduced macrophage infiltration, enhanced myofibroblast activation, and orderly collagen remodeling with a significant increase in collagen type III. Transcriptomic analysis revealed that the mesh induces a systemic anti-inflammatory and pro-repair molecular phenotype. In summary, this work achieves a strategic shift from passive support to active regeneration through synergistic mechanical and biological design, offering a promising direction toward next-generation pelvic floor repair.
title_zh: 充满外泌体的 3D 复合网片可减轻应力集中并促进胶原蛋白再生，以修复盆腔器官脱垂
abstract_zh: 盆腔器官脱垂是影响中老年女性生活质量的常见疾病。传统的聚丙烯（PP）手术网片经常因机械失配和生物惰性而导致长期并发症，表现为应力集中和慢性炎症。为了同时解决这些双重挑战，本研究设计并制造了一种多功能复合网格。该网状物采用了用于机械支撑的临床级 PP 底座，并与经季铵化壳聚糖 (QCS) 改性的三维印刷聚己内酯 (PCL) 仿生网络集成。人脐带间充质干细胞衍生的外泌体（Exos）通过静电吸附进一步加载到该网络上。 PP/PCL/QCS 复合网表现出结构完整性和稳定的降解性。有限元分析验证了其独特的应力缓冲和重新分布能力，有效缓解界面应力集中。生物学上，PP/PCL/QCS/Exos网在体外促进细胞增殖和粘附，在体内表现出良好的生物相容性。它积极调节修复微环境，导致炎症反应迅速消退，巨噬细胞浸润减少，肌成纤维细胞活化增强，胶原蛋白有序重塑，III型胶原蛋白显着增加。转录组分析表明，网状结构可诱导系统性抗炎和促修复分子表型。综上所述，本工作实现了从被动支持到主动再生的战略转变。

title: Ultralow-CNT-Reinforced Thermal and Mechanical Properties for Polymer-Bonded Explosives
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Enhancing the thermal and mechanical properties of polymer-bonded explosives (PBXs) is critical for improving their safety and reliability. Carbon nanotubes (CNTs) are promising fillers, yet forming continuous conductive networks at ultralow loadings remains challenging. Herein, we developed a multi-level composite strategy combining water suspension and slurry methods to construct hierarchical thermal/mechanical networks with only 0.5 wt % CNTs. At 0.5 wt % CNT loading, the thermal conductivity increased by 52.09% to 0.6993 W·m-1·K-1, and the Brazilian splitting strength surged by 181.6%. Systematic studies on binary (CNT/F2311) and ternary (CNT/F2311/melamine) composites, supported by morphological characterization, thermal/mechanical testing, theoretical modeling, and COMSOL simulation, reveal the reinforcement mechanisms. This work provides a facile and effective approach for designing high-performance energetic composites with ultralow functional fillers.
title_zh: 聚合物炸药的超低碳纳米管增强热性能和机械性能
abstract_zh: 增强聚合物粘结炸药 (PBX) 的热性能和机械性能对于提高其安全性和可靠性至关重要。碳纳米管（CNT）是有前途的填料，但在超低负载下形成连续导电网络仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们开发了一种结合水悬浮液和浆料方法的多级复合策略，仅用 0.5 wt% CNT 构建分层热/机械网络。当CNT负载量为0.5 wt%时，导热系数提高了52.09%，达到0.6993 W·m-1·K-1，巴西劈裂强度提高了181.6%。在形态表征、热/机械测试、理论建模和 COMSOL 仿真的支持下，对二元 (CNT/F2311) 和三元 (CNT/F2311/三聚氰胺) 复合材料进行了系统研究，揭示了增强机制。这项工作为设计具有超低功能填料的高性能含能复合材料提供了一种简便有效的方法。

title: Plant-Inspired Aerogels with Vertically Aligned Channels for Synergistic Solar-Driven Interfacial Evaporation and Catalytic Degradation
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: The synergistic coupling of solar-driven interfacial evaporation with photocatalysis has emerged as a promising strategy for simultaneously producing clean water and removing pollutants. However, their practical application is hindered by limited interfacial evaporation and photocatalysis efficiencies, as well as the complexity of real-world aqueous environments-particularly the coexistence of high salinity and organic pollutants. Herein, inspired by plant transpiration, a novel biomimetic carbon nanotube (CNT)/chitosan (CS) aerogel with a vertical channel structure was fabricated via directional freeze-drying as an evaporator. By coupling photothermal and photocatalytic functionalities, this system provides exceptional thermal confinement to enhance photothermal efficiency and boost catalytic kinetics while simultaneously acting as rapid capillary highways to accelerate the transport of water and contaminants. Consequently, the evaporator exhibits a remarkable evaporation efficiency of 94.66%, with an evaporation rate of 1.71 kg m-2 h-1 under 1 kW m-2 irradiation. Concurrently, the evaporator exhibits excellent catalytic degradation performance for tetracycline (TC), achieving 87.67% removal within 60 min with a pseudo-first-order rate constant of 0.0440 min-1. Electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) spectroscopy identifies the catalytic system that generates a highly selective, interference-resistant non-radical (singlet oxygen, 1O2) in situ. This study offers an innovative approach to developing integrated evaporation systems that simultaneously generate freshwater and remediate wastewater.
title_zh: 具有垂直排列通道的植物气凝胶，用于协同太阳能驱动界面蒸发和催化降解
abstract_zh: 太阳能驱动的界面蒸发与光催化的协同耦合已成为同时生产清洁水和去除污染物的一种有前景的策略。然而，其实际应用受到有限的界面蒸发和光催化效率以及现实水环境的复杂性——特别是高盐度和有机污染物的共存——的阻碍。受植物蒸腾作用的启发，通过定向冷冻干燥作为蒸发器，制备了一种具有垂直通道结构的新型仿生碳纳米管（CNT）/壳聚糖（CS）气凝胶。通过耦合光热和光催化功能，该系统提供了卓越的热限制，以提高光热效率并促进催化动力学，同时充当快速毛细管高速公路以加速水和污染物的传输。因此，蒸发器表现出高达94.66%的蒸发效率，在1 kW m-2辐照下蒸发速率为1.71 kg m-2 h-1。同时，该蒸发器对四环素（TC）表现出优异的催化降解性能，在60 min内实现了87.67%的去除率，准一级速率常数为0.0440 min-1。电子顺磁共振 (EPR) 光谱可识别原位产生高选择性、抗干扰非自由基（单线态氧，1O2）的催化系统。这项研究提供了一种创新方法来开发同时产生淡水和再生水的集成蒸发系统

title: Controlling Both Anode and Cathode Interfacial Properties of Nanocrystal LEDs by Combining Solution-Processed Semiconducting Polymer Interlayers
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Light-emitting diodes (LEDs) based on colloidal semiconductor nanocrystals represent a promising technology for next-generation electroluminescence displays. While ongoing efforts focus on optimizing nanocrystal properties, device performance also critically depends on the LED architecture, particularly the design of interfacial layers. Efficient charge injection and balanced carrier transport toward recombination layers require careful alignment of energy levels between adjacent layers. In this study, we investigate the cooperative role of different hole-transporting (HT) and electron-injecting (EI) polymers in a multilayered all-solution-processed LED structure incorporating CdSe/CdZnS nanoplatelets as deep-red emitters. Three commercially available HT polymers, differing in hole mobility and energy levels, were combined with custom-designed EI polar polymers featuring varied conjugated backbones and tailored highest occupied molecular orbital/lowest unoccupied molecular orbital (HOMO/LUMO) levels. Particular attention is given to the EI/metal interface, whose properties are tuned via phosphonate-functionalized polymer side chains. Device performance is assessed under inert and ambient conditions (without encapsulation) and correlated to the electronic properties of the interfacial layers. Notably, specific HT/EI polymer pairings substantially influence key parameters of fabricated LEDs, enabling either a reduced turn-on voltage down to 1.7 V or enhanced external quantum efficiency up to 7%, depending on the selected combination.
title_zh: 通过结合溶液加工的半导体聚合物中间层来控制纳米晶体 LED 的阳极和阴极界面特性
abstract_zh: 基于胶体半导体纳米晶体的发光二极管（LED）代表了下一代电致发光显示器的一项有前途的技术。虽然目前的工作重点是优化纳米晶体特性，但器件性能也很大程度上取决于 LED 架构，特别是界面层的设计。向复合层的有效电荷注入和平衡载流子传输需要仔细对准相邻层之间的能级。在这项研究中，我们研究了不同空穴传输 (HT) 和电子注入 (EI) 聚合物在采用 CdSe/CdZnS 纳米片作为深红色发射器的多层全溶液处理 LED 结构中的协同作用。三种市售 HT 聚合物（空穴迁移率和能级不同）与定制设计的 EI 极性聚合物相结合，这些聚合物具有不同的共轭主链和定制的最高占据分子轨道/最低未占据分子轨道 (HOMO/LUMO) 水平。特别关注 EI/金属界面，其性能可通过膦酸酯官能化聚合物侧链进行调节。器件性能在惰性和环境条件下（无封装）进行评估，并与界面层的电子特性相关。值得注意的是，特定的 HT/EI 聚合物配对极大地影响了制造的 LED 的关键参数，可以将开启电压降低至 1.7 V，或将外部量子效率提高至 7%，具体取决于所选的组合。

title: Wet-processed high-areal-capacity electrodes via transformative spandex–poly(acrylic acid) binder toward 450 Wh kg−1 lithium-ion batteries
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Driven by the increasing interest in lithium-ion batteries with high energy density, the design of high-mass-loading electrodes with Ni-rich positive materials has recently been considered one of the most promising strategies to achieve this goal. However, the conventional binder, poly(vinylidene fluoride), cannot ensure structural integrity and uniform charge transfer in high-mass-loading electrodes. Herein, we propose a dual-acting hybrid polymer as an advanced wet-processable binder, comprising a crosslinked network of spandex and polyacrylic acid. Spandex imparts high elasticity and strong affinity with Ni-rich positive electrode, while poly(acrylic acid) forms lithium polyacrylate on the electrode surface to enhance interfacial Li+ transport. The distinct roles of each polymer ensure mechanical robustness, enhance Li+ transport, and suppress binder migration during the drying process, thereby alleviating chronic issues in high-mass-loading electrodes. Notably, proposed hybrid polymer binder enables the fabrication of high-mass-loading electrodes (70 mg cm−2) with stable cyclability, despite a low binder content of 2 wt%. Moreover, pouch cell employing high-loading positive electrode based on the hybrid polymer binder exhibited improved cycling stability over its conventional poly(vinylidene fluoride)-based counterparts, ultimately highlighting its industrial applicability. This study provides practical insights into rational design of binders and highlights their potential to enable wet-processable fabrication of high-mass-loading electrodes.
title_zh: 通过变革性氨纶-聚丙烯酸粘合剂湿法加工高面积容量电极，用于 450 Wh kg−1 锂离子电池
abstract_zh: 由于人们对高能量密度锂离子电池的兴趣日益浓厚，采用富镍正极材料的高质量负载电极设计最近被认为是实现这一目标的最有前途的策略之一。然而，传统的粘合剂聚偏二氟乙烯无法确保高质量负载电极中的结构完整性和均匀的电荷转移。在此，我们提出了一种双作用杂化聚合物作为先进的可湿加工粘合剂，包含氨纶和聚丙烯酸的交联网络。氨纶赋予高弹性和与富镍正极的强亲和力，而聚丙烯酸在电极表面形成聚丙烯酸锂以增强界面Li+传输。每种聚合物的独特作用可确保机械稳定性、增强 Li+ 传输并抑制干燥过程中的粘合剂迁移，从而缓解高质量负载电极中的长期问题。值得注意的是，尽管粘合剂含量低至 2 wt%，但所提出的混合聚合物粘合剂能够制造具有稳定循环性能的高质量负载电极 (70 mg cm−2)。此外，采用基于混合聚合物粘合剂的高负载正极的软包电池比传统的基于聚偏二氟乙烯的同类电池表现出更好的循环稳定性，最终凸显了其工业适用性。这项研究为粘合剂的合理设计提供了实用的见解，并强调了它们在可湿法加工制造高质量负载电极方面的潜力。

title: Finite-temperature criticality through quantum annealing
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Critical phenomena at finite temperature underpin a broad range of physical systems, yet their study remains challenging due to computational bottlenecks near phase transitions. Quantum annealers have attracted significant interest as a potential tool for accessing finite temperature criticality beyond classical reach, but their utility in precisely resolving criticality has remained limited by noise, hardware constraints, and thermal fluctuations. Here we overcome these challenges, introducing a sampling protocol that combines real-time temperature inference with fine control of the energy scales throughout experiments. A careful embedding strategy allows us to fully capture the finite-temperature critical behavior of the paradigmatic two-dimensional Ising ferromagnet on toroidal lattices up to 2640 spins. By tuning the energy scale of the system and mitigating device defects, we sample effective Boltzmann distributions extracting both the critical temperature and the associated universal critical exponents. Our approach opens the study of equilibrium and non-equilibrium critical phenomena in a broad class of systems at finite temperature.
title_zh: 通过量子退火实现有限温度临界
abstract_zh: 有限温度下的临界现象支撑着广泛的物理系统，但由于相变附近的计算瓶颈，他们的研究仍然具有挑战性。量子退火器作为获取超出经典范围的有限温度临界值的潜在工具引起了人们的极大兴趣，但它们在精确解决临界值方面的效用仍然受到噪声、硬件限制和热波动的限制。在这里，我们克服了这些挑战，引入了一种采样协议，该协议将实时温度推断与整个实验中能量尺度的精细控制相结合。仔细的嵌入策略使我们能够完全捕获典型二维伊辛铁磁体在最多 2640 次旋转的环形晶格上的有限温度临界行为。通过调整系统的能量规模和减轻设备缺陷，我们对有效的玻尔兹曼分布进行采样，提取临界温度和相关的通用临界指数。我们的方法开启了对有限温度下一大类系统的平衡和非平衡临界现象的研究。

title: Extracellular Matrix Inspired Molecular Polarization in Hydroxypropyl-β-Cyclodextrin Organic Dielectric Films
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Inspired by the extracellular matrix (ECM), which integrates a fibrous collagen scaffold with a hydrated polysaccharide matrix, we developed a PVDF-based ternary dielectric energy storage film by introducing hydroxypropyl-β-cyclodextrin (HP-β-CD) within a fluorinated methacrylate crosslinked network. The crosslinked network serves as a compact insulating scaffold analogous to collagen fibers, while HP-β-CD mimics the hydrated polysaccharide components. The abundant hydroxyl groups of HP-β-CD form stable hydrogen bonds with PVDF chains, strengthening interfacial adhesion and tuning local chain conformation. Under an external electric field, the polar hydroxyl and hydroxypropyl groups of HP-β-CD contribute to orientational polarization, increasing the dielectric constant to 9.7. In addition, the hydroxyl-rich exterior and cavity-bearing structure of HP-β-CD may provide charge-trapping sites that help suppress charge accumulation and conduction losses, thereby retarding electrical breakdown. The fluorinated crosslinked network enhances breakdown strength by restricting PVDF segmental motion and improving film compactness and structural stability. Consequently, the leakage current density decreases to 5.25 × 10-7 A/cm2, approximately one order of magnitude lower than that of neat PVDF (2.02 × 10-6 A/cm2). Benefiting from this ECM-inspired molecular-regulation approach, the optimized composite achieves a discharged energy density of 9.03 J/cm3 at 560 MV/m, while the residual PVDF-related hysteresis indicates that further efficiency optimization remains necessary for practical high-efficiency capacitor applications.
title_zh: 羟丙基-β-环糊精有机介电薄膜中细胞外基质激发的分子极化
abstract_zh: 受细胞外基质（ECM）的启发，细胞外基质（ECM）将纤维胶原支架与水合多糖基质整合在一起，我们通过在氟化甲基丙烯酸酯交联网络中引入羟丙基-β-环糊精（HP-β-CD）开发了一种基于PVDF的三元介电储能薄膜。交联网络充当类似于胶原纤维的紧凑绝缘支架，而 HP-β-CD 则模仿水合多糖成分。 HP-β-CD 丰富的羟基与 PVDF 链形成稳定的氢键，增强界面粘附力并调节局部链构象。在外部电场作用下，HP-β-CD 的极性羟基和羟丙基有助于取向极化，将介电常数提高至 9.7。此外，HP-β-CD 富含羟基的外部和空腔结构可以提供电荷捕获位点，有助于抑制电荷积累和传导损失，从而延缓电击穿。氟化交联网络通过限制 PVDF 链段运动并提高薄膜致密性和结构稳定性来增强击穿强度。因此，漏电流密度降至 5.25 × 10-7 A/cm2，比纯 PVDF (2.02 × 10-6 A/cm2) 低大约一个数量级。受益于这种受 ECM 启发的分子调节方法，优化后的复合材料在 560 MV/m 下实现了 9.03 J/cm3 的放电能量密度，而残余 PVDF 相关的滞后表明，进一步的效率优化对于实际的高功率仍然是必要的。

title: Crush-resistant air sacs allow insect larvae to exploit aquatic habitats at extreme depth
source: AAAS: Science: Table of Contents
abstract:
The absence of aquatic insects from pelagic marine habitats has been attributed to their air-filled tracheal respiratory system, which could implode at depth while undertaking diel vertical migrations to escape predatory fish. However, we found that the aquatic larvae of the lake fly
                    Chaoborus edulis
                    in Lake Malawi have modified their tracheal system into reinforced buoyancy-regulating air-filled sacs, allowing them to escape predatory fish by undertaking these migrations well over 200 meters deep into the lake’s anoxic hypolimnion during the day. The crush depth of their air sacs increases with each instar, with final instars resisting implosion at depths greater than half a kilometer. Contrary to expectations, these insects adapt to the extreme hydrostatic pressures of deep-water habitats, allowing them to coexist with pelagic fish.
title_zh: 抗压气囊使昆虫幼虫能够利用极深的水生栖息地

                    美味豆豉
                    马拉维湖的鱼类将其气管系统改造为增强型浮力调节充气囊，使它们能够在白天迁徙到湖中缺氧的低层水深 200 米深处，以逃避掠食性鱼类的追捕。它们气囊的挤压深度随着每个龄期的增加而增加，最后的龄期可以在超过半公里的深度抵抗内爆。与预期相反，这些昆虫适应了深水栖息地的极端静水压力，使它们能够与中上层鱼类共存。

title: Invasive species’ environmental impacts are more severe in the Global South
source: AAAS: Science: Table of Contents
abstract: Invasive alien species (IAS) are a major threat to biodiversity, yet their impact distribution remains poorly understood. Global biodiversity assessments suggest the highest impacts in wealthy countries of the Global North, but this is only inferred from IAS numbers, reflecting research bias. Using a new global database of standardized impact measures, we calculated average impact severity per country and found that it is higher in the Global South despite more than twice as many reports in the Global North. Weak governance and limited management capacity are the main drivers of high impact severity. Emerging economies with rapid economic growth but poor governance are particularly vulnerable. Failure to recognize the Global South as facing the highest IAS impacts diverts attention away from the most threatened regions.
title_zh: 入侵物种对南半球的环境影响更为严重
abstract_zh: 外来入侵物种 (IAS) 是生物多样性的主要威胁，但对其影响分布仍知之甚少。全球生物多样性评估表明，北半球富裕国家的影响最大，但这只是根据 IAS 数据推断的，反映了研究偏差。我们使用标准化影响衡量指标的新全球数据库计算了每个国家的平均影响严重程度，发现尽管全球北方的报告数量是南方国家的两倍多，但全球南方的影响严重程度更高。治理薄弱和管理能力有限是造成严重影响的主要原因。经济快速增长但治理不善的新兴经济体尤其容易受到影响。如果不认识到南半球面临着最严重的外来入侵影响，就会转移人们对受威胁最严重地区的注意力。

title: Spatially resolving the cone of reaction for a single molecule
source: AAAS: Science: Table of Contents
abstract: Collisions of atoms and molecules are required for bond formation and are thus key to any chemical reaction. Their outcome is determined by the collision energy, relative orientation, and impact parameter of the reactants. Collision studies in the gas phase have shown that energies are easily controlled, whereas it is difficult to steer the molecular orientations and completely impossible to control the impact parameter. Here, we study the collision of individual molecules at a surface where each involved compound is imaged before and after collision by scanning tunneling microscopy, allowing precise control of orientations and impact parameter. We observe that the molecules must collide in a narrow cone of reaction and that surface atom displacements can enable a reaction even for disfavored pathways.
title_zh: 空间解析单个分子的反应锥
abstract_zh: 原子和分子的碰撞是键形成所必需的，因此是任何化学反应的关键。它们的结果由反应物的碰撞能量、相对方向和冲击参数决定。气相碰撞研究表明，能量很容易控制，但很难控制分子方向，并且完全不可能控制碰撞参数。在这里，我们研究了表面上单个分子的碰撞，通过扫描隧道显微镜对碰撞前后的每个涉及的化合物进行成像，从而可以精确控制方向和冲击参数。我们观察到分子必须在狭窄的反应锥体中碰撞，并且表面原子位移甚至可以在不利的路径下发生反应。

title: University science in the US needs a coherent plan
source: AAAS: Science: Table of Contents
abstract: The Trump administration continues to degrade America’s scientific establishment, causing widespread harm to the country’s broader interests and well-being. Last week, the Association of American Universities reported that graduate student enrollment in major research universities, which award half of all doctorate degrees in the United States, is down 15% compared to a year ago. And no wonder, considering the effect of recent immigration policies that deter international students and the financial uncertainties that universities are facing given the unpredictable nature of federal funding. The ability to support new doctoral students depends heavily on research grants, and any responsible administrator would be cautious about making commitments to students they can’t keep. This is discouraging to the scientific community but should be alarming to everyone.
title_zh: 美国的大学科学需要一个连贯的计划
abstract_zh: 特朗普政府继续削弱美国的科学机构，对国家更广泛的利益和福祉造成广泛损害。上周，美国大学协会报告称，主要研究型大学的研究生入学率比一年前下降了 15%，这些大学授予美国一半的博士学位。考虑到最近阻碍国际学生的移民政策的影响，以及考虑到联邦资金的不可预测性，大学所面临的财务不确定性，也就不足为奇了。支持新博士生的能力在很大程度上取决于研究资助，任何负责任的管理者都会对向他们无法兑现的学生做出承诺持谨慎态度。这令科学界感到沮丧，但也应该引起所有人的警惕。

title: The rise and fall of language diversity through the Holocene
source: AAAS: Science: Table of Contents
abstract: Characterizing the factors that have shaped linguistic diversity is fundamental for understanding human history, culture, and cognition. In this study, we combined statistical and social computational modeling, ethnographic data, and paleodemographic inference to model trajectories of global linguistic diversity. Before the onset of plant and animal domestication, the number of languages was smaller than it is today (4500 to 6000 compared with 7500). Subsequent increases in global population precipitated increased linguistic diversity. We uncovered a linguistic “golden age” with tens of thousands of languages 3000 to 1000 years ago. Great loss of linguistic diversity did not begin with recent colonial expansion but as multinational empires first spread along with their languages, pathogens, and cultures. Thus, extinction has likely played a much greater role in shaping linguistic and cultural diversity than previously thought.
title_zh: 全新世语言多样性的兴衰
abstract_zh: 描述塑造语言多样性的因素对于理解人类历史、文化和认知至关重要。在这项研究中，我们结合了统计和社会计算模型、人种学数据和古人口学推断来模拟全球语言多样性的轨迹。在动植物驯化出现之前，语言的数量比现在少（从 7500 种到 4500 到 6000 种）。随后全球人口的增加促进了语言多样性的增加。我们发现了3000至1000年前的一个拥有数万种语言的语言“黄金时代”。语言多样性的巨大丧失并不是从最近的殖民扩张开始的，而是随着多民族帝国首先连同其语言、病原体和文化一起传播而开始的。因此，灭绝在塑造语言和文化多样性方面发挥的作用可能比之前想象的要大得多。

title: Late-stage functionalization with strain-release warheads enables tunable covalent inhibition
source: AAAS: Science: Table of Contents
abstract: Covalent inhibition continues to gain momentum as a strategy for selective protein modulation in both therapeutic and chemical biology contexts. Covalent reactive groups (CRGs) typically engage nucleophilic residues such as cysteine, resulting in targeted protein inactivation. However, common electrophiles such as acrylamides often suffer from nonselective reactivity, leading to off-target effects and toxicity. To overcome these limitations, we developed a modular sulfur(IV) reagent platform for the mild, late-stage installation of sulfonyl- and sulfonimidoyl-bicyclobutane motifs with complete cysteine selectivity. This methodology enables access to diverse sulfur(VI) CRGs with tunable strain-release reactivity. Incorporation into US Food and Drug Administration–approved covalent inhibitors demonstrated effective bioisosteric replacement of acrylamides and the potential of strain-release CRGs for selective protein targeting. Preclinical studies in mice have validated this approach, highlighting its promise for next-generation covalent drug design.
title_zh: 应变释放弹头的后期功能化可实现可调节的共价抑制
abstract_zh: 共价抑制作为治疗和化学生物学背景下选择性蛋白质调节的策略继续获得动力。共价反应基团 (CRG) 通常与半胱氨酸等亲核残基结合，导致目标蛋白质失活。然而，常见的亲电子试剂（例如丙烯酰胺）通常会发生非选择性反应，导致脱靶效应和毒性。为了克服这些限制，我们开发了一种模块化硫 (IV) 试剂平台，用于磺酰基和磺酰亚氨基双环丁烷基序的温和后期安装，具有完全的半胱氨酸选择性。该方法能够获得具有可调应变释放反应性的多种硫 (VI) CRG。纳入美国食品和药物管理局批准的共价抑制剂，证明了丙烯酰胺的有效生物等排替代以及菌株释放 CRG 用于选择性蛋白质靶向的潜力。小鼠临床前研究验证了这种方法，凸显了其对下一代共价药物设计的前景。

title: The global biogeography of passerine songs
source: AAAS: Science: Table of Contents
abstract: Although bird songs are classic models for understanding the evolution of vocal communication, their global diversity has long made the development of a unifying framework challenging. By analyzing the acoustic architecture of songs from more than 3000 passerine species worldwide, we show that this acoustic space can be structured around eight elemental motifs. The differential use of these motifs is driven by a combination of species’ biological traits (social organization, morphology, and mating system) and the physics of sound propagation. In tropical rainforests, environmental filtering for transmission efficiency favors structurally simple motifs, such as flat whistles. Conversely, in temperate regions, where high population densities facilitate close-range communication and short breeding seasons intensify sexual selection, the balance shifts toward complex, information-rich motifs, such as ultrafast trills, despite their susceptibility to acoustic degradation. Ultimately, the global geography of birdsong reflects a spatially varying equilibrium between physical environmental constraints and the biological drive for complex communication.
title_zh: 雀形目鸟类鸣叫的全球生物地理学
abstract_zh: 尽管鸟鸣声是理解声音交流进化的经典模型，但它们的全球多样性长期以来使得统一框架的开发充满挑战。通过分析全球 3000 多种雀形目鸟类歌曲的声学结构，我们表明该声学空间可以围绕八个基本主题构建。这些主题的不同使用是由物种的生物特征（社会组织、形态和交配系统）和声音传播物理学的结合驱动的。在热带雨林中，传输效率的环境过滤有利于结构简单的图案，例如平口哨。相反，在温带地区，人口密度高有利于近距离交流，而繁殖季节短则加强了性选择，平衡转向复杂、信息丰富的主题，例如超快颤音，尽管它们容易受到声学退化的影响。最终，鸟鸣的全球地理反映了物理环境限制和复杂交流的生物驱动力之间的空间变化平衡。
